jobs.description:
As a Neurology Nurse Practitioner (NP), you’ll provide comprehensive neurological care in an onsite military healthcare environment. Working across outpatient and inpatient settings, you’ll practice independently within your clinical privileges and collaborate with physicians and other healthcare professionals to evaluate, diagnose, and manage acute and chronic neurological conditions.

Your work will include developing treatment plans, prescribing medications, performing or assisting with neurological procedures, responding to consultations, communicating test results, and educating patients and families. You’ll also contribute to clinical education, peer review, and quality-improvement activities.

Employment Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, typically 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m., with a one-hour unpaid meal break. Shift times may vary within operating hours of 6:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. No weekend or federal holiday coverage. Employees will work no more than 40 hours per week.

Key Responsibilities

• Evaluate new and established patients and diagnose and manage acute and chronic neurological conditions.
• Develop treatment plans and prescribe medications and immunizations within approved protocols and clinical privileges.
• Provide scheduled outpatient care and inpatient, urgent, same-day, and telephone consultations as needed.
• Perform or assist with medically indicated neurological diagnostic and therapeutic procedures.
• Communicate laboratory and radiology results and educate patients and families about treatment, prevention, and self-management.
• Collaborate with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to coordinate care.
• Maintain timely and accurate medical records and clinical coding.
• Participate in peer review and quality-improvement activities, support clinical education as assigned, and promote patient safety and infection-control practices.

Requirements

• Master’s degree in nursing and graduation from an applicable nursing specialty program accredited by ACEN or CCNE.
• Current Nurse Practitioner certification in the applicable specialty through ANCC, AANP, or another recognized national nursing certification organization appropriate to the specialty.
• Full, current, and unrestricted professional license from any U.S. state, territory, commonwealth, or the District of Columbia.
• At least 24 months of experience practicing as a Nurse Practitioner within the preceding 36 months in an outpatient and/or inpatient clinical setting.
• Neurology experience required.
• Current Basic Life Support (BLS) and Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certifications.
• Ability to practice independently within the authorized scope of practice and clinical privileges.
• Basic knowledge of managing daily clinic operations serving a high volume of patients with varied healthcare needs.

jobs.title: Workplace & Experience Coordinator
jobs.description:
Reducto is the agentic document platform for leading AI teams who demand enterprise performance at scale. We provide a comprehensive toolkit for working with documents the way a human would, combining custom in-house and leading frontier models to power efficient and accurate document workflows.

We’ve grown rapidly, increasing revenue 8x year over year and partnering with hundreds of companies, from leading AI teams like Harvey, Vanta, and Scale, to enterprise customers across FAANG and top trading firms.

Reducto has raised over $100M from world-class investors including a16z, Benchmark, and First Round Capital.



The Opportunity
As Workplace & Experience Coordinator, you will be the person who makes Reducto's San Francisco office feel like the best part of someone's day. You'll work closely with the Office of the CEO and People team, but the office itself is yours: how it looks, how it runs, and how it feels to walk into.

This is a hands-on, in-person role. You're the first face people see when they walk in, the person who notices the snack drawer is running low before anyone else does, and the reason an investor visit or team offsite comes together without a hitch. We're a fast-growing AI company, which means priorities shift quickly and the office needs to keep up. You'll thrive here if you love creating order out of chaos and take real pride in making people feel taken care of.



This is an in-person role based in out San Francisco HQ.



What You’ll Do:

 - Own the day-to-day feel and function of the SF office, from daily walkthroughs to restocking supplies to making sure the space is clean, safe, and welcoming every single day.

 - Manage relationships with vendors and building partners, including food & beverage, cleaning, maintenance, and security, holding them to the standard our team deserves.

 - Plan and execute in-office events and culture moments, team lunches, celebrations, offsites, and the spontaneous stuff that makes people want to come in.

 - Coordinate catering and food programs, including ordering, setup, takedown, and invoice review.

 - Act as the on-the-ground host for guests, candidates, and visitors, including investors and customers, making sure every visit reflects well on Reducto.

 - Support space planning, furniture moves, and office improvement projects as the team grows.

 - Help manage the workplace budget: track expenses, review invoices, and flag cost-saving opportunities in partnership with Finance.

 - Support health, safety, and emergency preparedness for the office, including drills and readiness materials.

 - Partner across People, IT, Security, and the Office of the CEO to keep employees informed of workplace updates and to support company-wide events and initiatives.

 - Gather feedback from the team and use it to keep improving the office experience.



You’ll Thrive Here If You:

 - Are the type of person who loves creating order out of chaos.

 - Have genuine hospitality instincts. You notice what needs fixing before you're asked, and you take pride in the details other people miss.

 - Have 2+ years of experience in an administrative or hospitality setting, ideally somewhere fast-paced.

 - Are warm, outgoing, and easy to be around. If an investor or candidate is waiting in the lobby, you're the person who makes them feel instantly welcome.

 - Are highly organized and can juggle competing priorities without dropping anything.

 - Communicate clearly and professionally with everyone from vendors to executives to new hires.

 - Are comfortable working independently and making judgment calls in a startup environment where the plan can change by lunchtime.

 - See this work as a craft. You want to build something people notice and appreciate, not just check boxes.



Bonus points if you:

 - Have experience planning events or managing office operations at a high-growth startup.

 - Are fluent in Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, and expense platforms like Ramp.

 - Have experience supporting executives or high-visibility guests.

 - Hold a CPR/AED certification.



Why Reducto

 - Impact: Your work directly shapes how the world’s best AI companies access and use enterprise data.

 - Speed: We move fast, ship often, and iterate in days, not months.

 - Learning: Work alongside world-class engineers, operators, and founders who care deeply about product, precision, and velocity.
   

Benefits

 - Unlimited PTO, because great work requires recharging.

 - Daily Lunch, enjoy free lunch with teammates in the office.

 - Commuter Reimbursement, we’ll cover your transportation costs.

 - Comprehensive Insurance, medical, dental, and vision.

 - Health and Wellness Budget, up to $150 per month for wellness spending such as gym memberships or fitness classes.

 - Parental Leave, flexible scheduling that works for you and your family.


This is an in-person role based in our San Francisco office. We’re an early-stage company, we move fast and work hard. Please apply only if that excites you.



Equal Opportunity
Reducto is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other protected category.

jobs.description:

Must be able to work Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday 7:30am - 5pm and Wednesday 7:30am - 2pm.

The Phlebotomist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Phlebotomist provides expert phlebotomy services and must demonstrate excellent customer service and communication skills. The phlebotomist must have the ability to function as part of a highly effective team that consistently puts “Patients First”.

The Phlebotomist is responsible for venipuncture collection and specimen processing. Other responsibilities include but are not limited to order entry in multiple systems, verification of test result receipt, patient information retrieval and lab reception/clerical duties and functions

Responsibilities:

· Performs phlebotomy and other lab specimen collections per age related standards and in accordance with departmental policies, protocols and procedures.

· Demonstrates AIDET model and optimizes patient safety to reduce the likelihood of medical/health care errors.

· Receives and reviews physician orders; ensures that all necessary information is included for appropriate lab services. Enters accurate orders for lab tests in accordance with department policies, protocols and procedures.

· Patient communication model and provides appropriate post-phlebotomy patient care.

· Processes specimens in a timely manner to ensure stability and integrity of samples including labeling, centrifuging, aliquoting, freezing and packaging specimens for transport in accordance with established protocols and policies.

· Reviews/Records refrigerator temperature(s) and QC/QA records. Areas of concern are recorded through the Corrective Action Log and reported to maintenance for repair. Findings are reported to supervisor or manager.

· Understands the operation and maintenance of equipment pertinent to the job. Follows up with all outstanding orders on manifest log, and communicates all timed, completed or uncompleted draws/charges/results as appropriate

· Communicates and notifies Laboratory and/or Physician of problems with specimen procurement for optimal care

· Maintains a safe work environment, holds self-accountable for safe work practices; including adhering to biohazard waste procedures and ensuring proper storage and timely pickup of biohazardous waste.

· Performs lab-related clerical duties include but not limited to order entry, verification of test result receipt, patient information retrieval as well as utilization of email, medical record systems, handheld and desktop devices, ordering and maintaining supply inventory, filing and sanitizing equipment as necessary

· Uses department’s resources efficiently; participates in efforts to reduce costs and streamline work processes.

· Adheres to continuing education expectations; completes and signs-off on competency assessments

· Demonstrates the value of teamwork on a consistent basis; interacts with and assists others in a professional manner

· Applies critical thinking, sound decision making and judgment to investigate and resolve challenging situations

· Complies with all organizational policies regarding ethical business practices.

· Performs other duties as assigned

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• High School diploma or equivalent.

Certification:

• ·Phlebotomy certification through a nationally recognized organization or training from a phlebotomy school or medical institution or one or more years of phlebotomy experience in a healthcare setting or CMA certification.

Preferred:

· Experience performing phlebotomy on a broad range of patient’s types.

· Experience with processing lab specimens, transferring specimens, and handling a centrifuge.

· Familiar with medical EMR systems.

· Knowledge of medical terminology.

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel

Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.



If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.



*Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco, San Jose, Bellevue or upcoming NYC office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

As demand for compute and AI capabilities accelerates globally, Lambda is rapidly expanding its cloud platform, data center footprint, and strategic partnerships with enterprises, hyperscalers, and leading AI companies. Lambda’s legal team plays a critical role in enabling this growth by structuring and negotiating the agreements that power Lambda’s most important customer relationships, infrastructure partnerships, and global expansion efforts.

As Commercial Counsel, you’ll join a lean, high-impact legal team where your work will immediately shape how Lambda scales. You’ll own a high volume of customer and vendor agreements end to end, partnering directly with Sales, Finance, and Supply Chain, and working alongside the Deputy GC, Commercial on our largest and most complex transactions. From cloud services agreements to data center and procurement contracts, you will be directly involved in the deals that enable Lambda to scale its AI cloud platform and support the next generation of AI innovation. This is a role for someone ready to step into real ownership early, build process where little exists today, and grow their scope alongside a function that is scaling quickly.

What You’ll Do

 - Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements including customer contracts, data center service provider agreements, partner and reseller agreements, distributor arrangements, and marketing partnerships.

 - Independently run day-to-day customer and procurement negotiations from first draft to signature, and partner with the Deputy GC, Commercial on enterprise and strategic deals.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Finance teams to enable deals while ensuring appropriate legal risk management.

 - Advise on contract structure and associated risks, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and legal requirements.

 - Use legal technology and automation tools to streamline contracting processes, compliance tracking, and knowledge management.

 - Contribute to the team’s operations, templates, and playbooks — including building new ones where none exist yet.

 - Operate with a high degree of autonomy and provide practical, responsive guidance to our business teams that balances business objectives with legal risk, including on subject matter that is new to you.

You

 - J.D. degree from an accredited law school and membership in at least one U.S. state bar.

 - 5-8 years of legal experience, ideally including in-house time at a technology, cloud infrastructure, or SaaS company; a mix of law firm and in-house experience is welcome.

 - Hands-on experience drafting and negotiating commercial transactions on both the buy-side and sell-side, with the ability to own routine and moderately complex agreements without day-to-day supervision.

 - Growth mindset, enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and managing multiple concurrent projects and tasks to completion within the required time frame.

 - Interest in growing your impact and responsibilities over time.

 - Comfort operating with limited structure — energized rather than slowed by ambiguity, and willing to build processes.

 - Strong client-service orientation and a track record of being a responsive, trusted partner to business teams under tight turnarounds.

 - Team mentality with the flexibility to address unique issues in real-time and the awareness to know when to bring in others.

Nice to Have

 - Experience in infrastructure-as-a-service industry

 - Familiarity with privacy, data security, and/or compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001) is strongly preferred.

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

jobs.description:
Mavericks Wanted

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on

In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.

Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.

What You'll Do

The Sr. Manager / Associate Director, QA Operations supports finished product batch disposition and market release for the commercial portfolio of BridgeBio and its affiliates, Eidos Therapeutics, Calcilytix Therapeutics, and ML Bio Solutions, across the US, EU, and rest of world (ROW) markets. The role also provides quality oversight of the contract service providers (CSPs) responsible for commercial packaging.

The role operates in a virtual, outsourced manufacturing model and works closely with CMC, Regulatory Affairs, and Supply Chain to ensure product is packaged and released in accordance with requirements. It also partners directly with external Qualified Persons (QPs), who perform EU batch certification.

Responsibilities

Batch Disposition and Market Release

• Own the market release process end to end, including finished product batch disposition and review of batch records, CSP documentation, and release testing results before disposition.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for EU QPs, preparing batch documentation to support QP certification.

• Maintain market specific release requirements and release status across US, EU, and ROW markets, in coordination with Regulatory Affairs and Supply Chain.

• Support ex US market launches, including establishing market release processes and QP release workflows.

CSP and Partner Oversight

• Provide quality oversight of packaging CSPs through remote collaboration, KPI monitoring, and adherence to quality agreements.

• Interface with CSPs, third party logistics providers (3PLs), and other partners to align on quality expectations and drive continuous improvement.

• Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections related to CSP oversight and finished product disposition.

Quality Systems and Compliance

• Author and review deviations, CAPA, change controls, risk assessments, and product investigations related to QA Operations and systems.

• Support tech transfer, validation, and shipping qualification protocols and reports.

• Support CMC activities, including review of regulatory submissions and post approval changes.

• Author, review, and update QA Operations SOPs and other quality documents.

• Contribute to the Annual Product Quality Review (APQR).

• Identify, assess, and escalate quality or compliance issues to management.

Where You'll Work

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration 2-3x per week in our San Francisco Office.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in a science discipline with 10+ years of experience in a biopharmaceutical company.

• Strong knowledge of US (21 CFR Parts 210, 211, and 11) and EU (Directive 2001/83/EC, EudraLex Volume 4 including Annex 16) regulations, plus ROW market release requirements. Hands on market release experience, including direct interaction with QPs.

• Experience overseeing CSPs within a virtual or outsourced manufacturing and packaging network, coordinating across multiple external partners.

• Excellent communication skills across functions, with the ability to work directly with external QPs and CSPs and with internal Regulatory and Supply Chain teams.

• Experience supporting a new market launch, including establishing market release processes and QP release workflows.

• Experience with serialization and track and trace: the US Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) and the EU Falsified Medicines Directive (2011/62/EU and Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/161).

• Experience with quality systems such as Veeva Vault.

• Experience with label and artwork management systems (such as GLAMS).

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Wallet Authentication
jobs.description:
Company Overview

IDMe is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with IDMe once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 175 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with IDMe at 22 federal agencies, 50 state government agencies, and more than 100 healthcare organizations. Over 600 consumer brands use IDMe to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. IDMe’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. IDMe is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.

IDMe is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At IDMe, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

Role overview

ID.me's Wallet Authentication team decides whether more than 140 million Members get into their Wallets. The team owns sign-in, registration, multi-factor authentication, account recovery, password reset and MyWallet for federal agencies, state governments, healthcare organizations and consumer brands, along with the real-time risk engine that defends those flows against credential attacks and account takeover.

This Staff Engineer owns the team's keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) work: production health across the team's applications, incidents, releases, partner escalations, security remediation, and the changes other teams ship through the team's code. You take that work first so the rest of the team can build, and you lead the engineering that makes it smaller every quarter: safer releases, stronger tests, canary deployments, clear alerts and runbooks. You work across Ruby on Rails applications and Java services, and you are the team's connector to the platform, security and partner-facing teams it depends on.

The team runs Ruby on Rails applications and Java and Spring Boot services on Kubernetes in Google Cloud, with Sidekiq background jobs, deploys through Argo CD, and watches production through Grafana, Sentry and Honeycomb.

The problem you solve

Production work on a sign-in platform arrives every week, across several applications and the teams that change them. You make it owned, measured and smaller each quarter, so that incidents end in written reviews with closed follow-ups, releases get faster and safer, and security findings are fixed inside their deadlines.

Key responsibilities

• Own production health for sign-in. Lead incident response across the team's Rails applications and Java APIs, coordinate with other teams during an incident, ship the fix, and lead the post-incident review and its follow-ups.

• Own the release process. Run releases across the team's applications, watch dashboards and error feeds after each deploy, roll back when the numbers move, and move the team to canary deployments on Kubernetes.

• Resolve partner escalations. Reproduce problems that agencies, health systems and brands report, find the root cause in authentication flows such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, passkeys and multi-factor authentication, and fix them.

• Lead security remediation. Fix dependency and container vulnerabilities from continuous monitoring and scanners, and upgrade Rails, Ruby and Java frameworks without changing behavior, inside compliance deadlines.

• Set the rules for other teams' changes. Agree with the teams that ship through the team's repositories how their changes are reviewed, released and monitored, and hold to it.

• Measure KTLO and make it smaller. Track pages, incident hours and walk-up requests every week, and build, with the engineering manager, the roadmap that removes recurring work.

• Raise the team's bar. Write runbooks, train the engineers who back you up each month, mentor through code review and pairing, and interview candidates.

• Contribute to the roadmap. When KTLO allows, build features such as merging duplicate Wallets, risk-based step-up authentication, phone-number sign-in and account recovery.

Required qualifications

• 8 or more years of professional software engineering, with deep experience operating high-availability web services in production, including leading incident response and post-mortems.

• Production experience with Ruby on Rails and with Java or another JVM backend, with expert depth in one and working fluency in the other.

• Proven ability to lead cross-team technical work from definition through delivery with minimal oversight.

• Proven ability to debug production systems across services using logs, metrics and traces.

• Strong command of relational databases and SQL, including schema changes and query performance in production.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployment on Kubernetes, including work that made releases safer, such as canary or progressive delivery and automated rollback.

• Experience remediating security vulnerabilities and upgrading frameworks and dependencies in live systems.

• Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, shown by at least one year of daily use, and a commitment to an AI-first engineering culture.

• Clear written communication, including incident updates for technical and non-technical readers, and a track record of mentoring engineers.

Preferred qualifications

The qualifications below are ideal, but not all are required. We encourage candidates to apply if they satisfy some, but not all, of these qualifications.

• Experience with authentication and identity standards: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, FIDO2 and WebAuthn, passkeys, and multi-factor authentication.

• Experience designing or running an on-call program, alerting and incident process for a product team.

• Experience with real-time risk, fraud detection or abuse mitigation, such as credential stuffing and account takeover defense.

• Experience in regulated or high-assurance domains such as government, healthcare or financial services, including NIST 800-63 or FedRAMP continuous monitoring.

• Experience with background job and event systems such as Sidekiq, Pub/Sub or Kafka.

• Front-end experience with React or another modern framework, enough to fix a sign-in screen end to end.

Education and experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Physical requirements

None.

The annual base salary listed does not include a company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity and benefits which will be determined based on experience, skills, education, relevant training, geographic location and role.

IDMe offers comprehensive medical, dental, vision, health savings account, flexible spending accounts (medical, limited purpose, dependent care, commuter benefit accounts), basic and voluntary life and AD&D insurance, 401(k) with company match, parental leave, ability to participate in unlimited paid time off subject to the terms and conditions of the PTO policy, including 8 company wide holidays, short and long-term disability insurance, accident and critical illness insurance, referral bonus policy, employee assistance program, pet insurance, travel assistant program, wellbeing and childcare discounts, benefit advocates, and a learning and development benefit.

Final offers may vary from the amount listed based on qualifications, professional experiences, skills, education, relevant training, geographic location, and other job related factors.

Mountain View, CA and New York, NY Pay Range

$194,000—$253,000 USD

IDMe maintains a work environment free from discrimination, where employees are treated with dignity and respect. All IDMe employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling our commitment to equal employment opportunity. IDMe does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. IDMe adheres to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, IDMe's policy is to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances where a particular employee works. Upon request we will provide you with more information about such accommodations.

Please review our Privacy Policy, including our CCPA policy, at id.me/privacy. If you provide IDMe with any personally identifiable information you confirm that you have read and agree to be bound by the terms and conditions set out in our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Senior Product Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.



Summary:

Delinea’s Cybersecurity organization is seeking an experienced Senior Product Security Engineer to provide technical leadership and execution for an industry-leading Product Security Program. This critical role is expected to be a key player in the rollout, implementation, and maturity of Product Security initiatives.

The ideal candidate will be highly collaborative, working alongside Enterprise Architecture, Development, and DevOps teams to lead and implement Product Security initiatives such as SAST, DAST, SCA, API Security, Vulnerability Management, etc. The candidate must be able to balance the right level of security with business objectives, comfortable with driving technical ideas and communicating clearly with technical as well as non-technical audiences, and work to creatively solve complex Product Security related problems.

This position will report to the Manager, Product Security Engineering and remote.

What You'll Do:

· Provide strong leadership and be a security thought leader across Delinea’s product offerings

· Gain an understanding of current product security program state and partner with the team to define future state and multi-year roadmaps

· Promote strategic direction and influence security architecture adoption in product strategy and roadmap

· Use knowledge of current product security best practices and industry trends to advise on the secure design of Delinea products and services

· Perform end-to-end security architecture reviews

· Perform Threat Modelling, assess and document product risks and/or application designs.

· Participate in expanding/maturing Delinea’s S-SDLC program

· Maintain and mature Product Security tooling (e.g. SAST, SCA, DAST, ASPM)

· Conduct security and code reviews

· Provide guidance on vulnerability management best practices and assist in remediation activities

· Stay up to date on the threat landscape, current technologies, security compliance requirements, standards, and industry trends in order to help achieve cybersecurity’s goals.

· Provide mentorship and guidance to other team members

 

What You'll Bring:

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, similar related field, or equivalent experience.

· Eight (8) years of professional work experience in Cybersecurity with a minimum of five years in a Product Security role that includes Security Architecture, Threat Modeling, Secure Design, AppSec tooling, Vulnerability Remediation, or similar activities.

· Well versed in current Product Security threat landscape and industry best practices.

· Experience performing Threat Modeling and Product Security design reviews and incorporating them as part of SSDLC processes.

· Experience in the following technologies:

o Cloud Security

o Cryptography

o Secure Design reviews and Threat Modeling

o SaaS multi-tenant product architecture

o REST APIs

o Containers (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar)

o Integration of Security testing tools into development pipelines

o Defect tracking (Jira, Bugzilla, ServiceNow, or similar)

o Source code management (ADO, GitLab, GitHub, or similar)

o Application security testing tools (SAST, DAST, IAST, SCA, or similar)

· Familiar with common programming languages (Python, C#.NET, etc.) and able to develop scripts for automation purposes

· Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization

· Strong analytical skills with the ability to prioritize, manage competing demands, and meet deadlines

· Strong communications skills both verbal & written with the ability to describe technical security issues in plain language

 

We'd Love to See:

· Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, risk management principles, and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, GDPR)

· Solid understanding of cloud security technologies including container security, serverless security, network and application security, and access management.

· Software engineering and/or development experience

· Cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CISSP, CSSLP, CISM, or similar)

· Proficiency with Azure and AWS



For this Job, Delinea is not considering candidates that need any type of US work authorization now or in the future. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J1, etc.

Why work at Delinea? 

 - We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
About the role

Chime is looking for a Staff Data Scientist to establish the analytical direction for Product Marketing (PMM). As PMM’s dedicated analytics partner, you will help leaders forecast card demand, understand how members discover and activate Chime products, and connect member research with behavioral evidence to guide strategy and investment.

Your work will span three priorities. You will evolve card demand planning into a rigorous, repeatable forecasting process. You will build on existing research and analytical prototypes to establish reliable measurement of product activation and the member lifecycle, from account opening and first direct deposit through adoption, engagement, and retention. You will also partner with Research to translate qualitative findings into testable hypotheses and assess how broadly those findings apply across the member population.

As a Staff individual contributor, you will define ambiguous problems, set analytical standards, and deliver practical solutions. You will establish a prioritized roadmap with PMM leadership and partner with Product, Growth Analytics, Research, Card Operations, Finance, Data Engineering, and Enterprise Data & Metrics to turn analytical work into trusted data products and business decisions.

In this role, you can expect to

Build reliable card demand forecasting

• Own the methodology for card demand forecasting, translating business planning needs into appropriate forecast horizons, granularity, refresh schedules, and performance measures.

• Develop and evaluate time-series and driver-based models incorporating member growth, product launches, marketing activity, seasonality, replacement demand, and other relevant inputs.

• Establish historical backtesting, benchmark comparisons, forecast bias and error monitoring, and uncertainty estimates. Investigate misses and continuously improve performance.

• Partner with PMM, Card Operations, and Finance to translate forecasts into planning scenarios and assess implications for inventory, supplier lead times, cost, and service risk.

• Build reproducible forecasting workflows with documented assumptions, stakeholder inputs, monitoring, and clear ownership.

Establish product activation and member lifecycle measurement

• Define measurement frameworks for product discovery, activation, adoption, and sustained engagement across the member lifecycle, accounting for cohort, tenure, eligibility, and member segment.

• Build on existing activation research and analytical prototypes to establish production-ready measurement, including cohort analyses anchored to milestones such as first qualifying direct deposit.

• Evaluate proposed operating metrics, including Activated Member Rate, assessing product selection, thresholds, observation windows, sensitivity, and relationships with downstream engagement and retention.

• Balance timely operational signals with cohort maturity and analytical validity. Distinguish predictive relationships from causal evidence and identify where further validation is needed.

• Identify friction and drop-off across onboarding and cross-product journeys, size opportunities, and recommend actions to improve activation and sustained use.

• Partner with Enterprise Data & Metrics and source-data owners to develop tested dbt models, historical backfills, governed metric definitions, and reliable Hex reporting.

• Establish metric governance, versioning, and historical comparability as products, eligibility rules, and definitions evolve.

• Create recurring monitoring and business-review mechanisms that help PMM understand performance and distinguish changes in member behavior from the incremental impact of its initiatives.

Connect member research with quantitative evidence

• Partner with User Research and PMM to translate qualitative findings about member needs, motivations, and barriers into testable hypotheses.

• Use behavioral data, segmentation, funnel analysis, and statistical methods to assess the prevalence of research findings and how they differ across member groups.

• Combine qualitative and quantitative evidence to guide positioning, messaging, onboarding, and product adoption strategies.

• Design, power, and interpret experiments to evaluate these strategies, coordinating analytical ownership with Product and Growth Analytics.

• Apply appropriate causal inference methods when randomization is not feasible, clearly communicating assumptions, uncertainty, and limitations.

• Identify where behavioral evidence and research findings diverge, and recommend follow-up analysis or research to resolve the gaps.

Lead analytical strategy and influence decisions

• Establish PMM’s analytics roadmap, balancing urgent forecasting needs with foundational measurement and longer-term strategic questions.

• Set standards for forecasting, experimentation, metric validation, and interpretation within your scope.

• Influence VP-level and executive decisions through clear recommendations, scenario analysis, and compelling written and verbal communication.

• Resolve conflicting assumptions, definitions, and priorities across PMM, Product, Growth, Finance, and other partners.

• Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, coding, and research synthesis while validating outputs and maintaining reproducibility.

• Raise the analytical bar through methodological guidance, peer review, and reusable tools and approaches.

To thrive in this role, you have

• A bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• Extensive experience in analytics or data science, with a track record of independently setting analytical direction, solving ambiguous problems, and influencing decisions across multiple teams.

• Hands-on experience building and operating demand forecasts used in business planning. You can explain how you selected methods, evaluated performance, quantified uncertainty, investigated errors, and incorporated stakeholder inputs.

• Strong knowledge of time-series analysis, regression, statistical modeling, and forecasting evaluation, with sound judgment about when a simple approach is sufficient.

• Experience measuring consumer product activation, adoption, engagement, and retention through cohort analysis, lifecycle measurement, and funnel analysis.

• Strong experimentation and causal inference skills, including the ability to distinguish observational patterns, predictive signals, and evidence of incremental impact.

• Expert SQL and advanced Python or R skills, with experience working with large datasets in cloud warehouses such as Snowflake.

• Experience translating analytical prototypes into recurring workflows, reliable data models, and decision tools in partnership with data teams.

• A track record of influencing senior leaders, establishing priorities, and building productive relationships across business and technical teams.

• Clear communication with nontechnical audiences, including the ability to explain uncertainty and turn findings into actionable recommendations.

• Comfort serving as a dedicated analytical partner while collaborating across a centralized Data Science and Analytics organization.

Nice-to-have

• Card demand, inventory, supply chain, or other operational demand forecasting.

• Product Marketing, lifecycle marketing, or consumer financial services analytics.

• Collaboration with User Research to connect qualitative findings with quantitative evidence.

• dbt, semantic layers, Hex, and governed self-service analytics.

• Fintech or consumer products with multiple interconnected offerings.

Provides day-to-day monitoring and basic plant and pump/booster station operations, routine lab tests and basic corrective and preventative maintenance activities.

• Performs routine CLAIR (cleaning, lubrication, adjustment, inspection and minor repair) on machines and related equipment which may include pumps, engines, centrifuges, generators, valves, gates, mixers, conveyors, blowers, dryers, chemical feed, odor control, disinfection equipment, vacuum filters and belt presses. Reports and documents results of work performed and enters into appropriate database. Promptly reports any operational problems with machines or equipment to Lead or Supervisor.

Performs field tests (chemical, physical and biological) in order to pace chemical dosages for process and odor control units. Prepares chemical solutions, monitors supplies and recommends reorder.
• Performs routine lab tests and prepares reports per procedure.
• Performs routine instrument calibration for portable meters including, but not limited to, dissolved oxygen, pH, H2S, percent oxygen, lower explosive limit.
• Learns to inspect and becomes proficient at mechanical troubleshooting to determine repairs needed. Dismantles equipment to gain access to and repairs defective parts using hand tools, power tools and precision measuring and testing devices. ABOUT THE ROLE

As an early leader, you will shape the team’s technical direction and culture while delivering against evolving launch and business needs. This role calls for someone comfortable growing a small function, setting priorities amid ambiguity, and achieving results through others.

This role is based in our San Francisco office.

 - Guide instrumentation, ingestion, and shared data models for manufacturing quality and traceability, device performance and usage, research, and safety.

 - Define data contracts and measurement needs with engineering, product, research, and data science early in development.

 - Build consistent, well-owned data products for finance, inventory, shipments, returns, customer support, and marketing.

 - Set standards for data quality, freshness, monitoring, incident response, and recovery. Build privacy, access controls, and governance into systems from the start.

 - Choose where to reuse shared platforms and where device or manufacturing needs warrant specialized capabilities, with clear ownership across infrastructure and partner teams.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Accountant- Platform Revenue
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast builds the all-in-one platform restaurants use to run their business. Our platform brings together software, hardware, and services that help restaurants manage their operations and serve their guests. Because our technology is purpose-built for restaurants, by restaurant people, restaurants can trust us to deliver on their needs today while we invest in the experiences that will power the restaurant of the future.

The Senior Revenue Accountant, Platform, owns key revenue accounting activities for Toast's platform products, ensuring revenue is recognized in accordance with US GAAP. This role combines hands-on revenue close responsibilities with analysis of complex revenue arrangements, large datasets, and revenue system activity. The ideal candidate brings strong problem-solving skills, an analytical mindset, and the ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

A day in the life (Responsibilities):

• Own monthly revenue close activities for platform products, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting analyses

• Manage revenue accounting activities in RevPro, including reviewing revenue schedules, investigating exceptions, and validating system outputs

• Prepare and analyze unbilled receivable and deferred revenue reconciliations and rollforwards, explaining movements and resolving differences across billing, revenue systems, and the general ledger

• Perform revenue fluctuation and budget-to-actual analysis, partnering with FP&A and business stakeholders to explain key drivers and investigate unexpected trends

• Partner with Billing, Finance Systems, and Data teams to investigate discrepancies and improve the accuracy and completeness of revenue data

• Assess and document the accounting impact of new products, pricing changes, contract terms, and system changes

• Support the design, implementation, and execution of key SOX controls over revenue accounting

• Support internal and external audit requests

• Drive process improvements, system enhancements, and automation of manual close and reconciliation activities

What you’ll need to thrive (Requirements):

• 4+ years of revenue accounting experience, preferably a combination of public accounting and industry experience, with in-depth knowledge of revenue recognition accounting standards

• Hands-on finance automation experience, such as streamlining manual close, reconciliation, or revenue processes

• Bachelor's degree or higher in accounting

• Strong knowledge of revenue accounting standards, including ASC 606

• Experience preparing revenue reconciliations and analyzing unbilled receivables, deferred revenue, and revenue recognition timing

• Experience working with revenue accounting systems and investigating differences across billing, subledger, and general ledger data

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues through resolution

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to explain complex accounting matters and financial trends in a clear and concise manner

• Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and manage competing priorities during the close process

Nice to Haves:

• Experience accounting for SaaS subscription or arrangement that combine software, hardware, services

• Experience with RevPro / Zuora Billing

• SQL skills or experience querying a data warehouse such as Snowflake

• Experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, and AI tools

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

jobs.title: Floor Trader- SOFR
jobs.description:
About Akuna:

Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions, and automation. We specialize in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully, we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies, and mathematical models.

Our Founding Partners first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Shanghai, London and Singapore.

What you’ll do as an SOFR Floor Trader at Akuna:

We are seeking a Floor Trader to join Akuna’s trading team in the SOFR pit on the CME floor. The ideal candidate will be a highly motivated individual interested in supporting our team coverage and competing in the marketplace.

As a part of Akuna’s SOFR team, you will make markets in SOFR futures options in the CME pit and manage the resulting risk book. Whether being first to make a market or removing liquidity on a resting order, the opportunities you identify and execute on in the marketplace will be immediately represented in the team’s P&L. You will be entrenched in a collaborative and comprehensive team environment where you will have the opportunity to learn our systems and trading style from some of our most experienced traders. Your previous experience will be expected to provide value from day one even as you adapt to your new role. In this role you will:

• Quote and trade SOFR options and multi-leg structures in the pit.

• Maintain relationships with floor brokers.

Qualities that make great candidates:

• 2+ years trading rate options, market-making preferred

• Strong grasp of options pricing, Greeks, and vol

• Knowledge of the US rates front end and Fed policy

• Fast mental math, composure under pressure

• The ability to react quickly and accurately to rapidly changing market conditions, including the ability to quickly and accurately respond and/or solve math and coding problems are essential functions of the role

In addition to technical skillsets, Akuna values the unique perspectives people can bring to the table to collaboratively solve complex problems and drive Akuna forward. We want everyone to feel empowered to apply. We welcome your application and encourage you to take the first steps toward your future with us!

In accordance with Illinois Equal Pay Act, the minimum base salary starts at $145,000. Exact compensation offered may vary based on many factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skill set. This role is also eligible for a discretionary performance bonus as part of the total compensation package and includes a comprehensive benefits package that may encompass employer-paid medical, dental, vision, retirement contributions, paid time off, and other benefits. The minimum base salary herein was determined in good faith by Akuna Capital LLC.

jobs.description:
SMX is hiring the Portfolio Solutions Architect for Strategy and Technology. You will own the work that crosses business unit lines: shared platform and product components, partner-driven opportunities, and SMX's enterprise AI positioning. Your accountability is horizontal. When two business units need the same platform component shaped in different ways, you arbitrate. When a hyperscaler or model provider brings an opportunity that spans portfolios, you own it until it has a clear home. When an SMX capability is presented to a customer, you own whether the evidence behind it holds up. This is a role for a builder who treats credibility as a deliverable. This is a remote position supporting a Herndon, VA based team.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1.    Own the cross-business-unit technical interlock for platform and product components that multiple portfolios depend on, including roadmap alignment, design decisions, and conflict resolution.
2.    Treat shared capabilities as reusable intellectual property: confirm each has a named owner, a roadmap, and an evidence base, and make the case plainly when one does not.
3.    Lead the technical side of partner-driven pursuits with hyperscalers and model providers, shaping solutions until each opportunity maps cleanly to a delivering portfolio.
4.    Translate co-sell motions and partner tier programs into qualified pipeline, working alongside Growth, Partnerships, and business unit leadership.
5.    Advance SMX's enterprise AI positioning, including reference architectures, governance approach, and the evidence standard for what SMX can claim in proposals and customer conversations.
6.    Serve as the technical authority on agentic and generative AI deployability in government environments: permission boundaries, evaluation methods, accreditation implications, and governance.
7.    Review capability claims in proposals, orals, and executive briefings to confirm they reflect delivered results, and strengthen or remove claims that do not.
8.    Recommend which capabilities SMX should invest in, consolidate, or retire, and bring the evidence to make that call stick.
9.    Mentor solution architects and engineers across SMX on platform thinking and AI architecture.

Required Skills & Experience

What You Bring (Required)
1.    10+ years in solution architecture, platform engineering, or technical product leadership, with at least 5 years supporting federal, DoW, or IC customers.
2.    Demonstrated platform and product thinking: you have managed a technical component as a product with an owner, roadmap, and adoption metrics, beyond delivering it as a project.
3.    Architecture-level command of generative and agentic AI systems, including evaluation, guardrails, permission and identity boundaries, and governance in regulated environments.
4.    Working fluency across the AWS, Microsoft, and Google ecosystems and at least one major model provider, including how partner tiering and co-sell programs generate pipeline.
5.    A record of driving decisions across organizations you did not control, without a P&L of your own to anchor to.
6.    Clear, direct written and verbal communication with executive, technical, and evaluator audiences.
7.    US Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance.
8.    Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience.

Desired Skills & Experience

1.    Consultative with a builder’s mindset.
2.    Experience taking AI capabilities through FedRAMP, DoD Impact Level, or RMF authorization.
3.    Professional certifications from a hyperscaler or model provider (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Claude Certified Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
4.    Prior experience in a cross-portfolio, CTO-office, or partner technical leadership seat at a government services firm.
5.    A track record of retiring or consolidating offerings that were not earning their place, and the story of how you made that case.

You will be the one connecting Nexthink's capabilities to what matters most to your clients: reducing IT costs, improving employee productivity, and protecting the digital workplace at scale.

What You'll Own

• Account Growth and Expansion — Develop and execute strategic account plans that drive license expansion, professional services adoption, and renewal excellence. You set the commercial direction for your portfolio and are accountable for the results.

Experience

• 10+ years of enterprise technology sales or account leadership, with a track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar revenue targets

• Direct experience in IT Service Management, IT Operations Management, Digital Employee Experience, or adjacent enterprise software categories
• Demonstrated success engaging and influencing at the executive level — including CIO, CHRO, and other C-suite stakeholders

• You are a strategic thinker and a skilled operator — you can build a three-year account vision and close the quarter
• You run disciplined pipelines, qualify rigorously, and don't chase the wrong opportunities
• You are a natural relationship builder — people trust you because you do what you say you're going to do

• A product that works. Customers choose Nexthink because it solves real problems — reducing IT costs, cutting ticket volume, improving employee satisfaction, and accelerating transformation programs. You will never struggle to show ROI.

• Collaborate with Product, Merchandising, and Marketing to ensure operational alignment.

Systems & Process Optimization

• Drive data integrity, systems compliance, and standard operating procedures across departments

• Champion operational change, identifying areas for improvement and leading the adoption of new tools, processes, and systems.

• Build cross-functional alignment and drive accountability with both internal teams and external partners

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Serve as central operations partner across the business, ensuring alignment between departments and timely execution of cross-functional initiative

• Manage, mentor and build an impactful ops team; create clarity around roles, responsibilities, and KPIs

• Strong communication skills and experience influencing across functions and levels.

• Highly organized and data-literate; proficient in Excel/Google Sheets and comfortable building complex templates.

jobs.title: Medical Receptionist/Phlebotomist
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a One Medical Medical Receptionist/Phlebotomist, internally known as Lab Services Specialist/Member Support Specialist, at one of our offices, you’ll provide an exceptional experience for our patients and help them accomplish an important part of their care journey by providing venipuncture as well as other clinical support services. You will be an ambassador for patients, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you’ll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions, both clinical and administrative, and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• Provide best in class venipuncture services on a population ranging from pediatrics to geriatrics, depending on the office location

• Perform and assist with extended scope duties such as, but not limited to non-blood specimen collection, EKGs/ECGs, vitals, ear lavages, vaccines, PPD tests, and swabs

• Maintain high standards of in-office care through proper specimen labeling, handling and processing, inventory upkeep, and tool sterilization

• Continue to care for our members beyond the lab room by answering patient messages, following up on lab cases and assisting our providers and virtual medical team with clerical duties such as, but not limited to biometric screening forms, medical record and consult review, billing inquiries, and DOH reporting

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

• Master our technology suite including, but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, Circulation, RingCentral, and our Electronic Medical Record System, in order to interact with team members and complete daily work

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, bilingual applicants encouraged to apply

• A High School Diploma or equivalent

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse, multi-disciplinary teams (additional experience with remote teams a plus)

• A proven ability to display confidence and instill trust during the collection process while delivering individualized, human-centered, customer-focused care

• A proven track record of persisting through change, consistently stepping up to take action on challenges, and learning quickly and effectively when faced with new situations or tasks

The range for this role is $19 to $21 per hour based on a standard full-time schedule. Total compensation packages may be based on factors unique to particular candidates, such as skill sets, depth of experience, and work location. The total compensation package for this position may also include benefits. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/

This is a full time role (40 hours/week) with 8 hour shifts generally taking place between 7am-7pm based in office in Miami, FL.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

jobs.title: Public Sector - Account Executive
jobs.description:
Bitwarden secures credentials and secrets for millions of users and tens of thousands of organizations worldwide. Our platform spans three products: Password Manager, Privileged Controls, and Secrets Manager. Open source, independently audited, and built for transparency, Bitwarden is trusted by security teams who need to verify what they deploy.

With FedRAMP authorization on the horizon and a growing installed base across federal agencies, states, counties, and municipalities, we are investing to make Public Sector a core growth engine for the business.

The Role

We are hiring a Public Sector Account Executive to win and grow Bitwarden's business across Federal, State, and Local government. You will own a blended territory, carry a quota, and run full-cycle sales — from first conversation with an agency CISO to a signed order through the right contract vehicle.

This is a ground-floor seat on a team being built now. You'll inherit real revenue, real agency logos, and a product roadmap purpose-built for government security requirements, and you'll help shape the playbook as our FedRAMP offering comes to market. You will report to the Vice President of Public Sector and work closely with Sales Development, Solutions Engineering, Partners, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance.

What You'll Own

Quota and Pipeline

• Carry and exceed an annual quota across a blended Federal, State, and Local territory

• Build territory and account plans that map agency missions, budget cycles, and security priorities to Bitwarden's products

• Generate your own pipeline through agency outreach, events, and partner co-selling, in partnership with Sales Development

• Maintain an accurate, disciplined forecast in the CRM and contribute to weekly forecast calls and deal reviews

Full-Cycle Selling

• Run complex sales cycles end to end: discovery, technical evaluation with Solutions Engineering, pricing, procurement, and close

• Sell to multiple stakeholders at once — CISOs, IT and security leaders, program offices, and contracting officers

• Expand existing agency accounts across Password Manager, Privileged Controls, and Secrets Manager

• Navigate fiscal-year timing, including end-of-year buying windows and appropriation rhythms

Contract Vehicles and Partners

• Close business through Bitwarden's existing vehicles — including our NASPO ValuePoint agreement via Carahsoft — and the resellers and distributors that carry them

• Guide customers to the right purchasing path, including GSA MAS, NASA SEWP, state term contracts, and cooperative purchasing agreements

• Co-sell with value-added resellers, systems integrators, and prime contractors to reach agencies and programs

• Flag vehicle gaps that block deals, and feed them into the team's contract vehicle strategy

Compliance-Led Selling

• Position Bitwarden's FedRAMP authorization path, FIPS validation, and open source transparency as reasons to buy

• Support agency ATO processes alongside Compliance and Solutions Engineering

• Respond to RFIs, RFPs, and sources-sought notices with Legal, Compliance, and Proposal support

Voice of the Customer

• Bring government requirements (StateRAMP, CJIS, agency-level controls) back to Product and Sales leadership

• Partner with Marketing on public sector events, campaigns, and customer references

• Represent Bitwarden professionally with agency leadership and procurement officials

What You'll Bring

Required

• 5+ years of quota-carrying software sales into U.S. Public Sector, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets

• Experience selling into both Federal and State & Local government — not exclusively one or the other

• Working knowledge of government procurement: contract vehicles, GWACs, cooperative agreements, fiscal-year cycles, and the reseller/distributor channel

• Experience selling cybersecurity, identity, or infrastructure software to security and IT buyers

• Proven ability to self-source pipeline and run multi-stakeholder, multi-month sales cycles

• Comfort in a high-growth environment where the playbook is still being written

Strongly Preferred

• Experience selling a FedRAMP-authorized product, or supporting agencies through the ATO process

• Existing relationships across federal civilian, DoD, and/or large state agencies

• Familiarity with identity security, PAM, or secrets management

• Experience co-selling with Carahsoft or other government distributors, resellers, and systems integrators

• Experience at an open source or developer-adjacent company

Why Bitwarden

• Mission. Our community loves us, and you'll bring better security to everyone from families to the world's largest organizations.

• Market. You'll become an expert in two growing markets: security and open-source software.

• Growth. You'll build channel, demand gen, and product-led growth experience in a fast-growing company.

• Team. Work remotely with motivated people around the world, with in-person meet ups.

In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $100,000k - $125,000k. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market.

jobs.title: Data Hall Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About TensorWave

Our mission is simple: deliver seamless, secure, reliable, and resilient AI compute at scale. We've built a versatile cloud platform that eliminates infrastructure barriers, empowering builders to focus on innovation instead of fighting their stack. Because breakthrough AI should move at the speed of ideas, not infrastructure.



About the Role

We’re looking for a Data Hall Design Engineer to join our team during an exciting phase of growth. Data Hall Design defines every data hall before it is built: layouts, power, liquid cooling and white space for high-density GPU clusters. As a Data Hall Design Engineer, you own design packages that Build turns into live capacity. Your work has to be right, buildable and on time, because the go-live date depends on it.



What You’ll Do

 - Produce and own data hall design packages: hall layouts, rack elevations, electrical one-lines, power distribution, cooling P&IDs and white space plans.

 - Design for high-density GPU racks, including liquid cooling (CDUs, manifolds, direct-to-chip and rear door heat exchangers) and MV/LV power distribution.

 - Run load, cooling and coordination calculations; check designs against NEC, NFPA and ASHRAE.

 - Apply the standard data hall design and document site-specific deltas for review.

 - Write and review scopes of work and bills of material for Build, Procurement and GCs.

 - Direct A/E consultants and vendors; review their drawings, calcs and submittals.

 - Answer RFIs from the field quickly and fold field changes back into the design.

 - Coordinate layouts and pathways with Network Engineering, Build, Operations and AMD.

 - Capture lessons learned after each site and improve the standard design.



Scope

 - Owns a defined package (one system in one hall) with review

 - Owns a full discipline for a hall from basis of design through IFC

Technical Depth

 - Working knowledge of one discipline (electrical or mechanical) and the relevant codes

 - Deep knowledge of one discipline and working knowledge of adjacent ones

Influence

 - Works with Build, consultants and vendors on own package

 - Represents the discipline in design reviews; directs A/E consultants; mentors others

 

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

 - 5 to 9 years, including data center design delivered through construction

 - Licensure
   
   - EIT or working toward PE
   
   - PE eligible or licensed preferred

 - Degree in electrical, mechanical or architectural engineering, or equivalent experience.

 - Proficient in AutoCAD and Revit; comfortable with BIM coordination.

 - Able to read and produce one-lines, P&IDs, floor plans and rack elevations.

 - Working knowledge of power distribution (switchgear, UPS, busway, PDUs) or cooling systems (CRAH, CDU, chilled water).

 - Clear written communication; organized and detail oriented.

Preferred Qualifications

 - High-density or liquid-cooled GPU or HPC data hall design (30 kW+ per rack).

 - CFD review experience.

 - Experience with hyperscale or neocloud standard designs and prefab or modular systems.

 - Field or construction experience on data center projects.

jobs.title: Studio Coach - Burlington, VT
jobs.description:
Weight Watchers is the global leader in science-backed weight management, offering an integrated support system built for the GLP-1 era that combines scientific expertise, medication, cutting-edge technology, and human connection. With more than 60 years of experience, Weight Watchers is the most studied commercial weight management program in the world, delivered through its No. 1 U.S. doctor-recommended weight-loss program. Its holistic, personalized approach also includes U.S.-based clinical interventions and access to GLP-1 medications when clinically appropriate, and a global network of coaches and community support. Since 1963, the company has led with science to deliver its members the personalized support they need to reach and sustain their goals. Members can access these solutions directly, or through Weight Watchers for Business’ full-spectrum platform for employers, health plans, and payers. In a landscape crowded with contradictory advice, isolating apps, and one-size-fits-all solutions, Weight Watchers offers a proven path forward that is rooted in research, grounded in empathy and designed to help every member feel better in their body and live a longer, healthier life.

Who we are

Our Field Team is comprised of Coaches and Guides who establish connections with members and create inclusive in-person communities at our Studio locations. They inspire our members to develop healthy habits by teaching them how to eat healthier while still enjoying their favorite foods, move more, sleep better, and shift their mindset, all while fostering a sense of community and belonging. Each week, our Coaches and Guides work hard to help members achieve their wellness goals and make positive lifestyle changes

What you will do
