jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Gradial is building the AI-native system of work for enterprise marketing. Our agents turn ideas into live campaigns by executing across the tools, teams, and workflows enterprises already use—from content authoring and campaign assembly to quality assurance and brand compliance. We give marketers and creatives more time to shape brands, understand customers, and create work that moves people.

We’re tackling some of the hardest problems in applied AI: building agent harnesses, sandboxed execution environments, and orchestration that enable agents to plan, act, and verify their work reliably at enterprise scale. We’re growing rapidly, winning Fortune 500 and enterprise customers including AWS, T-Mobile, and Prudential. Our $65 million Series C led by Insight Partners is accelerating that momentum.

Join us to help define how people and AI agents work together. We move with urgency, reason from first principles, and take ownership from idea to customer impact. You’ll shape the product, own consequential problems, and build systems that some of the world’s leading brands depend on every day.

Role Overview

We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to scale our category-defining technology to marketing organizations. Our platform automates complex web content operations using generative AI - enabling marketers to publish, update, and manage pages at scale without relying on engineering. As one of our first AEs, you'll be instrumental in shaping our sales strategy, refining our ideal customer profile, and turning interest from leading brands into long term partnerships.

This is a full-cycle, enterprise-facing role where you’ll own everything from initial outreach to close. You'll work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and customer success, and you’ll have the technical fluency to demo a highly capable AI system in detail. If you’ve sold marketing tech into complex orgs, have an instinct for finding the real problem and want to help build a generational company from the ground up, we’d love to meet you.

Responsibilities

• Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting to close, including qualification, solution mapping, negotiation, and contracting.

• Engage strategic accounts across industries with complex marketing operations, such as SaaS, ecommerce, and media.

• Deliver high-impact product demos that clearly communicate Gradial’s value across CMS integration, workflow automation, and AI-powered content operations.

• Translate technical features into business outcomes for multiple stakeholders, including Marketing, Web, Engineering, and RevOps teams.

• Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and customer success to incorporate customer insights and refine our go-to-market strategy.

• Develop and iterate on outbound messaging, ICP criteria and segmentation strategy in a fast-moving product-led growth environment.

• Manage a pipeline of opportunities with precision, forecasting accurately and consistently exceeding revenue targets.

• Travel as needed to meet with customers, build relationships and represent Gradial at relevant industry events.

Requirements

• Demonstrated success in full-cycle enterprise sales, preferably at a high-growth startup or in a category-creating company.

• Experience selling marketing technology or workflow automation platforms; familiarity with AI-native products is a strong plus.

• Strong technical fluency — able to demo product functionality, speak to integrations and APIs, and navigate product-led environments.

• Excellent consultative selling skills with the ability to uncover pain points, tailor solutions, and manage complex stakeholder dynamics.

• Self-motivated and highly accountable, with a strong sense of ownership over pipeline, strategy, and outcomes.

• Thrives in ambiguity and fast-paced environments where playbooks are being built in real-time.

• Willingness to travel for key accounts and events, based on business needs and deal flow.

Compensation

The OTE salary range for this position is $295,000 – $340,000 annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, and qualifications. This role will be eligible for performance-based bonuses in accordance with our Sales Incentive Plan and equity awards. Gradial offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental & vision insurance, 401K retirement plan, paid time off, paid sick leave and other employee wellness programs.

What we offer

• Performance-based annual bonus

• Meaningful equity awards

• Medical, dental & vision (fully covered for employees with 75% for dependents)

• Fertility & family-planning support

• 401k plan

• Unlimited PTO

• A beautiful Seattle office with a gym, sauna, and bike parking

• Free lunch three days a week in our HQ

• A front-row seat to building category-defining AI infrastructure

You'll thrive here if you

• Learn quickly, actively seek out new challenges, and regularly reconsider “how it’s always been done.”

• Want to have real impact with zero bureaucracy.

• Have an innate drive for being 1% better than the day before, building towards greatness.

• Embrace AI as a core tool for problem-solving, innovation, and scale.

• Show customer-obsession (internal or external), high ownership/accountability, and bias for action.

• Communicate clearly, directly, with curiosity, and assuming good intentions.

• Thrive in fast-paced, hyper-growth environments where building better > maintaining status quo.

AI Literacy & Interviewing Tools

As an AI-first company, we prioritize AI literacy as a core competency in our hiring decisions. We’re excited by candidates who thoughtfully apply AI tools in their work, but during interviews we’re focused on you. This is your opportunity to show how you think, communicate, and solve problems. Over-reliance on AI-generated responses during the interview process (especially when it obscures your own voice) will result in disqualification. We want to understand your unique perspective and how you approach challenges, both with and without AI.

Gradial is dedicated to creating an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and all team members can grow. We offer competitive compensation, equity, flexible work hours, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative culture focused on learning and impact.

Hill House Home is seeking an experienced HR Manager, Retail to join our New York team, reporting directly to the HR Director. What You’ll Do:

• Track and analyze retail people data such as turnover, retention, and exit interview trends, and turn insights into practical action plans with Retail HQ leadership

• Champion retention and career growth for store teams, including clear pathways from Associate to Store Manager and support for engagement and pulse survey initiatives

• Co-lead the monthly HR & Store Managers Call, bringing timely updates, training topics, and space for questions from the field

• Support the annual performance review, compensation, and promotion cycles for retail employees,

• Partnering with Retail leadership to ensure timely payroll processing, accuracy and state compliance

• Design and deliver training for store leaders on topics such as manager documentation, and harassment prevention, and safety procedures

Who You Are:

• 4-5+ years of HR experience, including at least 3 years supporting multi-unit retail; fashion, or lifestyle retail

• Deep working knowledge of multi-state employment law and retail-specific regulations, including wage and hour and fair workweek requirements

• Proven experience managing employee relations and conducting thorough, fair investigations

• A trusted coach who earns credibility quickly with field leaders

jobs.description:

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. ABOUT THE ROLE

Socure’s mission is to verify 100% of good identities in real time and eliminate identity fraud across the digital world. To achieve that, we need differentiated, industry-specific narratives and strong ecosystem partnerships that translate our AI-driven platform into measurable customer impact.

We’re hiring a Vertical Marketing Lead to lead strategy and execution for how Socure shows up within a priority industry segment. This role owns vertical positioning, solution packaging, and partner go-to-market strategy for a defined GTM Pod — driving pipeline, revenue growth, and competitive differentiation.

You will serve as the vertical marketing lead for one of Socure's Tier 1 Banking POD, acting as the strategic owner of industry positioning, pipeline acceleration, and revenue impact within this segment.

This is a highly strategic, hands-on role for a senior marketer who thrives at the intersection of product, sales, and ecosystem partnerships. You’ll operate with autonomy, partner closely with GTM leadership, and directly influence how Socure wins in your assigned market.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Define and execute a vertical marketing strategy for the Tier 1 Banking GTM Pod.

 - Develop clear ICPs, value propositions, use cases, and competitive positioning aligned to the pod’s sales motion.

 - Partner with Product, Data Science, and Revenue Marketing to embed differentiated data and insights into vertical narratives.

 - Translate complex AI-driven capabilities into compelling, industry-specific messaging that resonates with economic buyers and technical stakeholders.

 - Deliver field-ready enablement (decks, playbooks, battlecards, ROI tools, customer stories) that improves win rates and accelerates deal velocity.


VERTICAL CAMPAIGN STRATEGY

 - Partner closely with GTM leaders to build and execute campaigns that generate qualified pipeline from target accounts.

 - Drive increased awareness within your vertical to position Socure as the standard identity and fraud infrastructure.
   Coordinate integrated campaign strategies across touchpoints including email, webinars, paid and organic channels, SDR outreach, in-person experiences, and more.

 - Partner with RevOps to define success metrics, analyze performance, and iterate based on results — scaling what works and refining what doesn’t.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP

 - Act as the vertical marketing owner for your pod during planning cycles and QBRs.

 - Influence stakeholders across Product, Sales, Data Science, RevOps, and Marketing to ensure strong commercialization of new capabilities.

 - Establish and track KPIs tied to pipeline, revenue contribution, win rates, and strategic account growth.

 - Bring market insights, competitive intelligence, and industry trends into GTM strategy discussions.

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 6–8 years of B2B marketing experience, including product marketing, vertical/industry marketing experience in high-growth SaaS, fintech, identity, fraud, risk, or adjacent environments.

 - Demonstrated success driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through vertical or segment-focused marketing initiatives.

 - Strong ability to translate complex AI-driven or data-centric technology into clear, compelling industry narratives.

 - Experience partnering closely with sales teams and influencing cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.

Every candidate meets Harper through you before they meet anyone else. How that goes is yours.



A candidate for a sales role applies on a Tuesday. By Thursday she has had her first screen, and the invite for the next one is already in her inbox with the right names, times, and room. On her super day she walks into our office and the person at the door knows who she is. Every interviewer has her resume and knows what they are there to assess. Their feedback is in that evening. She hears from us within two days, either way.

At most companies, candidates wait, chase, and reschedule, and that is how they decide what the company is like. Here, a fast and clear process is a promise we make to every person who applies, and you keep it.

Harper is hiring across sales and engineering in San Francisco and New York. You will report to our VP of People and work alongside our recruiters and hiring managers.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Schedule fast. Book screens, panels, and super days within a day of each decision, across interviewers' calendars and two offices.

 - Run the super day. Plan the agenda, prep the interviewers, greet the candidate, and keep the day on time.

 - Close the loop. Chase interviewer feedback the same day, and make sure every candidate hears back, including the ones we pass on.

 - Keep Ashby honest. Every candidate is in the right stage with the right notes, so the weekly hiring report is true without anyone fixing it.

 - Move offers to day one. Draft offer letters, run background checks, and hand each new hire to onboarding with nothing missing.

 - Find what slows us down. Spot where candidates wait or drop off, and tell the recruiters and hiring managers what to change.

 - Teach the machine. When our tools or AI get a schedule, a stage, or a message wrong, fix it and say so, so the next one is right.
   
   


WHAT YOU NEED

 - You have coordinated interviews, run events, or managed calendars for a team that moved fast, ideally in recruiting at a growing company.

 - You keep many moving pieces straight at once and notice the one about to slip.

 - You write clearly and warmly to candidates, interviewers, and executives alike.

 - You want to be measured in the open on time to schedule, time to feedback, candidate experience, and how clean the pipeline is. Nothing softer.

Ashby or another applicant tracking system helps, and it is not required. We teach the tools. If you meet most of this, apply.




THE REALITY: READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

This job is keeping two groups happy at once. Candidates want speed and clear answers. Interviewers and hiring managers have full calendars and other work. The hardest moments come when those pull in different directions. When they do, the candidate's experience wins, and you are the one who pushes for it.

This is not the seat if you want to source or close candidates yourself from day one, if you need every week to look the same, or if you need a remote or hybrid schedule.

It is the seat if being the reason a candidate says "that was the best interview process I've been through" sounds like the work you want.

Harper is an equal opportunity employer.



HOW WE HIRE

 1. A screen with a recruiter on fit and what you have coordinated.

 2. A conversation with our VP of People on how you work and your judgment.

 3. A super day in the office, with a live scheduling exercise and time with the recruiting team and hiring managers.


THE BASICS

 - Pay: $120,000 to $150,000 base salary with equity

 - Where: On-site, five days a week, in the room with the team. San Francisco at 425 Market Street,

 - Benefits: Health, dental, and vision. San Francisco adds three meals a day in the office, commuter benefits, and a gym membership.
   
   


HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a short note about a time a schedule, event, or process fell apart at the last minute. Tell us what broke, who you had to keep informed, and how it ended.

This is an in office - 5 days a week - position located in our DFW Corporate office in Irving, TX.

The Real Estate Analyst - Property Management provides financial, operational, and analytical support for the Cirrus portfolio.

This position is responsible for analyzing property and portfolio performance, supporting budgeting and financial reporting, conducting market and submarket research, and preparing reports and analyses to help drive informed business decisions.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, comfortable working with financial and operational data, and able to translate data into meaningful insights and recommendations. This role works closely with property operations, leadership, and clients and may assist with acquisitions, refinances, and other strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

• Annual Budgeting: Support the annual budgeting process by preparing, reviewing, and consolidating budget inputs for assigned properties.
• Portfolio Support & Analysis: Provide portfolio-level support and analysis for a designated group of assets, tracking performance against goals and benchmarks.
• Ad Hoc Analysis & Reporting: Prepare ad hoc analyses and reports as requested by internal and external clients, delivering clear and actionable insights.
• Due Diligence: Support the due diligence process on acquisitions and refinances as necessary, including data gathering, financial modeling, and document review.
• Special Projects: Complete special projects and other duties as assigned by leadership.
• Market Research: Conduct market and submarket research to inform leasing decisions and asset positioning.
• Property Operations Support: Partner with the property operations team, providing data and analysis to support day-to-day operational decisions.
• Financial Reporting & Variance Analysis: Prepare financial reports and conduct variance analysis, identifying key drivers of performance deviations from budget/forecast.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means providing accurate, timely, and meaningful analysis that helps Cirrus leaders, property teams, and clients make informed decisions. The Financial Analyst should be able to identify trends and opportunities within the data, communicate findings clearly, and serve as a reliable analytical partner to the teams supporting our properties and portfolios.

• 0-2 years of experience in real estate, asset management, financial analysis, or a related field.
• Strong proficiency in Excel – REQUIRED
• Familiarity with AI such as: Claude, Chatgpt

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant (Relief) - Princeton, NJ
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

At VEG, we don’t just hire assistants—we grow future emergency rockstars. As a per diem Emergency Veterinary Assistant, you’ll be in the heart of the action from day one, supporting your team, comforting pet parents, and learning the ropes in real time. You’ll be there for everything—the triage, the treatments, and the tail wags. You’re embarking on a path where careers start, grow, and thrive. Whether you’re on your way to becoming a credentialed technician or exploring where your passion can take you, we’ll say yes to your growth every step of the way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO*

• Be the first warm welcome and a steady support, triaging incoming patients and helping guide them toward care

• Assist with treatments, nursing care, and diagnostics, from bloodwork and imaging to catheter placement and oxygen support

• Work alongside our credentialed veterinary technicians and veterinarians to set up and monitor anesthesia and sedation cases

• Set up and manage IV fluids, blood transfusions, and medication administration

• Assist during every moment of care: outpatient or inpatient, exam room to treatment area.

• Join patient rounds and stay close to the clinical picture to ensure continuity of care.

• Learn how to perform CPR and become a RECOVER Certified Rescuer (training provided!)

• Grow into more advanced responsibilities, such as anesthesia support, ultrasound, and catheterization through guided training pathways

*As permitted by state law

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Enrolled in an AVMA-accredited veterinary technology program a plus

• 1+ years in a veterinary assistant role (emergency or specialty experience is a bonus!)

• Basic computer skills and an understanding of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation ($18.50/hr-$39/hr) and 401k match

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: VP, Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Us:

Pacvue is the leading Commerce Media OS, powering over $12B in advertising spend across 100+ global retail media networks including Amazon, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Instacart, Criteo, and CitrusAd. Powered by industry-leading AI and real-time data, Pacvue enables over 70,000 brands and agencies to maximize advertising performance, drive incrementality, and expand reach across the commerce universe from a single mission control. As of 2025, Pacvue powers 12% of total retail media ad spend worldwide excluding China. Combined with Helium 10’s SMB solutions, Pacvue delivers the industry’s most comprehensive platform for businesses of all sizes.

At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.

About the Role:

Partnerships are critical to Pacvue's success. Our relationships with leading retailers, data and measurement providers, and social, programmatic, etc., partners shape what we can build, where we can grow, and how we engage in the market. This is a key leadership role with high visibility across the company. You will set the strategy for how Pacvue partners and own the results, working directly with senior leaders both inside Pacvue and at our partners.

The VP of Partnerships defines Pacvue’s overall partnership strategy and operating philosophy across all regions, ensuring the partner ecosystem directly advances the company’s broader corporate strategy. Working between our commercial and product teams, you will identify and assess partnership opportunities, then drive the agreements, integrations and launches that extend where Prism, our agentic activation layer, can activate and measure media, all connected to commerce outcomes through our retailer integrations. You will lead a team that builds our most important partnerships across retailers, media activation channels, and data partnerships. You will bring what you learn in the market into the product roadmap, and lead a team that runs day-to-day partner management.

Responsibilities:

Lead and unify the partnerships organization

• Lead a consolidated team across retailers, DSPs, social/search/CTV and AI platforms, data and measurement partners, and EU. Set one operating model with clear roles, ownership and a single front door for partner requests.

• Build and manage the framework the team needs to scale: joint business plan (JBP) structure, partner tiering, scorecards, a QBR cadence, and consistent KPIs and reporting.

• Leads and develops the partnerships organization across multiple functional areas and regions, coaching the managers who run day-to-day partner relationships, while personally owning the strategic direction and outcomes of the function at a corporate level.

• Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, Development, Finance and Legal to execute Pacvue's partner strategy across all partner types

Build executive relationships and own partner performance

• Build and own executive relationships with key partners to set direction and unlock scaled growth, including regular QBRs and a visible presence at partner events.

• Own JBPs and account plans with strategic partners. Deliver against commitments, secure preferred-partner status, and win first-to-market, alpha and beta access.

• Negotiate and deliver partner incentive agreements and co-funding, and own the incentive revenue target.

Identify, evaluate and manage new and complex partnerships

• Identify, evaluate, negotiate and manage complex, high-profile partnerships that enable new and valuable customer experiences relevant to Pacvue's product solutions.

• Lead business development and assessment of new retailers, platforms, and data and measurement partners. Build the business case with Product, Commercial and Finance, and run the pathway from sourcing through contract to launch.

• Set the criteria for which partnerships Pacvue pursues and decide when to stop investing in ones that aren't working.

Drive market leadership

• Lead partner co-marketing, case studies, thought leadership and executive engagement with partners. Make sure co-marketing activity converts into pipeline in coordination with Marketing and Sales.

• Own partner-facing reporting, including regular partner updates and external newsletters

Skills & Qualifications:

• Typically 15+ years in partnerships, business development, or strategic alliances, including senior leadership experience setting direction at the executive level. You have personally managed major partner relationships in retail media, ad tech, commerce or data.

• A record of building and delivering joint business plans and negotiating complex, high-profile commercial terms, including incentives, rev share and co-funding.

• Deep, master-level fluency across partner integrations, data/clean room architecture, and commercial structuring, sufficient to shape Product and Engineering’s roadmap decisions, not just evaluate them.

• Experience sourcing and assessing new partners and building the business case, ideally across more than one region.

• Serves as a voice within the executive team, directly shaping corporate strategy alongside the C-suite, while building and holding executive relationships with partner leadership globally

• A history of operating through influence. Most of the outcomes you own (billable spend, adoption, launches) depend on Product, Sales and CS.

• Experience with OKRs and KPI-driven management.

Benefits:

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Paid Holidays and Floating Holidays

• Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA with employer contribution, Life Insurance and Pet Insurance

• 401k with Employer Match

• Take up to 2 Days of Paid Time Off to Volunteer with a 501c Organization

• Paid Parental Leave

• Company-subsidized membership to Wellhub and Peloton

• Fertility and family-building information platform through Carrot

The annual base salary range for this position is $265,000-$275,000. The actual salary will vary depending on the applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and market data for their location. This position is also eligible for an additional annual bonus compensation through one of Pacvue’s highly attractive incentive plans, full details will be provided during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Senior Director, CMC Technical Development
jobs.description:
Amylyx has an audacious mission to usher in a new era for treating diseases with high unmet needs. Where others see challenges, we see opportunities that we pursue with urgency, rigorous science, and unwavering commitment to the communities we serve. We are a clinical-stage company currently focused on post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH), Wolfram syndrome, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

Our mission is powered by our people. Our core values – be audacious, be curious, be authentic, be engaged, and be accountable – creating a culture of caring. Amylyx has assembled an experienced team ready to take action because the communities we serve have no time to wait. If you share our passion and are determined to tackle some of medicine’s toughest problems, we encourage you to read the opportunity below and apply.

The Opportunity

Amylyx is seeking a highly experienced Senior Director, CMC Technical Development to provide strategic and technical leadership across Amylyx’s clinical and late-stage pipeline, including the Phase III synthetic peptide avexitide, Phase I antisense oligonucleotide AMX0114, and Phase 2 small molecule AMX0035. This leader will be responsible for driving phase-appropriate technical development including drug substance and drug product process development, product characterization, formulation selection, process scale-up, and validation readiness in partnership with internal CMC functions and external CDMOs.

The ideal candidate will combine strategic leadership, deep scientific and technical expertise, strong partnership skills, and the willingness to contribute hands-on when needed in a small, fast-moving biotech environment. This role reports to the Senior Vice President, CMC and External Manufacturing.

Responsibilities

Strategic Technical Leadership:

• Lead technical development across Amylyx’s pipeline, ensuring plans are scientifically rigorous, phase-appropriate, and aligned with clinical, regulatory, quality, supply, and business objectives.

• Serve directly or through direct reports as the Technical Development lead on CMC asset teams, accountable to provide clear technical requirements, risks, timelines, decision options, regulatory filing materials, and clinical supplies.

• Provide input into target product profiles ensuring technical feasibility and translating into critical quality attributes and critical process parameters.

• Partner with CMC Team Strategy lead(s) to integrate technical development plans into overall asset strategies.

• Proactively identify critical path activities, technical risks, resource needs, and budget implications; develop practical mitigation plans and contingency strategies in collaboration with internal and external teams.

• Provide technical leadership for CDMO evaluation, selection, onboarding, due diligence, technology transfer, and external development or manufacturing campaigns.

• Travel to global manufacturing and development sites as needed to support technical transfers, GMP campaigns, and troubleshooting.

Process Development &Scale-Up:

• Lead phase-appropriate drug substance and drug product development for clinical and late-stage programs, including formulation and process optimization, scale-up, and process characterization.

• Establish robust, scalable, reproducible, and cost-effective drug substance and drug product manufacturing processes capable of supporting clinical supply, regulatory submissions, and future commercial manufacture.

• Develop and maintain control strategies and ensure manufacturing processes, specifications, and technical packages are scientifically justified and aligned with global regulatory expectations.

• Serve as a technical subject matter expert through product registration, supporting technical assessments, development reports, process descriptions, control strategy documentation, and regulatory submission content.

• Lead technical troubleshooting, deviation investigations, root-cause analyses, CAPAs, change controls, batch record review, campaign data review in collaboration with Quality and external partners to support clinical supply.

• Review and approve key clinical CDMO technical documents, including protocols, batch records, campaign plans, development reports, deviation assessments, technical memos, and drug substance/drug product manufacturing documentation.

Regulatory and Commercial Readiness:

• Partner with Regulatory CMC to author, review, and defend technical content for INDs, NDAs, BLAs, MAAs, health authority questions, and briefing materials.

• Support MSAT team with PPQ planning and commercial technical readiness by ensuring drug substance and drug product process understanding, control strategy, comparability, and manufacturing documentation are appropriately developed for late-stage programs approaching filing and launch.

People Management:

• Lead, mentor, and develop internal technical development team members and matrixed project leads, fostering scientific rigor, accountability, collaboration, urgency, and pragmatic decision-making.

• Provide career development guidance, coaching, performance feedback, and succession planning for team members.

• Allocate resources effectively across programs and ensure technical development priorities are aligned with organizational objectives, program milestones, and available capacity.

• Build scalable technical development processes, templates, governance routines, and best practices appropriate for a growing biotech organization operating through external partners.

• Promote technical excellence through coaching, training, knowledge sharing, and transparent communication across internal teams and CDMO partners.

Requirements

• Advanced degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, biochemistry, or a related scientific or engineering discipline; Ph.D. preferred.

• Strong understanding of small molecule, synthetic peptide, oligonucleotide, RNA, and/or amino acid chemistries and related manufacturing technologies.

• Minimum of 15 years of progressive pharmaceutical or biotechnology experience in technical development, process development, and late-stage CMC development including at least 5-8 years in a leadership capacity.

• Demonstrated expertise developing phase-appropriate processes across modalities from early clinical development through late-stage filing and commercialization.

• Deep expertise in Quality by Design (QbD), Advanced knowledge of cGMP expectations and relevant FDA, EMA, ICH, and other global CMC guidance and regulatory requirements.

• Strong track record supporting global CMC submissions, health authority interactions, inspection readiness, and successful product approvals preferred.

• Proven ability to operate independently, influence without direct authority, make sound technical decisions under ambiguity, and build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners.

• Excellent leadership, communication, collaboration, technical writing, and executive-level presentation skills.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 10%, with additional travel as business needs require.

Work Location and Conditions:

• At Amylyx, we proudly support remote work opportunities within the United States. However, due to business considerations candidates must be able to attend meetings at our office in Cambridge, MA on a regular basis. Preference will be given to candidates who reside in the New England region and can be in person on an as needed basis.

• When working remotly, you must have access to a work setting which enables meeting all requirements of the role (including privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to video conference, etc.) at your remote location.

Compensation

The pay range posted below represents our good faith estimate of compensation for this role, based on market data and internal benchmarks. The final offer may vary depending on a candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as considerations of internal equity.

Base salary is one component of Amylyx’s total rewards package. In addition to competitive base pay, eligible employees may receive annual performance-based bonuses and equity awards, providing an opportunity to share in the company’s long-term success. Amylyx also offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees.

Estimated Pay Range

$247,000—$278,000 USD

The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 50 pounds, occasionally up to 60 pounds. The employee frequently uses both hands as well as full range of motion of the neck, head and back. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, grasp and perform repetitive hand, wrist and arm motions. The employee is frequently required to climb stairs, kneel/squat, bend and carry. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Employee may be required to wear a headset covering one or both ears. Basic literacy is required for operation of machines and necessary daily paperwork.

Work environment is moderately noisy. The employee is occasionally required to work near conveyor systems. There is exposure to dust and changes in weather conditions. Work is performed under typical warehouse conditions. Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced. The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter (3-6 month contract)
jobs.description:
About Northbeam

Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi-touch attribution, MMM+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser-accurate first-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.

We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast-moving, high-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.

We're a remote-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

About the Role

We're hiring a contract Technical Recruiter for 3–6 months to hire against our engineering headcount. Headcount is growing across several product lines all at once, and these searches need a dedicated recruiter who has run software engineering searches and can run them from start to finish.

You'll partner with our engineering hiring managers and our in-house recruiting lead, spend a significant amount of time sourcing and vetting software engineers and you'll be measured on outreach, passthrough rate and closed hires.

Your Impact

• Run engineering searches full cycle. Lead kickoff and calibration with hiring managers, then source, screen, coordinate interviews, run debriefs, and support offers through close.

• Focus primarily on sourcing passive prospects. Build targeted talent pools beyond the obvious.

• Run multi-channel outreach using our sequencing tool, noon.ai.

• Balance vetting prospects with evangelizing Northbeam in video and phone interviews.

• Keep the hiring team informed. Keep Greenhouse feedback current, and share a weekly pipeline update.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of technical recruiting, with full-cycle ownership of senior and staff software engineering searches at startups.

• A track record of closing senior software engineers in a competitive, remote market.

• Enough technical fluency to screen prospects and candidates with confidence.

• A track record of sourcing prospects and converting them into hires.

• A track record of working well with hiring managers. You calibrate early, push back with an informed opinion/data, and keep loops moving.

• Self-direction. You can ramp in a week, work async over Slack, and own several reqs with light oversight.

Bonus Skills & Experience

• Recruiting experience in marketing measurement, adtech, martech, analytics, or e-commerce SaaS.

• Past searches for fullstack engineers, data-tilted engineers, or data science.

• A network in data infrastructure, data streaming, or experimentation-platform communities.

• Hands-on use of AI sourcing tools alongside traditional sourcing tools.

Compensation

$65-$95/hr.  This is NOT a full-time employee role, but could result in a full-time employment offer if there's mutual interest during the contract engagement.

Interview process

The interview process includes video interviews with the hiring manager, our Chief of Staff, and an Engineering Manager along with a take-home assignment.

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.

In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.

Interview Process
The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5-7 interviews total and requires around 5-8 hours of your time.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

AECOM is seeking an experienced Senior Consultant – Mineral Processing to join our Mining and Minerals team. This senior-level position offers the opportunity to provide technical expertise and consulting services across a diverse portfolio of mineral processing projects, supporting clients throughout the mining project lifecycle.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience in mineral processing engineering, metallurgical studies, process optimization, and technical consulting across multiple commodity sectors. This individual will serve as a trusted technical advisor, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, project managers, and clients to develop innovative, practical, and cost-effective mineral processing solutions.

The role requires strong technical judgment, project delivery experience, and the ability to contribute to client relationship development and business growth while supporting the continued technical excellence of AECOM's mining business.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a senior technical consultant and subject matter expert on mineral processing projects involving base metals, precious metals, critical minerals, and industrial minerals.
• Lead and contribute to mineral processing engineering studies, including scoping studies, preliminary economic assessments (PEA), pre-feasibility studies (PFS), feasibility studies (FS), and process optimization assessments.
• Provide technical oversight and guidance for mineral processing plant design, equipment selection, process flowsheets, mass and water balances, and metallurgical performance evaluations.
• Support greenfield processing plant development, brownfield expansions, plant upgrades, and operational improvement initiatives, including troubleshooting and performance benchmarking.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams and project managers to deliver high-quality technical solutions through detailed engineering, owner's engineer, and EPCM project assignments.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree or PhD in Metallurgical Engineering, Mineral Processing Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• 15+ years of progressive experience in mineral processing engineering, technical consulting, plant design, or metallurgical operations.
• Technical expertise in multiple mineral processing technologies, including comminution, flotation, gravity separation, magnetic separation, hydrometallurgy, and leaching processes.
• Experience working across multiple commodities, including copper, gold, silver, nickel, lithium, rare earth elements, or other critical and industrial minerals.

jobs.title: FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next-generation AI capabilities.

While autonomous machines offer significant advantages, they also introduce new safety challenges. FORT addresses these concerns by providing solutions such as the Wireless E-Stop, which allows operators to instantly stop any machine from a safe distance, enhancing safety during emergencies.

Additionally, FORT's Safe Remote Control enables operators to manage heavy machinery remotely, reducing the risk of accidents and improving visibility.

By ensuring communications integrity across any network, FORT empowers customers to protect their most valuable assets—people, data, and machines—ensuring they remain safe and secure.

The FP&A Manager is the VP, FP&A's right hand in planning, forecasting and performance reporting. You will own the core financial model, run the budget and forecast cycles, and help department leaders understand their numbers and make better decisions. This is a hands-on role with visibility to the CFO and executive team as FORT becomes a public company.

You will own the monthly forecast and variance analysis, build the annual operating plan with business leaders, and support the de-SPAC model and investor materials. You will work closely with Accounting, Sales, Operations, Product and Engineering.

What you'll do

Forecasting and planning

• Build and maintain FORT's driver-based three-statement model, linking bookings, revenue, gross margin, headcount, opex and cash.

• Run the monthly rolling forecast and quarterly reforecast, consolidating inputs from business leaders.

• Run the annual operating plan build on behalf of the VP, FP&A: templates, timeline, departmental budgets and review cycles.

• Build scenario and sensitivity analyses for decisions on hiring pace, pricing, new products and market expansion.

Performance reporting

• Deliver monthly budget-vs-actual and forecast-vs-actual analysis that explains drivers and recommends actions.

• Own the KPI dashboard: recurring revenue, bookings, gross margin by product line, unit economics and cash burn.

• Prepare analysis and scenario models for monthly business reviews, executive meetings, and board, investor and lender materials.

• Maintain the 13-week and longer-range cash forecast with Accounting and Treasury, and work with Accounting to align forecasts with close results and improve data quality.

Business partnership

• Act as finance partner to Sales, Operations, Product and Engineering, tracking headcount, vendor spend and program costs against plan.

• Model sales capacity, quota and pipeline coverage with Sales leadership

• Work side by side with Sales and Operations leaders on bookings and pipeline forecasts, demand and supply planning, inventory levels, production costs and gross margin, so plans reflect what is happening in the field and on the factory floor.

• Analyze pricing, product margin and investment decisions for hardware, software and services, and build business cases for new initiatives.

Systems and process

• In the future help select and implement a planning tool (e.g., Adaptive, Pigment, Anaplan) integrated with accounting systems and CRM.

• Use AI tools and automation to speed up reporting and analysis, with sound controls on accuracy and data security.

What you'll bring

• 5+ years in FP&A, corporate finance or investment banking, including 2+ years in FP&A at a growth-stage or public company.

• Expert financial modeling: you have built three-statement, driver-based and scenario models from scratch that held up to executive, investor or auditor review.

• Hands-on ownership of a monthly forecast, variance analysis and an annual operating plan cycle.

• A solid grasp of how GAAP results flow into forecasts, including revenue recognition for hardware, software and services.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, plus experience with a planning tool (e.g., Adaptive, Pigment, Mosaic)

• AI-savvy: hands-on use of AI tools to automate reporting and speed up analysis, with sound judgment on accuracy and data security.

• Clear communication: you turn numbers into a short story and recommendation for non-finance leaders.

• Comfort with ambiguity, fast timelines and building processes from scratch on a fully remote team.

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related field.

Nice to have

• Experience supporting fundraising, an IPO, a de-SPAC or other public-company transaction, or FP&A at a public company (guidance, earnings, consensus).

• Experience in robotics, industrial technology, hardware-plus-software or IoT businesses with mixed hardware, SaaS and services revenue.

• Implementation experience with Adaptive, Pigment, Mosaic, Anaplan or a similar planning platform.

• SQL or BI tool skills (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).

• MBA, CPA or CFA.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary range: $140,000-$170,000, based on experience and location.
Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited PTO; stock options; 3% 401(k) match, paid holidays, and parental leave.
Application window: Applications accepted through the end of December 2026. This date will be updated if the window is extended.

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. Job's mission

Support product structure management, configuration control, and product lifecycle execution across our semiconductor equipment portfolio.

Responsible for maintaining product configurations, bill of materials (BOMs), and engineering changes that enable accurate manufacturing, order fulfillment, and customer delivery. Work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Order Fulfillment, and Product Management teams to ensure product data accuracy throughout the lifecycle of released products.  Proficient in managing complex product data and ensuring accuracy across numerous configuration details. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple stakeholders.

Configuration Management Strategy & Product Structures

• Own and govern the product configuration architecture for EPI products, ensuring robust, scalable, and error-free product structures.

• Ensure product options, variants, and configurations accurately reflect engineering intent and manufacturing requirements.

• Review and validate configuration data to ensure consistency, completeness, and accuracy.

• Identify and resolve configuration discrepancies that may impact manufacturing, ordering, or shipment execution.

Product Lifecycle & Change Management

• Support implementation of Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) and Engineering Change Orders (ECOs).

• Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders to ensure that changes approved are accurately reflected in product structures and BOMs.

• Perform to change impact assessments and verify readiness for implementation.

Copy Exact BOM Strategy Ownership:

Cross-Functional Execution

• Participate in configuration reviews and readiness assessments for product changes and new product introductions.

• Support recurring execution reviews by tracking actions, risks, and open items related to product configurations.

Continuous Improvement

• Support configuration process improvements that enhance data quality, accuracy, and efficiency.

• Assist with standardization initiatives that reduce product complexity and improve maintainability.

• Help develop and maintain configuration documentation, work instructions, and best practices.

• Participate in root cause investigations for configuration-related issues and support corrective actions.

Experience and Qualification

• Experience supporting product lifecycle management, manufacturing engineering, product engineering, configuration management, or related technical functions.

• Familiarity with BOM structures, engineering changes, and product data management processes.

• Strong organizational and analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail.

• Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple functional teams and priorities.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with Bill of Materials (BOM), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Configurations, and SAP/ERP systems.

• Knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) and High-Volume Manufacturing (HVM) environments.

• Some experience supporting complex semiconductor capital equipment, including cross-functional coordination across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and product teams.

Competencies

• Extremely detail-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy and data quality.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks.

• Process-driven mindset with a commitment to consistency and execution excellence.

• Effective communicator who can collaborate across engineering, manufacturing, and operations teams.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to identify discrepancies within complex product structures.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment.

Qualification:

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or a related technical discipline with 1-3 years of relevant experience.

OR

• Master’s degree in an Engineering discipline

• Experience supporting product lifecycle management, manufacturing engineering, product engineering, configuration management, or related technical functions.

• Familiarity of BOM structures, configuration management, and product lifecycle management in the semiconductor industry.

• Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence engineering, operations, and commercial teams.

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

jobs.description:
Internship Program Overview

At ServiceNow, we’re looking for students who want to learn, grow, and take a giant step early in their careers, all while making a giant impact. We offer 12-week summer internship opportunities across various business functions.

Interns will participate in executive speaker series, career development workshops, philanthropic efforts, and team-building activities. Additionally, interns will have access to online learnings and a dedicated summer coach to further grow their careers with us.

If you want to make work, work better, we want you. To learn more, check out our Early Career Page!

Product Team Overview

We are looking for full-time MBA students to join our Product Management team at ServiceNow. As a Product Manager, you will work on complex high-tech problems by undertaking research, designing, and executing analysis, and helping frame and structure complex problems. You will work closely with other team members and stakeholders to accelerate our impact and directly contribute to our overall business strategy. This is an excellent opportunity if you are looking to get a taste of product management at a high-growth enterprise software company!

Product Management is a team sport at ServiceNow. We have a unique organization structure in which multiple Product Management roles work together to contribute to a product’s success.

We have two types of Product Managers within our teams: Inbound and Outbound

For the application: If you’re interested in both Inbound and Outbound Product Manager roles, please apply to your top choice only. Your application will automatically be considered for both roles. You are welcome to include your thoughts during the hiring manager notes.

For context: Outbound Product Managers enable Go-To-Market teams on product innovation and evangelize the product with customers and partners. Considered the product experts, they generally serve as the bridge between the inbound PM and the product marketing team to ensure the product gets to our customers.

For this role: Inbound Product Managers plan for and develop new products and future releases of a product. They gather feedback to determine the problems we're trying to solve, then generate a product roadmap. They work with various teams such as release management, design, and engineering development.

A few key responsibilities of Inbound PMs include:

• Set product vision & strategy

• Define the roadmap, requirements & product success metrics

• Develop and test innovative product ideas

• Work closely with customers to understand their needs and problems to be solved

• Own detailed competitive analysis for their feature/product

Additional possible responsibilities include:

• Support senior program managers and/or product managers across the entire project lifecycle to deliver critical programs for Service Now initiatives.

• Work and collaborate directly with Product Managers, Product Design, & Development Teams to build new features and improve adoption on existing features.

• Build familiarity with scrum process and willingness to contribute to team deliverables.

• Understand product strategy that sets us up for success as we look to grow to $15B+ in revenue.

• Research and collect product requirements from key buyer audiences and end-users to determine areas of opportunity for product enhancements.

• Oversee the product or project timeline, deadlines, milestones as it is being built by development/engineering and communicate with stakeholders to keep them updated.

• Contribute to the complete product lifecycle, from researching market needs and competition, analyzing customer data, writing product requirements, and delivering product features to market.

• Understand the technical and business impacts of product decisions that inform tradeoff decisions to optimize against product delivery and customer value.

Internship location may vary based on team growth strategies.

Required Qualifications

• Currently enrolled full-time at an accredited university pursuing an Masters in Engineering, Business Management, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Applied Sciences, or a related field.
• Graduating May 2028 or later.
• Available to work full-time for a 12-week summer internship.
• 0-3 years of related experience.
• Experience using or evaluating AI to improve workflows, decision-making, problem-solving, automation, or data-driven insights.
• Experience defining product requirements and translating them into a product roadmap.
• Strategic mindset with the ability to balance customer desirability, business viability, and technical feasibility.
• Strong prioritization, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with a data-driven and hypothesis-led approach.
• Deep curiosity about customer needs and a passion for building relationships and delivering high-value solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
• Experience collaborating with developers and designers to create compelling customer experiences.
• Demonstrated project management experience through internships, academic work, or personal projects.

Reporting to the Vice President of Human Resources, you will oversee recruiting strategy, lead and develop our Talent Acquisition Team, and partner closely with HR and Operations leaders to ensure our communities and corporate teams have the talent they need to succeed.

Build Strong Partnerships & Candidate Experiences

• Guide hiring managers on interviewing, candidate evaluation, selection strategies, and offer decisions.
• Ensure candidates receive a professional, responsive, and positive experience throughout the hiring process.

Strengthen Employer Branding & Talent Pipelines

• Develop sourcing strategies, job board relationships, and community and school partnerships.
• Promote internal mobility, employee referrals, and rehire programs that support retention and career growth.

Use Data to Drive Results

• Track and report recruiting KPIs, including time-to-fill, requisition aging, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, quality of hire, and early retention.
• Use recruiting metrics and labor market insights to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Manage recruiting budgets, vendor relationships, and agency usage while improving recruiting efficiency and cost-per-hire.
• Ensure recruiting practices, applicant records, and selection processes comply with applicable employment laws and Company policies.

What Success Looks Like

You will help ensure our communities and corporate teams remain fully staffed with qualified talent. Through effective recruiting strategies, strong hiring manager partnerships, and a well-developed talent pipeline, you will help reduce vacancy-related costs, improve quality of hire, and strengthen retention.

You will also build a high-performing TA team that delivers consistent results, maintains strong candidate relationships, and supports the continued growth of Cirrus.

• A minimum of five years of progressive full-cycle recruiting or Talent Acquisition experience, including at least two years in a lead or supervisory role. - Required
• Experience recruiting high-volume, hourly, and professional positions within a multi-site or multi-state organization. - Required
• Experience in multifamily property management. - Required
• Demonstrated success developing sourcing strategies, building talent pipelines, and using recruiting metrics to improve hiring outcomes.
• Strong knowledge of employment laws and compliant recruiting, interviewing, and selection practices.
• Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop recruiting professionals.
• Exceptional communication, organizational, relationship management, and consultative skills.
• Proficiency with applicant tracking systems, HRIS platforms, and Microsoft Office applications.
• Experience with SmartRecruiters, Yardi Voyager, Aspire, or comparable systems is preferred.
• A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
• SHRM-CP, PHR, or other relevant professional certifications are preferred.

Salary: $100,000 - $110,000 per year

Monday through Friday - 9:00 am - 6:00 pm

Three days per week will be in-office at our Irving, TX corporate office.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Back End
jobs.description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About the Role:

As a member of the Product and Engineering team at PitchBook, you will be part of a team of big thinkers, innovators, and problem solvers who strive to deepen the positive impact we have on our customers and our company every day. We value curiosity and the drive to find better ways of doing things. We thrive on customer empathy, which remains our focus when creating excellent customer experiences through product innovation.

We know that greatness is achieved through collaboration and diverse points of view, so we work closely with partners around the globe. As a team, we assume positive intent in each other’s words and actions, value constructive discussions, and foster a respectful working environment built on integrity, growth, and business value. We invest heavily in our people, who are eager to learn and constantly improve. Join our team and grow with us!

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Auth & Identity team, you will design, build, and run the secure, high-scale backend services behind how customers, agents, and systems access PitchBook products. You will own meaningful pieces of the platform end-to-end, from design through production, and be a trusted technical voice who raises the bar for the engineers around you. You work autonomously, bring opinions to design discussions, and use AI as a core part of how you build.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and operate secure, reliable backend services and APIs; own features end-to-end from requirements through production support

• Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows daily across design, coding, testing, and code review, applying human review and quality gates to everything AI produces

• Contribute to architecture and design discussions, weigh tradeoffs, and advocate for sound engineering decisions

• Perform code reviews, mentor peers, and support production systems, including deployments and incident response

• Partner with product managers, security, and engineering teams in an Agile environment

• Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors

• Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested

Skills and Qualifications:

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a similar field

• 5+ years of backend software engineering, including

• 5+ years of Java with production microservices

• 1 or more years experience using AI coding assistants and agentic tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) and prompt and context engineering in a professional environment

• Authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship now or in the future

• Ability to work onsite in Seattle daily

Preferred

• Experience with AWS and/or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Spring Boot and RESTful API design

• Strong testing discipline and a security-first mindset

• Experience owning production services end-to-end, including CI/CD, observability, SLOs, and on-call

• Track record of technical leadership: writing design docs, mentoring engineers, and driving work across teams

• Sound judgment in applying AI to engineering work: verifying, testing, and securing AI-generated code before it ships

• Familiarity with the Agentic Development Lifecycle (ADLC): building and evaluating LLM and agent features (RAG, tool calling, MCP), evals, observability, guardrails, and responsible AI practices

• Knowledge of identity and security standards such as OAuth 2.x, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM

• Distributed systems experience (Kafka, PostgreSQL, eventual consistency, idempotency)

• Excellent written and verbal communication

Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health

• Comprehensive health benefits

• Additional medical wellness incentives

• STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance

Emotional Health

• Paid sabbatical program after four years

• Paid family and paternity leave

• Annual educational stipend

• Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement

• CFA exam stipend

• Robust training programs on industry and soft skills

• Employee assistance program

• Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days

Social Health

• Matching gifts program

• Employee resource groups

• Subsidized emergency childcare

• Dependent Care FSA

• Company-wide events

• Employee referral bonus program

• Quarterly team building events

Financial Health

• 401k match

• Shared ownership employee stock program

• Monthly transportation stipend

*Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.

Compensation

• Annual base salary: $175,000-$215,000

• Target annual bonus percentage: 10%

Working Conditions:

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

We are excited to get to know you and your background. Concerned that you might not meet every requirement? We encourage you to still apply as you might be the right candidate for the role or other roles at PitchBook.
