jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Summary

Zoro.com is a leading eCommerce platform offering nearly 12 million tools, parts and supplies for our business customers. Launched in 2011, we brought a B2C-like experience to the B2B industry, and continue to be at the forefront of digital innovation at the intersection of technology and distribution. We have rapidly grown to over $1 billion in annual revenue and we’re just getting started!

Job Summary:

As a Senior Engineering Manager on Growth and Commerce Engineering in the AI org, you’ll lead product engineering teams that build and run customer-facing experiences and the platforms/services that power them. You’ll partner with Product and Design to turn customer problems into shipped experiences that measurably move key business outcomes, while keeping critical systems secure, reliable, and compliant. Work closely with Product Management, Design, Research, Analytics, the Staff Engineer group, data product teams, Data Engineering, and Machine Learning teams to align on strategy, execution, and outcomes.

AI is changing both how commerce works and how software gets built. You'll bring a practical understanding of AI and agentic systems to both. That means building AI-powered and agent-ready customer experiences, including the coming shift where AI agents research and buy on behalf of business customers. It also means leading teams that use AI tools and agents to build, test, and ship faster without lowering the quality bar. You'll keep strong hands-on technical skill and occasionally contribute directly to high-impact work, especially around quality, testing, and AI-assisted engineering.

Key Responsibilities

Product and Technical Leadership

• Partner with Product Management and Design to shape the roadmap. Size and sequence the work, weigh technical tradeoffs, and commit to customer and business outcomes such as conversion, approval rates, and order growth.

• Set and execute technical direction for customer-facing commerce experiences. Emphasize robust, scalable, well-tested services that comply with industry standards (PCI/SOX/NIST).

• Build experimentation and instrumentation into the product so teams can test ideas quickly and measure impact on the funnel.

• Ensure predictable, timely, high-quality delivery of large initiatives through planning, prioritization, and alignment with organizational goals and capacity.

• Keep hands-on technical expertise and contribute directly to critical engineering work when it matters most.

AI and Agentic Engineering

• Lead the design and delivery of AI-powered commerce features, such as smarter product discovery, assisted quoting and reordering, and personalized checkout.

• Prepare Zoro's commerce platform for agentic commerce, where AI agents browse, compare, and buy on behalf of customers. Help define the APIs, permissions, payment and fraud controls, and emerging standards that let agents transact safely.

• Set the standards for building with LLMs and agents in production, including evaluation, guardrails, observability, cost, latency, and responsible handling of customer and payment data.

• Drive adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic developer tools across the team. Measure their impact on speed and quality, and build the practices that keep AI-generated code secure and well tested.

• Stay current on the fast-moving AI landscape and help the team separate real value from hype.

People Leadership and Team Development

• Lead and mentor one or more product engineering teams, building a culture of customer focus, technical excellence, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

• Give clear, actionable feedback and growth opportunities, and help engineers build new skills in AI and agentic development.

• Hire, develop, and retain strong engineers and future leaders.

Operational Excellence

• Champion process and tooling improvements, including AI-assisted testing, code review, and delivery, to raise efficiency and reduce technical debt.

• Align team capacity and initiatives with organizational priorities.

• Own the team's infrastructure, third-party tool, and AI model and usage costs. Make sure leadership understands the cost and value of the team's spending.

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Work closely with Product Management, Design, Research, Analytics, the Staff Engineer group, and data product teams to align on strategy, execution, and outcomes.

• Partner with Finance, Security, Legal, and Compliance on payments, fraud, and responsible AI requirements.

• Communicate technical strategy and project status to technology leadership and business stakeholders. Adapt to each audience's technical level, and raise it through education and explanation, including on what AI can and can't do.

Incident Management and Reliability

• Oversee proactive monitoring, incident response, and systemic improvements for revenue-critical purchase flows, including AI-powered features where model behavior can fail in new ways.

• Take part in the enterprise-wide on-call rotation and lead engineers through critical real-time issues.

• Drive root cause analysis to find and fix the causes of incidents. Mentor and support more junior managers in their RCAs where needed.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Help influence the roadmap by partnering with Product Management and Design.

• Accountable for technical design, quality, implementation, and delivery of their team’s work.

• Manage the performance and career growth of team members.

• Perform regular one-on-ones and provide timely and constructive feedback.

• Lead your engineers using Zoro values and help them execute initiatives.

• Clear the road for the team by identifying and removing obstacles.

• Ensure Zoro's engineering standards and best practices are followed.

• Collaborate and partner with our customer experience, marketing, and other amazing teams at Zoro.

• Be a thought leader for your team and your peers.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5+ years leading engineering teams.

• Proven experience leading product engineering teams that build customer-facing digital experiences, ideally in ecommerce, or other transactional products, with measurable impact on business outcomes.

• Strong partnership with Product Management and Design, with a track record of turning customer and business needs into shipped capabilities.

• Hands-on understanding of AI and agentic systems, including LLMs, prompting, retrieval, tool use, and agent workflows, and how to evaluate, ship, and run them responsibly in production.

• Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agentic developer tools, and leading a team in adopting them effectively.

• Deep technical expertise in distributed systems, APIs and integrations, and cloud-native infrastructure.

• Demonstrated senior-engineer-level skill, with direct contributions to complex, critical technical work.

• Experience putting rigorous testing, experimentation, and reliability practices in place for high-traffic, revenue-critical systems.

• Exceptional leadership and mentorship skills, with a record of developing engineering leaders and building high-performing, inclusive teams.

• Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to explain technical vision, tradeoffs, and AI opportunities and risks to senior business leaders.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Advanced degree (Master's or equivalent) in a technical field.

• Significant involvement in technology planning, tech leadership decisioning, performance turning and monitoring, resource budgeting, and resource allocation decisions.

• Experience with experimentation, funnel optimization, and conversion-rate improvement.

• Experience with B2B ecommerce or complex business purchasing journeys, such as quoting, quote-to-order, or negotiated pricing.

• Experience with payments, payment authorization, fraud detection, or PCI-compliant systems.

• Experience shipping LLM-powered or agentic features to customers at scale, including evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring.

• Familiarity with agentic commerce, such as making catalogs, carts, and checkout usable by AI agents, and the emerging protocols and standards for agent-driven transactions.

Total Rewards

Zoro’s total compensation plan includes our Zoro Incentive Plan (ZIP) that is designed to foster and reward our team members for strong performance. Total compensation will be highly competitive.

In addition to competitive compensation, Zoro offers comprehensive benefits and perks including:

• Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans with coverage starting on day one of employment

• Maternity support programs, nursing benefits, and up to 14 weeks paid leave for birth parents and up to 4 weeks paid leave for non-birth parents. We also support growing your family through access to adoption assistance program

• 6 free sessions each year with a licensed therapist and Wellhub portal membership to support your mental and emotional wellbeing

• At least 18 paid time off days annually for full-time employees and 6 company holidays per year

• 6% company contribution to a 401K Retirement Savings Plan each pay period, no employee contribution required

• Tuition reimbursement, student loan refinancing and access to financial counseling, education, and tools

• Charitable Gift Program - match gift to an eligible educational, cultural, community health, and human service organizations

• Employee discounts and admission to various civic and cultural institutions around Chicago

• Zoro office perks including coffee bar, beer on tap, unlimited snacks, access to the onsite gym, and incredible city skyline views

For additional information and details regarding our benefits and our parent company, W. W. Grainger, please click on the link here.

The pay range provided is not a guarantee of compensation. The range listed reflects the expected base pay for this position at the time of posting, based on the role's job grade. Actual compensation may vary depending on factors such as location, relevant experience and individual qualifications.

Illinois

$136,800—$228,000 USD

Our Culture

Zoro was founded in 2011 with a simple idea: make it easy for businesses to get the tools, parts, and supplies they need to keep things running. We've grown by staying curious, moving quickly, and solving everyday challenges in smart, practical ways. Backed by W.W. Grainger and inspired by our endless assortment business model, we’re on a clear path toward our next big milestone: $2 billion in revenue—and beyond.

At Zoro, we don’t just follow a playbook—we help build it. You’ll get to work on real problems with a supportive team that shares ideas freely, learns from each other, and celebrates wins together. Our culture is grounded in values that guide how we show up every day: Winning & Learning Together, Being Customer Obsessed, Being Transparent, and Taking Ownership. We don’t have all the answers, but we’re always asking good questions.

Zoro’s culture has been recognized by Fortune, Best Places to Work, and Built In Chicago—but the recognition we care about most comes from our team members, who make this place what it is.

We also know that flexibility matters. Our hybrid work model gives you space to focus and the flexibility to live your life — asking team members to be onsite at least two days a week. Our Chicago HQ (right above Ogilvie Transportation Center in the Accenture Tower) is always open and ready for connection, collaboration, or just a good cup of coffee.

At Zoro, we’re growing fast toward big aspirations — and we’re continuously excited about the new challenges we get to solve together.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are also committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible work environment that includes both providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities during the application and hiring process as well as throughout the course of one’s employment. Should you need a reasonable accommodation during the application and selection process, including, but not limited to use of our website, any part of the application, interview, or hiring process, please advise us so that we can provide appropriate assistance.

jobs.title: H&M Sales Advisor - South Park Mall, OH
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $14.25 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director of Growth Marketing
jobs.description:
About Us
At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since our founding in 2016, we’ve helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through our leading AI-native Platform of Action.

Over 55K legal professionals and 450+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud-based technology, configurable AI-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need.

About the Role
We're hiring a Director of Growth Marketing to own and lead Litify's pipeline engine. You'll lead Demand Generation, paid media, lifecycle marketing, and the growth channels that continue to scale our pipeline and funnel – partnering closely with Field Marketing, Content, BDR, and Marketing Operations to keep evolving our pipeline and funnel model.

Our next stage of growth is about scale and efficiency: maturing our channel mix, unlocking more from paid and owned channels, and improving how MQLs convert to pipeline. We're looking for a strategic operator who sees the full picture across channels, knows where the next dollar should go, and keeps testing and optimizing to unlock growth.

You'll report to the VP of Marketing and drive growth across all of our verticals.

What You'll Do:

• Own the growth strategy and pipeline plan – set MQL, SQL, and pipeline targets by segment, and lead the channel mix, budget, and forecast to hit them

• Continuously unlock growth across our demand gen channels – evaluate performance, shift spend toward what works, and improve conversion from MQL to pipeline

• Lead paid media – own the paid budget and agency partnership, and scale search, social, review sites, and ABM/intent programs

• Lead owned and lifecycle channels – email, nurture, website conversion, webinars, and SEO/GEO

• Lead integrated demand gen campaigns – plan and run multi-channel campaigns that support business priorities, like product launches and key verticals, built with pipeline in mind

• Own and scale account and lead prioritization – lead and evolve scoring and intent signals across all programs to ensure ICP fit, including tiered ABM

• Drive a culture of testing – across channels, offers, and audiences, doubling down on what works

• Partner across marketing and GTM – work closely with the marketing team and cross-functional partners in Sales, Product Marketing, and RevOps on targets, campaigns, and the data behind the funnel, including integrated campaigns that amplify our events

• Build and lead the team – grow and coach the Demand Generation team, with room for your scope to grow as the team scales

• Own performance reporting – pipeline, CAC, and ROI for the exec team and board

What You Bring:

• 8+ years in B2B SaaS growth or demand generation, ideally at Series B/C or growth-stage companies

• A proven track record of building pipeline and scaling GTM demand gen channels and programs

• A track record of leading a broad mix of demand gen channels – paid media and agency partners, plus owned and lifecycle (email, nurture, website conversion, SEO) — and being accountable for their results

• Experience building lead and account scoring and prioritization using intent signals and tiered ABM to focus on the right accounts

• Strategic and analytical – you build the forecast and channel mix, and use funnel data, attribution, CAC, and ROI to make decisions

• Experience partnering closely with Sales, BDR, and Marketing Ops teams

• Hands-on with Salesforce and Marketo (or similar)

• A player-coach – as comfortable executing as setting strategy and ready to build the team as it grows

Nice to Have:

• Legal tech, legal, or professional services experience

• SEO and GEO (AI search) experience

• Experience building growth programs with AI tools and automation

Disclosure:
This job is fully remote, with the exception of employees living in New York City and New Jersey. Our NYC/NJ employees adhere to our hybrid schedule, which involves working in our Manhattan office 6 days a month.

The estimated base salary pay range for this role is $170,000-190,000. You will also be offered a bonus and benefits.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

jobs.title: General Manager - Optical
jobs.description:
See your leadership skills in focus!

As a General Manager, you’ll lead a talented team, drive results, and create an amazing experience for both patients and associates every single day.

The General Manager is responsible for the overall success, sales, and profitability of the store. This includes managing all aspects of operations — from financial performance and team leadership to merchandising, training, and patient care.

You’ll set the tone for a positive, high-energy environment where exceptional service and teamwork thrive.

What You’ll Do

• Oversee all daily store operations, including staffing, inventory management, bookkeeping, planning, and enforcing company policies.

The ideal candidate will possess comprehensive expertise across the full PCIe protocol stack - from the Physical Layer (PHY) through the Data Link Layer and up to the Transaction/Transport Layer - with a proven track record in hardware/firmware design, protocol implementation, and complex link bring-up and debugging.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
Hi, Future Homie!

At Homebase, you’ll join a team that’s bold, fast-moving, and obsessed with helping small businesses thrive. We build with empathy, act with urgency, and take big swings that drive real-world impact. Here, every Homie shows up to raise the bar, support one another, and celebrate wins as a team.

We’re not just building an app—we’re building unstoppable teams. So what do you say, are you in?


 📍Your Impact Starts Here

We're hiring a Revenue Enablement Specialist to build and scale enablement across all of our frontline teams. You'll create high-impact learning paths and drive measurable outcomes for the people who talk to our customers every day. You'll partner closely with frontline managers to diagnose performance gaps and design scalable learning solutions that support revenue growth and drive strong customer outcomes.

This is a flex role. In any given week, you may be a trainer running a live session, an analyst digging into performance data, a builder shipping a new learning asset, or a coach supporting a manager or an individual. You're comfortable living in the gray, can make progress without a perfect plan, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

You'll work closely with our Director, Revenue Enablement, and be the boots-on-the-ground presence for our Denver/Houston frontline teams. If you love building programs that change behavior (not just fill a deck) while impacting core business metrics, this role is for you.

These are the key ways you’ll contribute and create impact in this role:

Onboarding & Continuous Learning

 - Own day-to-day execution of new hire onboarding, including schedules, invites, and making sure content is loaded and ready.

 - Deliver engaging, interactive, high-energy training sessions (virtual, in-person, and self-paced) for audiences at all levels, tailored to each frontline role.

 - Keep onboarding and ongoing learning materials up to date as products, processes, and tools evolve.

Diagnose and Consult

 - Partner with business leaders, frontline managers, and subject matter experts to run needs assessments that surface critical skill and knowledge gaps across frontline teams.

 - Use performance, pipeline, and customer data to pinpoint where behavior needs to change, and turn coaching requests from managers into scalable solutions.

 - Translate product updates, partner announcements, and strategy or process changes into clear, ready-to-use enablement for the field.

Design and Build

 - Design and develop learning programs using a blended approach: e-learning, virtual classrooms, workshops, microlearning, and performance support tools.

 - Create talk tracks, decks, one-pagers, guides, role-play tools, and interactive activities, applying adult learning principles, reinforcement loops, and impact measurement so learning sticks.

 - Build and maintain a centralized, current, easy-to-find repository of enablement content, mapped to the right audience and use case.

Coach and Reinforce

 - Reinforce best practices through ongoing sessions, live support, and coaching materials.

 - Help managers coach their teams more effectively with the resources and structure they need.

Measure and Improve

 - Track adoption, completion, and assessment results, and grade evaluations to surface knowledge gaps quickly.

 - Evaluate the effectiveness of learning initiatives, report on key metrics, and make evidence-based recommendations for continuous improvement.

 - Configure and prompt our conversation intelligence tool to surface skill gaps, trends, and coaching opportunities.

Run the program

 - Manage the full project lifecycle, from initial consultation and design through delivery and evaluation, on time and within budget.

 - Serve as a power user of our enablement tech stack (CRM, conversation intelligence, and AI tools).

 - Build strong relationships with cross-functional partners, including Product Marketing, RevOps, and leadership, to integrate learning into broader talent and business strategy.

 - Stay current on trends, tools, and adult learning research, and bring in what makes our programs better.



🚀 The Foundation for Success - These are the experiences and strengths that will set you up for success in this role:

 - 5+ years in a training, instructional design, or revenue enablement role, preferably in a growth-oriented setting.

 - Proven success designing and running learning and enablement initiatives tied to business results.

 - Experience building enablement programs for revenue-generating and customer-facing teams, such as sales, account management, and customer experience, ideally using AI and automation tools.

 - Expertise in adult learning principles and instructional design, and strong facilitation skills (commanding a room, interactivity, gamification).

 - Demonstrated ability to use data analytics to evaluate learning and performance, including hands-on experience with CRM reporting and conversation intelligence tools.

 - Hands-on experience with an LMS, plus familiarity with coaching and content management systems.

 - Proven experience prompting AI tools to improve workflows, generate content, and extract insights.

 - Comfort with ambiguity: you thrive in the gray, can flex between trainer, analyst, builder, and coach, and make good decisions with incomplete information.

 - Ability to build strong relationships and work with a broad range of stakeholders.

 - Ability to manage time, prioritize, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, start-up environment.

 - This is a hybrid role (non-negotiable). You must be able to work in our Denver/Houston office Monday – Thursday.



🤝  The Homie Way - These principles guide everything we do—from how we work and make decisions to how we show up for each other.

 - 💡 Be Customer Obsessed – Solve problems with empathy and creativity.

 - ⚡ Move Fast, Learn Fast – Experiment, take action, and grow every day.

 - 🎯 Own Your Impact – Think big, focus on what matters, and make decisions you stand behind.

 - 🏆 Master Your Craft – Excellence fuels impact—show up, step up, and make your mark.

 - 🏅 Win Together – Put goals over roles, lead with trust, and connect to our mission and each other.



What We Offer 

 - 💰 Ownership & Financial Security: Stock options + 401(k) with 4% match

 - 🏥 Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage + FSA options

 - ⏰ Paid Time Off: Flexible PTO + company holidays + designated focus periods

 - 🤖 AI access, for real: We invest in builders and believe that curiosity shouldn't have a paywall. That means you'll have access to paid AI tools with minimal restrictions, so you can build, experiment, and level up your craft.

 - 👶 Family Support: Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave (after 6 months of service)

 - 🛡️ Protection Plans: Life insurance + short/long-term disability coverage

 - 🌟 Work Your Way: Work From Anywhere Month + meeting-free weeks yearly

 - 🍽️ Workspace Perks: Meals provided, commuter benefits, team offsites, and Customer Days

 - 💼 Our Hybrid Rhythm: We believe collaboration drives impact. That’s why Monday-Thursday are our required in-office days—a time to move faster as a team, build deeper connections, make better decisions, and build together.



What to Expect During the Interview Process 

We’re reviewing applications as they come in, and momentum builds as we head into the new year. We’re aiming for a January start date for this role.

 - Meet the Talent Acquisition team

 - Meet the Hiring Manager, Ana Hey-Colon https://www.linkedin.com/in/ana-hey-colon/

 - Participate in a Talent Showcase

 - Meet Cross-functional Partners

 - Background Check + Offer Stage

 - Welcome to the team, Homie 🎉



💜 Belonging at Homebase - We're committed to fostering a welcoming space where every Homie can be their full self. Experience comes in many forms—so if you're excited about this role, even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply! 



👋 Hey, We’re Homebase

Homebase is the everything app for hourly teams—built to simplify the day-to-day and superpower local businesses. With tools for scheduling, time clocks, payroll, communication, HR, and more, we help teams stay connected and in control. Today, over 150,000 small (but mighty) businesses rely on us to make work radically easier. Together, we’ve tracked over a billion hours for 2M+ workers—and we’re just getting started.

At Homebase, we celebrate diversity and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all candidates and do not discriminate based on any legally protected status. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know—we’re committed to ensuring fair and equitable access for all.

Our Scarborough, ME laboratory is seeking an entry-level Field Services Technician to join their team!

Field Service Technicians are responsible for collecting environmental water, soil, and air samples to be analyzed for numerous industrial and municipal clients. The ideal candidate should enjoy working with their hands and be able to troubleshoot problems that come up in the field.  Daily tasks can vary greatly.  Typical tasks include communicating with team members, clients, and vendors, traveling to sites, maintaining equipment, preparing sampling containers, collecting samples, and completing documentation requirements.  Sample collection practices include several methods of collecting groundwater with pumps and bailers, using programmable instrumentation to collect composite samples of effluent and wastewater, and using meters to record field conditions. Field Service Technicians also provide routine and technical laboratory support services when not on field sampling assignments.

The Medical Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Medical Assistant is a member of the health care team primarily responsible for providing support to physicians, nurses, and other licensed medical staff by facilitating efficient patient flow, assisting with various patient care activities, and performing related administrative functions. The Medical Assistant is responsible for ensuring efficient patient flow through the clinic; maintaining neat, clean and safe patient care areas; promoting patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner; safeguarding patient confidentiality.

Obtains accurate vital signs, per organization standards. Documents reason for visit and updates/confirms, allergies, smoking history and pharmacy information. Promptly informs the provider and registered nurse of any significant change in vital signs or acute symptoms. Anticipates/sets up equipment or supplies needed for visit. Cleans and prepares exam room for next patient. Responds to needs to expedite visits and maintain flow of patients and prioritize tasks accordingly.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
In today's dynamic worksites, seamless collaboration between people and machines is essential. FORT's platform ensures safe, secure, and dynamic control that surpasses legacy systems and next-generation AI capabilities.

While autonomous machines offer significant advantages, they also introduce new safety challenges. FORT addresses these concerns by providing solutions such as the Wireless E-Stop, which allows operators to instantly stop any machine from a safe distance, enhancing safety during emergencies.

Additionally, FORT's Safe Remote Control enables operators to manage heavy machinery remotely, reducing the risk of accidents and improving visibility.

By ensuring communications integrity across any network, FORT empowers customers to protect their most valuable assets—people, data, and machines—ensuring they remain safe and secure.

The Accounting Manager runs FORT's day-to-day accounting and the monthly close. You will own the accuracy of the general ledger, lead a small team, and build the processes and controls a public company needs.

Your close is the foundation for everything downstream: FP&A forecasts, SEC filings, and the audit. You will work closely with the VP, Accounting, the Head of SEC Reporting, FP&A, operations, and our external auditors.

What you'll do

Run the close

• Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, delivering accurate financial statements on a defined calendar aligned with a public company timeline.

• Review journal entries, account reconciliations, and balance sheet and P&L flux analyses.

• Supervise AP, AR, payroll accounting, fixed assets, accruals, prepaids, and equity-related entries, including stock compensation.

Own the complex areas

• Apply ASC 606 to hardware, software, subscription and services arrangements, including contract review, standalone selling prices and deferred revenue.

• Manage inventory and cost accounting with operations: standard costing, variance analysis, excess and obsolete reserves, cycle counts and COGS.

Build controls and scale

• Design, document, and operate internal controls over financial reporting and help prepare FORT for SOX 404 compliance.

• Own close-related audit requests, prepare schedules for the annual audit and quarterly reviews, and support tax filings and SEC reporting.

• Improve close speed and quality through automation, ERP tools, and related tools.

Lead the team

• Hire, train, and develop staff accountants in a remote team; set clear priorities and review their work.

What you'll bring

• Bachelor's degree in accounting or a related field; CPA strongly preferred.

• 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 2+ years in public accounting (Big 4 or national firm preferred).

• 2+ years managing or supervising accountants, including reviewing their work.

• Hands-on ownership of a month-end close in an ERP.

• Strong US GAAP knowledge, especially ASC 606 revenue recognition and inventory and cost accounting.

• Experience designing or operating internal controls, ideally under SOX or in preparation for it.

• A track record of improving close speed and quality while keeping deadlines.

• Clear, organized communication suited to a fully remote team.

Nice to have

• Experience at a hardware, manufacturing, robotics or technology company.

• Experience at a public company or a company preparing for an IPO.

• Experience implementing close automation or reconciliation tools (e.g., FloQast, BlackLine).

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary range: $135,000-$165,000, based on experience and location.
Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited PTO; stock options; 3% 401(k) match, paid holidays, and parental leave.
Application window: Applications accepted through the end of December 2026. This date will be updated if the window is extended.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, GTM Strategy & Operations, Square

jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

As the Senior Manager, GTM Strategy & Operations, you'll be a strategic partner to Square's Revenue leaders and own the most consequential decisions shaping how our go-to-market organization is structured, prioritized, and scaled across the full seller lifecycle — from acquisition and conversion through retention, expansion, and portfolio growth. You'll partner with senior leaders across Sales, Account Management, Partnerships, Finance, Data Science, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to translate company priorities into clear GTM direction and shape the bets that define Square's revenue trajectory.

This is a hands-on strategic role. You'll define the right questions, bring an independent point of view on where our GTM motions need to evolve, and influence executive decisions through structured frameworks, operational rigor, and sharp written narrative. You'll also stay close to execution — building prototypes, owning complex cross-functional workstreams end-to-end, and raising the analytical bar across the team.

Your work will shape planning and investment strategy, the operating cadence of Revenue leadership, the design of Square's GTM motion across segmentation and coverage, and the executive narrative that aligns cross-functional partners around our most important bets. This role is designed to flex across the Revenue organization — anchored in Strategy & Ops with scope that can shift across acquisition and post-sale motions based on where the business most needs leverage. You will report to the Director of GTM Strategy & Operations and will mentor junior members of the team.

Key Responsibilities

GTM Strategy

• Serve as a thought partner to senior Revenue leaders, helping shape business priorities, resource allocation, and performance strategy across the GTM organization.

• Partner with Revenue leadership and Finance to design the GTM motion — including segmentation, territory and coverage models, engagement strategies, and the operating playbooks that scale across acquisition and post-sale.

• Own complex, cross-functional strategic initiatives end-to-end: problem framing, business case, stakeholder alignment, execution, and post-launch measurement.

Performance & Business Insights

• Analyze pipeline, productivity, and lifecycle performance data to diagnose gaps and surface initiatives that improve conversion, deal velocity, retention, and expansion outcomes.

• Partner with Data Science and Finance to define KPIs, build executive-ready dashboards, and own the WBR/MBR cadence that keeps Revenue leadership close to the business.

• Translate complex analyses into executive-ready performance narratives and recommendations that drive leadership decisions and shape strategic bets.

Cross-Functional Execution & Program Management

• Lead cross-functional workstreams across the Revenue organization and its partner teams, driving clarity, alignment, and structure through ambiguity.

• Translate business goals into clear technical requirements (PRDs/BRDs) and partner with technical teams to deliver programs on time and to spec.

• Break large, multi-quarter initiatives into pilots and iterations; manage the roadmap in collaboration with leadership and cross-functional partners.

AI, Automation & Process Innovation

• Identify and champion AI-native opportunities to increase rep productivity across the full seller lifecycle — from prospecting and acquisition through portfolio management, retention, and expansion.

• Partner with CRM, Systems, and Engineering on the design of process, policy, and system architecture, including routing, SLAs, rules of engagement, segmentation, and handoffs.

• Stay at the frontier of AI-native GTM tooling and bring proven new approaches into the team's playbook.

• Raise the AI-native operating bar across the GTM Strategy & Ops team — model what hands-on AI fluency looks like for other operators.

Team Leadership & Craft

• Mentor junior members of the GTM Strategy & Ops team; raise the bar on analytical rigor, written communication, and executive-ready output.

• • Model the operating standards (ownership, bias to action, builder mindset) that define how the team works.

You have:

• 8+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience in GTM / Revenue Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, or Management Consulting — ideally within SaaS, FinTech, or high-growth technology.

• Proven track record of leading global, cross-functional strategic initiatives that drive measurable revenue, retention, or expansion outcomes.

• Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level stakeholders through structured analysis, clear narratives, and strong business judgment.

• Strong commercial instincts; comfort tying strategic decisions to investment prioritization and revenue outcomes.

• AI-native operating mindset: fluent with AI/LLMs in day-to-day work, hands-on with workflow automation, and energized by shipping real tools that remove manual work from the team.

• Expertise in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), GTM analytics tools (Looker, Snowflake, or equivalents), and SQL for independent data analysis.

• Executive-ready written and verbal communication — able to distill complex analyses into clear leadership narratives and board-level recommendations.

jobs.title: Director of Communications
jobs.description:
About TensorWave

Our mission is simple: deliver seamless, secure, reliable, and resilient AI compute at scale. We've built a versatile cloud platform that eliminates infrastructure barriers, empowering builders to focus on innovation instead of fighting their stack. Because breakthrough AI should move at the speed of ideas, not infrastructure.



About the Role

We’re looking for a Director of Communications to join our team during an exciting phase of growth. In this role, you’ll be responsible for owning TensorWave’s external narrative across media, analyst, investor, and community audiences, working closely with cross-functional partners to support business objectives while upholding our standards for excellence, collaboration, and impact.

What You’ll Do

 - News Engine: Build and own TensorWave's communications calendar, turning product launches, capacity milestones, partnerships, and company news into a steady cadence of earned coverage.

 - Media Relations: Develop direct, working relationships with reporters across technology, data center, and business media. Pitch and place stories independently rather than relying solely on agencies.

 - Business & Financial Narrative: Shape how TensorWave's growth story reaches business and capital markets audiences, partnering with Finance and leadership on funding announcements and other investor-relevant news.

 - Executive Counsel: Serve as media advisor to TensorWave’s broader leadership team, preparing briefing materials and talking points and supporting leaders through interviews and press moments.

 - Reputation & Issues Management: Maintain response protocols and ongoing media monitoring, coordinating closely with Legal and leadership so the company responds quickly and consistently when sensitive situations arise.

 - Community & Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with Government Affairs on community and policy narratives connected to data center expansion and new markets.

 - Analyst Relations: Build relationships with the firms that influence how buyers evaluate AI infrastructure providers, and make sure TensorWave is accurately represented in their research.

 - Thought Leadership: Develop and place executive bylines and op-eds, and secure high-value speaking opportunities in coordination with the internal speaker program.

 - Partner Communications: Coordinate with ecosystem partners on joint announcements and co-branded news.

 - Agency Management: Lead the day-to-day relationship with TensorWave's existing PR agency, directing their work toward the highest-value opportunities and holding the team accountable to outcomes.

 - Measurement: Own communications reporting, tracking share of voice against competitors and connecting earned media to brand and pipeline goals.



Who You Are

Required Qualifications

 - 10+ years in public relations or corporate communications, including time leading PR programs at a high-growth technology company.

 - Proven track record of securing coverage in top-tier technology and business outlets.

 - Established relationships with reporters covering enterprise technology as well as business and financial news.

 - Experience advising senior executives and preparing spokespeople for high-profile interviews.

 - Calm, sound judgment under pressure, with experience guiding a company through sensitive or fast-moving news cycles.

 - Exceptional writer who can make complex infrastructure stories clear and compelling for technical and business readers alike.

 - Comfortable building process from the ground up in a fast-scaling, ambiguous environment.

 - Data-driven, with a history of tying communications work to measurable business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience at a data center or B2B AI infrastructure company.

 - Experience supporting funding announcements or other news aimed at the investor community.

 - Familiarity with analyst relations in cloud and AI infrastructure markets.

 - Experience managing joint announcements with hardware or semiconductor partners.



What We Offer

 - Stock Options

 - 100% paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance for Employees

 - Company Health Savings Account Contributions

 - 100% paid Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance for Employees

 - Life and Voluntary Supplemental Insurance Options

 - Other Insurance Options, such as Pet & Legal Insurance

 - Various Supplementary Health Benefits, such as discounted Virtual Healthcare Appointments and Serious Illness Support

 - Flexible Spending Account

 - 401(k)

 - Employee Assistance Program

 - Flexible PTO

 - Paid Holidays

 - Parental Leave

 - Other In-Office Perks

TensorWave is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected status under applicable law.

TensorWave provides reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact accomodations@tensorwave.com.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative I
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is building the payment layer for life's financial obligations, giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By offering greater choice over how and when payments are made and allowing eligible on time payments to help build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.

That work brings together people with different perspectives who challenge the status quo and take ownership of solving difficult problems. For you, that means doing the best work of your career next to people who make you better, and together bringing ideas to life that make a real impact for the people we serve.

About the role

Flex is on a mission to change the way bills get paid, starting with rent. We give renters more flexibility and control over one of their biggest monthly expenses, and we give the property management companies we partner with a modern, easy way to offer that flexibility to their residents. As we grow, we're looking for our next SDR to help bring more Property Management Companies into the Flex family.

This is a foundational role on a high-performing sales team, and it's designed to be the start of a real career, not just a first job. You'll be on the front lines building the pipeline that fuels our growth — and you'll be developed deliberately from day one through the Flex Sales Onboarding & Enablement, not just thrown into the deep end.

Where you'll work: This role is hybrid out of our Salt Lake City office (Lehi, UT), and you'll be in with the team 3 days a week. We're big believers that some of the best coaching, energy, and deals happen in person (and honestly, the team is pretty fun to be around). As a bonus, you'll get a Grubhub credit for lunch on the days you're in the office.

Where you'll travel: Beyond SLC, you'll get out of the office for company offsites in Mexico and our Sales Kickoff in Florida as well as onboarding in NYC , both built for big wins, big energy, and time to connect with the team outside the day to day grind.

What You’ll Do

• Win new client relationships, driving revenue and market share across the rental real estate space.

• Manage a robust pipeline in our CRM, keeping it sharp and up to date.

• Tailor creative prospecting approaches for different personas across each business you target.

• Establish relationships with senior executives and decision-makers through smart, persistent outbound efforts.

• Follow up quickly and efficiently on every inbound lead you receive.

• Educate prospective customers on how Flex helps property management companies offer their residents real financial flexibility.

• Collaborate with our Accounts team to shape strategic adoption plans for new customers.

• Take initiative, jumping into ad-hoc projects across the sales org.

You Could Be a Great Fit If

• You're a self-starter who's genuinely hungry for success.

• You have excellent written and verbal communication skills — you know how to make someone want to keep talking to you.

• You build relationships with middle management and ownership quickly and authentically.

• You move fast, stay flexible, and don't need everything mapped out to get started.

• You thrive both working independently and collaborating with a team.

How We Set You Up

• A structured first 90 days — foundational training, tool ramp, and your first certifications, building toward your first real production.

• Hands-on certifications, not just training modules — you'll prove you can actually do the work, evaluated against a clear, consistent standard every SDR is held to.

• An assigned AE mentor and a manager who coaches you weekly, not just at review time.

• Ongoing enablement long after ramp ends — monthly development themes, team-wide visibility into what's working, and campaigns focused on where the market is moving.

• A real, defined path forward — promotion to SDR II is earned through clear, objective criteria, and from there, real tracks into Account Executive or Account Management roles.

Why Flex

• Strong onboarding, built to set you up for real success — we invest in ramping you right, not just throwing you into the deep end

• Revenue enablement that never stops — ongoing coaching and resources designed to sharpen your skills long after ramp is over

• Mentorship, built in — you'll learn directly from peers and senior sales folks who want to see you win, not just hit your own number

• A real career path — this is a role to grow in, not just grow out of

• A team that's winning — you'll be surrounded by top performers who are closing deals and hitting numbers, with the energy and momentum that comes from being part of a team that's actually putting up results

Compensation

The compensation range for this role will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and Flex's internal leveling guidelines and benchmarks. This is a commission earning role. The OTE (On Target Earnings) listed below:

OTE (NYC/Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle)

$68,000—$85,000 USD

OTE (Salt Lake City, all other USA cities)

$64,000—$72,250 USD

Life at Flex

Building a successful company takes a diverse team of intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self-aware people. Our headquarters is in New York City, with employees across the US, Australia, Canada, and South America. We’re growing quickly and deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. We value the perspectives our people bring and take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

View our benefits and more at getflex.com/careers.

jobs.title: Director, Worker Management Support
jobs.description:
Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. Its unified platform streamlines compliance, prequalification, safety and performance benchmarking in a single, integrated experience. Trusted by 360,000 businesses across more than 120 countries, Avetta blends AI-driven insights and human expertise to close risk gaps and strengthen supplier reliability so projects start on time, risks are managed proactively and operations scale with certainty.

SUMMARY

The Director, Worker Management Support, leads Avetta’s worker support operations, ensuring a seamless and positive compliance experience for workers. This role focuses on simplifying the compliance process, swiftly resolving worker challenges and escalations, meeting with customers, and fostering a best-in-class support experience that exceeds worker expectations. The Director achieves this by strategically managing people, processes, and technology across multiple teams, collaborating cross-functionally with departments such as IT, HR, Client Success, Supplier Success, Implementation Project Management (IPM), Sales & Account Management, and Marketing. A key aspect of this role is leveraging data analysis and process improvement to scale our worker efforts by optimizing support efficiency and effectiveness. This position requires a strong understanding of Avetta's worker support business, training expertise, capacity planning skills, and extensive experience working with international teams. The ideal candidate will be passionate about delivering exceptional customer service and driving continuous improvement in support operations.

This role requires a hybrid schedule in our Lehi office (3 days in office, 2 days work from home).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Oversee and support a team of operations managers and international support teams, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality support across all channels.

• Drive the operation to achieve best-in-class Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), focusing on continuous improvement and exceeding industry benchmarks for customer loyalty and advocacy.

• Coach, develop, and mentor team members at various levels to foster a culture of exceptional customer services and continuous learning, with a strong emphasis on customer-centric communication and problem-solving skills.

• Creative and iterative approach to proactive support processes to drive new levels of customer compliance and satisfaction.

• Collaborate strategically with the Vice President, Global Customer Support to enhance processes and practices, own initiatives, drive metrics, and improve the overall worker experience.

• Design and manage incentive, rewards, and recognition programs in partnership with Team Leaders and other departments, aligning incentives with exceptional customer service behaviors and outcomes.

• Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with other departments, including HR, Training, Client Services, Supplier Support, Product, IT, IPM, etc., ensuring a unified and seamless customer experience across all touchpoints.

• Manage and resolve escalated service issues within the department promptly and effectively, demonstrating empathy and a commitment to finding mutually beneficial solutions.

• Maintain expertise in Avetta’s systems and tools, leveraging technology to enhance the customer experience and streamline support processes.

• Ensure consistent achievement and exceeding performance for Metrics that Matter, prioritizing responsiveness and resolution speed without compromising quality.

• Provide clear leadership and communication regarding company and department goals and vision, emphasizing the importance of customer satisfaction as a key driver of business success.

• Utilize data analysis to identify trends, improve processes, and optimize resource allocation, focusing on initiatives that will have the greatest impact on the customer experience.

• Lead and implement process automation and streamlining initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operational costs, ensuring that automation enhances rather than detracts from the customer experience.

• Develop and manage capacity planning strategies to ensure adequate staffing levels and resource allocation to meet worker support demands, minimizing wait times and ensuring timely responses to worker inquiries.

• Other duties and responsibilities as required.

• Regular and predictive attendance.

• Customer Satisfaction (CSAT): Measures customer satisfaction with specific interactions or the overall experience.

• First Contact Resolution (FCR): Measures the percentage of issues resolved during the first interaction.

• Service Level Agreement (SLA) Adherence: Measures the percentage of interactions handled within agreed-upon timeframes.

• Agent Productivity: Measures the percentage of time agents are actively engaged in customer interactions (used for capacity planning).

• Own and monitor additional team-level performance metrics based on ongoing initiatives and focus.

• Travel up to 20% of the time within NORAM and international locations is expected for this role.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION & TRAINING:

• 7+ years of experience leading teams.

• 7+ years of experience with customer-facing support roles at Avetta or within the contractor compliance, supply chain risk management, or EHS software industry is required.

• Proficiency with hiring, onboarding, and team design.

• Proficiency creating and implementing ongoing team training.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Excellent collaboration skills, with a proven ability to work effectively across diverse teams and regions.

• Extensive experience working with a global team and partners.

The salary range for this position is $115,000 - $151,000 per year, with a potential bonus. The final compensation offered will be determined based on the skills, experience and qualifications of the candidate selected in consideration of market pay rates and internal pay equity.

jobs.title: Medical Assistant-Medical Oncology Part Time Days
jobs.description:
**This is a Part Time position at 20 hours per week located at the Grayslake Cancer Center with travel to Lake Forest Hospital as needed. Schedule is Tuesday, Thursday and Friday flexible day shift hours.**

The Medical Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Medical Assistant is a member of the health care team primarily responsible for providing support to physicians, nurses, and other licensed medical staff by facilitating efficient patient flow, assisting with various patient care activities, and performing related administrative functions. The Medical Assistant is responsible for ensuring efficient patient flow through the clinic; maintaining neat, clean and safe patient care areas; promoting patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner; safeguarding patient confidentiality.

Responsibilities:

• Assures efficient patient flow through the site: Escorts patient to exam room, identifies patient with 2 identifiers and prepares patient for examination. Obtains accurate vital signs, per organization standards. Documents reason for visit and updates/confirms, allergies, smoking history and pharmacy information. Promptly informs the provider and registered nurse of any significant change in vital signs or acute symptoms. Anticipates/sets up equipment or supplies needed for visit. Cleans and prepares exam room for next patient. Responds to needs to expedite visits and maintain flow of patients and prioritize tasks accordingly.

• Assists practitioner with medical and surgical procedures in accordance with established protocols such as: Electrocardiogram (ECG), venipuncture, immunizations, setting up procedure trays, specimen collection and/or Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) waived testing as directed by Provider.

• Provides high quality care by: Prepares and stocks all exam rooms in treatment area by following established protocols for disinfecting and sterilizing equipment and instruments. Participates in environmental safety rounds. Maintains vaccine/medication inventory. Monitors and maintains equipment and instruments according to clinic guidelines. Assists in ordering supplies and correctly disposes of all expired items. Adheres to office opening and closing procedures.

• Functions as an integral part of the patient care team and promotes patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner: Accepts and performs delegated responsibilities in a positive manner. Offers assistance to others. Attends and participates in staff meetings. Communicates appropriately and effectively with patients and patient care team (in the office and on the phone)

• Performs delegated procedures common to the specialty area in a safe, effective, and efficient manner (see specialty practice addendum)

• Performs all other duties as assigned by the Supervisor or Manager

Required:

• High school diploma or GED.
• Current certification in one of the below or must have written proof of meeting candidate eligibility requirements for writing one of the five eligible certification exams (AAMA, AMT, NCCT, NHA, NRCMA)Accepted documentation:New MA Graduates within six (6) months from date of graduation from an MA Program must submit: a letter from the school or a letter from the certifying bodyNon-Certified MAs or new graduates past six (6) months from date of graduation from an MA program must submit: a letter from the certifying bodyWithin first six months of employment, will complete one of the following certifications after up to two test attempts:Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) through American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA)Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) through American Medical Technologists (AMT) orNational Certified Medical Assistant (NCMA) through the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT)Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) through the National Healthcareer Association (NHA)Nationally Registered Certified Medical Assistant (NRCMA) through the National Association for Health Professionals (NAHP)Signed acknowledgement during onboarding that certification must be attained within six (6) months, as a condition of employment
• American Heart Association accredited Basic Life Support (BLS/CPR) certification.
• Zero (0) to two (2) years’ experience in a relevant role.
• Strong computer skills.

Preferred:

• Completion of accredited Medical Assistant training program.
• One to two years of ambulatory care experience.
• Experience with electronic medical record.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

jobs.title: SVP, Commercial Marketing

We're looking for a Senior Vice President, Commercial Marketing to join our Marketing and Communications team in New York City. Our team follows a hybrid schedule, working in-office three days a week and remotely for the rest.

The primary purpose of this role is to own how customers, prospects and employees understand Nexxen. You will lead the Marketing and Communications disciplines closest to revenue like product marketing, customer marketing, commercial training and international field marketing. You will be the accountable owner for whether temas have the narrative, materials and support they need to win. This is an active individual contributor and team leader role at both the group and corporate level, and a key partner to the C-suite.

What you'll do:

 - Own and integrate the commercial marketing pillars globally: product marketing across DSP, SSP, growth formats and data; customer marketing; commercial training and field marketing across EMEA and APAC

 - Drive the key go-to-market strategies that grow the business, including narratives, pitches, marketing plans and naming, in close partnership with the CMO and commercial as well as product leadership

 - Build, sustain and expand trust with the commercial and product organizations, ensuring marketing makes it easier for teams to turn our work into action

 - Establish best-in-class go-to-market approaches, including stakeholder engagement, clear briefs covering personas and messaging that lead with commercial rationale

 - Own commercial enablement end-to-end, from onboarding and LMS through to playbooks, tentpoles, RFP support and ongoing commercial training

 - Drive a global focus with the ability to dive deep into regions, ensuring key regions beyond the US have the presence, materials and support their markets require

 - Partner with product leadership to translate roadmap and capability into positioning the market and our sellers understand

 - Lead a team to enable career growth, operational efficiency and support on their respective priorities

 - Drive and support cross-functional processes and tools that grow the core and deliver focused innovation, including case studies, competitive intelligence, project management and documentation

 - Represent Nexxen at industry and owned events as a speaker or panelist, demonstrating expertise and thought leadership

What you'll bring:

 - Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing or equivalent training or experience; Master's Degree in a related field a plus

 - 15+ years in media, marketing, product marketing, sales enablement or digital advertising

 - 12+ years holding a marketing or product marketing specific role

 - 3+ years as a VP at Nexxen or another company, with 12+ years managing multiple direct reports

 - 8+ years at a technology company, ad tech a plus

 - Deep expertise across the programmatic ecosystem, including DSP, SSP, data and CTV

 - Mastery at training and educating large teams, notably with sales and go-to-market focus

 - Mastery over strategy, from development through implementation, with cross-functional involvement and sign off

 - Demonstrated ownership of multiple team budgets and strong business acumen aligned to company financial and strategic goals

 - Experience in change management, with a track record as a positive change agent at group level

 - Critical thinker who can work cross-functionally across different business groups and stakeholders

 - Ability to effortlessly translate complex capabilities and ever-evolving ecosystems into clear, differentiated messaging

 - Exceptional written, oral and presentation skills, including trainings, executive presentations and client communications

 - Proven ability to build trust, manage through conflict and demonstrate foundational emotional intelligence

 - Ability to masterfully delegate, prioritize and develop direct reports, and to cascade knowledge across other groups inside marketing

 - Extremely strong project management with global, cross-functional relationships

 - Strong work ethic, integrity and a high level of confidentiality

 - Willingness and ability to travel, potentially internationally

In support of pay transparency and equity, the minimum and maximum full-time annual base salary for this role is $250,000 - $300,000.
