jobs.title: H&M Department Supervisor - Woodbridge Center
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Department Supervisor, you will be responsible for for supporting the Sales and Profit goals in the store by executing a plan to deliver the Best Customer Experience in the department and overall store. The Department Supervisor will work in accordance with legal requirements and H&M standards, policies, and procedures to meet the expectations of customers and colleagues.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• You are responsible for supporting the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines.
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
• Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and working with your Department Manager to act on them
• Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
• Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
• Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way

Fashion & Trend Awareness

Team & Development

jobs.title: Clinical Administrative Assistant/Front Desk Coordinator (Bella Terra, CA)
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a Member Support Specialist you will be an ambassador for patients in office, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for patient feedback, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or in office providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you'll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc..

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Master our technology suite including but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, and our Electronic Medical Record System 1Life, in order to interact with team members and patients and complete daily work

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification.  They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification.  Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• At least 1 year of experience in high touch customer or patient facing roles

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse and feedback-driven multi-disciplinary teams

• A proven track record of persisting through change, demonstrating a forward thinking perspective when under pressure, and consistently stepping up to take action on challenges

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

Competitive salary: the base pay for this position is $22.00 per hour based on a full time schedule.

This is a full-time, in-person role (40 hours per week, 8 hours a day, Monday through Friday, 7:30am-6:30pm) based at our Bella Terra office located at 7881 Edinger Ave #124, Huntington Beach, CA 92647. Office type: Pediatrics. This role requires flexibility to cover at the following locations as needed (e.g., when colleagues are on vacation or out sick): Long Beach, Irvine Spectrum, Irvine Crossroads, and Aliso Viejo.

Physical Demands:  Mostly sedentary work duties require exerting up to ten pounds of force occasionally and/or small amounts of force frequently. Sedentary work typically involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

jobs.title: Network Engineer (Enterprise Product Development)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

NETWORK ENGINEER (ENTERPRISE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT)

Starlink Enterprise Product Development is looking for an exceptional Network Engineer who wants to design and build the Starship of networks. Capitalizing on SpaceX's capability to launch routers, switches, and compute to Earth orbit and beyond, the mission of this role is to maximize the impact of space infrastructure within Earth-based networks. You will re-imagine global enterprise network architectures around what space infrastructure makes possible, define the products and features that bridge from the enterprise network architectures of today, and drive execution of those products and features with the broader Starlink engineering team.

To succeed in this role, you must be a technically excellent first-principles problem solver. You must operate with extreme ownership, be a self-starter, skilled technical leader, and be biased toward action. You must be passionate about shipping a quality technical product that solves real customer problems.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design enterprise network products that leverage the Starlink space network to unlock new capabilities for Earth-based networks.

• Define the protocols, interfaces, and product capabilities that let customers adopt space infrastructure from the architectures they already operate.

• Be the technical authority on customer needs. Understand how customer networks are designed, constrained, bought, and run.

• Work with customers to test and iterate in real-world environments. Incorporate what you learn back into the product.

• Coordinate hardware, software, network, and business teams to define and build the specialized pieces required for customers to adopt the product.

• Drive the work you own to release. Hold a high bar for designs that are robust and maintainable and keep the path to shipment as short as that bar allows.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering or STEM discipline.

• 1+ years of networking experience designing or deploying enterprise network solutions and/or cloud and web-scale networks (inclusive of student/capstone projects).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience organizing and focusing contributions from other technical experts and specialists to produce a cohesive deliverable.

• Experience defining system architecture or product requirements for networking systems.

• Experience in software engineering, or working directly with software engineering teams.

• Experience at an early-stage technology startup or on a program that scaled rapidly.

• Mastery of core networking concepts from layer 1 through layer 3 and of protocols such as IPv4, IPv6, DHCP, NAT, NTP, and IPsec VPN.

• Understanding of backhaul, cloud, and ISP networking technologies such as dedicated interconnects, peering, and BGP.

• Ability to validate a design in a live network, including reading packet captures and hardware telemetry to separate a product defect from an integration constraint.

• Excellent written and verbal communication.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willingness to travel domestically and internationally in support of customer site design and activations.

• Must be willing to work long hours and occasional weekends when necessary to support critical project timelines.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $125,000.00 - $165,000.00
Level 2: $145,000.00 - $200,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Director of Sales
jobs.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

WVEC-TV, the TEGNA-owned ABC affiliate in Norfolk, Virginia is seeking an innovative and results-driven Director of Sales to lead a high-performing revenue team across linear, streaming, and digital platforms. This leader will drive strategy, grow market share, develop top talent, and help local businesses connect with audiences through modern marketing solutions.

The Director of Sales creates, leads, and executes the station’s sales strategy to achieve or exceed annual revenue goals while growing market share across broadcast, digital, streaming, and emerging platforms. This leader is responsible for building and developing a high-performing sales organization, empowering managers and sellers, and creating alignment around a shared vision for success.

The Director of Sales partners closely with station leadership and corporate teams to identify opportunities, strengthen client relationships, and position the station as a trusted marketing partner in the community. The ideal candidate is a strategic and adaptable leader who can navigate change, lead with transparency, and keep teams aligned and motivated in a fast-evolving media landscape.

This position reports to the President & General Manager.

Responsibilities

• Build and execute a strategic sales plan designed to achieve or exceed revenue goals across linear, digital, streaming, and emerging platforms

• Recruit, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing sales leadership team

• Directly manage, coach, develop, and retain local Account Executives, with a focus on individual accountability, sales performance, new business development, and long-term growth

• Foster a culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous development

• Lead pricing, inventory management, forecasting, and revenue pacing strategies to maximize revenue performance

• Partner closely with station leadership, marketing, news, and corporate teams to identify opportunities and deliver integrated client solutions

• Collaborate with content and marketing leaders on ratings analysis, projections, and audience strategies to optimize inventory value

• Develop strong relationships with local business leaders, agencies, and community partners to drive new business growth and long-term client partnerships

• Leverage TEGNA’s full suite of marketing capabilities and resources to grow market share and create customized advertising solutions for clients

• Work closely with TEGNA Sales to maximize opportunities with national, political, and strategic accounts

• Lead teams effectively through organizational change, evolving business priorities, and industry transformation with clear communication and strong leadership

• Create alignment and maintain team engagement in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment

• Lead teams effectively through new technologies, changing market conditions, and emerging product opportunities while encouraging innovation and adaptability

• Maintain accurate forecasting, reporting, and communication with station and corporate leadership teams

• Represent the station at industry, community, and client events

• Travel regularly and attend sales-related functions outside of standard business hours as needed

Requirements

• 10+ years of TV sales experience with 3-5 year(s) of experience in broadcast TV sales leadership role with track record of achieving or exceeding goals.

• Proven track record of achieving or exceeding revenue goals and leading high-performing sales teams

• Strong understanding of multiplatform advertising solutions, including broadcast, digital, OTT, CTV, and streaming products

• Knowledge of political advertising sales cycles and revenue strategy

• Demonstrated ability to lead strategically, solve problems, and drive results in a fast-changing environment

• Proven ability to lead successfully through change, ambiguity, and evolving business conditions

• Demonstrated resilience, adaptability, and the ability to maintain momentum in a dynamic environment

• Experience building inclusive, collaborative, and performance-driven team cultures

• Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence, motivate, and align teams around a shared vision

• Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt quickly, and lead effectively under pressure

• Experience with CRM and sales systems including Salesforce and WideOrbit preferred

• Working knowledge of Comscore, Matrix, ShareBuilder, and related sales and analytics platforms preferred

Pay Range

$140,000—$165,000 USD

Benefits:

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian - Doral, FL
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management (R14361)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to lead strategy, growth, and execution across key digital products and member experiences. You’ll help shape how Oportun serves members throughout their financial journey while building products that create meaningful customer value and support sustainable business growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll set product direction, develop roadmaps, lead discovery, guide cross-functional execution, and coach product managers while staying close to customers, data, and product performance. Success requires strong strategic judgment, deep customer empathy, and the ability to move comfortably between long-term vision and detailed execution.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

• You’ll define product vision, strategy, and priorities that connect member needs with Oportun’s business objectives.

• You’ll own and evolve a portfolio of digital products and experiences, balancing growth, engagement, retention, customer value, and business performance.

• You’ll build outcome-focused roadmaps and make clear investment decisions across existing products, new capabilities, and emerging opportunities.

• You’ll develop a deep understanding of member behavior, friction points, and unmet needs through research, product analytics, funnel analysis, cohort performance, and experimentation.

• You’ll lead product initiatives from discovery and validation through launch, measurement, iteration, and scale.

• You’ll establish clear hypotheses, success measures, and performance metrics and use results to guide future product decisions.

• You’ll partner closely with Design, Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and other teams to resolve trade-offs and deliver strong member experiences.

• You’ll balance customer experience, growth, product economics, risk, regulatory requirements, and operational complexity when making product decisions.

• You’ll coach and develop product managers, set clear expectations, and strengthen product judgment, ownership, and accountability across the team.

• You’ll communicate product strategy, priorities, performance, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

• You’ll bring ideas for how we can improve our products, processes, and ways of working, proactively, not just when asked.

• You’ll look for practical ways to use AI to improve product discovery, analysis, experimentation, decision-making, and team productivity.

• You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a strategic and hands-on product leader who combines strong customer judgment with data, business acumen, and disciplined execution. You know how to build products that customers value while making thoughtful trade-offs across growth, economics, risk, and operational complexity.

You’re comfortable leading through ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and creating clarity across teams. You communicate directly, build strong partnerships, and stay close enough to the work to understand what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next.

You’re also a strong people leader. You know how to coach product managers, raise the quality of product thinking, and create accountability for measurable outcomes.

You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

• 8+ years of product management experience, with increasing responsibility for product strategy, roadmap ownership, and measurable customer and business outcomes.

• Significant experience building and growing consumer digital products.

• Proven experience owning engagement, retention, growth, monetization, or other meaningful product-performance outcomes.

• 3+ years of experience directly managing and developing product managers.

• Strong track record leading cross-functional teams from discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.

• Experience setting product strategy and translating it into focused, executable roadmaps.

• Strong product judgment and a high standard for simple, intuitive, and customer-centered experiences.

• Strong analytical skills, including experience with funnel analysis, cohort performance, product economics, experimentation, and performance measurement.

• Experience evolving established products while balancing current customer needs with new strategic priorities.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to align senior stakeholders around priorities, risks, and trade-offs.

• Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments with competing priorities and significant ambiguity.

Nice to Have

• Experience in fintech, financial services, lending, banking, payments, savings, budgeting, investing, or financial wellness.

• Experience building consumer mobile products or other high-engagement digital experiences.

• Experience with subscription, recurring-use, or habit-forming consumer products.

• Experience serving customers managing complex or variable financial needs.

• Experience working in a regulated environment and incorporating Risk, Legal, and Compliance requirements into product experiences.

• Experience leading products through periods of growth, transformation, or significant strategic change.

• Experience using AI tools to improve product research, analysis, experimentation, documentation, or team productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

US Benefits:

• Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

• 401(k) including company match

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers

Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range that meets your criteria during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
The Regional Manager, Retail is fiscally responsible for the oversight and execution of monthly sales plan achievement, bi-yearly inventory results, and overall brand standards and operational efficiencies across all Shop locations within their designated territory. In partnership with General Managers and Assistant General Managers of their assigned clubs, they are responsible for staffing positions and training all Shop Managers-on-Duty and Style Advisors to operate according to brand standards. This role directs and motivates the retail sales team to ensure the highest level of customer service to every Equinox member and guest.

The Regional Manager, Retail reports directly to the Senior Regional Club Director, supporting club leadership with overall brand and club culture cohesion for Retail, and a seamless member experience across all locations within the Market. They are also supported by a national Retail Field Leadership team and a Retail Corporate team, from whom they take direction on Retail-specific policies and procedures, financial goals and planning, and merchandise selection and allocation — ensuring maximum productivity and compliance with all company standards across their territory.

Reporting Structure & Key Partnerships

• Reports directly to the Senior Regional Club Director to align retail operations with broader club culture, brand standards, and the overall member experience
• Supported by a national Retail Field Leadership team for field-level guidance, best practice sharing, and field communications
• Supported by the Retail Corporate team for Retail-specific policies and procedures, financial planning and goal-setting, merchandise selection, and inventory allocation
• Partners closely with club-level General Managers, Assistant General Managers, and club leadership teams to ensure retail is integrated seamlessly into the overall club environment

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

Talent Management

• Serves as point-person for coaching, training, and developing all levels of Shop staff within their Market, including Shop Managers-on-Duty (MODs) and Style Advisors
• Identifies top training talent on the existing team and partners with them to onboard and develop each new employee
• Recruits and maintains a staff that reflects the needs of the business and the character of each club community
• Assists club management team with hiring, coaching, and development of Shop staff
• Creates and maintains a succession plan within the territory
• Acts as partner to club management and People & Culture on all employee relations and accountability interactions

Sales & Service

• Achieves assigned monthly sales goals across all Shop locations within the territory
• Coaches and develops Shop MODs and Style Advisors in selling tactics, tools, and key business metrics
• Ensures an unparalleled customer experience for all Equinox members and guests
• Acts in the best interest of the member when resolving any issues related to The Shop
• Maintains current knowledge of all club and Shop services, programs, and products
• Understands the member profile and demographic of each club in the territory
• Personally engages in club communities and helps Shop teams do the same

Communications & Collaboration

• Engages Shop teams in a manner that is respectful, professional, inspirational, and motivating
• Maintains a regular communication cadence with the Senior Regional Club Director to ensure retail operations align with club-level priorities and brand direction
• Provides global feedback and offers possible solutions to the Retail Corporate team, Retail Field Leadership, and club business partners
• Contributes a clear point of view during company calls, team meetings, and leadership presentations
• Keeps all relevant parties informed of Corporate communications through timely emails and verbal discussion
• Shares vision and direction with the Shop team in a way that earns enthusiasm and ensures follow-through

Operational Excellence

• Understands and upholds all loss prevention and inventory management policies, and ensures total team adherence to these standards
• Ensures personal and team comprehension of all communications and training materials, and timely, accurate completion of all assigned operational tasks
• Assists with scheduling and shift coverage in partnership with the Senior Regional Club Director, club management, and the Retail Corporate team
• Performs timely, comprehensive Shop Visit Audits — both formal and informal

Product & Presentation

• Ensures that each Shop and its staff reflect company brand standards through proper execution of merchandising and marketing direction, housekeeping standards, and adherence to the Shop dress code
• Enforces and maintains excellent organizational standards on sales floors, at cash wraps, and in stockrooms
• Ensures Shops within the territory are visually compelling by adhering to standards set by the Retail Corporate team and in partnership with the Senior Regional Club Director, club business partners and Retail Field Leadership team

Decision Making

• Seeks creative solutions to operational and business challenges
• Adapts management style as appropriate based on audience and context
• Manages time efficiently across the territory, implementing best practices for visit planning and prioritization

Professional Dimension

• Builds effective relationships and partnerships with fellow employees, colleagues, supervisors, and club leadership
• Maintains working knowledge of happenings and general standards across the club environment to encourage camaraderie and a unified team spirit
• Complies with and enforces all company policies and procedures; embraces and champions company initiatives
• Communicates clearly and effectively at all levels, with tact and diplomacy
• Remains receptive to feedback and demonstrates the ability to adapt accordingly

Pay Range: $80,000 annually, additional bonus opportunities available

To successfully perform in this role, the individual should meet the following minimum requirements and qualifications:

• Combination of education and/or experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the role
• Multi-unit or multi-store management experience preferred
• Proven leadership ability and comfort taking direction from multiple stakeholders
• Experience in a customer service business; retail experience strongly preferred
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Basic computer skills and retail math knowledge
• Hardworking and diligent, with a high degree of personal integrity and honesty
• Strong time management, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills
• Ability to embrace and apply new techniques and ideas
• Availability to work a varied schedule based on the needs of a unique retail environment
• Physical requirements: ability to lift, carry, and move a minimum of 40 lbs, including fixtures and product
• Ability to actively supervise a retail sales floor
• Ability and willingness to travel to all Shop locations within the territory

AS A MEMBER OF THE EQUINOX TEAM YOU WILL RECEIVE:

• We offer competitive salary, benefits, and industry leading commission opportunities for club employees
• Complimentary Club membership
• Perks and incentives with our products and services including Personal Training, Pilates, Spa and Shop

This job description is intended to describe the general requirements for the position. It is not a complete statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Other duties not listed here may be assigned as necessary to ensure the proper operations of the department.

Equinox is an equal opportunity employer. For more information regarding our career opportunities, please visit one of our clubs or our website at https://careers.equinox.com/

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Must have a legal right to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian - Fort Myers, FL
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Facilities Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

About the Role

The Facilities Maintenance Technician ensures safe, reliable, and well-maintained facilities by performing skilled and semi-skilled tasks in plumbing, carpentry, electrical, painting, and general building maintenance. This role emphasizes preventive, predictive and reactive maintenance, excellent customer service, problem-solving, and teamwork.

About the Work

• Perform general maintenance, repairs, and preventive maintenance on building systems, equipment, and facilities.

• Inspect buildings and grounds to ensure timely repairs and maintenance.

• Read and interpret blueprints, shop drawings, OEM and maintenance manuals.

• Create, complete and document work orders, inspections, and maintenance records.

• Trade-specific tasks include:

• Plumbing: Repair/replace bathroom and kitchen fixtures, clean drains, renew washers, gaskets, and valves.

• Carpentry: Patch drywall, repair doors/locks, replace ceiling tiles, and perform general construction work.

• Painting: Prepare surfaces, match colors, and perform touch-ups.

• Mechanical Systems: Replace filters, service equipment, and support mechanical upkeep.

• Assemble, move, and install furniture, fixtures, stands or equipment as needed.

• Maintain tools, equipment, and workspace in a safe, clean, operational condition.

• Respond to facility-related emergencies and participate in safety drills.

• Operate basic power tools (e.g., drills, saws, grinders, pneumatic/hydraulic tools, presses).

• Other duties as assigned.

About You

• 3-5 years experience in general building maintenance and basic trades (plumbing, carpentry, painting, etc.).

• Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

• Ability to safely operate hand and power tools.

• Strong technical aptitude with the ability to read technical drawings and follow maintenance instructions.

• Basic computer skills (Internet, Email, Word); experience with Jira and Confluence is a plus.

• Excellent soft skills, including:

• Communication: Clear and professional interaction with colleagues and vendors.

• Teamwork: Collaborative approach and respect for team dynamics.

• Adaptability: Ability to adjust to changing priorities and work under pressure.

• Problem-Solving: Proactive in diagnosing and resolving maintenance issues.

• Attention to Detail: Consistently delivering high-quality, thorough work.

Physical and Environmental Requirements
This role requires the ability to complete the following physical activities in warehouse-like environments:

• Move yourself in different positions to accomplish tasks while stooping and holding up to 25 lbs.

• Remain in a stationary position frequently, often squatting, standing or sitting for prolonged periods.

• Adjust or move objects up to 50 lbs. in all directions.

• Able to work in various positions/environments including overhead reaching, kneeling, crawling, twisting, and stretching on dusty concrete floors, rubber mats, and steel.

• Routinely required to talk and hear; use hands to touch, feel, handle, push/pull, and move objects; see details of objects that are less than a few feet away; and distinguish between colors, shades, and brightness.

• Exposure to dust, chemicals, electrical/mechanical hazards, and inclement weather.

• Work in areas with poor lighting, ventilation, noise or potentially wet.

• Requires lifting, climbing ladders, driving mobile equipment and physical activity.

• Must carry a cell phone for emergency response.

• PPE required, including but not limited to safety-toe shoes, gloves, hearing protection, and safety glasses.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.

Location

• This is an onsite position at our Salem office.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to: job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Agility Robotics is a multi-state employer and this salary range may not reflect positions who work in other locations. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Anticipated Base Salary Range

$23—$30 USD

In addition to base pay, our competitive total rewards package consists of the following for full-time employees:

• 401(k) Plan: Includes a 6% company match.

• Equity: Company stock options.

• Insurance Coverage: 100% company-paid medical, dental, vision, and short/long-term disability insurance for employees.

• Benefit Start Date: Eligible for benefits on your first day of employment.

• Well-Being Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Time Off: Exempt Employees: Flexible, unlimited PTO and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown. Non-Exempt Employees: 10 vacation days, paid sick leave, and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown, annually.

• On-Site Perks: Catered lunches four times a week and a variety of healthy snacks and refreshments at our Salem and Pittsburgh locations.

• Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave programs.

• Work Environment: A culture that supports flexible work arrangements.

• Growth Opportunities: Professional development and tuition reimbursement programs.

• Relocation Assistance: Provided for eligible roles.

• Annual Discretionary Bonus: Provided for eligible roles.

All of our roles are U.S.-based. Applicants must have current authorization to work in the United States.

Agility Robotics is committed to a work environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Each individual has the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal employment opportunities and prohibits unlawful discriminatory practices, including harassment. Therefore, it is the policy of Agility Robotics to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, citizenship, national origin, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Agility Robotics prohibits any such discrimination or harassment.

jobs.title: Primary Care Physician - Sign On Bonus Available, 4 days in clinic, 1 day remote
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

Employment type:

• Full time

What you'll be working on:

• Managing a patient panel with a broad array of patient needs; conducting a mix of acute, chronic, and well visits

• Treating patients in-office or in testing centers as well as conducting occasional tele-health visits

• Continuous learning during weekly Clinical Rounds and through other modalities

• Ongoing collaboration with in-office teammates via daily huddles, as well as with virtual clinical teams

• Utilization of your specific clinical training and opportunities to perform in-office procedures

• Supervising one or more NP or PA colleagues

• Willing to obtain additional state licensure and credentialing for One Medical virtual primary care in additional states

Education, licenses, and experiences required for this role:

• Enrolled in, or have completed, an accredited Internal or Family Medicine residency program

• Practiced at least 2 of the last 5 years in an outpatient primary care setting

• Board Certified in Internal or Family Medicine, or Board Eligible with plans to obtain board certification within 1 year of your One Medical start date

• State licensed in Massachusetts, obtained before your One Medical start date

One Medical providers also demonstrate:

• A passion for human-centered primary care

• The ability to successfully communicate with and provide care to individuals of all backgrounds

• The ability to effectively use technology to deliver high quality care

• Clinical proficiency in evidence-based primary care

• The desire to be an integral part of a team dedicated to changing healthcare delivery

• An openness to feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into strengths and weaknesses

• The ability to confidently navigate uncertain situations with both patients and colleagues

• Readiness to adapt personal and interpersonal behavior to meet the needs of our patients

This is a full-time role based in Boston, Massachusetts.

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base salary range for this role is $252,000 to $301,275 per year. Total compensation packages may be based on factors unique to particular candidates, such skill sets, depth of experience, and work location. The total compensation package for this position may also include restricted stock unit grants, and/or benefits. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

jobs.title: Oncology Nurse Educator- Manchester/Boston/Hartford
jobs.description:

The Oncology Nurse Educator (ONE) will be responsible for proactively engaging with allied healthcare professionals to provide product and disease education, in support of before, during and after patient management on approved therapies in our solid tumor portfolio. The ONE will focus on providing ongoing education and resources related to patient management, dosing and administration, and side effect management. The ONE will collaborate with other field teams within ways of working guidelines to ensure education support for allied healthcare clinicians.

The Oncology Nurse Educator (ONE) interacts with allied healthcare clinicians in key targeted accounts and provide clinical in-services and education. The ONE identifies educational needs and expands disease state awareness, initiating and managing patients on a therapy, understanding of symptom management and appropriate patient identification through these educational interactions within a defined geographical region.

Responsibilities

• Serve as a strategic education leader across academic and community oncology accounts by way of:Proactive and reactive education with approved resources to the patient care team members.Develops a customized educational plan through the analysis of account dynamics and clinical insights that meet the patient care team’s needs and clinical challenges.Educate on the preparation and administration requirements of TA products; and adverse event mitigation, monitoring, and management.Interpret and communicate relevant clinical education topics to diverse audiences as per materials approved for the role.Educate on disease state awareness, including clinical and operational aspects of appropriate patient diagnosis.Provide education programs through 1:1 presentations/in-services and other methods expressly approved, which may include round-table discussions, and podium presentations.
• Educate patient care teams about the infusion process associated with the product.
• Utilize strategic questioning and active listening to routinely document and share clinical insights.
• Attend and provide clinical information and/or presentations at internal national, regional, and local meetings.
• Provide staff support as appropriate at exhibit booths and displays.
• Provide support to enhance training initiatives clinically and improve the clinical competencies of the internal sales team.
• As deemed appropriate, collaborates across internal functional areas as it relates to the Oncology business (e.g., sales, marketing, clinical operations, medical, clinical value & evidence)
• Potentially provide education to patients in patient advocacy meeting settings using materials and messaging tailored and approved for use with such an audience.

• Bachelor’s degree required (Nursing or NP preferred)
• Master's level education preferred
• Three or more years of combined clinical experience and/or pharmaceutical sales, clinical educator, or medical affairs experience (Oncology preferred)Experience working in or supporting patients and HCPs in the infusion center setting, including the development/implementation of chemotherapy/biologics infusion procedures and protocols for therapy administration and patient safety monitoring is preferred.
• Excellent communication(s), objective setting, influencing, business acumen, and analytical skills
• Demonstrated experience adapting to change and embracing learning
• Demonstrated experience interpreting clinical and pharmacoeconomic data
• Recognizes evolving shifts in oncology market trends and respective effects on provider and patient
• Success operating within a cross-functional team
• Proficiency in Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and other relevant applications
• The individual must be able to travel 50% of the time, including the ability to travel overnight and occasionally on weekends
• Driving a personal auto or company car or truck, or a powered piece of material handling equipment
• Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements

jobs.title: Senior Director, GTM Analytics
jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking a Senior Director, GTM Data Analytics to lead and scale the analytics capabilities that drive go-to-market performance and revenue growth. This strategic leadership role will define the vision, strategy, and operating model for GTM analytics, transforming complex data into actionable insights that inform executive decision-making, improve forecasting, and increase sales productivity.

The Senior Director will establish a trusted, integrated analytics framework across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Finance, ensuring leaders have consistent visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, rep-level performance, and key revenue drivers. This leader will oversee the development of scalable data products, KPI governance, automated reporting, and predictive analytics capabilities, including AI-enabled insights that improve business outcomes.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for an analytics executive who can combine strategic vision, technical expertise, commercial acumen, and organizational leadership to build a world-class GTM analytics function. The successful candidate will partner closely with executive leadership to translate business priorities into analytical strategies that accelerate decision-making, improve accountability, and support Kaseya’s continued growth.

Key Responsibilities

• GTM Data & Analytics Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year GTM analytics strategy aligned with business priorities and revenue objectives. Establish the operating model, delivery standards, and roadmap for analytical products, ensuring investments are prioritized based on business impact and measurable outcomes.

• Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Own executive-level GTM performance reporting, scorecards, and analytics used to evaluate pipeline health, bookings, revenue, sales productivity, retention, and expansion. Translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations for executive leadership and board discussions.

• KPI Development & Data Governance: Establish and maintain consistent, trusted definitions for GTM metrics, including pipeline, bookings, win rates, sales cycles, quota attainment, and rep productivity. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Finance to align metric definitions, ownership, data quality, and reporting standards.

• Forecasting & Predictive Analytics: Lead the development and continuous improvement of pipeline, bookings, and revenue forecasting capabilities. Leverage historical trends, leading indicators, and predictive modeling to improve forecast accuracy, identify performance risks, and inform territory planning, capacity decisions, quotas, and resource allocation.

• Data Integration & Automation: Partner with Data Engineering, IT, and Sales Operations to integrate CRM, marketing automation, customer success, product usage, billing, and financial data into a unified GTM analytics ecosystem. Drive automation of recurring reporting and develop scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical products using shared enterprise platforms.

• AI-Enabled Insights & Innovation: Identify and implement opportunities to apply artificial intelligence, machine learning, and predictive analytics to GTM performance, including opportunity scoring, churn and expansion risk, forecast automation, and automated insight generation.

• Executive Partnership & Business Adoption: Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior GTM and functional leaders. Collaborate with stakeholders to define business questions, identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and ensure analytical insights translate into decisions and measurable action. Drive adoption through effective communication, training, documentation, and integration into business operating routines.

• Organizational Leadership & Development: Build and lead a scalable, multi-layer analytics organization, including managers and senior individual contributors. Establish organizational structures, career paths, and operating practices that support growth while developing future leaders and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and measurable business impact.

• Budget & Resource Management: Own the GTM analytics budget, evaluate investments in talent and technology, and develop business cases that demonstrate the value of analytics initiatives. Prioritize resources and tooling to maximize efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes.

• Continuous Improvement & Scalability: Establish standards for analytical solution development, testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement. Reduce manual reporting efforts, improve data reliability, and build reusable analytics capabilities that scale with business growth.

• Cross-Functional Data Strategy: Partner with enterprise data and technology teams to influence platform priorities, integration strategies, and vendor decisions affecting GTM analytics. Support the integration of data and reporting from acquired businesses into Kaseya’s GTM analytics environment.

Required Qualifications

• 12+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data strategy, reporting, or forecasting, including leadership of analytics functions supporting go-to-market organizations within SaaS or technology businesses.

• Deep expertise in GTM and revenue analytics, including pipeline management, forecasting, sales performance, rep-level productivity, and revenue-driving metrics.

• 5+ years of experience leading analytics or business intelligence teams, including managing managers and leading multiple teams or functions.

• Demonstrated success developing and executing an analytics strategy and building, scaling, or transforming an analytics organization.

• Proven experience owning executive-level GTM reporting, KPI frameworks, forecasting, and decision-support capabilities within a complex organization.

• Experience managing an analytics budget, evaluating technology investments, and prioritizing resources based on business impact.

• Strong technical proficiency with Salesforce, Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform, and modern business intelligence and reporting tools.

• Experience integrating multiple data sources, developing scalable reporting solutions, and implementing data governance practices that improve data quality, consistency, and automation.

• Experience applying predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled capabilities to business data to improve forecasting, performance insights, or decision-making.

• Demonstrated ability to influence C-suite executives and senior business leaders, communicate complex analytical findings clearly, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.

• Strong organizational leadership, strategic thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in high-growth SaaS, enterprise software, IT management, cybersecurity, or a related technology environment.

• Experience with Power BI or comparable business intelligence tools, semantic modeling, and enterprise BI governance.

• Background in revenue analytics, Sales Operations, territory and capacity planning, or enterprise performance management.

• Experience deploying predictive analytics, machine learning, or AI-enabled solutions in production environments, including opportunity scoring, churn prediction, or forecast automation.

• Experience integrating data, systems, and reporting capabilities following acquisitions, particularly within private-equity-backed or high-growth organizations.

• Experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple regions.

• Demonstrated success building scalable analytics capabilities that improve operational efficiency, sales productivity, and revenue performance.

jobs.title: Channel Sales Manager (founding)
jobs.description:
ABOUT SPRIG

Sprig is the enterprise survey platform, rebuilt around AI agents.

For two decades, companies have relied on Qualtrics, Medallia, and SurveyMonkey to understand their customers and markets. Those platforms were built for a slower era, with manual setup, fragmented workflows, and insights that arrive too late to shape decisions. The gap between how fast businesses move and how fast research can keep up has never been wider.

We're building something different. With Sprig, AI agents design studies, adapt surveys in real time, and turn responses into clear insight. Research, insights, and customer experience teams move from question to evidence in hours instead of weeks, without sacrificing rigor.

Our mission is to make deep customer understanding effortless and always on, so the world's leading companies can act on evidence instead of assumptions.

Leading companies like Microsoft, TikTok, DoorDash, and Coinbase trust Sprig to conduct research at scale. Backed by $85M in funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, and First Round Capital, we're rapidly expanding our enterprise presence.

We’re redefining the category, with AI at the core. If you're excited to solve hard problems and have the chance to shape how the world's largest companies understand their customers, we'd love to meet you.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Channel Sales Manager (Founding) to build and scale Sprig's partner ecosystem, creating a new engine for revenue growth.

As our first dedicated channel hire, you'll have the opportunity to shape our partner strategy from the ground up. You'll identify and develop relationships with agencies, research consultancies, and resellers that serve leading enterprise organizations, turning strategic partnerships into meaningful revenue opportunities.

This is a hands-on, quota-carrying role for someone who loves both building relationships and closing deals. You'll own partner-sourced revenue, recruit and activate new partners, and work alongside our Account Executives to bring Sprig to more customers.

You'll report directly to our Chief Revenue Officer and collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Finance. If you're excited by the opportunity to build something new, take ownership of a growing channel, and make a measurable impact on a company's next stage of growth, this role is for you.

This role is based in our San Francisco office four days per week, with up to 15% travel.


YOUR IMPACT

 - Build our partner ecosystem: Identify, recruit, and develop high-value partnerships with agencies, research consultancies, and resellers serving enterprise research, insights, and customer experience teams.

 - Drive revenue growth: Own and exceed a partner-sourced revenue quota, building a healthy pipeline and converting partner relationships into closed business.

 - Turn partnerships into performance: Develop onboarding, enablement, and go-to-market strategies that empower partners to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell Sprig.

 - Win together: Partner closely with Account Executives to identify opportunities, develop account strategies, and navigate complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery through close.

 - Shape our channel strategy: Help define the processes, programs, incentives, and engagement models that will support a scalable and successful partner ecosystem.

 - Build strong commercial partnerships: Structure and negotiate referral and reseller agreements that create long-term value for Sprig and our partners.

 - Own channel performance: Manage partner pipeline, forecasting, and deal registration in HubSpot, ensuring visibility, accountability, and alignment across the sales organization.


YOUR STRENGTHS

 - Proven channel sales success: You bring 4+ years of experience in channel sales, partnerships, or partner-led revenue roles at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

 - Builder mentality: You've successfully recruited, launched, and grown revenue-producing partnerships and are energized by the opportunity to build a program from the ground up.

 - Revenue-driven approach: You know how to turn relationships into pipeline and closed revenue, balancing long-term partner development with near-term sales execution.

 - Enterprise sales expertise: You're comfortable navigating complex B2B sales cycles, collaborating with Account Executives, and engaging senior stakeholders.

 - Strong commercial instincts: You understand partner economics and have experience negotiating referral agreements, reseller terms, or other revenue-sharing arrangements.

 - Cross-functional collaborator: You know how to align partners and internal sales teams around shared opportunities, clear expectations, and mutual success.

 - Operational discipline: You bring structure to pipeline management, forecasting, and partner operations, with experience using CRM platforms like HubSpot or Salesforce.

 - AI-forward mindset: You're excited about how AI is transforming enterprise software and actively use emerging tools to work smarter, identify opportunities, and scale your impact.


BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Competitive Employee Equity

 - 401K Program

 - Additional Wellbeing Benefits

At Sprig, we pride ourselves on being a people-first company, where your contributions truly matter and are valued. We were recently awarded by Fortune as top 50 best places to work in the US, and top 50 Places to Work in the Bay Area by Built In. Come join our mission of building products users love and have a real impact on Sprig’s future.




OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We prioritize diversity within our team and value different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

Just finished your degree or field school and ready to turn it into a career? Join our cultural resources team and get paid to do hands-on archaeology across Texas and nearby states, learning from experienced crew chiefs along the way. New grads and upperclassmen with field school experience are encouraged to apply.

• Support site documentation, background research, and report preparation
