COMPANY OVERVIEW

Founded in 2015, PHIL is a Series D healthtech growth-stage startup that is building a platform that interfaces between doctors, pharmacies, and patients to streamline the process of patients receiving prescription medication. This is a traditionally complex, archaic industry, and we've set out to change that through our digitally-enabled direct-to-patient hub and fulfillment platform. PHIL uniquely combines a digitally-enabled hub and pharmacy model to help patients access medication more quickly, affordably, and consistently over their treatment journey.

PHIL's B2B2C platform provides an end-to-end prescription management and delivery service for pharma manufacturers. Our robust platform connects patients, prescribers, pharmacies, and manufacturers, enabling easy and affordable access to medicine. Through PHIL's digital stakeholder experiences, patient access services, market access solutions, and distribution models, pharma manufacturers can deliver affordable and timely therapy access to patients, resulting in more patients staying on their treatment plans longer. Consequently, pharma manufacturers are enabled for more innovation and more patients are able to access the therapy they need.

The team at PHIL is a group of like-minded individuals from varying backgrounds, passionate about creating a new and innovative healthcare platform that is focused on patient experience and overall human wellbeing. Patients love our platform, as evidenced by our top Trustpilot rating (https://www.trustpilot.com/review/phil.us), and pharma manufacturers increasingly put their trust in PHIL to optimize their brands' commercialization strategy. Ready to join our team of mission-driven, analytical, and passionate people? Keep reading!


POSITION OVERVIEW

PHIL is seeking a Vice President of Business Development and GTM Strategy to join our Revenue team. Reporting to the SVP, Business Development, you will lead our most important pharma opportunities from first conversation to launch, grow the partnerships we already have with pharma manufacturers and ecosystem players, and help shape how PHIL goes to market.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with real ownership. You will work directly with senior leaders at pharma manufacturers and across PHIL's leadership team, and you will see the direct effect of your work in how many patients start and stay on the therapies they need. The pace is fast and the scope is broad: one day you may be shaping a proposal, the next building a partner relationship or sharpening our positioning. If you love both thinking strategically and winning business, and you want to help build a company that is reshaping how patients get their medicine, we'd love to meet you.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 1. Lead deals end to end: own key new-business opportunities and RFPs from discovery through scoping, proposal, and negotiation, and hand off cleanly to implementation.

 2. Grow existing partnerships: serve as the business-development lead for select existing pharma customers, bringing new drugs and new capabilities onto the PHIL platform.

 3. Design the solution: turn each client's needs into a clear, differentiated PHIL solution, and build the proposals, presentations, and ROI models that make the case.

 4. Shape our go-to-market: help define positioning, competitive differentiation, and therapeutic-area approach.

 5. Build our ecosystem: develop partnerships and advisor relationships that open doors with pharma manufacturers.

 6. Represent PHIL: speak for the company at industry events and in partner and customer settings.

 7. Work across PHIL: partner with account management, implementation, product, and operations, and help raise the bar for how we work.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

 - Substantial experience in client-facing roles across business development, sales, consulting, partnerships, or strategy.

 - Experience working at, consulting for, or selling to pharmaceutical manufacturers.

 - Experience in strategy or consulting, including building frameworks, presentations, and financial or ROI models.

 - A track record of selling: owning deals, projects, or engagements through to close.

 - Executive presence and comfort working with senior client leaders.

 - Ability to travel regularly.


WHAT MAKES AN OUTSTANDING CANDIDATE

 - Experience leading, mentoring, or developing others, in any function.

 - Comfort in startup or fast-changing environments, and a bias toward ownership.

 - Experience building partnerships, alliances, or advisor networks.

 - Willingness to roll up your sleeves across proposals, analysis, and operations.


NICE TO HAVE (WE WILL TEACH THE REST)

 - Familiarity with hubs, prior authorization, and pharmacy distribution.

 - Experience representing a company at industry conferences and events.


BENEFITS

 - Ground-floor opportunity with a fast-moving, growth-stage healthtech company.

 - Fully remote working environment.

 - Competitive compensation (commensurate with experience).

 - Full benefits (medical, dental, vision).

 - 401(k) contribution opportunity.

PHIL Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Director of Finance & Business Support
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Director of Finance & Business Support provides strategic financial leadership for Franz Klammer Lodge, ensuring the integrity of financial reporting, regulatory compliance, asset protection, and long-term financial sustainability. This position serves as a key business partner to the General Manager, Executive Committee, Accor leadership, and the Homeowners Association (HOA) Board of Directors, overseeing all aspects of hotel, residential, and HOA financial operations.

What you will be doing:

• Provide accurate and timely financial, management, and HOA reporting in accordance with Accor standards, management agreements, governing documents, and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Lead all budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, variance analysis, and business performance reviews, identifying opportunities to improve financial results and operational effectiveness.
• Manage the financial affairs of the HOA, ensuring compliance with governing documents, management agreements, fiduciary obligations, and board-approved policies.
• Serve as a trusted advisor to the General Manager, Executive Committee, HOA Board, and Finance Committee by providing strategic financial analysis and recommendations.
• Maintain compliance with GAAP, Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI), company policies, and all applicable federal, state, and local regulations.
• Lead the annual audit process and coordinate all external audits, tax reporting, reserve studies, and financial reviews.
• Oversee capital planning, reserve funding, and capital expenditure programs, ensuring alignment with ownership objectives, HOA requirements, and long-term asset preservation strategies.
• Protect and safeguard company and HOA assets through effective internal controls, risk management practices, and financial oversight.
• Maintain oversight of contracts, leases, management agreements, and critical financial obligations to ensure compliance and minimize organizational risk.
• Lead, develop, and mentor the finance team while fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, professional development, and operational excellence.
• Partner with operational leaders to enhance financial acumen, improve business decision-making, and drive performance throughout the organization.
• Build and maintain productive relationships with homeowners, ownership representatives, HOA Board members, Finance Committee members, and external business partners.
• Oversee fixed asset accounting, depreciation schedules, reserve fund administration, and capital asset tracking.
• Monitor and evaluate residential and homeowner benefit programs to ensure financial accuracy, compliance, and operational effectiveness.
• Collaborate with residential operations and real estate partners to support owner value, property performance, and long-term business objectives.
• Prepare, interpret, present and communicate financial results, forecasts, trends, risks, and opportunities to executive leadership, ownership, and governance stakeholders

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field required.
• CPA, CMA, MBA, or other relevant professional designation preferred.
• Minimum 5 years of progressive finance leadership experience, including experience as a Director of Finance, Controller, or equivalent senior financial leadership role.
• Hospitality finance experience required, preferably within luxury hotels, resorts, mixed-use hospitality and residential operations, or homeowners' association (HOA) environments.
• Demonstrated expertise in financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, internal controls, audit coordination, balance sheet management, and strategic financial planning.
• Experience overseeing reserve studies, reserve funding plans, capital improvement projects, and long-term asset planning.
• Strong understanding of HOA governance, owner relations, board reporting, and fiduciary responsibilities preferred.
• Experience presenting financial results, budgets, forecasts, and capital plans to ownership groups, boards of directors, and executive leadership teams.
• Demonstrated experience managing multiple legal entities, cost centers, or business units with varying stakeholder requirements.
• Proven ability to lead annual budget development, long-range planning, and capital expenditure forecasting processes.
• Advanced knowledge of U.S. GAAP, financial controls, compliance requirements, and risk management practices.

Technical Skills

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office Suite, and cloud based accounting systems.
• Experience with hotel and hospitality Property Management Systems.
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate financial data into strategic business recommendations.

Leadership Competencies

• Proven ability to lead, develop, and retain high-performing finance teams while fostering accountability and continuous improvement.
• Strong business acumen with demonstrated success partnering with executive leadership, ownership groups, and boards of directors.
• Exceptional communication, presentation, organizational, and decision-making skills.
• Highly responsible, detail-oriented, and capable of effectively managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Additional Requirements

• Ability to serve as a strategic member of the Executive Committee while providing strong financial stewardship, operational support, and partnership with ownership and governance stakeholders.
• Ability to balance long-term business planning with hands-on financial leadership in a dynamic hospitality and residential environment.

jobs.title: Director, Sales Development
jobs.description:
BUILDING HEALTHCARE THAT REMEMBERS 

Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to. 

At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 345 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1.6 million decision pathways. 

We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C https://www.assorthealth.com/blog/assort-health-raises-120-million-series-c-to-scale-largest-deployment-of-ai-agents-for-the-patient-journey at a $1.2 billion valuation from investors including Menlo Ventures and Lightspeed. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!

Healthcare spends $1.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Assort is growing fast, and we're looking for a Director of Sales Development to build and lead the SDR function that drives pipeline across our Provider Group and Health Systems businesses. You've built a sales development motion from scratch before. You know how to pick the right first experiments, move quickly, learn from what doesn't work, and turn what does into a repeatable playbook.

You will lead SDR across business units, develop first-line managers, and work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships to build pipeline. You'll be a thought partner to the VP of Sales, and the role is designed to grow into broader pipeline ownership as our AE organization scales.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build new pipeline motions

 - Form and test hypotheses for how to generate pipeline in each segment and buyer type, starting with Provider Group and Health Systems.

 - Choose the first tests, launch quickly, and decide what to continue, change, stop, or scale based on evidence.

 - Document what works so it can be repeated across teams.

Lead and develop people

 - Coach first-line managers hands-on, with clear expectations, so they get stronger and the team executes more consistently.

 - Establish repeatable SDR processes for hiring, onboarding, coaching, and performance management.

 - Drive strategy and results through your managers rather than leading everything yourself.

Run the operating rhythm

 - Turn strategy into a manageable set of sprints with owners, deliverables, deadlines, dependencies, and review points.

 - Run several builds and tests at once, remove blockers, and spot stalled work early.

 - Set outcomes, sequence initiatives, allocate resources, and define milestones and performance measures tied to explicit decision points.

Partner across the pipeline

 - Align SDR, Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships on priorities, definitions, handoffs, and shared measures.

 - Resolve channel friction through shared decisions, and build trust with partners.

 - Help shape the path toward broader pipeline ownership as the AE team grows.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Personal ownership of building a sales development motion from zero, with limited infrastructure, at a scale comparable to Assort today. You can explain what you built, how long it took, what failed, and how pipeline changed.

 - At least two years of second-line leadership experience.

 - A track record of developing managers, with specific examples of managers who got better under your leadership.

 - Strong track record as a successful first-line leader

 - Experience running multiple projects or tests concurrently with clear owners, timelines, and decision points.

 - Working fluency in how SDR, Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships each generate pipeline, and how to coordinate them.

 - Strong strategic judgment, bias toward speed, and willingness to change course when an approach isn't working.

 - Resourcefulness and comfort with ambiguity, without needing extensive support or infrastructure.

 


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - First 30 days: You understand the current SDR motion, and you've chosen and launched your first pipeline tests.

 - First 90 days: You've set up a sprint-based operating rhythm with your managers, aligned partner teams on definitions and handoffs, and made your first continue/change/stop decisions based on data.

 - First 12 months: You've built repeatable SDR motions for each business unit, your managers are measurably stronger, and cross-functional partners trust your judgment.




BENEFITS & PERKS FOR ASSORTIES

 - 💸 Competitive Compensation – Including salary and employee stock options so you share in our success.

 - 📚 Lifelong Learning – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.

 - 💻 Office Setup Stipend – We’ll outfit your in-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.

 - 🩺 Top-Tier Health Coverage – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first.

 - 🏖 Flexible PTO – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it.

 - 🥗 Meals & Snacks – Lunch, dinner, and snack breaks that fuel great ideas.

 - 💪 Fitness Stipend – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health.

 - 🚆 Commuter Benefits – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier.

 - 👵 401(k) – Build your retirement savings.
   
   


HOW WE WORK & WHAT WE VALUE

Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide how we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a Day One Drive, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a 5-Star Focus, as our customers are our lifeblood, always Answer the Call, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with One Pulse, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: the Assort Health Talent Team will only email you from an assorthealth.com http://assorthealth.com email address.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Shift5

Shift5 is the observability platform for onboard operational technology (OT). We’re a rapidly growing scale-up that specializes in cybersecurity, predictive maintenance, and compliance for OT systems across defense, aerospace, and rail. We are a collaborative, passionate, and driven cadre of dynamic, multidisciplinary experts focused on helping our customers’ fleets run smarter and safer by accessing and democratizing the volumes of onboard OT data generated by transportation, freight fleets, defense fleets, and other critical infrastructure. Come join us.

Shift5 is seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager to join our team. In this role, you will serve as the critical operational bridge between Program teams, Engineering, and real-world deployments. This role is execution-oriented and deeply cross-functional, focusing on milestone tracking, resource and capacity planning, tooling optimization (Jira/Confluence), and ensuring seamless delivery across internal products and customer deployments.

This position is based out of our headquarters in Rosslyn, VA, but is open to remote candidates within the U.S. This role also requires up to 30% travel to support customer site integrations and testing.

What You'll Do

• Cross-Functional Execution & Delivery: Serve as a key liaison between Program teams and Engineering, translating program priorities, milestones, and functional requirements into clear, actionable tasks and engineering plans across hardware, software, firmware, platform, and systems teams.

• Program Tracking & Risk Management: Track milestones, cross-team dependencies, risks, and resource constraints. Proactively identify execution conflicts and escalate issues that may impact program commitments.

• Stakeholder Alignment & Facilitation: Partner with Engineering managers, technical leads, TPMs, and Program leadership to align priorities, sequencing, ownership, and timelines. Facilitate planning sessions, status reviews, and cross-functional working sessions to drive decisions and follow-through.

• Tooling & Process Optimization: Maintain deep expertise in Jira and Confluence to drive project tracking, workflow optimization, sprint planning, and program visibility. Partner with the broader Operations team to continuously improve planning, reporting, and execution processes across Engineering.

• Resource & Capacity Planning: Support capacity planning by identifying competing program demands and potential bottlenecks across engineering disciplines.

• Customer & Field Operations Support: Work onsite as needed alongside technical and customer-facing teams to support product deployment, implementation, adoption, and ongoing operations. Manage and prioritize requests from customers, users, and field teams, balancing responsiveness with engineering capacity.

• Internal Product & Tooling Improvement: Partner with internal users and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and drive improvements to internal products and tooling through requirements gathering, roadmap input, and structured feedback loops.

What Success Looks Like

• Seamless Program-to-Engineering Translation: You convert ambiguous program goals and functional requirements into crisp, well-sequenced engineering plans with clear ownership across hardware, software, and firmware teams.

• Proactive Risk & Capacity Control: You anticipate dependencies, competing demands, and execution bottlenecks early, keeping leadership aligned and ensuring program commitments are met without surprises.

• Operational Visibility & Rigor: Your mastery of Jira, Confluence, and operational reporting gives leadership and engineering teams real-time clarity into sprint progress, roadmaps, and program health.

• High-Impact Field & User Alignment: You effectively balance urgent customer, field, and internal user requests against engineering capacity, driving smooth deployments and continuous improvements to internal tooling.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

• Experience: 4+ years of experience in engineering operations, technical program coordination, project/program management, or a similar role working directly with engineering teams in a cross-functional technical environment.

• Program & Execution Management: Strong program management skills, including milestone tracking, dependency management, risk management, prioritization, and cross-team coordination.

• Technical Translation: Proven ability to decipher functional requirements and customer needs into actionable engineering plans while effectively communicating engineering constraints back to stakeholders.

• Tooling Proficiency: Advanced proficiency with Jira (including custom workflows, dashboards, and reporting) and Confluence for technical program planning and tracking.

• Communication & Leadership: Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to drive alignment and execution across teams without direct authority.

• Adaptability & Customer Empathy: Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating in an environment with ambiguity and changing priorities, paired with demonstrated empathy for users and field teams.

Preferred:

• Government & Defense Experience: Experience delivering software or hardware in support of U.S. Government-funded programs.

• Complex Systems Background: Experience working with integrated hardware and software systems within aerospace, defense, or other complex technical environments.

• Security Clearance: Active Secret clearance or the ability to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance.

Compensation & Benefits

• Base Salary: $119,000 - $131,000

• Bonus program and equity in a fast-growing startup

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families

• Health Savings Account with annual employer contributions

• Employer-paid Life and Disability Insurance

• Uncapped paid time off policy

• Flexible work & remote work policy

• Tax-deferred public transit benefits with Metro SmartBenefits (DC/MD/VA)

We are committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that embraces the diversity of our people and represents the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives and ways of solving problems. We strive to attract and retain talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.

Shift5 is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identify, national origin, disability, age, marital status, ancestry, projected veteran status, or any other protected group or class.

jobs.title: Reliability Test Specialist
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Reliability Engineering team partners across Anduril's engineering, manufacturing, and operations organizations to ensure our autonomous systems survive real-world conditions and deliver consistent performance for our customers. Our mandate spans the complete product lifecycle - from early concept design through production scale-up and fielded operations. We use data, statistical methods, and engineering analysis to forecast how our systems will perform over time and influence design decisions, including part selection, redundancy strategies, and maintenance approaches. We establish tailored reliability frameworks by program and partner with Quality to drive design robustness, failure prevention, and rapid response to issues in the field.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) group is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

We are seeking a Reliability Test Technician to join our team in Santa Ana, CA, supporting reliability test execution, instrumentation, and fixture build-out across our Intelligence Systems products. This role is critical to building a sustainable reliability test capability for the business, and will partner with our Reliability Engineers to support the physical execution of test campaigns - HALT, HASS, environmental, vibration/shock, and more. You will own test setup builds, equipment operation, data capture, and calibration coordination, and be responsible for standing up repeatable, well-documented test processes (SOPs, test plans/procedures, readiness checklists) so that testing can scale predictably as new programs are added. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who enjoys working in a lab/test environment, is comfortable with tools and test equipment, and takes ownership of getting testing completed correctly the first time.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Set up, execute, and monitor reliability tests including HALT, HASS, thermal cycling, vibration, shock, and other reliability tests

• Operate and maintain test equipment (repetitive shock shakers, electrodynamic shakers, IR chambers, ESPEC chambers, vacuum chambers, ingress chambers, DAQ systems, and sensors/instrumentation), and maintain a fixture and equipment inventory to support reuse across programs

• Build, assemble, and validate test setups (i.e. HTOL racks) and fixtures needed for reliability and environmental test campaigns, working from designs provided by partner Engineering teams

• Troubleshoot test setup and equipment issues in real time to keep test campaigns on schedule

• Document test observations, anomalies, and failure data with sufficient detail to support root cause investigations

• Support failure analysis activities through test setup, in-situ monitoring, and physical teardown/inspection of test articles, including use of metrology equipment (CT, X-ray, CMM, Keyence scope, etc.)

• Support Reliability Engineers in executing DOEs, including RF-related test campaigns

• Coordinate test article logistics (receipt, tracking, prep, teardown) across concurrent programs, including for external testing

• Write and maintain test plans, procedures, SOPs, and final test reports; support test readiness reviews (TRRs) with clear documentation

• Create and maintain test readiness checklists to ensure consistent, repeatable test execution across technicians and programs

• Serve as the primary interface with Quality for equipment calibration scheduling, tracking, and upkeep

• Support Reliability Engineers in witnessing tests at outside test houses, capturing data and documentation as needed

• Track qualification test article status and maintain test logs/records to support compliance reporting

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Associate's degree or technical certification in Electronics, Mechanical/Manufacturing Technology, or equivalent, plus 2+ years of relevant hands-on test/lab experience (additional experience may substitute for degree)

• Hands-on experience with environmental test equipment such as thermal chambers, vibration/shaker tables, or HALT/HASS chambers

• Practical mechanical aptitude - comfortable building test setups and fixtures using hand tools, power tools, and basic shop equipment

• Experience with data acquisition systems and common test instrumentation (accelerometers, thermocouples, strain gauges, etc.)

• Ability to read and interpret mechanical and electrical drawings/schematics

• Strong documentation habits - able to write clear test plans, procedures, SOPs, and reports, and accurately maintain test logs

• Ability to work independently in a lab environment, managing multiple concurrent test setups

• Willingness to travel occasionally to support testing at external test labs

• Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Familiarity with test standards such as MIL-STD-810, GM/Qualmark HALT specifications, and MIL-STD-461/464

• Direct experience operating HALT/HASS equipment (i.e. Qualmark or similar chambers)

• Experience with metrology and inspection equipment (CT, X-ray, CMM, Keyence scope, or similar)

• Prior experience in a defense, aerospace, or other regulated hardware test environment

• Basic machining or fabrication experience (mill, lathe, 3D printing) for test setup builds

• Familiarity with DOE concepts and structured test planning

• Experience with equipment calibration processes and records

• General knowledge of Linux, PCBA architecture, communication buses (I2C, SPI, UART), and networking concepts (TCP/IP, OSI layers) - not required, can be learned on the job

US Hourly Range

$42.31—$56.25 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Compilers
jobs.description:
Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler  (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber’s first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

Why This Role Matters

Our compiler, built in Python on xDSL, represents designs and manufacturing work as typed intermediate representations (IRs). We call it a synpiler: a synthesizing compiler that combines transformations with synthesis steps to resolve missing details as a design becomes a manufacturing program.

Today, the compiler resolves work to methods and block classes; separate tools generate machine instructions. You’ll bring those stages into shared compiler representations, interfaces and verification, including decisions that depend on measurements taken during production.

You’ll own compiler representations, lowering and verification. FABOS maintains production state, plans and authorizes work, and reconciles physical results. Machine endpoints retain final binding, lowering and local control using the selected block’s context. Compiler verification checks representation validity; physical measurements support acceptance of the device against its requirements.

AI fluency is central: use agents throughout development while owning the decisions, code and results you accept.

What You’ll Do

• Build xDSL dialects, analyses, synthesis steps, transformation passes, verifiers and lowering pipelines.

• Represent physical effects, measurement-dependent control flow and unresolved decisions; preserve source process graphs while refining derived IR.

• Define instruction-generation targets and interfaces with FABOS and machine endpoints, making explicit what must be resolved before dependent work can execute.

• Integrate CAM, toolpath and machine-specific instruction generation through typed interfaces, using the selected block’s configuration, calibration and limits during endpoint lowering.

• Specify and test the properties transformations must preserve, including required ordering and evidence; invalidate affected artifacts when target assumptions change.

• Work with Process, CAM, motion, planning and Quality engineers on requirements, acceptance criteria and fab integration; connect generated instructions to requirements and acceptance evidence.

• Use AI throughout investigation, design, implementation, testing and documentation; inspect changes and verify results.

What You’ll Need

• Production software ownership, typically 8+ years for the senior target; productive Python and strong Go or C⁠+⁠+, with readiness to work in Python/xDSL.

• Implementation depth in compilers: typed IRs, analyses, transformations, effects, control flow, verification and progressive lowering.

• Strong AI fluency: provide context, challenge proposals, inspect code and meaningfully test accepted work.

• Evidence of simplifying, testing, operating and safely evolving systems, with clear interfaces, technical writing and explicit correctness conditions for compiler transformations.

• Ability to turn user needs and expert knowledge into requirements, working with process, geometry, motion and planning specialists.

• Willingness to work directly with fab equipment; hardware experience preferred.

• BS in CS or a related field.

Also Useful

• MLIR or xDSL implementation experience, including dialects and rewrite or conversion infrastructure; CIRCT, async or Transform dialects, or equality saturation.

• Program synthesis, partial programs, constrained search, or specification and verification using SMT solvers, TLA+, Lean, Coq or property-based testing.

• CNC/CAM, G-code, trajectory generation, or integration with C⁠+⁠+ motion-control code and gRPC services.

The compensation for this position also includes equity and benefits.

Salary Range

$170,000—$230,000 USD

We are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including for individuals with disabilities. ABOUT VEG

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff’s E-commerce team builds an app-to-web product that drives mobile app users to purchase on Shopify web stores. We operate like a startup inside Liftoff. Requirements shift as we learn from live customers, and most problems arrive without an internal playbook. We built the product from the ground up and have already shipped major performance wins.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll turn ambiguous problems into sound designs and execution plans, then drive them to production. You’ll own architecture and technical decisions for core targeting and attribution systems, and help shape the team’s work through design and code review. When customer performance drops, you’ll trace the cause through our systems, determine whether it’s a bug or a market signal, and turn the finding into a design.

Responsibilities:

• Own epics end to end, including scoping, design, delivery, and production health.

• Help set the team’s technical direction and long-term roadmap.

• Build privacy-compliant data systems that expand reach while maintaining accuracy.

• Design attribution logic that captures more of the purchases we drive without overcounting.

• Lead customer performance deep dives and turn findings into experiments.

• Research new tools and approaches, and recommend solutions that balance short-term and long-term needs.

• Review design docs and PRs, and help set the team’s bar for reliability, scalability, observability, privacy, cost efficiency, and documentation.

• Partner with ML engineers to improve conversion models, including training data and conversion signal quality.

• Build and extend our Shopify app and web pixel.

• Mentor engineers and help hold the senior engineering bar in interviews.

• Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

• Minimum Bachelors Degree and 8 yrs of relevant experience. Equivalent practical experience may be considered in place of a formal degree.

• Experience leading the design and delivery of complex projects across multiple engineers.

• Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript, plus fluent SQL (Trino, Spark, or equivalent).

• A track record of taking ambiguous problems from scoping to shipped outcome with minimal oversight.

• Demonstrated ability to diagnose performance or data discrepancies across a multi-stage pipeline, from raw signal to reported outcome.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and event-driven systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub, or equivalent).

• You operate with Agency and Urgency by taking initiative to solve problems and drive outcomes independently, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• You have a Growth Mindset and are adaptable, quick to test, iterate, and improve both ideas and your own skill set.

NICE TO HAVE:

• Experience with web attribution or conversion tracking, such as pixels, server-side conversion APIs, or attribution platforms.

Working at Liftoff is fast-paced, fun, and challenging, and we thrive on innovation. Come join our team and help shape the future of the mobile app ecosystem. If this role sounds interesting to you, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Organ Preservationist
jobs.description:
Career Opportunity: Organ Preservationist in the Tri- State of Kentucky and Surrounding Regions

Are you looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on organ donation by bringing your surgical expertise to a role where precision, purpose, and teamwork come together? As an Organ Preservationist, you will evaluate potential donors, coordinate clinical care, and help maximize opportunities for successful donation through the recovery, preservation, and perfusion of organs and tissues for transplantation or research. This role is ideal for an experienced healthcare professional who thrives in fast-paced, sensitive, and highly collaborative environments.

As an Organ Preservationist, you will perform aseptic organ preservation and kidney perfusion, support operating room preparation, maintain preservation supplies and equipment, and build strong relationships with hospital OR teams through education and collaboration. You will help ensure every recovery is handled safely, accurately, and in accordance with applicable policies, regulatory standards, and manufacturer guidelines. This position reports to the Manager of Surgical Services.

We are committed to supporting the professional growth and development of our team members, with opportunities to expand skills, take on additional responsibilities, and advance within the organization. In this role, you will be expected to consistently perform your work safely, ethically, and in accordance with organizational policies, professional standards, and applicable laws and regulations. Your commitment to safety, integrity, and compassionate care will be essential to supporting donors, their families, healthcare partners, and our mission.

Responsibilities:

• Perform aseptic organ preservation, including flushing abdominal organs with the appropriate solution and packaging and labeling organs, vessels, and tissue-typing materials in accordance with OPTN policy.

• Assist hospital staff with operating room preparation for organ recovery procedures.

• Perform aseptic kidney pumping and pulsatile perfusion following kidney separation by a surgeon.

• Support aseptic surgical recovery of organs and tissues for research.

• Obtain biopsy specimens, prepare frozen slides, and submit materials for pathologist review.

• Maintain preservation supplies, solutions, laboratory readiness, and mechanical preservation equipment in accordance with organizational policy, regulatory standards, and manufacturer guidelines.

• Develop productive relationships with operating room staff and provide donation-related education through in-services, presentations, and meetings.

Qualifications:

• Completion of a Surgical Technologist Program required; Certified Surgical Technologist credential preferred.

• Two or more years of operating room experience with demonstrated knowledge of sterile technique.

• Experience in organ or tissue recovery is strongly desired.

• Organ perfusion and previous on-call experience preferred.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively while demonstrating sound judgment, problem-solving, and decision-making.

• Excellent arm-hand steadiness, manual dexterity, and finger dexterity for precise clinical work.

• Strong computer and data-entry skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and internet-based systems.

• Professionalism, discretion, and a high degree of confidentiality.

• Certified Transplant Preservationist credential required within 24 months of hire.

Schedule & Work Environment:

This role includes significant on-call responsibility, including the ability to work 24-hour on-call shifts, respond promptly to dispatches, and travel throughout the designated service area. Work is performed in hospital clinical areas. The position requires the ability to lift up to 75 pounds and assist with donor transfers. Reasonable accommodations may be available to support qualified individuals in performing the essential functions of the role.

What We Offer:

• Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays.

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

• Retirement savings benefits.

• Employer-supported professional development and training opportunities.

• Additional employee wellness and support resources.

If you are passionate about helping others and ready to bring your surgical expertise to a mission-driven, inclusive team, apply online today and become part of our future.

EEO/M/F/D/V. No third-party applications please.

Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

• Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.

• Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.

• Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.

• Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.

What We're Looking For

Lightning AI is looking for a Senior IT Systems Engineer to help manage, improve, and scale our internal IT operations. This is a hands-on role that combines systems administration, technical support, IT infrastructure, and process improvement, with a strong focus on automation and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in IT operations and systems administration, with experience implementing or supporting automation and system integrations. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, improving how things work, and helping build a more efficient IT department.

This position is based onsite at our San Francisco office.

What You’ll Do

IT Systems & Infrastructure

• Evaluate new technologies and recommend practical solutions that improve IT operations.

• Help introduce self-service capabilities and reduce repetitive IT requests.

Identity & Access Management

• Administer and maintain identity and access management systems.

• Manage user accounts, groups, permissions, and application access across enterprise platforms.

• Support SSO, SAML, SCIM, MFA, and role-based access control.

• Improve user provisioning and deprovisioning processes.

• Troubleshoot authentication, application access, and account provisioning issues.

• Partner with Information Security to maintain secure access controls and follow least-privilege principles.

• Support periodic access reviews and identity-related security initiatives.

IT Operation

• Work closely with the IT Manager to improve IT processes, standards, and operational practices.

• Take ownership of IT projects from planning through implementation and ongoing support.

• Identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements to existing systems and workflows.

• Help establish scalable processes for onboarding, offboarding, device management, and IT service delivery.

• Maintain and improve IT documentation, knowledge bases, and standard operating procedures.

• Collaborate with Engineering, Security, People Operations, and other departments on technical initiatives.

• Support IT planning, technology evaluations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Help build a reliable and scalable IT environment as the company grows.

Security & Compliance

• Partner with Corporate Security to implement and maintain security controls across endpoints, identities, and enterprise applications.

• Support security initiatives involving MFA, encryption, patch management, and application access controls.

• Assist with access reviews, audit evidence collection, and compliance requirements.

• Partner with GRC to support SOC 2 and other applicable compliance frameworks.

• Help identify and remediate security risks within IT-managed systems.

• Ensure IT processes and system configurations align with company security policies.

What You'll Need

• Strong experience managing enterprise IT systems, endpoints, and SaaS applications.

• Experience implementing or supporting IT automation, system integrations, or workflow improvements.

• Experience with identity and access management platforms such as JumpCloud, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, or similar solutions.

• Understanding of SSO, SAML, SCIM, MFA, and role-based access control.

• Experience administering Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or similar enterprise productivity platforms.

• Experience managing Windows and macOS environments, including endpoint management and security.

• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and wireless networking.

• Experience supporting employee onboarding, offboarding, and account provisioning.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoints, applications, identity systems, and enterprise IT infrastructure.

• Experience using IT service management or ticketing platforms such as Jira, ServiceNow, or similar tools.

• Ability to independently manage technical projects and follow through on implementation.

• Strong communication, documentation, and organizational skills.

• A proactive mindset with an interest in improving processes, reducing manual work, and building scalable IT operations.

• Comfortable working onsite and providing hands-on support when needed.

Nice to Have

• Experience integrating HRIS, identity management, and IT service management platforms.

• Familiarity with workflow automation tools or enterprise integration platforms.

• Basic scripting or API experience.

• Experience evaluating and implementing new IT tools and technologies.

• Experience supporting Linux environments or engineering teams.

• Experience supporting AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or other cloud environments.

• Experience with IT asset management and lifecycle management.

jobs.description:
Team Bio:

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform.

Our mission: We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise.

Why This Role Matters:

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software.

As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE), you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries.

Who You Are:

You are a systems-minded, AI-native engineer who ships real software. You own the full stack—and are equally motivated by elegant APIs, intuitive UIs, and scalable orchestration pipelines. You think like a product-minded CTO, balancing creativity with pragmatism to deliver impact.

What You’ll Do:

As a GenAI/ML Engineer on the FDE team, you will:

• Forward Deployed Engineers sit alongside our customers and turn ambiguous business problems into working AI systems.
• Partner directly with customers to discover problems and frame high-impact AI use cases.
• Design and build end-to-end GenAI/ML systems — RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, evaluation, and guardrails — and ship them to production.
• Prototype quickly, iterate with real users, and harden pilots into reliable, monitored services.
• Own the technical relationship, translating between business stakeholders and engineering.
• Raise the bar for ML depth and engineering quality across the team.

What Success Looks Like:

• Production-grade delivery: Your solution builds consistently convert to scaled deployments in production environments
• Reusable impact: You author libraries, prompts, and scaffolds that power multiple deployments and projects
• Platform influence: Your work shapes internal tooling and is integrated into platform roadmap and primitives
• Velocity and precision: You move fast without breaking things—shaping resilient, secure systems in high-stakes contexts
• Engineering leadership: You are trusted by architects, PMs, and customer teams to lead implementation from zero to one

What You Bring:

• Experience: In leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry
• Relevant Experience: 12+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years building systems in customer-facing or embedded roles. Experience building machine learning/ GenAI systems with modern AI/ML technologies, including LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG architectures.
• System architecture: Proven ability to design and implement AI-native software in production environments
• Engineering depth: Strength in backend (Python, Node.js, Java), frontend (React, Angular), APIs (REST/GraphQL)
• LLM tooling: Familiarity with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, prompt chaining, vector search, and context management
• Performance & observability: Skilled in debugging distributed systems, tuning for latency, and implementing monitoring
• Platform mindset: Can contribute to shared SDKs and tools, raising engineering velocity for the whole org
• Product sensibility: Prioritize for user value, MVP iteration, and long-term scale
• DevOps fluency: Experience deploying in AWS, Azure, or GCP with CI/CD, containers, and infra-as-code
• Field readiness: Able to travel up to 30% to embed onsite and deliver where it matters

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience integrating AI into SaaS platforms like ServiceNow or Salesforce
• Track record of production deployments in secure, regulated enterprise environments
• Contributions to dev experience tooling, frameworks, or reusable AI scaffolds

jobs.title: Food & Beverage Operations Training Manager
jobs.description:
The Operational Training Manager is responsible for elevating the quality and consistency of luxury guest service across the hotel’s Food & Beverage division. This highly operational role translates Fairmont brand standards, Leading Quality Assurance (LQA) standards, and hotel-specific expectations into consistent, observable service behaviors.

Approximately 90–95% of the position’s time will be spent embedded in the operation, observing service delivery, coaching colleagues in real time, assessing performance, and reinforcing expected standards. Working in partnership with departmental leadership, the manager will identify service gaps, deliver targeted on-the-job training, and validate that improvements are sustained.

The objective is to ensure that exceptional service is consistently practiced throughout the guest journey, not simply taught in training sessions or addressed during periodic audits.

Key Responsibilities

Service Standards & Coaching

• Maintain a visible presence across Food & Beverage, observing service delivery and reinforcing standards during daily operations.
• Serve as a resource for interpreting and applying Fairmont brand standards, LQA standards, and hotel-specific service expectations.
• Observe key guest touchpoints, including restaurant and breakfast service, guest requests, service recovery.
• Identify gaps in service execution, including colleague knowledge, communication, timing, accuracy, personalization, and follow-through.
• Provide immediate, constructive coaching and demonstrate the expected behaviors, allowing colleagues to practice and apply feedback.
• Model exceptional luxury service, including anticipation of guest needs, personalization, emotional connection, and thoughtful gestures that create memorable experiences.
• Reinforce consistency across departments, teams, and shifts, identifying opportunities to elevate service beyond minimum requirements.

Hands-On Training & Colleague Development

• Deliver individualized, on-the-job training through demonstration, guided practice, observation, and immediate feedback.
• Train colleagues across the division, adapting coaching to the responsibilities and service requirements of each role.
• Translate written standards into clear, observable behaviors that colleagues can consistently demonstrate.
• Address frequently missed standards, recurring guest complaints, audit findings, and specific performance gaps through targeted coaching.
• Reinforce service fundamentals, including guest engagement, eye contact, body language, use of guest names, product knowledge, anticipation, communication, timing, accuracy, and follow-through.
• Use realistic guest scenarios to develop colleagues’ ability to manage service delays, inaccurate orders, room concerns, complaints, unmet expectations, and opportunities to create special moments.
• Verify competency through observation and demonstration rather than relying solely on training attendance or completion records.
• Provide follow-up coaching and support operational onboarding to ensure colleagues can demonstrate required service competencies before working independently, in partnership with departmental leadership.

Quality Assessment & Continuous Improvement

• Conduct structured service observations and quality assessments using LQA, Fairmont, and applicable internal standards.
• Maintain an observation schedule that provides appropriate coverage across priority guest touchpoints, departments, and shifts.
• Analyze observations, guest feedback, TrustYou results, RPS trends, complaint themes, and other relevant quality indicators to identify improvement opportunities.
• Distinguish individual performance gaps from broader issues involving training, communication, operational processes, or leadership reinforcement.
• Translate findings into prioritized coaching activities, targeted training interventions, and measurable improvement plans in partnership with departmental leaders.
• Maintain accurate records of observations, coaching interventions, identified gaps, and follow-up assessments.
• Conduct validation assessments to determine whether service execution has improved and whether changes are sustained.
• Support ongoing readiness for LQA and other applicable brand or third-party quality assessments through consistent operational reinforcement.

Guest Experience & Service Recovery

• Reinforce a guest-centric approach that helps colleagues understand both what the standard requires and why it matters to the guest.
• Coach colleagues to recognize verbal and nonverbal cues, anticipate needs, personalize interactions, and create authentic emotional connections.
• Reinforce effective service recovery, including prompt acknowledgment, ownership, appropriate resolution, communication, and follow-through.
• Identify recurring guest pain points and partner with operational leaders to address the behaviors or service gaps contributing to negative experiences.
• Encourage colleagues to communicate concerns promptly, seek assistance when needed, and take ownership of the guest experience.
• Identify opportunities to create memorable guest moments that reflect the expectations of luxury hospitality and differentiate Fairmont San Francisco.
• Evaluate recovery from the guest’s perspective, including whether the guest felt heard, cared for, and confident in the hotel’s commitment to their experience.

Partnership with Operational Leadership

• Partner with Food & Beverage leaders, managers, and supervisors to establish consistent expectations for service execution and colleague development.
• Provide actionable observations and recommendations to help leaders prioritize gaps, establish improvement objectives, and implement practical solutions.
• Reinforce that departmental leaders remain accountable for service quality and colleague performance, with the Operational Training Manager serving as a specialized resource and partner.
• Coach leaders on effective observation, feedback, demonstration, and reinforcement techniques to strengthen their ability to maintain standards.
• Review progress against agreed action plans and determine whether further coaching, operational changes, or leadership intervention is needed.
• Share effective practices across Food & Beverage to improve consistency throughout the guest journey.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. Apply now!

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance & punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From assistant manager to general manager, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

· Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

SENSING

TEMPERAMENTS

Domino's Team USA stores value honesty, transparency, and accountability, and we want exceptional people like you to join our team! We have continued to prove we “Put our People First” by making sure our work environment is safe and provides stability for our team members.

jobs.title: Veterinary Nursing Trainer - Schaumburg, IL
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Nursing Trainer, you have one of the most meaningful jobs at VEG: helping others grow. You’ll lead with curiosity, coach with compassion, and obsess over development. You’re not just building skills—you’re building confidence, momentum, and careers in emergency medicine. Whether you’re working 1:1 on the floor, guiding peer-led sessions, or developing educational tools, your impact will be felt hospital-wide. You’ll tailor training to every learning style, celebrate every milestone, and say yes to every VEGgie who is ready to take the next step. Your work helps make VEG a place where people learn, lead, and love what they do.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Partner with leadership to identify individual and team training needs

• Assess assistants and credentialed technicians through direct observation and real-time immersion

• Drive advancement through VEG’s Cultivate program

• Implement VEG training programs and serve as the go-to training lead at your hospital

• Split your time between on-the-floor mentoring and strategic development

• Provide tailored, hands-on training for all learning styles and skill levels with patience and understanding

• Organize peer training opportunities and build a strong mentoring culture

• Collaborate with nursing managers and professional networks to broaden impact

• Develop and refine training content (i.e. presentations, videos, simulations, and assessments)

• Ensure all training aligns with VEG’s culture, mission, and emergency standards of care

• Continually evaluate and improve leveling programs for assistants and technicians

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a veterinary technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located; VTS in ECC, internal medicine, or anesthesia/analgesia a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation

• High level of knowledge and skill in emergency medicine

• Previous training experience preferred

• A relentless passion for teaching and uplifting others

• An ownership mindset around your team’s growth and development

• Strong communicator and collaborator across teams

• Excitement about VEG’s culture and mission, with a desire to lead by example

• Willingness to travel to other VEG hospitals in your region to help with new veterinarian onboarding as needed

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation: $33–$65 per hour in base pay, including 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, QPR training, and access to free therapy or counseling

• Depending on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave; up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.
