• Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below).
• Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program.

Universal Pictures is a division of Universal Filmed Entertainment Group, within NBCUniversal, one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. For more than a century, the Studio has helped to redefine global popular culture, ensuring that audiences have access to stories by artists who look like them, who see them, and who celebrate them. Universal’s deep library includes many of the world’s most beloved films and homegrown franchises, including Jaws, Back to the Future, Bourne, Jurassic World, Fast & Furious, Mamma Mia!, Fifty Shades of Grey, Jordan Peele’s Get Out and Nope, Blumhouse’s The Purge franchise and M3GAN, Christopher Nolan’s Academy Award®-winning Oppenheimer, as well as animated blockbusters from Illumination and DreamWorks Animation.

In addition to its lineup of groundbreaking originals, Universal Pictures works with leading content creators around the world to distribute and market their films to its global audience.

Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:

• Audience Analysis & Research: Intern will help support NBCU’s television distribution business with audience based quantitative reporting, insight and strategic analysis in key international territories across all television platforms, including both linear TV channels and global SVOD platforms.
• Brand Marketing: Intern will support team with global oversight of all brand components for franchise/event film launches, leading implementation of worldwide brand strategy and collaborate with divisions to optimize brands and business goals.
• Creative Advertising: Intern will support the team that produces campaign materials such as trailers, tv spots, and keyart from development to execution for various movies for global use.
• Digital Marketing: Intern will support team on social activations across Focus Features brand channels and individual film titles, social research, content creation, in-app engagement tactics (ie. Follow accounts/like posts from talent), social editorial calendaring, live social coverage at events.
• International Marketing: Intern in the International Distribution and Marketing will support that team that directly markets and distributes movies through its local offices, creating campaigns and release strategies that respond to the culture and market behavior of those territories.
• In-Theater Marketing: Intern will have exposure to the inner workings of individual media channels (linear & streaming), Digital, and how we create our content from start to finish.
• Multicultural Marketing: Intern will create campaigns specifically for Black, Hispanic and Asian American audiences, building off of the general strategy for the film but also adding specific cultural nuances to resonate with audiences.
• Partnerships & Promotions: Intern will support this group that is comprised of two teams (sales and creative execution with a designated focus on international and domestic territories) with the shared objective of developing and delivering third party branded campaigns for our theatrical releases.
• Publicity: Intern will help with preparing for press junkets, researching media outlets & contacts, and compiling coverage reports.

Basic Requirements:

• Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program. Spring 2027 graduates are not eligible for our Summer 2027 internship program.
• Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).
• Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
• Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027.
• Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA.

For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.

NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.

Desired Characteristics:

• Students with class standing of junior or above preferred.
• Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
• Detail-oriented, analytical, strategic thinker, creative, researcher, energetic, resourceful, self-starter, great time-management.
• Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• High level of organization and ability to manage multiple projects with various deadlines.
• Excellent communication skills, including written, verbal, and proofreading skills.

ADESA, a Carvana-owned company, currently operates in over 50 locations throughout the US. Our auto auctions, some up to 200 acres, provide a wide array of vehicle services, including repair, reconditioning, and auction remarketing, and many of our sites serve as market hub distribution centers. We work in a service industry and embrace a “we” versus “I” culture – help others, and they will help you. Our industry is fun, fast-paced, and competitive – and filled with the best people who are passionate about what they do.

We’re excited about the future! We are looking for great people who want to take this journey with us! Get a sneak peek into life at ADESA!

Your primary focus is to execute vehicle movement across the lot by transporting and staging units in designated areas under the direction of leadership.

Responsibilities

• Safe Operations: Always operate motor vehicles safely and practice conservative, cautious, and courteous driving habits.

• Vehicle Staging: Support efficient lot flow and ensure vehicles are positioned accurately to meet operational and sale day needs.

• Safety Compliance: Maintain work areas to ensure a safe environment and promptly notify managers of all driving-related incidents or potential hazards.

• Policy Adherence: Follow company procedures involving accidents, injuries, or property damage, and ensure all state or federal laws are followed.

• Other Duties: Perform any other duties assigned by the designated manager.

Skills and Attributes

• Teamwork: Hardworking, motivated team player who collaborates well with multiple departments and customers.

• Communication: Effective interpersonal skills with the ability to follow basic English instructions.

• Technical Literacy: Ability to comprehend alphanumeric order and motor vehicle traffic signs.

• Adaptability: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment in all weather conditions.

• Detail-Oriented: Proven ability to multitask while maintaining attention to detail.

• Customer Focus: Strong customer service skills.

Qualifications

• High School diploma or GED preferred

• Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver’s license that meets the requirements

• Able to safely drive a variety of vehicle makes, models, and sizes

• Automotive or auction experience preferred

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Customer Success
jobs.description:
WHY WE'RE HIRING

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage. Our product is the operating system our own teams run on: voice AI intake, placements, instant quoting, sales, service and retention, plus the operator tools that tie them together. Each module has engineers, a forward-deployed pod and operators who live in it every day, but not enough product ownership to decide what to build, measure whether it worked, and keep the module coherent as it scales. This hire closes that gap. Each PM becomes the single owner of a module's outcomes: its KPIs, its roadmap and the operator experience inside it.


Experience: 5–8 years. Scope: Service (Customer Success)

About the role

You own a product area that spans more than one team and more than one quarter. Nobody hands you the problem list; you find the problems worth solving, decide which to bet on, and are accountable for the outcome even when the work runs through several pods.

Service is the clearest example. It touches endorsements, certificates, renewals, billing and claims support, and today a lot of it runs on human effort. The Senior PM decides what gets productized, what stays operator-owned, and in what order.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Outcomes, not features. Propose the KPI set for your area and defend why those are the right targets. At least one should trace to a company top-line number (revenue, retention, cost per policy).

 - A 3–6 month roadmap with clear bets, sequencing and kill criteria.

 - Growth avenues. Look past optimizing today's funnel: new segments, use cases, or ways to expand revenue per account.

 - Cross-team delivery. Break initiatives into plans other people can execute; chase dependencies directly; re-plan out loud the moment reality changes.

 - Ops partnership. Be embedded enough that operators treat you as a peer on process. Turn recurring operational pain into bets with clear ROI.

 - Raising the bar. Mentor the PM on specs and prioritization; own a stage of the PM interview loop.
   
    
   
   
   LOGISTICS
   
    
   
   - Compensation: $125,000–$170,000 base + performance bonus + equity.
   
   - Location: San Francisco, in-office. Based here or willing to relocate.
   
   - Benefits: Uber commuter benefits; breakfast, lunch, and dinner provided; snacks and coffee stocked; free gym membership; health, dental, and vision.

If you want to own a module that touches real customers from week one — send your resume and tell us about something you built that moved a number.

About Us

Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

Primary Focus:

As Director, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for defining the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda that shape Fanatics Casino performance creative. You’ll uncover the hooks, angles and player insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role is the strategic link between player insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring the right problems are being solved and that learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention.

This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Performance Creative & GTM, and manages one Associate, Performance Creative.

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the Casino performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.

• Build and evolve the Casino creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.

• Own the Casino testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.

• Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.

• Identify and define the performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs

Partner with the Casino Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.

• Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.

• Source player insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.


THE ROLE

Some of the biggest commercial banks in the world already work with us. Their relationship managers would rather spend time with clients than dig through the books to find out what's changed. We're building this for them.

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform. It puts Codat's client intelligence inside the assistant a banker already uses, starting with Microsoft Copilot. A banker can ask it anything about a client and get an answer from that client's actual books. If they don't ask, it tells them anyway when something important changes, and suggests what to do.

It's a senior role and a hands-on one. Bankers make real decisions based on what the assistant says, so impressing people in a demo isn't enough. It has to be right. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS, and we work that way ourselves, with agents handling the repetitive work so engineers can focus on the hard problems. You'll build what you design and look after it once it's live, and you'll have a real say in where we take it.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - The reasoning layer. What goes into the model's context, which tools it calls, and when it should break a question into steps. Every number it gives has to trace back to a source, and it needs to know when to say it doesn't know. That last part is harder than it sounds.

 - Evals. You'll build the eval sets and harness, and do the analysis that tells us whether a change made the assistant better or just different. When a banker corrects an answer, that correction becomes a new test case.

 - Model choice and token economics. Which model should handle which job, and what that costs us per answer. Caching or a smaller model is often enough. For some questions a banker needs the strongest model available, and that's worth paying for.

 - The semantic and signal layers. You'll work on both with the data engineers. That means the definitions the model is allowed to use, and the signals that spot when something changes for a client. How the model uses them is down to you.

 - The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. This covers the tools the assistant can call, including the ones that will eventually let it draft that email. You'll work out how they break, and add the tracing we need to see what happened inside an answer.

 - Classical modelling where it beats an LLM. Anomaly detection, peer benchmarks, classifiers. Sometimes the best answer is a simple statistical model, not an LLM.


YOU'LL PROBABLY HAVE

 - Shipped LLM features that people actually used, and been the person they came to when something broke. You've designed how a model works with tools or structured data, and there are things you'd do differently now.

 - Built evals for your own work, and probably had one mislead you. We'd like to hear what you changed.

 - A feel for numbers, whether that comes from a quantitative degree or from your work. You want the denominator before you believe a percentage, and you notice when a headline figure is really about the mix of the data.

 - Opinions about models that come from using them. You've chosen between models on how well they did and what they cost, and you know when a classical model would do a better job.

 - Good engineering habits in Python or another general-purpose language. That means tested, modular services rather than notebooks. Strong SQL as well, and some experience with CI/CD, Docker, cloud (we're on Azure) and tracing for LLM systems.

 - Led work without having the title. People followed an approach you set because you made the case with evidence, and you can explain the trade-offs to someone who isn't technical.

 - AI as part of how you work, for research and prototyping as well as code.

 - Useful, not essential: fintech, lending or accounting; Spark or Databricks; semantic layers or metric views; fine-tuning.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We're more interested in what you've built and how you knew it worked than in a perfect match.




HOW WE WORK

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There's no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don't want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

jobs.description:
About Us
At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since its founding in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its leading AI-native Platform of Action.

Over 55K legal professionals and 450+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud-based technology, configurable AI-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need.

About the Role
Litify is looking for a seasoned and strategic Enterprise Program Manager to lead our most critical, high value customer implementation projects for the Enterprise Legal Management product suite. This role will become an expert on our ELM product and focus on the full services lifecycle, from pre-sales (involved in scoping and approving SOWs), through implementation (implementation partner management, timeline management, risk mitigation and management) and successful go-live and hand-off.

This role serves as the central point of coordination between enterprise customers, Litify internal teams, and implementation partners to ensure successful, on-time, and high-quality deployments. You will manage program governance, delivery health, and stakeholder alignment while driving outcomes that accelerate customer value and strengthen Litify’s partner ecosystem.

The Enterprise Program Manager is responsible for the following:

• Be the SME in Enterprise Legal Management product implementations at Litify

• AI forward thinker who can implement AI best practices in a complex enterprise projects

• Oversee and own end-to-end implementation projects in partnership with Service Implementation partners to ensure project success and drive on-time delivery

• Collaborate with the Product team on roadmaps and release plans and align with strategic objectives and priorities and educating both the Litify internal teams and the 3rd party partners running implementations

• Evaluate project team performance on individual projects and work to ensure that implementation teams have the tools, processes, and training required to deliver high quality implementations

• Identify issues and risk and ensure mitigation plans are defined or escalate as needed

• Design, pilot, and roll out new processes, best practices, standards, and KPIs as needed to improve team efficiency and effectiveness while avoiding unnecessary duplication of/variation from standard processes

• Evaluate team agile development practices, identify opportunities for improvement, and execute a visible plan for their achievement

• Own day-to-day communications with partners on project performance and progress

• Own process improvement in customer implementation cost reductions

• Own introduction of AI to enhance implementation processes.

• Own process improvement for pre-sales, implementation and partner onboarding and certification

A successful Enterprise Program Manager will exhibit the following:

• Strong knowledge and understanding of the corporate legal operations

• Business and growth experience to work with implementation partners

• Demonstrated experience in program management and managing multiple projects with varying timelines, scope, budget, etc. concurrently

• Collaborative, flexible, cross-functional nature with an extreme ownership mindset

• Passion for winning and raising the bar in everything you do

• Expert use of project planning and tracking tools

• Ability to influence others even when you do not have direct authority over them

Disclosure:
The estimated base salary pay range for this role is $140,000-155,000. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

ABOUT THE ROLE



We're hiring a Strategic Sourcing Lead to build Perplexity's procurement function. You'll design how Perplexity buys, from the workflow and policies teams follow to the agreements we sign and the vendor relationships we manage after signature. You'll be a key partner to teams across the company, helping them choose the right vendors and structure strong agreements without becoming a bottleneck, and making sure every dollar we commit to third parties earns its keep.



This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and wants to build the function, not inherit one, with room for your scope to grow as the company does. We value someone who can set direction, dig into the details, and follow through. This position is based in San Francisco and requires in-person attendance 2-3 days per week.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead our highest-impact vendor deals across software, cloud services, data, and professional services, from competitive alternatives through pricing, terms, and signature

 - Structure committed-spend, usage-based, and multi-year agreements that scale with our usage and preserve our flexibility

 - Own relationships with our most important vendors, including performance tracking, business reviews, and renewal negotiations

 - Design an efficient procurement workflow, policies, and approval thresholds, and implement the tools and AI automation to run them

 - Use AI workflows and agents to automate procurement, from intake and contract review to spend analysis and reporting

 - Build visibility into vendor spend and contracts, and drive savings through consolidation, right-sizing, and renegotiation

 - Partner with Legal, Security, and Accounting on contract terms, vendor risk reviews, and audit-ready controls




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

jobs.title: Instrumentation Controls & Power Generation Manager
jobs.description:
Overall Purpose and Objective of Position

This position will be a technical manager and leader of the resources at LDC Grand Junction, for overseeing all instrumentation and control activities at the site including real time health of said systems in our DCS SCADA system. This position will be responsible for overseeing multiple operational technologies and electrical power systems. This includes directing LDC and 3rd party I&E technicians as needed, to support the efficient installation, testing, maintenance, and troubleshooting of all instrumentation, measurement, control, power generation, and CSD devices for power generation both boiler steam and turbine electrical. This manager will also interface directly with the utility on incoming and outgoing power systems. This manager will be focused on optimizing the performance and reliability of all plant systems related to power generation, combustion, or instrumentation, driving preventative maintenance and repair initiatives, while maintaining world class safety standards and expectations. In addition, this manager will work closely with peers and other management to support operational objectives and foster enhanced team coordination. To be successful this individual should not only be highly technically adept, but also innovative, with a keen eye for detail and problem solving.

Primary Responsibilities/Essential Functions

• Lead and manage the Instrumentation and Controls (I&C) team, including I&C technicians both internal and external, and support staff.
• Develop and implement training programs to enhance the technical skills and expertise of team members in control systems and instrumentation.
• Ability to work on-site in a power plant environment, perform hands-on tasks in the field solely or with the Solar team ensuring tasks are carried out efficiently and safely.
• Plan, prioritize, and oversee the maintenance of process automation systems to optimize steam and electrical power production, ensuring the reliable operation of boilers and environmental systems.
• Foster a safe work environment by promoting adherence to safety protocols and addressing unsafe practices or conditions.
• Cultivate strong communication and relationships across all teams
• Oversee maintenance activities related to electrical systems, process control, and automation systems, including installation, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, testing, and calibration, ensuring thorough documentation and peak system performance and reliability.
• Collaborate with Area Managers on routine electrical and mechanical engineering tasks as well as special projects.
• Supervise troubleshooting and maintenance of distributed control systems (DCS) and programmable logic controllers (PLC), including Allen Bradley, Schnieder and Solar systems and the ability to troubleshoot and evaluate plant performance issues using eDNA and historians.
• Oversee the reception, installation, and configuration of all process related servers, networks, and equipment
• Monitor all data communication platforms
• Organize and maintain all license support documents
• Prepare documentation diagrams, process control narratives, instrumentation lists, I/O lists, as any part of project design or maintenance activities
• Provide oversight and support for Solar workstation computer and related equipment maintenance.
• Ensure that all responsibilities are executed in accordance with LDC Management’s established expectations.
• Contribute to the annual budgeting process for maintenance-related parts and materials.
• Schedule and manage preventive maintenance (PM) calibration of various field instrumentation.
• Identify and report necessary spare parts for efficient plant operation and improvement initiatives to Area Managers and direct managers
• Offer technical guidance and mentorship to the I&E team, ensuring continuous development and expertise.
• Uphold plant policies and procedures, ensuring all tasks are performed safely and in compliance with environmental regulations.
• Participate in Process Safety, 3D Model and Design Reviews such as:PRA/PHA/HAZOPControl narrativesCause and Effect documentsElectrical Area Classification
• Take on additional responsibilities as required and mutually agreed upon with Primary Energy Management.

Additional Responsibilities

• Serve as one of the primary interfaces for engineering on instrumentation, electrical generation or boiler issues with operations.
• Problem solving and troubleshooting as requested by operations or maintenance when requested.
• Works with the Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) staff to assure regulatory certifications and compliance on capital and process improvements, normal operating practices regarding SHE
• Reviews plant operations for potential process / procedural improvements for higher throughput and / or cost savings.
• Maintains good working knowledge of SHE policies, rules and procedures applicable to area of responsibility and ensures all applicable requirements are adhered to.
• Ensure employees are provided required training for area assigned, and jobs and tasks prior to assigning work.
• Ensures unsafe working conditions are remedied as soon as practicable.
• Follows construction completion criteria and construction requirements with the maintenance manager.
• Assists in the project start-up with local management.
• Additional projects and duties as assigned.

Education/Professional Certifications/Licenses

The following is the basic qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering; Chemical, Electrical or automation/Instrumentation engineering
• Professional Engineer (P.Eng) is preferred.
• Project Management Professional (PMP) is desired.

Experience

The following is the required qualifications:

• Minimum of 3+ years of relevant process supervisory experience.
• Extensive experience in managing instrumentation, and controls operations, related to Industrial Energy and Power Generation or Utility sectors
• Deep knowledge of industry process control systems and automation systems including but not limited to : DCS and PLC systems.
• Expertise in industrial networking and communication protocols.
• Comprehensive understanding of VFDs, PID controllers, temperature and pressure transmitters, flow meters, proximity probes, and position sensors
• Proven ability to perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
• Advanced trouble shooting skills for electrical, electronic, and pneumatic control systems.
• Hands on experience with steam turbines, environmental control systems, boilers and related boiler water treatment systems.

The following is the preferred qualification:

• Experience and direct involvement in the construction and start-up of plant improvement projects.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities (including any physical demands)

• Knowledge of applicable government regulations and personnel policies to ensure compliance and accomplish the safe and timely completion of capital projects and / or process changes.
• Knowledge of state and federal regulations regarding safety, health and environmental management to ensure compliance and accomplish the safe and timely completion of capital projects and / or process changes.
• Familiarity with the basics of plant processing, oils recovery, grain and milling operations or biofuels is desired.
• Proficiency with applicable computer software packages including AutoCAD, Microsoft Word, Excel, and Project.
• Knowledgeable with applicable software packages such as Wonderware, RSLogix, and PowerLogic.
• Exposure to plant operations, maintenance and safety
• Knowledge of design codes and governmental regulations affecting the industry including but not limited to NFPA 36, OSHA and EPA standards and requirements
• Demonstrated mechanical aptitude and interest with strong problem-solving skills
• Excellent organizational and planning capabilities with the ability to handle multiple assignments at the same time.
• Strong verbal and written communications skills
• Ability to work as a team member in a team environment.
• Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
• High sense of urgency
• Financial analysis skills.
• Procurement/ contract negotiations skills
• PHA/HAZOP implementation
• Tolerance for ambiguity.
• Comfortable working with individuals at all organizational levels.
• Ability to climb stairs

Working Conditions

Work is performed in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail and multiple priorities, primarily conducted in a climate-controlled office environment.  Travel is required as needed.  Periodic visits to industrial operations areas are necessary with exposure to variety of temperatures and prevailing weather conditions.  Anticipate regular exposure to gases, vapors, dust and odors, and occasional exposure to areas with wet floors and high volume of noise during plant visits.  Some stair climbing is required.  Extensions of regular working hours are occasionally necessary to complete time-sensitive projects or to respond to emergencies.

Decision Making/Accountability

Able to work unsupervised and make critical decisions on project and plant process management that have direct implications to budgets and profitability of an agricultural processing plant. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with multiple levels of management to make recommendations on capital projects and process improvements.

Employee Supervision

• Position may involve leading direct reports

What We Offer

We provide a dynamic and stimulating international environment, which will stretch and develop your abilities and channel your skills and expertise with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the largest and most solid private companies in the world.

- Comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental and vision care coverage, flexible spending account plans, employee assistance program, life insurance and disability coverage

- 401k with Company Match

Diversity & Inclusion

LDC is driven by a set of shared values and high ethical standards, with diversity and inclusion being part of our DNA. LDC is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion.

LDC encourages diversity, supports local communities and environmental initiatives. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Sustainable value is at the heart of our purpose as a company.

We are passionate about creating fair and sustainable value, both for our business and for other value chain stakeholders: our people, our business partners, the communities we touch and the environment around us

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Kikoff: The Fintech Powering Financial Security at Scale
Kikoff is a profitable, pre-IPO fintech company on a mission to empower everyone to achieve financial security. With record revenue growth in 2025 and a unicorn valuation, we've built a suite of products that help millions of people build credit, access liquidity, and save money.
We're scaling fast. Join us if you want to build something meaningful and help millions of people move forward financially.

Why Kikoff:

This is a consumer fintech startup, and you will be working with serial entrepreneurs who have built strong consumer brands and innovative products. We value extreme ownership, clear communication, a strong sense of craftsmanship, and the desire to create lasting work and work relationships. Yes, you can build an exciting business AND have real-life real-customer impact.

About the role

Kikoff builds and operates financial products used by millions of people. Our engineers own the customer experience and the systems behind it, including onboarding, payments, subscriptions, and credit reporting.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll lead complex projects from shaping the opportunity through launch and own the systems you deploy. You'll work with product, design, marketing, and data to identify solutions, decide what and how to build, and measure and demonstrate the impact. You'll make architecture decisions within your projects, coordinate work cross functionally, and resolve tradeoffs between delivery speed, reliability, security, and long-term maintenance.

This is a hands-on role. You'll own the implementation and review the code, investigate production failures, and improve systems that customers already depend on. You'll use AI agents to ship high quality solutions across the stack and move work forward in parallel, with responsibility for the design, correctness, and production behavior of what you ship.

What you'll own

• Define projects around customer and business outcomes. Use customer feedback and data to challenge assumptions, establish the expected impact, and choose a scope the team can deliver.

• Lead delivery across multiple contributors and services. Turn ambiguous requirements into a technical approach and a sequence of releases, anticipate dependencies, and unblock work when plans change.

• Design and implement complete customer flows. Own the decisions connecting user experience, APIs, data models, and external integrations, including retries, partial failures, and recovery.

• Own your systems in production. Establish tests, monitoring, safe rollouts, and rollback plans. Respond to incidents, protect customers' credit, money, and data, and address the causes of recurring failures.

• Be accountable for results after launch. Measure customer adoption, retention, reliability, or delivery speed against the project's goals, and drive changes when results fall short.

• Improve the team's technical judgment and delivery. Review designs and code, coach engineers through difficult decisions, and simplify brittle systems and recurring manual work.

What you bring

• Sustained ownership of production software. You've led complex projects, operated what you built, handled failures, and improved the system afterward. You can explain your decisions, the results, and what you'd do differently.

• Strong coding and system design skills. You have depth in at least one area and can work across the stack. You can trace behavior through unfamiliar code, reason about data and failure modes, and judge whether an implementation is correct and maintainable.

• Product and business judgment. You make reversible product and design decisions independently to keep work moving, and know when to involve product, design, or data partners. You use customer evidence and business results to test your assumptions and adjust your decisions.

• Experience delivering substantial engineering work with AI agents. You can break down a problem, direct implementation, review the resulting code, and verify behavior across the affected system.

• Experience leading work with multiple contributors and dependencies. You make progress through ambiguity, surface risks early, and keep engineering and cross-functional partners aligned.

• Clear, candid, kind communication. You explain technical tradeoffs, give useful feedback, and help teammates develop their judgment.

How you'll be supported

• You'll work with brilliant, passionate people across the business who share their knowledge and constructively challenge your thinking.

• Mentorship is available as you deepen your expertise and take on broader responsibilities.

• Training in financial systems, rules, and regulations to help you empathize with our customers and their journey.

• You'll have access to the latest frontier models and AI development tools, and teammates to experiment and learn with.

You may have built a company, led projects inside a larger organization, or moved between technical leadership and hands-on engineering. We value demonstrated ownership and impact across those backgrounds. Prior fintech experience is useful, but not required.

Our stack

Our stack includes Ruby on Rails, React, Flutter, and AWS. We expect strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to become effective in unfamiliar systems. Prior experience with every framework is not required.

If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd like to hear what you've built.

Base Range

$244,000—$292,000 USD

A note on applying: We know great candidates sometimes hold back if they don’t meet every qualification listed. If you’re excited about this role and believe you can do the work, we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Kikoff Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to complying with all federal, state, and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and considers qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure/SRE - 24/7 Rotation
jobs.description:
Be part of the team that defends the networks the world depends on

Corelight defends the world’s most sensitive networks—from global commerce to national defense—quietly, relentlessly, and with resolve. As cyber threats grow faster and smarter, we serve as the trusted force behind network resilience, putting elite defense within reach.

By transforming digital footprints from physical, virtual, and cloud networks into actionable insights, we empower defenders to illuminate blind spots and stay ahead of an evolving threat landscape. Built on open-source innovations and fueled by industry leading agentic AI technology, Corelight helps teams to detect advanced threats and close cases with unprecedented clarity and precision.

About the Role

Build, scale, and operate the cloud infrastructure supporting Corelight's federal customers. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you'll work with complex distributed systems to ensure our production environment remains reliable, secure, and capable of supporting growing customer demand.

You'll partner with Engineering and Security teams to improve infrastructure performance, automate operations, and maintain the security controls required for our FedRAMP environment. This role combines hands-on infrastructure engineering, system design, and production troubleshooting, with an emphasis on building scalable solutions rather than simply maintaining existing systems.

You'll also participate in a rotating 24/7 on-call schedule, helping ensure the continued availability and reliability of our federal cloud platform.

Federal Eligibility and Work Location Requirements

Due to specific U.S. federal government contractual and security requirements applicable to this position, candidates must be U.S. citizens and perform work associated with the federal cloud environment while physically located within the United States.

This position also requires participation in a rotating 24/7 on-call schedule, including availability to respond to production incidents outside standard business hours.

What You'll Do

• Design, build, and scale AWS cloud infrastructure and distributed systems supporting Corelight's federal production environment.

• Improve infrastructure reliability, performance, and scalability by identifying bottlenecks, resolving system limitations, and implementing lasting solutions.

• Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Terraform, Kubernetes, scripting, and CI/CD tooling to improve consistency and reduce manual intervention.

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer (Identity & Access Systems)
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role
We are looking for a Staff Security Engineer (Identity & Access Systems) to join our team. This is a Hybrid (San Jose, CA – 3 days/week in office) role, reporting to the Senior Director, Security Compliance in the Exposure Management & Security Operations / Technology Risk & Compliance department. We are seeking an experienced Staff Security Engineer to architect, scale, and govern our workload trust and access systems across our cloud-native Zero Trust ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the technical strategy for non-human identity (NHI) lifecycle management, establish real-time telemetry and observability pipelines, and automate service-to-service access controls to ensure robust enterprise security with developer-friendly velocity.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Architect and scale secure authentication and authorization mechanisms for distributed services, microservices, API clients, and cloud workloads across our Zero Trust ecosystem

• Establish and operate end-to-end Non-Human Identity (NHI) governance workflows—including automated onboarding, secret rotation, dependency tracking, and decommissioning for Server-to-Server (S2S) clients

• Design and maintain real-time observability pipelines, telemetry dashboards (e.g., Grafana), and alerting strategies to monitor authentication health, rate limits, and access anomalies

• Drive infrastructure automation and secret orchestration by integrating modern standards (OAuth 2.0, mTLS, SPIFFE/SPIRE) into CI/CD pipelines and developer self-service tooling

• Provide cross-functional technical leadership, collaborating closely with platform infrastructure, IT, and software engineering teams to embed security guardrails without impeding deployment velocity

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing a dynamic, evolving environment as an opportunity to design and build meaningful solutions.

• You operate with an owner's mindset and a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution to deliver high-integrity outcomes.

• You think at scale, connecting day-to-day security engineering to the broader organizational mission and building robust, long-term processes built to support high-growth global platforms.

• You champion simplicity by distilling complex technical security challenges and organizational needs into exceptionally clear, actionable plans and focused communications.

• You are a high-trust collaborator who actively participates in a challenge-oriented culture, sharing and receiving respectful feedback to build trust and elevate team performance.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

• 8+ years of relevant engineering experience across Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Distributed Systems, Infrastructure/SRE, or Identity & Access Management (IAM)

• Deep functional and technical understanding of authentication (AuthN) vs. authorization (AuthZ) mechanisms, token lifecycle handling (OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials, OIDC, JWT), and access control models (RBAC/ABAC)

• Hands-on experience governing machine, workload, or service-to-service (S2S) identity lifecycles and credentials in modern cloud environments

• Practical experience designing operational metrics, log aggregation, and real-time observability dashboards (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog)

• Strong track record of driving cross-functional alignment across security, IT, and platform engineering teams with clear technical communication

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency

• Practical familiarity with workload identity frameworks (e.g., SPIFFE/SPIRE) and mTLS/Private PKI certificate lifecycles

• Hands-on experience with enterprise secrets orchestration platforms (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault)

jobs.title: Operations Readiness Lead, Natural Gas
jobs.description:
We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.
 
Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.
 
Location & Team Gatherings
Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016.  We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.


Operations Readiness Lead, Natural Gas
 
About this role
As an Operations Readiness Lead, Natural Gas on Intersect's Operations team, you'll ensure our new natural gas generation and micro-grid facilities are built to operate safely, reliably, and efficiently from day one. Bringing deep operational and maintenance expertise into the earliest phases of development and design, you will influence equipment selection for gas turbines, reciprocating engines, power generators, and medium voltage systems before guiding projects through commissioning and commercial handover.
 
Acting as the critical bridge between Engineering, Construction, and Operations, you will partner with EPCs, OEMs, and internal teams to verify system turnover, witness initial firing and performance testing, and establish comprehensive operational readiness programs. Your work directly protects the long-term reliability and performance of power infrastructure built to support electrification and data center growth. This role is planned to start in December 2026.
 
Team overview
This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition and deliver resilient power infrastructure. The Operations team ensures that our utility-scale generation and micro-grid assets transition smoothly from concept to commercial operation and perform at peak reliability over their lifecycle. Joining this group means shaping fleet-wide operational standards, embedding real-world plant experience into new-build designs, and growing alongside specialists dedicated to operational excellence.
 
What you'll do
Embed Operational Excellence into Plant Design and Equipment Selection
Critique gas-fired plant and micro-grid designs, P&IDs, medium voltage single-line diagrams, and technical specifications early in development to safeguard operability, maintainability, and process safety.
Deliver operational feedback on major equipment selection, including natural gas reciprocating engines, gas turbines, power generators, fuel gas conditioning, balance-of-plant systems, and emissions controls.
Capture field lessons learned from operating assets and codify them into design and equipment standards for future natural gas projects.
 
Drive Commissioning Verification and System Turnover
Partner with EPC, commissioning, and testing teams throughout construction to track progress and proactively resolve issues affecting operational readiness.
Review and witness critical testing and commissioning milestones, including cold and hot commissioning, initial firing, micro-grid islanding/synchronization, performance and emissions testing, and punch list closure.
Verify that plant controls, DCS/SCADA interfaces, and medium voltage protection schemes meet operational and safety requirements prior to turnover.
 
Own Operational Readiness and Asset Handover
Define, track, and verify all readiness deliverables for handover to Operations, including O&M manuals, standard operating procedures, spare parts strategies, specialty tools, operator training, and CMMS configuration.
Coordinate fuel gas supply logistics, interconnection readiness, air permitting, and market interface requirements across Operations, Asset Management, and external partners.
Manage multiple project integrations simultaneously, keeping leadership and cross-functional stakeholders aligned on readiness status, technical risks, and mitigation plans.
 
What you'll bring
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent hands-on plant experience.
5+ years of experience in natural gas power generation across plant operations and maintenance, commissioning, construction, or project engineering.
Deep working knowledge of reciprocating natural gas engines, combustion gas turbines, power generators, fuel gas systems, medium voltage distribution, and micro-grid controls.
Proven ability to read, redline, and critique P&IDs, medium voltage single-line diagrams, control philosophies, and equipment specifications against industry codes (e.g., NFPA 37/85, ASME B31.1, IEEE).
Hands-on familiarity with commissioning turnover packages, CMMS implementation, DCS/SCADA systems, and air permitting/emissions compliance.
Strong organizational rigor and communication skills, with the presence to align EPC contractors, equipment vendors, and internal engineering and operations teams across multiple concurrent projects.
Commitment to safety, accountability, and collaborative problem-solving, aligned with Intersect's core values of Equity, Humility, Authenticity, Long-run Value, and People Come First.

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.

Commercial Counsel

About Adprime

Adprime Media is a vertically integrated advertising technology company headquartered in New York. Our platform spans a demand-side platform, a programmatic ad exchange, audience, data, and ad products, and campaign intelligence. We work with agencies, brands, and publishers across performance and healthcare verticals, and we are building an AI-first engineering and operations culture.

Role Summary

Adprime Media is seeking a practical, commercially minded full-time Commercial Counsel to support its digital advertising business. This attorney will lead day-to-day contract work across the company, including ad tech agreements, NDAs, vendor contracts, data protection agreements, and other commercial arrangements.

The role is suited for an experienced commercial attorney, or a product/privacy-adjacent attorney with strong ad tech contract experience, who can negotiate efficiently, identify legal and business risks, and provide concise, actionable guidance. The attorney will work closely with commercial, product, operations, and leadership teams in a fast-moving environment. Success requires balancing legal risk with commercial priorities rather than taking purely academic positions.

The position will report into General Counsel of NW Media Holding Corp., the parent company of Adprime Media LLC.

Key Responsibilities

• Draft, review, revise, and negotiate contracts across the business, including: DSP and SSP agreements; Advertiser, agency, publisher, and platform agreements; Identity resolution, measurement, attribution, and data partner agreements; NDAs and confidentiality agreements; Vendor, technology, software, and professional services agreements; DPAs and other privacy and data-related terms; and Other customer, partner, and general commercial agreements.

• Develop and maintain contract templates, standard provisions, negotiation positions, and practical contracting processes.

• Identify and advise on legal and business risks involving data use rights, service descriptions, platform obligations, performance commitments, liability allocation, indemnities, audit rights, confidentiality, regulatory compliance, and termination.

• Provide practical contract interpretation, issue spotting, and guidance on commercial, advertising, privacy, and data governance matters.

• Advise on advertising compliance topics, including truth-in-advertising, claim substantiation, disclosures, political advertising, platform-specific restrictions, and applicable sector-specific advertising rules.

• Address privacy and data governance issues relevant to programmatic advertising, including consent frameworks, lawful basis concepts, controller and processor roles, data-sharing restrictions, cross-border data considerations, and contractual privacy obligations.

• Conduct focused legal research concerning U.S. and European advertising and privacy requirements and translate findings into concise, business-oriented recommendations.

• Partner with commercial, product, operations, and leadership stakeholders to resolve legal questions and advance transactions under tight timelines.

• Identify matters requiring specialized or jurisdiction-specific advice and coordinate with outside counsel as appropriate.

Required Qualifications

• J.D. or equivalent legal qualification, with active bar membership or authorization to practice in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

• Meaningful experience drafting and negotiating ad tech and other commercial agreements.

• Strong familiarity with the programmatic advertising ecosystem and the contractual provisions commonly found in DSP, SSP, identity, measurement, data partner, NDA, DPA, and vendor agreements.

• General understanding of advertising regulations in the United States and Europe, with the ability to independently research specialized requirements, including political advertising rules.

• Functional understanding of privacy law in the context of programmatic advertising sufficient to support contract negotiation, issue spotting, and business guidance.

• Working knowledge of GDPR and ePrivacy concepts, U.S. state privacy laws like CCPA, data-sharing restrictions, cross-border data considerations, and advertising compliance issues arising in digital media transactions.

• Strong judgment, responsiveness, and the ability to work effectively with demanding stakeholders under time pressure.

• Excellent drafting, negotiation, prioritization, and concise communication skills.

• Ability to advise non-legal stakeholders in practical terms and independently manage multiple matters.

Preferred Qualifications

• Demand-side experience, including familiarity with advertiser, agency, DSP, measurement, attribution, and identity-related commercial arrangements.

• Experience advising digital advertising, media, martech, or data-driven technology businesses.

• Experience building scalable contracting processes and managing a broad commercial contract portfolio.

• Ability to assess legal issues across multiple jurisdictions while avoiding unnecessary complexity or delay.

• An existing network of trusted, cost-effective outside counsel in European jurisdictions for country-specific legal questions.

Compensation

Base salary: Up to $130,000 annually with annual performance bonus eligibility.

Working Style and Stakeholder Environment

This is a hands-on, business-facing role for an attorney who can serve as a practical legal partner across the company. The successful candidate will manage routine and complex commercial contracts, keep pace with a high-demand stakeholder environment, and provide advice that is clear, risk-aware, and commercially workable. The role does not require specialist expertise in every jurisdiction, but it does require the ability to identify material issues, conduct targeted research, and recognize when country-specific or specialized outside advice is appropriate.

Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Activation
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.

We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.

Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

About Justworks

Justworks is leveling the playing field for all small businesses. We handle the nitty-gritty of payroll, benefits, compliance, and HR, so our customers have more time to learn, grow, and seek something worthwhile. Today, Justworks offices in New York, Toronto, London, Tampa and Mexico City serve more than 12,000 businesses and 200,000 workers around the globe.

Our mission is to help entrepreneurs and businesses grow with confidence. This means our customers are at the center of everything we do, and working at Justworks is an opportunity to obsess over creating and delivering value that helps millions achieve their dreams.

We’re united by shared goals and motivations, best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our products and our team.

About the team / Product at Justworks

The Justworks Product team advances our mission by building products that extend levels of personal care and deep expertise that our customers have never experienced before. They craft innovative solutions that guide users through the most complicated challenges of running (and working for) a small business, with ease. They deeply understand complex regulatory spaces like FinTech, Healthcare, and HRTech, and have a keen intuition for how to connect threads across our customers’ needs and our business’ risk management and commercialization strategy. Our Product Managers lead highly collaborative creative endeavors, bringing together stakeholders across engineering, design, data services, operations, and customer-facing teams to deliver tangible value.

By joining us, you’ll be part of an experienced team of Product Managers who have a proven track record of building large-scale software products that impact small businesses worldwide.

We’re looking for teammates who will help shape Justworks’ future and make a profound impact on our business. As a Product Manager, you’ll be working across complex spaces - Fintech, Healthcare, HR Tech - all with serious policy/regulatory environments that will require you to have a keen intuition for customer needs, risk management, and commercialization. Care is at the center of everything we do, and you’ll need to love talking with customers and engaging with our Customer Success, Sales and Marketing teams to make sure that care is coming through in every part of our customers’ experience. You’ll be joining a diverse community of craftspeople who are passionate about learning, uphold exceptionally high standards of quality, and foster an environment of strategic thinking where product people can reach new heights.

About the role

The Activation team is a new pod within the Onboarding & Activation mission, sitting alongside our Company Onboarding and People Onboarding pods. While those pods focus on getting companies and their employees service-ready, the Activation pod’s goal is to get Justworks customers to that moment of value recognition as quickly and efficiently as possible. Comprised of Product, Engineering, Design, and Data, this pod will work cross-functionally with GTM, Ops, and other core product teams to drive activation across the customer lifecycle.

As a Senior Product Manager on the Activation team, you'll own the strategy, experimentation roadmap, and cross-functional execution to get customers to their first moment of value faster and turn initial setup into ongoing product adoption across core products like Payroll, PEO, EOR, and cross-product integrations and add-ons.

Responsibilities

• Embrace complex platform and experience related stakeholder problems

• Analyze funnel drop-offs, design and run experiments, work with research to interview customers, and partner with Data Science to define and track activation metrics

• Demonstrate expertise in deploying a product strategy and effectively tie insights to roadmap outcomes

• Scope, prioritize, and execute projects to deliver measurable business impact while ensuring clarity on objectives, leverage, and accountability for outcomes

• Partner deeply with Design and Engineering peers and organize and lead effective team processes and routines

• Demonstrate a rich understanding of engineering concepts, concerns and tradeoffs, and effectively communicate them to manage stakeholder expectations around deadlines and scope

• Drive camaraderie with your team while demonstrating effective collaboration with PMs across other pods/teams

What you’ll need

• 5+ years in product management, with 2+ years in product-led growth, self-serve activation, or onboarding

• 0-to-1 product execution, including experience standing up a new pod, defining baseline metrics, and building a roadmap from scratch

• Proven track record running A/B tests and shipping in-app flows -- checklists, nudges, guided setups -- that moved conversion, adoption, or time-to-value

• Strong data background and comfortable digging into funnel and cohort data and partnering closely with Data Science

• Excellent stakeholder management and ability to influence your working partners without authority

• Interest in leveraging generative AI to alleviate daily tasks and expedite delivery while retaining critical thinking and knowledge on core concepts

• Experience leading complex, cross-team initiatives from ideation to execution

• Track record of shipping continuous product improvements to an existing product portfolio at-scale

• Strong problem-solving skills, capable of breaking down complex problems for team execution against business needs

• Deep user empathy and a high bar for user experience

• Strong communication skills for effectively conveying product-related matters, including changes in scope or strategic direction

The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $166,000 - $242,500 per year.

Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks.

Diversity At Justworks

Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers.

jobs.title: Head of Travel Advisory and Community - East
jobs.description:
We are seeking an influential and enterprise-savvy Head of Travel Advisory and Community, North America (NA) to strengthen Navan’s customer advocacy and travel consultancy efforts at the highest level. This individual will serve as the connective tissue between our customers, product, sales, and brand—crafting a best-in-class enterprise practice that drives strategic deal-making, brand evangelism, and long-term customer growth.

As the“heart” of Navan’s travel organization, you will elevate and steward our Customer Advisory Board (CAB) strategy, strengthen our enterprise travel narrative in the market, and serve as the primary thought leader on critical travel innovations such as NDC and enterprise-grade deployment. Operating across pre-sale and post-sale motions, you will be deeply integrated into major enterprise opportunities and relied upon by the world’s most sophisticated travel buyers for strategic guidance and insight.

We’re looking for a customer-obsessed advisor with deep travel industry expertise, executive presence, and a track record of turning insight into impact. This role requires someone who can both drive enterprise revenue outcomes and build enduring, influential relationships with our largest customers and prospects.

What You’ll Do:

• Drive customer/prospect events in collaboration with Sales & Marketing

• Align with Global/NA AM/CS for customer attendees

• Host or liaise with executive team

• Lead Navan’s North America enterprise thought leadership — on the future of corporate travel, presenting at key industry events and publishing content that reinforces our competitive advantage, while building advocacy and travel community.

• Partner closely with Sales, Account Management, and Product leadership — from initial RFP to signed SOW to global rollout.

• Directly support Navan’s NA top enterprise pursuits by providing expert travel advisory to both internal deal teams and prospective customers to drive confidence and close deals faster.

• Serve as the trusted voice of the customer internally, informing product direction, sales strategies, and decision-making

• Serve as a liaison for Navan’s Customer Advisory Board (CAB), cultivating a highly engaged community of top referencable customers that influence product direction, strengthen enterprise relationships, and accelerate strategic growth.

• Drive agenda creation, speaker selection, and measurable outcomes in collaboration with AM/CS/Product teams..

What You’ll Drive:

• Measurable contribution to the NA pipeline in year one across deals ranging from $15M to $100M+ in Gross Booking Volume.

• Increase enterprise win rates and reduce sales cycles through trusted advisory and deal strategy.

• Successful expansion of the NA CAB program, in terms of product adoption influence, higher retention, and executive-level referrals through travel programme leads.

• Market visibility and credibility as Navan’s NA travel spokesperson—building awareness, trust, and advocacy in the travel operations and procurement community.

What We’re Looking For:

• 10+ years of travel, enterprise sales, or customer advisory experience—ideally in SaaS, travel management, or enterprise services.

• Executive-level communication and presence, with the ability to earn trust and influence across travel programme leaders in Fortune 500 organizations, and the S&P 500.

• Deep knowledge of the travel ecosystem, including modern retailing and distribution (e.g., NDC), policy design, global travel programs, transformation, implementation, and change management at scale. Meetings & events, payments, and expense knowledge are a plus.

• A strategic operator who can translate insight into scalable programs and repeatable outcomes.

• Strong collaboration and leadership skills—comfortable working cross-functionally and in a matrixed environment with executives, sales leaders, and product teams.

• Experience shaping and influencing go-to-market strategies in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

• A passion for customer advocacy, with a track record of building strong customer communities and executive relationships.

This is a rare opportunity to shape the face of enterprise travel innovation at a company redefining the category. If you’re ready to build a generational practice and be the travel voice of a global brand—Navan wants to hear from you
