jobs.title: Quantum Algorithms Research Scientist IV
jobs.description:
Position: Quantum Algorithms Research Scientist IV

Position Details

Salary Range:

$145,000-$175,000 annually.

Location :

This is a full time role that can be performed remotely from the successful candidate's home.

Due to the clearance required for this position, only U.S. citizens are eligible to apply; as outlined in Executive Order 12968: Access to Classified Information, eligibility for access to classified information may only be granted to employees who are United States citizens.

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Responsibilities and Duties

The Quantum Algorithms Research Scientist IV leads Technergetics' quantum algorithm research portfolio. The role combines hands-on research on algorithms for NISQ-era and hybrid quantum-classical systems with responsibility for setting research direction, guiding other researchers, and securing funded work. The incumbent is the company's senior technical authority on quantum algorithms and ensures that algorithm research is grounded in real device capabilities and customer problems.

• Develop and lead the company's quantum algorithm research portfolio, setting research direction, priorities, and a multi-year roadmap aligned with company strategy and customer needs.

• Identify, scope, and select algorithm research efforts, balancing near-term deliverables against longer-term, higher-risk research.

• Serve as the company's senior technical authority on quantum algorithms and represent that expertise to customers, partners, and the broader research community.

• Perform and direct research and development of quantum algorithms to advance state-of-the-art quantum computing and quantum networking.

• Develop novel algorithmic solutions for NISQ-era quantum computers and hybrid quantum-classical systems.

• Develop quantum algorithms for computationally hard tasks, including optimization (e.g., QUBO formulations) and classification.

• Implement and evaluate algorithms on quantum computers and quantum simulators using tools such as Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq, and PyTorch-based quantum frameworks.

• Assess the resource requirements, performance, and application fit of algorithms against real hardware constraints, working with the company's experimental and engineering teams.

• Provide technical leadership, direction, and mentorship to researchers and engineers working on algorithm efforts, and review their work for rigor and quality.

• Support hiring and development of algorithm research staff as the portfolio grows.

• Collaborate with the QBI, quantum communication, superconducting, photonics, and software teams to connect algorithm work to hardware and applications.

• Contribute to opportunity capture, including writing and leading technical content for proposals, grants, and white papers.

• Publish results and present at conferences and technical meetings, as appropriate for the program and its release restrictions.

• Prepare technical reports and briefings for government sponsors and company leadership.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Education and Certifications:

A Ph.D in physics, computer science, mathematics, or a closely related technical field, with specialization in quantum information science is strongly preferred.

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of industry experience, or equivalent post-doctoral/research experience, in quantum algorithms or closely related work.

• Demonstrated record of original research, such as publications, patents, or funded projects.

• Expertise in quantum computing, quantum information science, and computational numerical methods.

• Experience implanting algorithms for quantum optimization and/or quantum machine learning.

• Experience with quantum simulation and programming tools such as PyTorch-based quantum frameworks, Qiskit, PennyLane, and Cirq.

• Experience developing algorithms for NISQ-era devices and hybrid quantum-classical systems.

• Ability to lead a research agenda and mentor other scientists.

• Clear communication skills, able to convey highly complex concepts concisely in verbal and written form.

Desired Qualifications:

• Demonstrated experience in grant writing and opportunity capture.

• Knowledge of quantum networking, including quantum key distribution and distributed entanglement.

• Familiarity with the physical qubit technologies used to implement quantum algorithms, and experience with both analog and digital quantum computers.

• Knowledge of problem spaces where quantum algorithms apply (e.g., QUBO for optimization).

• GPU programming experience.

• Prior experience supervising or leading researchers.

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a background check and security investigation and must meet and maintain eligibility requirements for, at minimum, Secret access to classified information.

Travel:

This position is expected to require 10% travel to Rome, NY, (AFRL and the Innovare Advancement Center at the Rome Griffiss Institute campus) and conferences related to job duties.

Benefits:

Our benefits package includes health, life, disability, dental, and vision insurance coverage and a 401(k) policy with a 3% company contribution & 3% company match.

Other perks include generous Paid Time Off (including a PTO “gift day” for your birthday), 11 Federal Holidays per year, three weeks paid maternity/paternity leave, and annual technology “allowances”.

Even more perks include referral bonuses, professional recognition awards, healthcare stipends, tuition/education reimbursement (once specific requirements are met), and flexible daily start and stop times for most projects and positions.

Company Description

Technergetics is a US-based company headquartered in Utica, NY, with employees and clients located throughout the country.  The Utica/Rome area is a hub of cutting-edge cyber technology research, bolstered by the Griffiss Business & Technology Park’s tenants and facilities, including the Air Force Research Lab (AFRL).  At Technergetics, we work with a wide variety of technologies, including mobile and web apps, Quantum computing, machine learning and artificial intelligence, AI-enabled edge devices, and many more.

Beware of fraudulent job offers and postings!
Technergetics will never extend an offer of employment without a thorough interview process involving face to face interviews either in-person or a virtual Teams meeting from an official Technergetics email address (@techngs.com). If you receive any correspondence from an email other than techngs.com, it is a scam.

We do not discriminate on the basis of  race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Amazon PPC Specialist
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Alpha Lion is looking for an Amazon PPC Specialist to be the performance engine behind our paid and organic visibility on Amazon and Walmart. You'll own the marketing levers available on the marketplace — PPC campaigns, listing conversion, deals and promotions, and alignment with our DTC campaigns — and make sure every dollar of ad spend is tracked, tested, and optimized with precision. Your work will drive efficient, scalable growth and profitable revenue across our marketplace channels.

Responsibilities

• Build, launch, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns on Amazon and Walmart to hit target ACOS, TACOS, and ROAS goals.

• Use automation tools (such as Scale Insights) and bulk file operations to manage bids, rules, and keyword changes efficiently across the full catalog.

• Run search term analysis, negative keyword mining, and keyword harvesting to sharpen targeting and cut wasted spend.

• Improve listing conversion and organic ranking through structured A/B tests, content updates, and keyword strategy, working closely with our creative team.

• Plan and execute deals, coupons, and promotions, keeping them in sync with DTC launches and hero product pushes.

• Deliver weekly performance reports and post-event recaps that come with insights and recommendations, not just numbers.

• Help build out Walmart advertising, applying what works on Amazon while adapting to the differences between platforms.

What Success Looks Like

• You consistently hit or beat ACOS and TACOS targets while growing ad-attributed revenue quarter over quarter.

• You run a self-sustaining PPC system, with automation handling the routine so you can focus on strategic improvements.

• Your structured testing lifts conversion rates and improves organic rank on hero products without a proportional increase in ad spend.

• Promotions go live on time and perform at or above forecasted lift.

Who You Are:

• You have an extreme eye for detail. You catch keyword cannibalization, bid errors, and budget pacing issues before they hurt performance.

• You think in systems: you document what works, build templates, and create repeatable processes.

• You treat PPC as a business lever, not a task list, and connect every ad decision to revenue, margin, and brand outcomes.

• You take ownership. When a metric trends the wrong way, you flag it and come with solutions, and you meet every deadline without reminders.

• You play to win. You're not satisfied with "running ads" — you want to outperform the category and beat competitors.

• You communicate proactively, sharing trends, risks, and wins without being asked

Experience & Skills:

• 2–4 years of hands-on Amazon PPC management, with direct ownership of ad budgets and performance targets.

• Proven experience with an ad automation tool (Scale Insights, Pacvue, Quartile, or Perpetua) for automation rules, bid management, and bulk optimizations.

• Strong command of the Amazon Advertising console and Amazon CRO: A/B testing with Manage Your Experiments, keyword research (Helium 10, Data Dive, or similar), and listing optimization.

• Experience planning and running Amazon promotions: lightning deals, coupons, best deals, and Prime Exclusive Discounts.

• Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets, and a clear understanding of TACOS and contribution margin and how ad spend connects to profitability.

Nice to have:

• Experience managing PPC for supplement, health and wellness, or CPG brands on Amazon (regulated categories a plus), ideally on high-revenue accounts in a DTC environment.

• Exposure to Walmart Connect, and an Amazon Ads certification.

Why Alpha Lion:

Alpha Lion is a fast-growing, performance-driven brand focused on helping people unleash their Superhuman potential. We are building scalable systems, raising the bar on execution, and creating long-term competitive advantage in our category.

This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives, learn rapidly, and grow alongside a company that values ownership, curiosity, and results. If you’re excited by optimization, experimentation, and building systems that scale, Alpha Lion is a place where your work will matter.

Application Process

• Apply: Submit your resume + a brief note explaining why you’d crush it in this role.

• Screen: TA team reviews for skills and cultural alignment.

• Cultural + Behavioral: In this step, you will take a personality assessment to see how you will perform in the role, then review it on a call with a cultural specialist here.

• Interview: Conversations with the hiring manager and team.

• Final Round: Case study or work simulation (role-specific).

• Decision & Offer: We move fast — typically within 2–4 weeks.

Compensation:

We believe in competing at a high level — and that includes how we approach pay. This is a remote-first role, open to candidates anywhere in the U.S.

The expected base salary range for this position is 2.000-2,500(USD).

Your offer will reflect your experience, skill set, and where you live — we calibrate pay to ensure fairness and alignment with local markets.

Beyond base pay, team members may be eligible for performance bonuses, growth incentives, and benefits built to support their health, wellness, and professional goals.

jobs.title: Liquid Bulk Lead Logistics Specialist
jobs.description:
Overall Purpose and Objective of Position

This position is responsible for the execution and coordination of import and export shipments for food and feed ingredients for international and domestic shipments. In addition, this position would include coordinating warehouse activities including receiving, storing and dispatching goods to ensure on time deliveries to customers. This position would be responsible for developing key relationships with various carriers to maintain and or improve LDC’s competitive position within our industries. The ideal candidate will ensure compliance with global trade regulations, optimize supply chain efficiency and maintain accurate inventory control.

Primary Responsibilities/Essential Functions

• Maintains competitive transportation rates to accurately quote business for customers and manage shipments.
• Develop competence in LDC products’ markets, product qualities, and transportation needs
• Communicates professionally with customers to coordinate deliveries in a timely manner
• Contributes to inventory management of LDC products (warehouse/tanks/rail cars/containers etc.)
• Understand quality requirements and effectively communicate issues from customers with LDC quality and operation teams
• Coordinate international shipments, including documentation, customs clearance and freight forwarding.
• Track shipments to ensure on time deliveries and resolve delays or discrepancies
• Prepare and maintain shipping documents such as bills of lading, commercial invoices and packing list.
• Assists with other duties as assigned by the Head of Logistics
• Communicate with sales team any info that is helpful to determine pricing, freight risk awareness, and customer performance concerns.
• Assist with setting up carriers and maintaining documents and certificates.
• Utilize multiple systems to maintain carrier and freight information to assist with the coordinating of logistics for multiple products for inbound and outbound shipments
• Works with the logistics team to cross train and assist other team members efforts when needed
• Contribute to group discussions to improve processes and look for ways to elevate our business.

Education/Professional Certifications/Licenses

Basic qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in supply chain, business, finance, or economics
• Or in lieu of degree 4+ years of experience in import/export logistics, supply chain management or customs clearance of food grade products.

Preferred qualifications:

• Freight forwarding experience, warehouse inventory and freight experience with liquid food grade products
• Experience with CBP, CARM & ACE

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities (including any physical demands)

Basic qualifications:

• Strong knowledge of international shipping regulations and documentation with firm understanding of incoterms
• Ability to communicate and minimize risks associated with international shipments.
• Knowledge of US and foreign regulations for international shipments of food products.
• Knowledge of grain industry practices, terminology and settlement process.
• Strong practical accounting, analytical and organizational skills.
• Proficient on Excel and Office products.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to work independently.
• Ability to set deadlines and adhere to them.
• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks.

Company Conformance Statements

In the performance of their respective tasks and duties all employees are expected to conform to the following:

• Perform quality work within deadlines with or without direct supervision
• Interact professionally with co-workers, Company business associates and the general public
• Work together in a cooperative spirit to serve the best interests of the Company
• Operate in a fully responsible manner and comply with the law and Company policy

Working Conditions

Periodic visits to industrial operations areas are necessary with exposure during such visits to variety of temperatures and prevailing weather conditions. Interact closely with personnel in other departments and company locations, interact closely with middle and senior level management, domestic travel to visit customers required (up to 20% at times). Call-ins or the extension of regular working hours (50-60 hours per week) are occasionally needed to complete time-sensitive projects or respond to emergencies. Some weekend work is required.

Employee Supervision

Decision Making/Accountability

• Would be responsible for coordinating delivery of a sale with little supervision. Would communicate any concerns or risks they become aware of promptly to the appropriate audience. Would need to prioritize personal workload throughout the day to ensure meeting of deadlines.

What We Offer

We provide a dynamic and stimulating international environment, which will stretch and develop your abilities and channel your skills and expertise with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the largest and most solid private companies in the world.

- Comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental and vision care coverage, flexible spending account plans, employee assistance program, life insurance and disability coverage

LDC is driven by a set of shared values and high ethical standards, with diversity and inclusion being part of our DNA. LDC is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion.

LDC encourages diversity, supports local communities and environmental initiatives. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply.

Louis Dreyfus Company provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst
jobs.location: Boston, MA; Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada
jobs.description:
Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com.

Senior Product Analyst

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to turn product data into the decisions that grow Later's revenue and retention across Later Influence, Later Social, and Later Creator. As we invest in a unified data foundation and instrument more of the customer and creator experience, this role makes sure product and technology leaders have access to the data and reports to know what is working, what is not, and what to build next.

Reporting to the operations leader in Product & Technology, you'll partner with Product Managers, Engineering, Data, and the business teams that sell and deliver our products. You'll own the analytical foundation for the Product & Technology department, with regular exposure to senior leadership. Measurement and instrumentation will span across all three of our products and our platform portfolios with customers/users including Creators, Small/Medium Businesses, Enterprises and internal professional services teams.

This role will play a critical part in establishing the foundation for measurement and analytics within the Product & Technology department and setting us up for scale. As the company continues to grow in size and revenue, Product Analytics will provide the intelligence and confidence to inform decision-making across the department.

What You’ll Do

Foundations and Strategy

• Own the product analytics strategy and roadmap, deciding what we measure, in what order, and how we leverage our measurement tools.

• Own and evolve the Product & Technology metrics framework across outcomes, usage, adoption, satisfaction, delivery, operational effectiveness, quality, and AI adoption, with one set of definitions that Product, Engineering, and business teams share.

• Define the leading indicators that connect product activity to business outcomes such as revenue, retention, multi-product attach, creator earnings, and net revenue retention.

• Prioritize measurement gaps by business impact and make the tradeoffs and investment case explicit to leadership.

• Partner with Product and Technology Leadership and across stakeholders in Services, Business Operations, Sales, Marketing, Research and Partnerships to align product analytics strategy and implementation with our department objectives and targets.

Instrumentation and Data Quality

• Establish event tracking standards, naming conventions, and a tracking plan so new features ship measurable from day one.

• Instrument usage and adoption at the portfolio, product, and feature level so leaders see how customers and creators actually use what we ship.

• Partner with Engineering and Data to bring delivery and quality signals, such as cycle time, deployment frequency, and defect trends, into the same views as product data, applying DORA principles where they fit.

• Partner with Engineering and Data to specify the data models and pipelines that make product data reliable, accessible, and consistent across products.

• Own data quality for product metrics, building audits and monitoring that catch tracking gaps and drift before they distort a decision.

Tooling, Process, and Scale

• Evaluate, select, and implement the product analytics and tooling stack - in collaboration with the Data & Analytics function - including clear build versus buy recommendations.

• Build the metrics scorecard, core dashboards, and playbooks that give every metric a clear definition, owner, source, and target, and coach Product Managers to frame questions, set success metrics, and interpret results so they answer routine questions themselves.

• Establish the operating rhythms for measurement: experiment design and review, success metrics defined before build, post-launch readouts, an intake process for analytics requests, and a quarterly metrics review against targets.

• Shape the roadmap, role profile, and hiring bar for the analysts who join after you, and help us hire them.

Insight

• Define the framework for how we measure within the department, for example the adoption and impact of AI features and internal AI tools, and what good looks like as usage matures.

• Deliver high-impact analyses of funnels, cohorts, retention, satisfaction, and experiments that drive product decisions and prove the value of the foundation while you build it.

• Bring leaders a clear recommendation, not a dashboard, on where to invest, what to stop, and what to test next.

What Success Looks Like

• Product and Technology leaders make roadmap and investment calls from shared, trusted numbers, spend their time debating what to do rather than what a metric means, and every team can see how what it ships performs for customers and creators.

• Measurement coming from Product & Technology is widely understood and read with a high degree of confidence.

• Within your first 60 days, you've audited our current instrumentation and data quality, shared a prioritized gap list with leadership, and shipped a first decision-ready analysis that a product leader used to change a roadmap or prioritization call.

• By 90 days, the core metrics across the framework have agreed definitions, owners, and sources, a documented tracking plan is in place, and a first version of the metrics scorecard is live and trusted by Product, Engineering, and business leaders.

• Within 6-12 months, the product tooling decisions are made and implemented, core usage, adoption, delivery, and quality metrics are reported on a regular cadence, every launch has success metrics defined before build and a readout after, Product Managers self-serve routine questions, and your work has driven a measurable improvement in a metric you and your manager agree on (for example activation, retention, or multi-product attach).

What You Bring

• 6+ years of experience in product analytics or a closely related analytical role, with scope that extends beyond a single feature or team, at a scaled technology company.

• A track record of building or substantially establishing product analytics foundations (tracking plans, metric frameworks, dashboards, tooling) at a SaaS, marketplace, or platform company.

• Advanced SQL skillset and familiarity with Python/R for analysis, and hands-on experience implementing and administering a product analytics tool (such as Amplitude) and BI tools, including supporting build versus buy decisions.

• Experience specifying event instrumentation and data models with Engineering and Data teams, and working with cloud data warehouse and ETL tools (such as BigQuery and dbt).

• Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests and other experiments, with sound statistical judgment about causality and confidence.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear recommendation that senior leaders act on.

• A track record of getting up to speed quickly in a new domain and delivering results.

• Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building structure where it doesn't yet exist.

• Experience with a multi-product, marketplace, or creator economy business is a plus.

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only. The salary range listed for this role reflects the zones that applies to the location of this posting.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Salary range:

For candidates located in the US: $125,000-205,000 USD
For candidates located in the Canada: $110,000-160,000 CAD

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or age. Please let us know if you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Copy of Cyber Case Manager - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
About the Role

iCapital is seeking a Cyber Case Manager to join the Global Information Security team within Cyber Security Operations. As the Security Operations Center (SOC) continues to grow, dedicated ownership of the case lifecycle has become essential to ensuring incidents and investigations are consistently tracked and driven to closure. The Cyber Case Manager serves as the single point of accountability for that lifecycle – from intake through resolution – ensuring every case is owned, prioritized, progressing, and documented. This individual-contributor will report to the Security Operations leader.

Responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end lifecycle of security cases including intake, ownership assignment, progress tracking, and driving cases to resolution and closure.

• Serve as the single point of accountability for case status across the SOC, maintaining an accurate, prioritized, real-time view of all open incidents and investigations.

• Exercise authority to assign, reprioritize, and escalate cases across SOC Analysts, Threat Detection Engineering, and Incident Response to keep work moving and eliminate stalled cases.

• Enforce case-handling SLAs and quality standards; proactively identify aging, blocked, or at-risk cases and escalate to the Security Operations Leader.

• Coordinate cross-functional workstreams spanning incident response, DFIR, insider-threat cases, vulnerability-remediation tracking, audit and GRC findings, and eDiscovery and legal-hold requests.

• Manage case documentation and evidence integrity – ensuring timelines, actions, decisions, and artifacts are captured consistently and remain audit-ready.

• Integrate case workflows with SIEM/SOAR so alerts, enrichment, and automated actions flow into and out of the case record without manual re-keying.

• Produce case metrics and leadership reporting, including MTTD, MTTR, backlog, aging, closure rates, and SLA adherence for SOC leadership and stakeholders.

• Build and continuously improve case-management processes, intake criteria, and runbooks to increase throughput and reduce manager overhead.

• Facilitate case reviews, shift and regional handoffs, and post-incident lessons-learned, ensuring action items are tracked to completion.

• Leverage the SOC’s SIEM and SOAR platforms, with Jira and Confluence as the system of record.

• Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Human Resources, SOC Analysts, Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Incident Response, and business stakeholders to support sensitive investigations, maintain confidentiality and chain of custody, and strengthen iCapital’s overall cyber resiliency.

• Participate in incident-driven after-hours coordination as needed to keep high-priority cases moving.

Qualifications

• 3–6 years of experience in cyber security operations, incident response, or security case and program management

• Bachelor’s degree in information security, computer science, or information technology is preferred

• Experience in a regulated industry; financial services or fintech is preferred

• Hands-on experience managing incident or case queues in a SOC or incident response environment

• Working knowledge of SIEM and SOAR platforms and how alerts and cases flow through them

• Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for workflow management, tracking, and documentation

• Strong understanding of the incident response lifecycle and frameworks such as NIST and MITRE ATT&CK

• Demonstrated ability to coordinate across teams and drive work to closure through influence and follow-through, without direct reporting authority over those teams

• Familiar with handling sensitive investigations, evidence handling, and chain-of-custody principles

• Exceptional organization, prioritization, and attention to detail while managing many concurrent cases

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to report status clearly to both technical and executive audiences

• Relevant certifications (i.e. GCIH, GCFE, PMP, ITIL, or Splunk and SOAR) are preferred

• Experience with dedicated case-management or SOAR platforms (i.e. ServiceNow SIR, TheHive, Splunk SOAR and Phantom)

• Exposure to insider-threat, DFIR, eDiscovery, legal-hold, or GRC and audit workflows

• Familiar with cloud environments, AWS is preferred and knowledge of Agile frameworks is preferred

Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $110,000 to $145,000. iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Revenue Tools
jobs.description:
At MNTN, we put our people first, full stop. This allows our company culture to be defined by our team members and their shared values, like trust, ambition, quality, radical honesty, and compassionate leadership. It’s why we all really love working for the Hardest Working Software in Television™ (and also why we were named one of Ad Age’s Best Places To Work in 2026.)

We pride ourselves on bringing unrivaled performance and simplicity to Connected TV advertising. Our self-serve technology makes running TV ads as easy as search and social, helping brands drive measurable conversions, revenue, site visits, and more. You can learn more about us and everything we do by visiting https://mountain.com/.

We’re committed to innovation that empowers, not replaces. At MNTN, AI is a tool for growth, enhancing efficiency while keeping a people-first approach. Our goal is to streamline workflows and drive new solutions—without compromising the human element that makes our company great.

So if wanting to do more, own more, and make a bigger impact comes naturally to you, then you may be the person we're looking for to join us in our next stage of growth.

MNTN is looking for a Product Manager to own products that help our Revenue and Operations teams plan, prioritize, and act more effectively. At MNTN, Technical Program Managers operate as product managers: they understand user problems, set product direction, and own outcomes, not simply delivery plans and coordination.

This role will own internal products related to business forecasting, pipeline management, lead enrichment and automation, and the productization of customer-intelligence signals. You’ll turn data and insights produced across MNTN into useful tools and workflows that help teams make timely, consistent decisions at scale.

You’ll own these products end to end—from discovery and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and iteration. The work includes custom-built products and integrations across SaaS systems, but does not include IT administration or broad business-process ownership.

Reporting to the Group Product Manager for Internal Products, you’ll work closely with Engineering, Data, Revenue Operations, Sales, Growth, and Finance. You’ll operate within the broader Internal Products strategy while independently owning the roadmap and outcomes for your product area.

What you'll do

• Own the roadmap and product lifecycle for MNTN’s forecasting, pipeline management, lead enrichment, automation, and related customer-intelligence products.

• Build trusted forecasting and pipeline products that give Revenue and Operations teams clearer visibility and help them make better planning and prioritization decisions.

• Translate customer-intelligence signals produced by other teams into scalable tools and workflows that help users take timely, consistent action.

• Identify and prioritize opportunities to replace fragmented data, spreadsheets, manual analysis, and repetitive handoffs with durable product capabilities.

• Work directly with Revenue, Operations, Sales, Growth, and Finance users to understand their workflows, validate problems, and distinguish product opportunities from requests better addressed through process or existing tools.

• Define requirements and make product tradeoffs based on user value, business impact, data readiness, technical feasibility, and ongoing maintenance cost.

• Partner with Engineering and Data on data models, system integrations, product architecture, reliability, and the interpretation of data across multiple sources.

• Drive adoption after launch by measuring usage, gathering feedback, addressing gaps in trust or usability, and iterating based on demonstrated value.

• Communicate roadmap priorities, decisions, dependencies, and results clearly to the Group TPM and cross-functional partners.

What success looks like

• Revenue and Operations teams rely on trusted forecasting and pipeline products to guide planning and day-to-day decisions.

• The products have sustained, measurable adoption among their intended users.

• Customer-intelligence signals are translated into scalable tools and workflows that enable timely, consistent action without one-off analysis or manual intervention.

• High-value workflows require less manual effort, fewer handoffs, and less reconciliation across disconnected systems or data sources.

• Products have clear success measures and demonstrate improvements in efficiency, decision quality, or operational capacity.

• The product area has a focused roadmap that supports the broader Internal Products strategy and responds to evidence rather than disconnected stakeholder requests.

What you'll bring

• 3+ years of experience in product roles focused on workflow automation or related internal products.

• Direct experience in at least one of the following areas: revenue operations, business forecasting, pipeline management, or customer-intelligence products.

• A track record of owning products end to end, from problem discovery and prioritization through launch, adoption, and iteration.

• Experience building products for internal users and driving adoption across teams with different workflows, incentives, and levels of technical fluency.

• Strong data fluency and the ability to turn fragmented data and analytical outputs into clear, useful product experiences.

• Technical fluency with APIs, system integrations, data models, data pipelines, and the tradeoffs involved in connecting multiple platforms.

• The ability to productize predictive signals or analytical insights without needing to own the underlying models.

• Strong judgment about when to build custom capabilities, integrate existing systems, or solve a problem without creating another product.

• Clear, direct communication and the ability to work effectively with engineers, data teams, operational users, and business leaders.

About MNTN

Our recruiters will always reach out using an email address ending with @mountain.com OR @mntn.com. If you’re contacted by someone without that address and they mention a Reference Code (which we never use), then that ain’t us folks. Tell those trolls to take a hike–you’re waiting to climb a MNTN.

MNTN provides advertising software for brands to reach their audience across Connected TV, web, and mobile. jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Performance Marketing Manager

About Bombas:

Bombas is a comfort focused premium basics brand with a mission to help those in need. The company launched in 2013, after the founders learned that socks are the #1 most requested clothing item at homeless shelters. From there, they set out to solve that problem, donating a pair of socks for every pair they sell. How do you donate a lot of socks? You sell a lot. And how do you sell a lot? You make the most comfortable socks in the history of feet. Millions of pairs sold and donated later, Bombas has continued to innovate within its mission and product, introducing new socks, as well as underwear and t-shirts, the #2 and #3 most requested clothing items at homeless shelters, all while continuing to make a positive impact on the community where we all work and live.

Click here to see what it's like to work inside the Bombas Hive!

The word Bombas is derived from the Latin word for bumblebees. Bees work together to make their hive a better place. At Bombas, we’re inspired by that. We know it’s the collective efforts of our team that keeps the Hive alive and strong - a team that is diverse and inclusive. Different perspectives strengthen our ability to make the most comfortable versions of the products people wear closest to their bodies every day and to serve the communities where we all work and live. We are committed to continuously building a Hive where all are welcomed, seen, and heard regardless of age, color, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, genetics, physical or mental ability, protected veteran status race, religion and sexual orientation. As a team, we will strive to create room for different experiences and empower all voices.

Based on the specific needs and job requirements, this role will be working out of our Bombas HQ in New York City.

About the Job:

We’re looking for a strategic and driven Performance Marketing Manager to lead day-to-day management across our Social platforms. Reporting directly into the Director of Acquisition, this role is for someone who sees paid media as a dynamic growth engine and thrives on owning channel performance and optimization end-to-end.

You will own the day-to-day tactical optimization of channels like Meta and Applovin, collaborating with our Manager of Search and Senior Manager of Offline to hit specific revenue and margin goals. To effectively manage your platform(s), you’ll triangulate performance data across internal systems to validate incrementality, pressure-test results, and uncover growth opportunities others miss.

This role sits at the intersection of media, analytics, and creative strategy. You’ll partner closely with our internal Content and Site Merchandising teams to develop channel-specific creative and landing page POVs that drive measurable performance improvements.

If you’re deeply analytical, relentlessly curious, and energized by turning data into growth — we’d love to meet you.

What you’ll be responsible for:

Channel Strategy & Performance

• Own end-to-end strategy for Paid Social across our product categories (Sock, Footwear, Intimates, and T’s).

• Execute daily, tactical platform optimizations. You will actively manage campaigns/ad sets, pacing, and budget allocations to ensure we never miss a beat on performance.

• Identify opportunities for incremental growth across campaigns.

• Continuously test audiences, bidding strategies, creative formats, landing pages, and campaign structures.

• Partner closely with the Search Manager and Offline team on overarching channel strategy, pacing, and performance.

Data Validation & Incrementality

• Demonstrate a strong data propensity, cross-referencing platform-reported metrics with internal data to validate incrementality and aggressively scale what works.

• Identify discrepancies and/or trends between platform reporting and internal data and proactively adjust strategy.

• Partner with Analytics to evaluate incrementally and pressure-test performance.

• Analyze customer cohort performance and CAC:LTV ratio to assess impact.

Testing & Optimization

• Develop and maintain structured testing roadmaps across channels while executing clear A/B tests within the platforms. Leverage performance insights to iterate quickly, rigorously documenting what works to build a playbook of 'hyperefficient products' and scale creative winners.Stay ahead of platform changes, new features, and emerging technologies and opportunities.

• Champion a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Partner directly with the Sr. Manager of Growth Content (our internal 'Content Supply Chain') to rapidly ingest, test, and scale assets. You will translate platform performance back into actionable feedback to fuel the next batch of creative/copy, reflecting a strong POV on what works on each platform and why.

• Partner with the merchandising and planning teams on product support based on company priorities, channel performance, and seasonal stories.

• Work with the site merchandising and digital product teams on landing page and/or site testing strategies to amplify channel performance.

What we’ll love about you:

• Analytical rigor, with comfort working in Looker and excel, analyzing large datasets, and translating numbers into actionable insights

• A 'create vs. find winners' mentality. You rigorously triangulate platform metrics with internal incrementality data to prove real business value, and you try multiple angles on selling products.

• Experience acting as the testing engine for high-velocity creative. You excel at taking a high volume of assets from an internal 'Content Supply Chain,' rapidly testing them, and pinpointing winners.

• A genuine enthusiasm for the craft of media buying. You possess a deep 'joy and curiosity' for what's possible on platforms, getting excited by reading the daily data and testing new hypotheses.

• A proactive, inquisitive mindset. You are the type of media buyer who wants to know exactly what tools we use, what experiments we are running, and how we are building our growth engine.

• Flexible work schedule based on channel optimization needs (e.g. comfortable with weekend platform management based on performance).

• Experience with feed management, especially Feedonomics is a plus

What you’ll love about us:

• We are a team of smart, interesting, diverse, funny, and loving people.

• We offer competitive compensation, employer paid health, medical and dental benefits, 401k with match, paid parental leave, snacks, socks and a fun, relaxed office environment.

• We take the responsibility to make sure you are excited, happy, and find fulfillment in your work very seriously.

• We value fun. This is why we host office lunches, offsite team outings and company retreats.

• We believe in giving back to the community and helping those in need, which is why we volunteer as a team regularly.

• We believe success comes from the collective effort of all, which is why all full-time employees receive equity in the business.

• We understand the value of health, relaxation, spending time with friends and family, and traveling the world and offer flexible paid time off for all full-time employees. This includes over 20 paid company holidays, year-round "Flexible Fridays" and unlimited vacation, sick, and wellness days.

• We understand the importance of communication and offer a monthly phone stipend for all full-time employees.

• We believe a healthy body equals a healthy mind, so we offer a $100 monthly wellbeing reimbursement to all full-time employees.

What you’ll bring:

• 4-7+ years of experience in performance marketing and media buying, specifically managing Paid Social budgets of $30mm+

• Proven track record of managing and scaling sizable monthly budgets in alignment with CPA and ROAS targets

Bombas is committed to delivering competitive and equitable pay for our employees.

Each component of the Bombas total rewards package, including benefits and pay, is aimed at contributing to an environment where team members have resources to  manage their lives and are enabled to focus on doing their best work.

The pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $110,000 and 140,000/year. However, the base pay offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, market factors, and business need.

The Bombas total rewards package offered for this position may also include other elements, such as annual bonus and equity target award opportunities as well as medical, financial, and well-being benefits. Additional details of these benefits will be provided if a candidate receives an offer of employment.

If hired, the position is “at-will” and the Company reserves the right to modify any component, plan, or program of the total rewards package at any time, for any reason.

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any employment testing, or otherwise participating in this hiring process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@bombas.com. Only requests related to accommodations will be responded to.

jobs.description:
CONSEQUENTIAL WORK. DEDICATED PEOPLE.



ABOUT ONEBRIEF


Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Required: Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI

Remote with up to 60% travel




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

As a Business Development Executive - Navy at Onebrief, you will be responsible for expanding Onebrief’s presence across the U.S. Navy by identifying, developing, and capturing new business opportunities. You will leverage your understanding of Navy operations, organizational structures, acquisition processes, and existing relationships to introduce modern software and AI capabilities that transform military decision-making.

You will develop and execute strategic account plans, build relationships with senior military and civilian leaders, and identify opportunities to expand Onebrief across Navy commands, programs, and operational organizations. You will work closely with existing customers, Customer Relations, Marketing, and Product teams to turn successful deployments into broader adoption and demonstrate the operational value of Onebrief.

This role requires a combination of strategic relationship building, direct business development, and an understanding of how the Navy identifies, acquires, and implements technology. You will own your pipeline, drive opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution, and play a critical role in establishing Onebrief as a foundational capability across the Navy.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Core responsibilities:

 - Develop and execute a Navy-focused business development strategy to expand Onebrief’s presence across operational commands, Fleet organizations, Program Acquisition Executives, and other Navy stakeholders.

 - Identify, develop, and capture new business opportunities by leveraging existing relationships, industry partnerships, customer referrals, and targeted outreach.

 - Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior military and civilian leaders, operators, acquisition professionals, program offices, and technical stakeholders.

 - Develop strategic account plans that identify organizational priorities, decision-makers, funding sources, acquisition pathways, and opportunities for broader adoption.

 - Drive the full business development lifecycle, from initial customer engagement and opportunity qualification through pipeline development, capture strategy, and contract award.

 - Partner closely with Customer Relations to identify expansion opportunities within existing Navy customers, leverage successful deployments, and translate demonstrated mission impact into additional business.

 - Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Growth leadership to align customer engagement, messaging, demonstrations, and go-to-market strategies with Navy priorities.

 - Stay informed on Navy modernization priorities, organizational changes, budget cycles, congressional activity, and acquisition trends to anticipate opportunities and inform growth strategies.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of experience in U.S. Navy, Department of War (DoW), defense technology, or government-focused business development, with a demonstrated track record of developing relationships and generating revenue within government organizations.

 - Deep understanding of the U.S. Navy and its organizational structure, including major operational commands, OPNAV, Fleet Forces, systems commands, and the acquisition and budgeting processes that influence technology adoption.

 - Proven ability to identify, develop, and capture new business opportunities within the U.S. Government, including account planning, pipeline development, opportunity qualification, and contract execution.

 - Experience selling or deploying software, technology, or mission-critical capabilities to Navy or DoW customers, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into compelling operational and mission outcomes.

 - Demonstrated ability to build relationships with senior military and civilian leaders while also developing trusted relationships with operators, technical stakeholders, acquisition professionals, and contracting organizations.

 - Experience navigating complex government acquisition environments, including understanding funding mechanisms, procurement pathways, program offices, and contracting vehicles.

 - Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate Onebrief’s value proposition to audiences ranging from operational users to senior military leadership.

 - Demonstrated ability to independently manage a business development pipeline, prioritize opportunities, and consistently work toward revenue and growth objectives.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Prior experience selling or scaling a software or technology product across multiple U.S. Navy organizations, with a demonstrated ability to turn successful deployments into broader adoption.

 - Strong understanding of Navy modernization priorities, operational planning processes, and the technology requirements of Navy commands and organizations.

 - Established relationships across Navy operational, acquisition, and strategic organizations.

 - Experience developing and executing complex, multi-year account and capture strategies, including account mapping, pipeline development, strategic partnerships, and expansion across large government accounts.

 - Experience operating at the intersection of mission, technology, and government acquisition, with the ability to translate customer needs into actionable business opportunities.

 - Familiarity with Navy budgeting and programming processes, including the Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) process.

 - Experience working with defense technology companies, government contractors, or emerging technology providers supporting military modernization initiatives.




INDICATORS OF SUCCESS

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Business Development Executive, Navy Growth will:

 - Establish a strong understanding of Onebrief’s existing Navy footprint, customer relationships, and expansion opportunities.

 - Develop and maintain a strategic pipeline of qualified Navy opportunities with sufficient coverage to achieve assigned revenue targets.

 - Establish meaningful relationships with key Navy stakeholders across operational commands, acquisition organizations, and senior leadership.

 - Identify and advance new business opportunities that expand Onebrief’s adoption across Navy organizations.

 - Develop account strategies that connect existing customer success and demonstrated mission impact to broader Navy adoption.

 - Maintain strong alignment with Customer Relations, Marketing, Product, and Growth leadership to ensure coordinated customer engagement and effective execution of Navy growth initiatives.




TOOLS, SYSTEMS & TECHNOLOGIES

 - Government acquisition and business intelligence platforms

The Global TA Program Manager is chartered to analyze, optimize, and streamline processes not just at the local or departmental level, but across all HR, TA, and People Services functions and geographies in a holistic, end-to-end manner. jobs.title: Community & Events Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Cube is the financial intelligence platform built for the AI-era.

The world has evolved, but FP&A is still trapped in manual reconciliation cycles. While most platforms try to replace the spreadsheets finance teams love, Cube is different: we are the intelligent finance layer that unifies fragmented data into a centralized command center. By automating data management, we empower the Office of the CFO to stop moving numbers and start driving the strategic analysis that turns data into growth.

We don’t compete with AI; we make it trustworthy. In a world where AI is often only 80% right, Cube provides the 100% truth and governance finance teams need to turn data into growth. Our mission is clean data, everywhere, allowing the modern Office of the CFO to move beyond manual data management and lead with strategic certainty.

Cube has raised >$65M and is backed by top-tier investors such as Battery Ventures and Mayfield. We’re also proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of the Best Places to Work in 2026. Together, we’re building a culture that challenges and celebrates everyone with a path to growth. We’re guided by our company values: act with urgency, keep it simple, build with joy, obsess over the details, own the outcome, raise the bar, champion our customers, and win together. As we enter our next phase of growth, we believe having the right Cubers on our team will be the reason we win.



Note: This position requires working onsite at our New York office Monday through Friday.

 About the Role:
We’re hiring a hands-on marketer to build Cube’s presence where finance leaders actually spend time: in their peer communities, on LinkedIn, and in the room at events. You’ll own our community programs, social channels, and event calendar end to end, and you’ll be measured on whether that work turns into relationships, pipeline, and customer advocacy. This role fits someone early in their career who wants real ownership and the chance to build programs from scratch.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 - Own Cube’s social presence, primarily LinkedIn, including the content calendar, posting, engagement, and growth of both the company page and executive/employee voices

 - Build and grow our finance community of CFOs, FP&A leaders, and finance operators through peer roundtables, online groups, customer spotlights, and recurring programming that people want to show up for

 - Run our events program across field dinners, happy hours, webinars, and industry conferences (planning, vendor and venue management, promotion, on-site execution, and follow-up)

 - Partner with Sales and Account Management to target events and community touches at priority accounts, and make sure every attendee lands in Salesforce with clean campaign attribution and a timely follow-up

 - Drive customer advocacy by recruiting customers for case studies, reviews (G2), speaking slots, and references

 - Run invites and follow-up in HubSpot, including segmented email sends, registration pages, and post-event nurture

 - Report on what’s working: attendance, engagement, pipeline sourced and influenced, and cost per opportunity by program

 - Use AI natively to move faster on content drafts, event logistics, research, and reporting

Qualifications:

 - 2 to 4 years in community, social, events, or field marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS

 - Hands-on event experience, from small executive dinners to conference booths, with a track record of running events on time and on budget

 - A strong LinkedIn instinct: you know what gets engagement with a professional audience and can write in a clear, credible voice

 - Working knowledge of HubSpot (email, landing pages, lists); Salesforce campaign familiarity a plus

 - Highly organized and detail-oriented, comfortable juggling multiple programs at once

 - Comfortable being the face of Cube in a room full of senior finance leaders

 - Curious about the numbers behind your programs, not just the logistics

Bonus Skills:

 - Experience marketing to finance, accounting, or other technical/executive buyers

 - Background building or moderating an online community (Slack, LinkedIn Groups, Circle, etc.)

 - Familiarity with event tools (Goldcast, Luma, Splash, Zoom Webinars) and basic design tools (Canva, Figma)



The expectations above are meant to represent the ideal candidate, but if you don’t meet all of them and think you’d be a great fit for this role, please apply. This position is open to candidates who are authorized to work in the posted location. Immigration sponsorship is not available at this time.



Full-Time Employee Benefits

 - We provide 100% covered employee medical, dental, and vision insurance options, including FSA/HSA options plus free memberships to OneMedical, Teladoc, and Talkspace.

 - Our flexible paid vacation and sick/mental health time guidelines help you get the time and space you need.

 - We offer stock options to all full-time employees of Cube, as we want you to be connected to the success of the company.

 - We offer 12 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for the birthing parent.

 - We offer each Cuber a quarterly learning budget to spend on books, classes, or events that support your development.

We invite you to bring your civil engineering and land development experience into play as you support the planning, permitting, and design of data center and other large-scale industrial sites. The successful candidate will have direct experience coordinating with local AHJs and will help strengthen Ramboll's technical capabilities in one or more strategic U.S. data center markets. Are you excited about understanding, interpreting, and navigating complex projects with real-life implications? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you a curious and open-minded person?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment & Health Division as our new Civil Engineering Lead – Data Centers and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

POWER SYSTEMS ENGINEER

Join the High Power Engineering team at SpaceX to pioneer the design, build, operation, and maintenance of advanced power generation, transmission, and distribution systems for Starship's launch, production, propellant generation, and the city of Starbase, TX. As a power systems engineer, you'll work with a team to scale high-capacity electrical infrastructure for the world's most powerful rocket, ensuring seamless energy flow for groundbreaking missions. The position is based at Starbase, TX, with potential travel to other SpaceX facilities.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design, build, operate, and maintain the various microgrids that comprise Starbase, TX

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams; lead projects; and drive rapid, continuous improvements at Starbase launch sites

• Be responsible for infrastructure upgrades to dynamically scale systems for Starship's production rate targets

• Create and maintain sitewide power budgets, monitoring, and metering for mission-critical assets to optimize visibility and efficiency

• Develop and execute asset strategies for high-power launch and grid infrastructure

• Develop standardized designs for launch, propellant generation, and power delivery facilities

• Performs detailed design on all aspects of electrical power systems: one-lines, three-lines, control/relaying schematics, wiring diagrams, SCADA, conduit/cable sizing/routing, grounding design, general arrangement, etc.

• Develops and implements protective relay settings and schemes for high voltage equipment

• Maintain organized design and asset documentation for all Starbase launch and power facilities

• Ensure compliance with NFPA 70, 70B, 70E, NESC, and IEEE standards, prioritizing safety and engineering excellence

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or another engineering discipline

• 1+ years of experience in power systems design, analysis, and build, with a focus on high-power, high-voltage systems

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 3+ years of professional experience in a similar role

• Professional Engineering license or intention to actively seeking PE license

• Experience with power systems analysis software and tools: ETAP, SKM, EasyPower, PowerWorld, Matlab, PSCAD, PSEE, Simulink, etc.

• Experience performing basic load flow, short-circuit, arc-flash, coordination, and transient stability studies

• Familiarity with industrial power systems up to 345 kV, including switchgear, transformers, BESS, VFDs, motors, distribution systems, UPS/emergency backups, power generation, relaying, metering, protective devices, and networking

• Familiarity with industrial communications protocols and networking: Modbus, IEEE C37.115, IEEE C37.111, DNP3, etc.

• Experience with CAD software: Revit, AutoCAD, NX, etc.

• Demonstrated initiative, creative problem-solving, and strong analytical/engineering fundamentals

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Proven ability to lead teams, work independently, and thrive in dynamic, high-stress environments with tight deadlines

• Strong organizational skills to prioritize, schedule, and implement solutions with minimal operational impact

• Ability to quickly troubleshoot issues and support technicians hands-on

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights

• Work extended hours and weekends as needed to support launch operations

• Remain focused in hazardous environments while wearing appropriate PPE

• Lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted

• Provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, https://www.gpbullhound.com/articles/top-100-next-unicorns-the-uk-france-and-germany-lead-with-the-most-promising-technology-companies-in-europe/ 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ https://page.camunda.com/wp-2025-gartner-magic-quadrant-for-boat for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies https://flexa.careers/companies/camunda, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.



About the role:

We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer who's passionate about building reliable, scalable infrastructure that helps developers ship better software faster. You'll design and maintain our Kubernetes-based multi-cloud platform, improve our monitoring and observability tools, and collaborate with product and engineering teams to solve real problems in real time. This is a role where you'll own the systems that power Camunda, drive automation that raises the bar for everyone, and mentor others who want to do the same. If you thrive on building things that work well and don't break when they shouldn't, we'd love to talk.

What You’ll Be Doing:

 - Design and maintain our infrastructure – You'll evolve our Kubernetes-based, multi-cloud platform architecture, ensuring it's available, scalable, and fault-tolerant. You'll establish configuration best practices and network services that our teams rely on.

 - Build observability that matters – Implement and improve monitoring and alerting tools that give both SREs and developers real visibility into system health and performance. Make it easy for teams to understand what's happening across our stack.

 - Own your systems end-to-end – You'll adopt a "you build it, you run it" mentality, which means participating in on-call rotations and being the go-to person when things need quick fixes. You'll create runbooks and automation that turn complex problems into manageable processes.

 - Ship features and improvements with product teams – Work cross-functionally with product engineering, product management, and support to define and deliver features that move the needle. Bring your expertise to the table early and often.

 - Push automation to the next level – Identify repetitive work and automate it away. Share what you learn with your teammates so everyone gets better at their craft. We measure progress by the quality of our systems, not hours worked.

 - Be the expert others learn from – Help less experienced engineers tackle complex infrastructure challenges. Break down technical problems into clear steps and support others in growing their skills. 

What You Bring:

Must Haves:

 - Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes – You've built, deployed, and maintained Kubernetes clusters in production environments. You understand how to manage workloads, networking, and storage at scale.

 - Infrastructure as code expertise – You're fluent in tools like Terraform (or similar IaC tools) and know how to version, test, and safely deploy infrastructure changes.

 - Demonstrated experience in monitoring and observability – You've worked with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms to instrument systems and alert on what matters.

 - Strong 3rd-level support and incident response skills – You've responded to production incidents, diagnosed complex issues, and communicated clearly with stakeholders under pressure. You understand root cause analysis and how to prevent issues from happening again.

 - A passion for automation and raising the quality bar – You see manual work as a problem to be solved. You care deeply about building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and easy to understand.

 - Responsible use of AI tools – You leverage AI for research, code review, documentation, test generation, and automation to improve your effectiveness.
