jobs.title: Customer Value Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We're growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks, insurers and fintechs, and we're looking for a Customer Value Engineer to own a portfolio of our North American customers from New York.



As a Customer Value Engineer at Taktile you work with our customers to maximize the value they get from the platform. Our Customer Value Engineering team manages about 70% of Taktile's revenue, so this is one of the most customer-facing and commercially important roles in the company. You will partner with Taktile's Sales and Solutions teams and make sure our customers get value from Taktile throughout their entire lifecycle. You will report directly to the head of Customer Value Engineering and be the first dedicated CVE hire in North America, working alongside our CVE teams in EMEA and LATAM.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own a portfolio of around 15 customers, with average contract values ranging from $100K-$300K annually, plus a small number of additional accounts you support as needed.

 - Keep customers on the platform and grow them: you are measured on minimizing churn and driving account expansion.

 - Orchestrate renewals and handle the hard commercial conversations, such as churn risks and discount requests, while keeping the relationship strong.

 - Find and develop new use cases with customers, from credit underwriting to fraud, KYC/KYB and AI agents, working on both the business case and the technical approach.

 - Build relationships with executive stakeholders and with the core users of Taktile in each customer team, together with our Solutions Engineers.

 - Bring what you learn from customers back to our product and engineering teams, so that Taktile keeps solving their real business problems.


ABOUT YOU

 - Personable: people enjoy working with you. You build trust quickly with risk teams, engineers and executives, and customers look forward to your calls.

 - Organized: you manage many accounts, projects and timelines at once, and you keep internal and customer stakeholders informed without being chased.

 - Commercially confident: you are comfortable in difficult conversations about renewals, pricing and churn, and you can hold your position while keeping the relationship intact.

 - Experienced: you have 2+ years of account management or customer success experience at a B2B SaaS startup, ideally one selling into a regulated industry such as financial services, insurance or healthcare.

 - Curious and customer-centric: you want to understand how your customers' businesses work and how Taktile can help them make better decisions.

 - Team player: you enjoy working closely with Sales, Solutions, Support, Product and Engineering.


IDEAL, BUT NOT REQUIRED

 - Domain knowledge of financial services, such as banking, lending, insurance or payments.

 - Technical fluency: you are comfortable talking through APIs, data and integrations with engineers, and you know the basics of SQL or Python.

 - Experience running renewals or expansion against a target.

 - We are not looking for a pure consulting background. We want someone who has owned customer relationships at a software company.




YOUR FIRST YEAR AND BEYOND

 - Your first quarter is for ramping up: learning the platform, meeting your customers and building an account plan for each of them.

 - From your second quarter, you own your portfolio's renewal and expansion results.

 - As you grow, you can take on larger, more strategic accounts, or move toward supporting proofs of concept or deployment on enterprise accounts.


OUR OFFER

 - A self-development budget you can use for conferences, books or classes.

 - Work from our New York office 3 days a week. Travel to our twice-yearly company-wide meetings around the world.

 - Make an impact and shape an early-stage company.

 - A flat hierarchy: work with and learn directly from the founding team. Your opinions and ideas are welcome, especially when they challenge the status quo.

 - Learn from experienced mentors, such as the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog and UiPath.

 - The equipment of your choice, including a home office set-up.



Our Stance

 - We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply

 - We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears



About Us

Taktile helps financial institutions make smarter, safer decisions with the power of AI. Our software gives teams the tools to automate complex decisions — like who to onboard, how to underwrite, or when to flag suspicious activity — with full visibility and control.

By combining AI with a rich ecosystem of financial data, Taktile enables companies to adapt their decision-making in real time as markets, customer behavior, and risks evolve.

Our mission is to build the world’s leading platform for automated decision-making in financial services — setting the standard for how AI is applied responsibly and effectively in this industry.

We were founded by machine learning and data science experts with deep experience in financial services. Today, our team works across Berlin, London, and New York, bringing together engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers from companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, as well as fast-growing startups and enterprise leaders.

Backed by top investors including Y Combinator, Index Ventures, Balderton Capital, and Tiger Global, along with the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath - we’re building a world-class organization across all functions and levels to power the next generation of AI-driven decision-making in financial services.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Meet Upside:

We created Upside to transform brick-and-mortar commerce. Our technology uses the sophistication of online retail—profit measurement, attribution, and incrementality—to provide users with more value on their everyday purchases and brick-and-mortar businesses with new, profitable customers. We’ve helped millions of users earn 2 to 3 times more cashback than any other product, and hundreds of thousands of brick-and-mortar businesses earn measurable profit. Billions of dollars in commerce run through the Upside platform every year, and that value goes directly back to our retailer partners, the consumers they serve, and important sustainability initiatives.



The Impact You'll Make

As the Senior Growth Marketing Manager  for Paid App & Digital Acquisition, you'll own the largest share of Upside's acquisition budget and the channels that drive most of our new users. You'll run Google, Meta, Apple Ads, TikTok, Snap, ROKT and programmatic DSPs at expert level, decide where each incremental dollar goes, and be the team's authority on app attribution in a world of iOS signal loss. You'll work with agency partners but you won't depend on them: you'll build, launch and fix campaigns yourself when that's the faster path. You'll report to the Director of Acquisition Marketing and operate with high autonomy and high accountability, with your results reviewed weekly at the leadership level.



What You'll Do

Own the Paid Digital Budget and Targets

 - Manage $50M+ in annual spend across Google (App campaigns, Search, YouTube, Demand Gen), Meta, Apple Ads, TikTok, Snap, ROKT, and programmatic DSPs.

 - Own allocation, pacing and weekly reallocation by channel against new user, CAC, conversion rate and M1 payback targets.

 - Forecast channel performance and pacing for the weekly business review and the weekly acquisition plan.

Build and Optimize Hands-On

 - Build, launch and optimize campaigns directly in platform: account structure, bidding strategy, audiences, events and creative rotation.

 - Manage 6+ agencies and direct partnerships as an expert peer: set direction, audit their work, and hold them to performance targets.

 - Run a structured creative testing program with in-house design and creative partners, and scale winning concepts across channels and merchant campaigns.

Own App Attribution and Measurement

 - Be the team's expert on MMPs and deep linking (Branch, AppsFlyer), including link setup, event mapping and postback configuration to ad networks.

 - Own iOS measurement: ATT, SKAdNetwork / AdAttributionKit conversion value schemas, and modeled conversions, and know how to make decisions with incomplete iOS data.

 - Reconcile platform-reported, MMP and internal results, and partner with Analytics on incrementality testing (geo-lift) so budget follows incremental users, not reported ones.

Measure Incrementality and cMMM

 - Own the Haus geo-lift test roadmap for paid digital: pick which channels and tactics to test, set budget and holdout design with Analytics, and turn each readout into budget decisions.

 - Use incrementality factors from Haus to calibrate platform-reported and MMP results, so channel CAC and payback reflect incremental users.

 - Partner with Analytics on the cMMM (calibrated marketing mix model): supply clean spend and test inputs, use Haus results to calibrate it, and use its response curves to set channel budgets and find saturation.

 - Bring Haus, cMMM and attribution together into one recommendation when the three disagree, and explain the tradeoffs clearly to leadership.

Partner Closely with MarTech

 - Work side by side with MarTech on the acquisition data stack: MMP and SDK setup, in-app event taxonomy, postbacks, conversion APIs (Meta CAPI, Google enhanced conversions), and deep links.

 - Define the events and data requirements that paid channels need to optimize. Partner with MarTech to ship and QA them before campaigns launch.

 - Flag tracking breaks and data gaps quickly, and co-own fixes so platform algorithms keep optimizing on accurate signal.

Test Into Growth

 - Run a standing test roadmap across new channels (for example AppLovin, Unity, Reddit, retail and commerce media), new formats, web-to-app flows and landing pages.

 - Give every test a hypothesis, budget, success metric and readout date; scale winners quickly and shut down losers.

AI-Forward Execution

 - Use AI tools to speed up creative versioning, performance analysis, reporting and campaign operations, and help build the agents and automations the acquisition team uses.

Communicate and Influence

 - Produce clean, polished performance readouts and recommendations for the Director, CMO and Consumer leadership.

 - Partner with Lifecycle, Product Marketing, Analytics and merchant GTM teams so that acquired users convert and stay.



Competencies You'll Need

 - 8+ years of performance marketing experience, with most of it in mobile app user acquisition at a mobile-first B2C company, marketplace, or growth-stage app.

 - Has personally managed $50M+ in annual paid media budgets with accountability for CAC and payback.

 - Expert, hands-on knowledge of Google Ads, Meta, Apple Ads, TikTok, Snap, ROKT and programmatic DSPs, including the newest automated campaign types on each.

 - Deep working knowledge of MMPs (Branch, AppsFlyer) and app ad networks such as AppLovin: setup, troubleshooting, and how data flows between them.

 - Comfortable with app attribution and iOS data limitations (ATT, SKAN / AdAttributionKit, modeled conversions) and with incrementality methods such as geo-lift testing.

 - Experience managing agencies, plus the ability and willingness to build and run campaigns without one.

 - AI enthusiast with hands-on use of AI tools in day-to-day marketing work.

 - Data-first decision maker with a test-and-learn mindset; fluent in SQL-based or BI reporting (Looker, Hex, or similar) is a plus.

 - Thrives in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and weekly performance accountability.

 - Clean, polished presentation and written communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders.

 - Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.



The fine print:

Location:

This hybrid role is based in our DC or NYC office. In-office attendance is required on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday and may increase based on project-based needs and changes to Upside’s in-office policy over time.

 

Compensation:

Director of Capital Markets
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




ROLE SCOPE

 - Run our project financings from mandate to funding: bank selection, rating agency processes, the offering memorandum and disclosure, investor marketing, pricing, closing and the covenant and reporting obligations that follow, across several concurrent processes at all times.

 - Structure novel financings around the assets and contracts that make AI infrastructure bankable, including designing new lease, off-take, and power purchase structures to enable our business plan and project pipeline.

 - Finance accelerator purchases behind multi-year compute contracts, balancing bank delayed-draw term loans, private placements and bonds, and structuring the residual-value and hedging terms these markets require.

 - Create, close, and administer corporate-level facilities (revolvers, land loans, pre-construction loans, long-lead equipment facilities), keeping one view of leverage, liquidity and restricted-payment capacity across the parent, the project companies and our partnerships.

 - Support institutional equity and JV capitalization processes: operating models, the information memorandums, investor Q&A, and the coordination of placement consultants, agents, counsel and auditors.

 - Own the day-to-day relationships with the banks, private credit funds, insurance investors and rating agencies that fund the build, and the quarterly lender, bondholder and investor reporting that they require.

 - Build the capital markets team and function: hiring and mentoring junior team members and creating repeatable and scalable processes that let several transactions run in parallel as Fluidstack grows.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

 - You have personally taken billion-dollar-plus project or asset-backed bond issues from mandate through pricing, including the rating agency process, and you can walk through the terms you negotiated and why.

 - You have built debt and equity financing models from scratch for complex, multi-asset transactions and defended your numbers line by line to internal committees, ratings agencies, and external lender audiences.

 - You have negotiated credit agreements and indentures line by line (baskets, restricted payments, intercreditor terms, reserve accounts) and know which are critical for power, data center, and accelerator financing.

 - You have run financing workstreams across legal document review, outside counsel management, and external advisory scopes without losing momentum and while managing and developing multi-member teams.

 - You can turn a complex capital structure, transaction scope, or JV proposal into a clear recommendation and next step for an executive audience, board, or investor.

 - Bonus: Data center or digital infrastructure project finance (hyperscaler-leased buildings, powered shell, tower or fiber securitizations). Accelerator financing (GPU delayed-draw term loans, residual value mechanics, hardware-as-a-service leases). Private placement and insurance investor relationships (4(a)(2), NAIC-rated paper). Rating agency relationships (Moody’s, S&P, KBRA, Fitch). Energy markets and PPA experience.

jobs.description:
About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Team

As part of the Engineering organization, Power Conversion develops the technologies that efficiently transform reactor-generated heat into usable electrical power. The team focuses on maximizing system performance, reliability, and commercial viability.

The Role

Valar Atomics is seeking a Supercritical Fluid Processing Engineer to join the turbomachinery team and advance power generation capability. In this role, you’ll be responsible for the design and integration of the inventory management system at the heart of Valar’s power generation system. You’ll be working with cross-functional team members to define a manufacturable, high efficiency, robust design. As an early hire in power generation, you will be able to directly influence design decisions on the system architecture.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the design of the inventory management system for Supercritical Carbon Dioxide

• Architect filling, purging, and operating procedures of the SCO2 inventory management system

• Facilitate required analyses to further the design and procurement of your components.

• Own all aspects of bringing assigned components to test and to full scale production

• Develop detailed 3D CAD models, assemblies, and engineering drawings (SolidWorks, Creo, or NX), applying advanced GD&T and tolerance analysis.

• Interface with internal and external machine shops to develop a manufacturable design

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering

• Excellent judgement in material selection for new components

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and good judgement of when to use them

• Familiarity with ASME pipe standards

• 3+ years of experience in fluid handling or processing

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Master's degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering

• Experience with supercritical C02

• Experience with cryogenic liquid handling

• Experience with basic structural or thermal analysis for component sizing

• Experience in gas turbines, gas compressors, turbopumps, or turboexpanders

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary

• Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company

• Comprehensive medical benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite

• Generous PPE stipend

• High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy

• Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement

• Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders

• The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

$140,000—$215,000 USD

About the Team

Since 2017, Avride has been building expertise in autonomous technologies to create solutions that address current needs and anticipate future demands.  We are a U.S.-based autonomous vehicle startup headquartered in Austin, Texas with additional R&D hubs around the world. Our company develops and operates both autonomous cars and delivery robots that share technologies and mutually benefit from each other’s advancements — a unique approach in the industry.

About the Role

Avride is preparing to launch a fleet of autonomous delivery robots at multiple campuses across the U.S. and we are hiring a motivated, entry-level Robot Service Technician Assistant to support this exciting deployment. In this role, you will support the daily operations, maintenance, and preparations of our delivery robots. This part-time and weekend-based role is the perfect starting point for individuals looking to build a career in robotics and electro-mechanical assembly. You will ensure our fleet is ready for deployment while learning foundational skills needed to advance in our rapidly growing industry.

This position is employed through our staffing partner and offers weekly pay.

What You’ll Do

• Prepare robots for the shift: Ensure all hardware and software are ready for daily deployment.

• Put robots/batteries on chargers for the night: Manage power cycles to ensure maximum fleet readiness.

• Clean robots: Maintain physical appearance and protect sensitive external hardware.

• Perform mechanical repairs: Assist with and execute basic repairs on the robot fleet.

• Perform service campaigns: Help implement widespread hardware or software updates across the fleet.

• Assist remote support coordinators: Act as the hands-on field contact for the remote tracking team.

• Perform calibrations and wheel alignment: Ensure sensors and chassis components are properly tuned for safe navigation.

• Keep workshop clean and tidy: Maintain a safe, organized, and efficient workspace for the entire technical team.

What You’ll Need

• Comfortable working in varied field environments.

• Ability to lift and move items over 50 pounds safely.

• Strong attention to detail and a logical approach to problem-solving.

• Team-oriented mindset with strong communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have

• General computer literacy.

• Introductory background or interest in electric vehicle (EV) service, automotive repair, or electronics.

Candidates are required to be authorized to work in the U.S. The employer is not offering relocation, sponsorship, and remote work options are not available.

jobs.title: Associate Detection Engineer
jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As an Associate Security Engineer at Everpure, you will join the Global Information Security Office (GISO) and begin your security career alongside the engineers and architects who protect our global cloud, infrastructure, and platform environments. You will learn by doing: supporting real security work, automating the manual parts of it, and building the hands-on foundation that security engineering depends on.

This role is built for early-career engineers who are curious, methodical, and eager to be mentored, with a clear path toward deeper technical specialization over time. No prior professional security experience is required.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Support Day-to-Day Security Engineering: Assist with configuration, tuning, and routine health checks of security tooling across cloud and endpoint environments, working from documented runbooks and standards with guidance from senior engineers.

• Build Automation and Tooling: Write and maintain scripts (Python preferred) and small integrations that remove manual effort, including pulling data from APIs, generating recurring reports, cleaning up findings, and connecting tools to each other.

• Learn Detection and Telemetry: Work with log and telemetry platforms such as Splunk to run queries, validate data sources, and help investigate and document findings alongside Security Operations.

• Contribute to Reviews and Documentation: Participate in design and configuration reviews to see how real security trade-offs get made, capture the decisions that come out of them, and keep standards, diagrams, and runbooks accurate as systems change.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Foundational Technical Knowledge: Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience, with a working understanding of operating systems (especially Linux), TCP/IP networking, and core security concepts such as authentication, encryption, and least privilege.

• Some Hands-On Exposure: Coursework, internships, labs, CTFs, personal projects, or open source contributions where you have worked at a command line, read and modified code, and touched a public cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• Scripting Ability: Comfort reading and writing basic Python or a similar language, and the appetite to grow into production-quality automation.

• Analytical Problem Solving & Communication: Methodical approach to troubleshooting technical problems, combined with the ability to ask inquisitive questions, absorb feedback, and document technical processes clearly for cross-functional partners.

• Location: We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service

• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store

• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work

• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $15.25 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director, Client Procurement
jobs.description:
ABOUT VAYNERX

VaynerX is a family of companies building brands for the now. Founded by Chairman Gary Vaynerchuk in January 2017, the modern-day parent company is home to relevance-driving businesses including VaynerMedia, ChukMedia, Tamara Group, Gallery Media Group, Tingley Lane Trading, and VaynerSpeakers.

ABOUT VAYNERMEDIA

VaynerMedia is a global integrated creative and media agency, built for today's consumers. As the Modern Agency of Record, it understands the nuances of today's attention landscape, empowering brands to win attention, drive relevance, and deliver business results. Founded in 2009, by Gary Vaynerchuk, the independently owned agency operates in 15 offices worldwide, including Amsterdam, Bangkok, Chicago, New Delhi, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Miami, New York, Tokyo, Toronto, Singapore, and Sydney. VaynerMedia is part of the VaynerX family of companies.

Summary

We are seeking an experienced Director, Client Procurement to help continue to build out our strategic procurement discipline in key markets and work closely with Business Development and Client Partnerships leadership stakeholders to lead client scoping negotiations, foster relationships with clients’ marketing procurement contacts, and set the overall strategy for pricing, discounting, and value creation on assigned projects.

The ideal candidate will bring a client-side perspective, having worked in marketing procurement, and apply this expertise to drive agency-side initiatives and priorities. This role will play a critical role in ensuring that our procurement strategies align with both client needs and the agency’s financial objectives, delivering value in every engagement.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the development and execution of procurement strategies in collaboration with Business Development and Client Partnerships teams to support assigned client engagements in their market

• Build and nurture strong relationships with clients’ marketing procurement contacts to ensure alignment and value creation throughout the client lifecycle

• Understand our approach to pricing including but not limited to rate cards, deliverables-based pricing, retainer engagements, consulting projects, and the various components to how those projects are priced out

• Drive negotiations around client pricing, scoping, and discounting strategies, ensuring competitive and sustainable agreements that align with our key business objectives and that support our ability to close deals

• Bring market-related subject matter expertise into the organization, understanding market dynamics and marketing pricing trends for your assigned region in order to inform how we best optimize our pricing strategy to drive business development efforts

• Provide leadership direction and approval support in the development of MSAs and SOWs in partnership with Finance, Legal and Project Management teams

• Act as the procurement lead on high-value client negotiations in assigned markets, ensuring that client expectations are met while protecting agency pricing ideals

• Monitor and analyze macro-level industry trends such as sustainability initiatives and DE&I efforts to continuously improve procurement strategies and reporting and align with industry standards

• Develop and maintain strong internal relationships across all levels of the organization to promote cross-functional collaboration between Business Development, Client Partnerships, Project Management, Finance, and Legal teams

Qualifications

• 5 - 8 years of experience in marketing procurement, with a strong understanding of agency-client dynamics

• Demonstrated success in leading complex client negotiations, pricing strategies, and value creation initiatives

• Strong commercial acumen and contract review experience in a marketing & advertising capacity

• Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills for building and maintaining relationships with internal teams and client contacts

• Proven ability to create and implement procurement strategies in the regional and country-specific markets we operate in that protect our revenue goals and pricing ideals

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively

This position is currently designated as hybrid and is subject to the Company's workplace attendance and in-office work requirements, as in effect from time to time. The Company reserves the right to modify these requirements at any time.

jobs.title: Burson Summer 2027 HBSI (Client-Facing, USA Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

The Harold Burson Summer Internship (HBSI) Program gives early-career professionals an opportunity to explore the world of communications at a top-tier global communications agency during an exhilarating 12-week experience.

The HBSI culminates a real-world challenge where interns research, design and present a campaign for a current Burson client to the agency’s senior management, receiving feedback, tips and insights that would ordinarily take years to obtain. The summer internship program offers an invaluable career-development experience. So … are you ready to be a Harold Burson summer intern?

The program will run from June 7– August 31, 2027, and you will be connected to one of our U.S. offices. The health and well-being of our employees, including you as our future intern, are our top priorities. All our offices are open, and we plan to welcome you to them as many days a week as you'd like, but Burson U.S. is currently following an in-office hybrid policy.

Please note, this application is for one of our client-facing positions within the following practices: Consumer & Brand, Corporate & Public Affairs, Digital, Health & Wellness, Insights & Intelligence, Performance Media, Transportation, Energy & Industrials, Technology, and Grassroots (Direct Impact). To help you understand our practices and to aid in your decision making when choosing your top three areas of interest, please review the descriptions at the bottom of this post.

There is a separate application for Creative roles on the Burson HBSI landing page. If you are interested in a Creative role and this client facing role, please feel free to apply for both. They are all still a part of the broader Harold Burson Summer Internship, you will just have a different focus area.

Application requirements (Incomplete applications will not be eligible for consideration):

• Resume

• Cover Letter

• Writing Prompt: AI is changing the way we communicate, create and solve problems. As our industry continues to evolve, how we use these tools matters just as much as what they help us achieve. In 500 words, how would you use AI responsibly and thoughtfully while staying true to Burson's core values?

APPLICATION DEADLINE: Friday, January 10, 2027 at 11:59 pm PST. If you have specific questions, please email the HBSI team at HBSIProgram@bursonglobal.com.

What you'll do:

• During this paid internship, interns work alongside top professionals in the field, participating in everything from strategy and planning discussions to creative brainstorms aimed at capturing national news, shaping public opinion and sparking community engagement. Consumer & Brand: We build brands that enhance reputation, create culture and influence consumer behavior. Whether putting brands into pop culture at the speed of news or addressing more deeply seeded societal challenges, we develop communications that create reputation capital for our clients with unrivaled intelligence, innovation and impact. Corporate & Public Affairs: From policy shifts to trade to supply chain dynamics, our experts have worked directly with policymakers around the world. We understand the drivers and know the players, the power centers and the right messages – and messengers – for success. Our global team of strategic advisors provide seasoned counsel and nuanced strategies that reflect and respond to the multi-layered realities of today’s global communities. Digital: The Digital team customizes campaigns for their clients. From insights to influence and content to paid media, digital designs engagements for brands that move audiences to action. Whether launching social media pages, introducing always-on paid media campaigns or developing creative that breaks through the clutter, Burson’s digital team is synonymous with change and innovation. Health & Wellness: We provide strategic counsel and flawless execution from corporate to R&D communications to regulatory milestones and more. We have strong connections to regulatory bodies and a deep understanding of the intersection of advocacy, policy and sustainability. Insights & Intelligence: Burson's Insights & Intelligence team transforms information into action. We cut through the noise, analyzing brand perception, monitoring online conversations, and conducting custom research to uncover actionable strategies. Leveraging data science and AI, we uncover hidden patterns and predict future outcomes with precision, empower brands and businesses with the insights they need to succeed. Performance Media: The Performance Media team specializes in developing integrated media campaigns that intersect audiences where, how and when they are the most receptive to content. The team is focused on developing programs that not only drive results, but also uplift the brand. The team works to craft amazing stories on behalf of our clients that get audiences to move in the desired direction to make defendable business impact across digital media channels and develop custom measurement and attribution programs to deliver. Technology: Technology has never been more transformative, more promising or more risky. Burson deftly navigates that balance, and no one is better prepared to help technology clients navigate what's next. Transportation, Energy & Industrials: From the way people and goods move to the systems that power our world, we help clients navigate complex, fast-moving environments and position themselves for progress. We combine deep issues expertise with an understanding of the policies, regulations and stakeholder networks shaping these industries to help clients navigate challenges and reach the audiences that matter most. Direct Impact (Grassroots): Our team has a nationwide field network that offers scalable, high impact communications services covering every community, media market, political jurisdiction, and digital landscape in the U.S. We redefine what is means to engage communities and move stakeholders through 21st century grassroots and purpose-driven communications.

Experience that contributes to success:

• At the start of the internship, must be a recent (May/June) 2027 graduate.

• Strong research, written and verbal communication skills.

• Able to work in a fast-paced environment with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.

Please note, Burson does not provide any form of relocation/housing assistance. Once hired, it will be up to the individual to find accommodations for the duration of the program.

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package; click here for more details: https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome.

The base salary for this position at the time of this posting may range between:

$15—$19 USD

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

jobs.title: Start your ABA practice in Illinois! (BCBAs)
jobs.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

Ready to break free from clinic burn-out and build something that is truly yours?

At Finni Health, we were built with a single mission: to empower passionate BCBAs to launch, own, and lead their own thriving practices. For far too long, dedicated providers have been overworked, undervalued, and boxed in by traditional clinic models. It’s time for a change—and you can be the one to lead it.

We are hunting for visionary practice owners ready to partner with us in expanding access to world-class autism care. By pairing our cutting-edge software suite with your clinical expertise, our all-in-one launchpad gives you complete freedom to deliver the ethical, life-changing care every family deserves.

Whether your dream is to transform your local community or to provide services for underserved families within state lines, we will stand by your side to build your therapy practice from the ground up.

Take the driver's seat of your career, rekindle your passion for ABA, and help us lay the foundation to empower BCBAs nationwide. Your practice starts here. Let's build it together.

Learn more here: https://www.finnihealth.com/providers https://www.finnihealth.com/providers


What the role entails!

 - Launch with Built-In Infrastructure: Collaborate with our team using our pre-built guidelines, handbooks, and clinical operations frameworks to get your practice up and running seamlessly.

 - Hassle-Free Billing & Payor Management: Partner directly with our insurance experts to handle billing, clear payor requirements, and meet submission deadlines—so you actually get paid on time without the administrative headaches.

 - Lead & Mentor Your Clinical Team: Provide impactful field and virtual supervision for Behavior Technicians, delivering real-time feedback and training to ensure top-tier ABA intervention delivery.

 - Deliver Meticulous, Evidence-Based Care: Conduct functional assessments, craft progress reports, and continuously adapt treatment plans grounded in the latest research findings.

 - Empower Families & Caregivers: Collaborate directly with families to design customized behavior support strategies and deliver hands-on intervention training to parents and staff alike.
   
   Qualifications

 - Master's Degree in Applied Behavioral Analysis, Special Ed, Psychology, or Related Field

 - Valid BCBA Certification.

 - Applicable licensure to practice within the state hired.

 - Minimum three years experience in ABA, with supervisory roles preferred.

 - Strong leadership skills.

 - Strong oral and written communication skills.

Why partner with Finni?

Starting a practice used to be risky, overwhelming, and lonely. We fixed that. Finni handles the heavy lifting so you can focus on what you love—delivering exceptional care and owning your future.

 - Be a Trailblazer: Transform the ABA landscape by bringing high-quality, personalized care to families who need it most.

 - Ethics Over Output: You protect your workload. No bloated caseloads, no burnout culture—just world-class care delivered by supported providers.

 - Unmatched Mentorship & Resources: Gain full access to top-tier training curricula, clinical tools, and continuous mentorship to elevate your team’s expertise.

 - Ongoing Support: Turn your dream of practice ownership into reality with a team built entirely around your success.


Compensation Package:

 - Imagine a career where your paycheck has no ceiling and your drive directly dictates your success. With unlimited earning potential, your effort isn't just rewarded—it's multiplied. Break past fixed salaries, take complete ownership of your income, and build the financial freedom you’ve always wanted. How far you go is entirely up to you.


Schedule:

 - Flexible


License/Certification:

 - BCBA (Required)
   
   #PracticeOwner

jobs.title: Program Manager, North America Policy
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Airbnb’s public policy team aims to work closely with politicians, regulators, and legislators to educate them about Airbnb and the “sharing” or “collaborative” economy, highlight the significant social and economic impact our business has on local areas, and showcase best practices from around the world. We want policy makers to understand the regulatory challenges that affect our host community and find solutions that are good for cities and our thriving local communities.

We structure our work in local campaign groups, drawing on a wide range of tools and campaign disciplines - from detailed policy work, through high-impact partnerships, proactive media relations, community organizing, digital platforms and content, polling, and innovative data science and research.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Program Manager will support the priorities of the US & Canada Campaigns Director as they execute  strategy and initiatives in coordination with global and regional campaigns and cross functional partners.

A Typical Day:

• Partner with the US & Canada Campaign Director to drive strategy and analysis presentations, own deliverable tracking, and lead measurement and reporting of the priorities of the US & Canada policy team

• Own the development and implementation of policy programs ensuring consistency and continuous improvement across all regions of the team

• Drive clear lines of communication between local campaign teams and global leadership, proactively surfacing risks and opportunities

• Collaborate with each campaign region to deliver regular reporting and tracking (e.g. weekly reports, strategic campaign plans, quarterly policy reports (QPRs) and to ensure campaign achievements and milestones are being properly recognized and communicated

• Ensure individual projects and initiatives are executed according to strategic priorities

• Lead high-impact strategic initiatives requiring senior internal and external engagement and alignment, including with government stakeholders

• Identify operational roadblocks and bottlenecks – and best practices – making recommendations for process improvements that will increase campaigns’ efficiency across markets and regions

• Develop and maintain a culture of collaboration and innovation among and between the global campaign teams.

• Some administrative duties will be required including, but not limited to, calendaring, preparing for meetings, assisting with anticipating and prioritizing of the day, scheduling travel, and processing expenses.

• Drafting presentations, reports and conducting research on housing topics, policy points of view papers, and performing ROI assessments.

Your Expertise:

• Proven ability to independently lead and execute complex cross-functional programs with senior stakeholders, often without formal authority

• 8+ years of relevant experience including US or Canadian political and/or policy campaign work. Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

• Exceptional organizational skills. Detail-oriented and process-driven - with an ability to drive clarity in complex environments

• Expertise in strategy development with a demonstrated ability to connect high-level strategies to operational excellence and drive measurable outcomes

• Thrives in fast-moving environments with shifting priorities and tight deadlines, maintaining focus and sound judgment under pressure

• A natural coalition-builder and collaborator - able to build and maintain strong working relationships with peers and external partners across diverse perspectives and competing interests

• Able to distill ambiguous, complex problems into actionable plans and drive outcomes at a team and organizational level

• First-rate communication skills - written and oral - in a wide range of formal and informal contexts

• Familiarity with North American legislative and regulatory processes, including how policy is shaped through government affairs or engagement with external counsel and advocacy partners

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list  If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$132,000—$154,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.description:

We are running a paid study on modern accounting operations and financial reconciliation workflows. Understanding how finance teams manage these processes helps us identify common friction points and workflow inefficiencies. Your perspective will inform better approaches to handling third-party service partnerships and daily financial tasks.


HOW IT WORKS

You will join a remote video interview to walk us through your typical accounting operations. We will ask you to describe your current financial reconciliation workflows and how you interact with third-party service partners. You will share specific challenges you face during these processes and how your team resolves them. The conversation will focus entirely on your professional experience and operational strategies.


WHO THIS IS FOR

We are hiring experienced finance and accounting professionals who manage daily operational workflows. We welcome staff accountants, finance managers, controllers, and accounting operations specialists. You should have direct experience handling financial reconciliations and working alongside third-party service providers.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Walk us through your daily accounting operations and financial workflows

 - Describe your process for managing financial reconciliations

 - Discuss how you collaborate with third-party service partners

 - Share challenges and bottlenecks in your current accounting tasks

jobs.title: Assistant Manager (02819) - 1002 Shooting Park Rd
jobs.description:
Domino's in Peru, United States is seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Assistant Manager to join our dynamic team at 1002 Shooting Park Rd. In this pivotal role, you will partner with the Store Manager to drive operational excellence, foster a positive team environment, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. As an Assistant Manager, you will demonstrate leadership, analytical thinking, and a commitment to achieving our organizational goals while maintaining the highest standards of service and quality.

• Oversee daily store operations and manage shifts with efficiency and transparency, ensuring smooth workflow and adherence to company standards
• Lead, train, and motivate team members with a supportive and inclusive approach, fostering professional development and growth opportunities
• Interact positively and empathetically with employees and customers, building strong relationships and resolving concerns promptly
• Manage cash handling, financial transactions, and reconciliation with accuracy and attention to detail
• Maintain store cleanliness, organization, and visual standards to create an inviting environment for customers
• Answer phones, process customer orders accurately, and provide responsive customer service
• Ensure strict compliance with food safety regulations, quality standards, and company policies
• Assist in inventory management, stock control, and ordering processes to optimize operational efficiency
• Analyze performance metrics and contribute to data-driven decision-making to support sales targets and operational goals
• Participate actively in team meetings, share innovative ideas, and collaborate on process improvements
• Support the Store Manager in implementing strategic initiatives and achieving organizational objectives
• Demonstrate resilience and decisiveness when handling challenging situations and customer complaints

• Proven leadership skills with the ability to motivate, inspire, and develop team members in a collaborative environment
• Excellent customer service orientation with a friendly, approachable, and empathetic demeanor
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail
• Proficient time management and multitasking skills to thrive in a fast-paced environment
• Demonstrated ability to handle pressure, remain organized, and maintain composure under demanding circumstances
• Proficiency in cash handling, financial management, and basic accounting principles
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work inclusively with diverse teams
• Physical capability to lift up to 25 pounds regularly and stand for extended periods
• High school diploma or equivalent
• Food service industry experience preferred
• Knowledge of food safety standards, quality assurance, and inventory management preferred
• Flexibility to work various shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays
• Conflict resolution and performance management experience preferred
• Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and commitment to professional growth within the organization

What are we looking for?

The good news is we can teach you how to answer the phone and make a perfect pizza. But here are a few skills you should have to be a successful Assistant Manager:

•Experience leading a team; during your shift, you will manage a staff of anywhere from 3 to 15 people. You will need to use your stellar attitude and motivational skills to get them in the right place, at the right time and doing the right thing all while creating a great place to work.

•A clean driving record and the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Record check. Safety is a priority for us and we want to make sure anyone we put on the road is safe to be there. You will also need access to reliable vehicle that is insured and have a valid driver's license

•A great role model - you're the person everyone will look to. From being on time for your shift, to having a great attitude to customers and co-workers and even how you dress - you have to have high standards for yourself and the rest of the team.

•Our stores are open 365 days a week. Yes, that's right even on the weekends and the holidays; that's when we are busiest! While you schedule is pretty flexible, you have to be willing to work when the team needs you the most.

•You have to be at least 18 years old.

You'll be working for a company that is fun and flexible. Not to mention, its work experience you will rely on for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now it's time to help up be the pizza delivery company in the world. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. Apply now!

jobs.title: Community Lead & Talent Acquisition Advisor - AMER
jobs.description:
Hi, I’m Kayla https://www.linkedin.com/in/kayla-ricketts-9727976b/ :) I lead global community activation within Partnerships at Ashby. Before joining a year ago, I spent 15 years in TA and was an Ashby customer. I made the move out of TA into this role, and nothing I’d learned has gone to waste. If anything, I’ve learnt even more from the community. It’s genuinely one of the most rewarding and fun roles I’ve had.

We’re hiring an experienced TA Expert & Community Lead in AMER to help expand one of our most successful GTM experiments: a high-touch, customer-led approach to growth. The model is already working in EMEA, built on curated events, product education and early community activation.—to create meaningful impact across the funnel. You’ll own it across the US, from customer breakfasts and curated experiences to enablement sessions and product demos.

This role suits someone who has worked with Ashby All-in-One, has a solid background in TA, and cares about tools, process, hospitality and community building. It also works well for TA people who still love the work but want to use what they know somewhere new. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Product Marketing, own a region end-to-end, and see how community connects to pipeline and retention.

A quick summary on travel, since it’s usually the first question, and we know it means time away from home: you’ll have events around twice a month, usually for around four days. There is flex, though. I’m a mum of three, and in this role, I’ve been able to stay home and take meaningful time off during every school holiday. We plan the calendar well in advance, so you’ll know what’s coming and can sort things at home with plenty of notice.

It’s also one of the best parts of the job. I’ve met some amazing people and had some really cool experiences along the way, from hosting a dinner cruise on the Seine  https://www.linkedin.com/posts/ashbyhq_last-night-we-spent-a-great-evening-with-activity-7518934121507913728-51U1?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAA7jUaYB2IctkRuC7u91bcl_fuRCHV_o-w8and a TA leader workshop with a partner https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7519293611298131968 at the Shangri-La Paris, to spending time in customers’ offices https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7519293611298131968 in Stockholm, our company offsite  https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7516557949570412544in Playa Del Carmen, and hosting the mainstage at our first Ashby One London. https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7503489909475876864



What you’ll do

 - Lead AMER Community Events
   
   - Run community events across target AMER markets. Event types might include:
     
     - Customer learning breakfasts
     
     - A mixed ecosystem event for customers and prospects
     
     - Partner cocktail events or roundtables co-hosted with local ecosystem players
   
   - Build and nurture relationships with TA leaders
   
   - Partner with Event Ops on venue selection, invites, and post-event recaps
   
   - Drive improvement and reimagine how we can show up in a very meaningful way for the community

 - Drive Customer Education
   
   - Become an Expert in Ashby + TA leader needs to curate relevant content
   
   - Design and lead live sessions that help customers activate key Ashby features and keep customers ahead on key TA trends and topics
   
   - Partner with CS and Product Marketing teams on the Ashby Hidden Gems program
   
   - Develop and distribute product tips, dashboards, and templates to increase customer sophistication

 - Expand AMER Community and Customer Advocacy
   
   - Help Ashby deepen its brand and trust by showing up consistently and thoughtfully
   
   - Develop onboarding and enablement loops for ACE (Ashby Customer Expert) events
   
   - Partner with GTM teams on prospect and customer onsite visits
   
   - Moderate panels, attend events, and build a presence at industry gatherings



Who you’ll work with

You’ll report directly to me, but work closely with Willem https://www.linkedin.com/in/willemwijnans/ and the EMEA community team, who’ve pioneered what community growth looks like at Ashby. Within partnerships, you’ll also work closely with Katie https://www.linkedin.com/in/katherineelainecampbell/ to scale trusted community partner relationships and our Event Ops team on bringing Owned Community experiences, like Ashby Cafe https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7478334221007294465, to life.


About You

We think the ideal person for this role will have experience and skills that look something like this:

 - You’ve been an Ashby power user or at least very familiar with Ashby and seen its benefits first-hand—someone who knows the product and Ashby community, champions good recruiting practices, and isn’t afraid to dive into dashboards, workflows, or templates

 - You’ve built a reputation inside organizations as the go-to expert on TA process and tooling

 - You’re a strong communicator—whether facilitating a breakfast, writing a post-event summary, or helping a customer understand how to build a dashboard

 - You love curating and connecting people and ideas. You get energy from hosting, matchmaking, and finding smart formats to share what works

 - You’re excited about being on the road ~2x/month and tapping into your existing network (and growing it!) in the TA space

 - You have strong business acumen. You understand how community supports the wider business and work well with Sales and CS to make sure our programs are reaching the right people

 - You’re entrepreneurial and experimental in nature. You’re not looking for rigid playbooks; you want room to try new formats and evolve what ‘great’ looks like. You come prepared with AI tools / automations that help us execute faster while maintaining quality.

 - You believe in unreasonable hospitality—the idea that going above and beyond for a customer doesn’t just build goodwill, it builds momentum.

This Role Probably Isn't Right If ...

 - You’re not excited about hosting or don’t enjoy the details of curating small, thoughtful gatherings

 - You hate writing and have difficulty building a cohesive brief (this is a very important skill at Ashby)

 - You don’t enjoy travelling and building new connections while you’re at it

 - You’ve never had hands-on TA experience

 - You’ve never used Ashby and aren’t familiar with modern TA systems and practices

 - You prefer working from a very established playbook and are uncomfortable with ambiguity or iteration

 - You only have an ‘events background’. For this role, we need folks with deep knowledge of the TA ecosystem and a proven network in major city hubs like San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles, Seattle, Boston, Austin, and Chicago

Interview Plan

 - Hiring Manager Interview with Kayla - 45 minutes

 - $100/month learning budget, with conferences covered with manager approval.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

This position involves the preventative and corrective maintenance of the tool sets found in the Implant area. Tool sets include AMAT 9500, Varian E220, and Axcelis (Eaton) 6200.

• Strong mechanical skills
• Strong electronic skills
• Excellent Oral communication skills

• A lawful permanent resident (Green Card holder); or

This position is 100% onsite in Palm Bay, FL.

jobs.title: Organ Recovery Coordinator I
jobs.description:
Career Opportunity: Organ Recovery Coordinator I in the Tri-State of Kentucky and Surrounding Regions

Are you looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on organ donation by evaluating potential donors, coordinating clinical care, and helping maximize opportunities for successful donation? This role is ideal for an experienced healthcare professional who works well in fast-paced, sensitive, and highly collaborative environments.

As an Organ Recovery Coordinator I, you will evaluate the medical eligibility of potential organ donor referrals and organ imports, coordinate donation activities, and support the comprehensive clinical management of donors. You will collaborate with hospital teams, coordinate organ allocation, recovery, preservation, transportation, and documentation, and serve as a clinical resource for Hospital Services and Family Services. This position reports to the Manager of Recovery Services.

We are committed to supporting the professional growth and development of our team members, with opportunities to expand skills, take on additional responsibilities, and advance within the organization. In this role, you will be expected to consistently perform your work safely, ethically, and in accordance with organizational policies, professional standards, and applicable laws and regulations. Your commitment to safety, integrity, and compassionate care will be essential to supporting donors, their families, healthcare partners, and our mission.

Responsibilities:

• Respond to donor referrals, complete follow-up evaluations, and determine organ and tissue suitability using LCO, CMS, OPTN/UNOS, AOPO, and CDC guidelines.

• Apply legal and hospital requirements for death declaration and organ donation, identify the legal next-of-kin, and assess family dynamics and support needs.

• Clinically manage donors under established protocols and collaborate with hospital teams to support optimal organ function.

• Coordinate organ allocation, recovery, preservation, transportation, recovery teams, and related specimen collection and labeling.

• Identify organ-, tissue-, and behavior-specific risk factors and serve as a clinical resource for Hospital Services and Family Services.

• Maintain accurate, confidential donor records, complete post-recovery documentation and quality control, and support departmental quality-improvement projects.

Qualifications:

• Associate degree in nursing, respiratory therapy, EMT, paramedic medicine, a related biological science, or certification as a paramedic required.

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in nursing, respiratory therapy, or a related biological science preferred.

• Organ recovery coordination or hospital emergency room, intensive care, or surgical experience preferred.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively while demonstrating sound judgment, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to respond sensitively to individual needs and values.

• Strong computer and data-entry skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and internet-based systems.

• Professionalism, discretion, and the ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality.

• BLS, ACLS, and PALS certifications required within 12 months of hire; Certified Procurement Transplant Coordinator certification required within 24 months.

Physical Requirements:

Ability to work 12-hour shifts outside normal business hours, respond promptly to dispatches, and travel to assigned work sites. The role operates across office and hospital clinical settings and requires lifting to 75 pounds and assisting with donor transfers. Reasonable accommodation may be available.

We offer:

• Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays.

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance options.

• Retirement savings benefits.

• Employer-supported professional development and training opportunities.

• Additional employee wellness and support resources.

If you are passionate about helping others and are ready to join a diverse and inclusive team; apply online today. Be a part of our future!

EEO/M/F/D/V. No third-party applications please.
