jobs.description:
About Us

DLH delivers improved health and national security readiness solutions for federal programs through science research and development, systems engineering and integration, and digital transformation. Our experts in public health, performance evaluation, and health operations solve the complex problems faced by civilian and military customers alike by leveraging advanced tools – including digital transformation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud enablement, modeling, and simulation, and more. DLH is dedicated to the idea that “Your Mission is Our Passion” and brings a unique combination of government sector experience, proven methodology, and unwavering commitment to innovation to improve the lives of millions. Please note that this is an onsite position.

Overview

The Hardware Installation Technician is responsible for delivering high-quality technical support and customer service to end users, including VIP and executive-level personnel. This role provides hands-on and remote support for desktop and mobile computing environments, ensuring the secure configuration, deployment, maintenance, and troubleshooting of IT equipment and software. The specialist serves as a key point of contact for resolving technical issues, managing service requests through a ticketing system, and supporting organizational IT initiatives and special projects.

Responsibilities

• Configuring, installing, and supporting desktops, laptops, handheld devices, printers, monitors, portable data storage devices, and other peripherals.

• Providing enhanced VIP desktop and user support service.

• Configuring IT devices for secure operation, including installation of security software, software updates, and other configurations as required.

• Providing software support for users of NIH-provided applications (as identified by the task).

• Ability to work well under pressure and meet deadlines as needed.

• Ability to lead/track special projects

• Using an IT ticket system, responsible for receiving and tracking trouble tickets, updating open tickets appropriately with actions/steps taken; working them to completion and/or re-assigning them to a technical specialist for action, and closing out with the customer and in the ticketing system.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's and 4 years or an Associate's degree and 6+ years of technical support (or equivalent combination of education and experience).

• Experience with current desktop and laptop computers.

• Experience supporting various operating systems – expertise should include Windows 10 and 11; macOS (ideally 14 or higher); Linux (Ubuntu preferred)

• 3+ years of technical support experience in Microsoft suite.

• Experience troubleshooting and resolving network connectivity issues.

• Experience providing and supporting remote access services for employees working onsite, remotely, and while traveling.

• Experience mentoring and overseeing performance for desktop support resources working on projects and initiatives.

• Experience using ServiceNow for incident management, problem management, and request fulfillment.

• Strong customer service and end-user equipment support skills; preferably with some experience supporting VIPs.

• Strong written and oral communication skills are required

• Must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance

Desired Qualifications

• Experience supporting the National Institutes of Health

• Bachelor’s degree preferred; ideally in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Social Science

• Experience with Active Directory

• Experience with Mobile Device Management (such as MobileIron or Ivanti)

• Experience providing IT support in a healthcare/clinical environment, ideally supporting connected medical devices

• One or more of the following certifications is desired: Apple Certified Support Professional Microsoft Certified Professional CompTIA Security+ CompTIA A+ HDI-SCA ITIL Foundations v4/v5

Basic Compensation: $60,000 - $68,252 yearly salary

The salary range listed reflects what we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The final offer may vary based on skills, experience, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. Additional compensation may include performance incentives and program-specific awards. We do not use salary history to determine compensation, in line with applicable law.

Benefits

DLH Corp offers our employees an excellent benefits package, including Personal Time Off (PTO), medical, dental, vision, supplemental life with AD&D, disability coverage, flexible spending accounts, and more. We want our employees to save for their future; therefore, we offer a 401(k) Retirement Plan, which includes a matching component. DLH is dedicated to your career development, providing training to help drive success, with access to our best-in-class e-learning suite for formal and informal learning, professional and technical certification preparation, and education assistance at accredited institutions.

EEO

DLH Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.  DLH will provide reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities and disabled Veterans who need assistance to apply.

DLH is committed to maintaining a fair and authentic interview process

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter, Campus
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

• We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

• Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.

• Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Recruiter, Campus

Own Quince's campus and early-career recruiting execution from attraction through assessment and closing, and partner with Talent and business leaders on hiring plans, school priorities and process design across MBA and undergraduate pipelines in Engineering, Product and business functions.

Core responsibilities

• Help create the campus strategy: partner with Talent and business leaders on hiring plans, school priorities and the annual recruiting calendar.

• Own full-cycle recruiting: applications, recruiter screens, assessments, interviews, offers and closing across MBA and undergraduate programs, with candidate ownership through acceptance.

• Lead technical campus recruiting: partner with Engineering on candidate profiles, create and lead full assessment process including technical interviews, and credibly sell Quince Engineering to CS students.

• Deliver attraction events: info sessions, coffee chats, tech talks and Palo Alto HQ events for both undergraduate and MBA schools, with functional leaders and recent hires.

• Build school relationships and pipelines: career centers, student organizations, alumni and school champions; primary day-to-day contact for all target schools.

• Run the assessment process: review batches, batched interview days, Bar Raiser coordination, interviewer capacity and calibration with hiring teams, with logistics support in peak periods.

• Own reporting and retro inputs: Greenhouse accuracy, pipeline conversion by school and function, candidate experience, weekly pipeline readout.

• Launch approved expansions: internship, functional or geographic pipelines with clear delivery and resource plans.

Experience

• 5+ years recruiting experience in tech hiring, with a working foundation in how engineering roles are assessed; ideally campus recruiting in that space.

• Campus or early-career recruiting experience, ideally across undergraduate technical and MBA populations.

• Builder profile: creates process and pipeline where none exists and is comfortable with a late, compressed cycle.

• Strong assessment, candidate management, stakeholder partnership and closing skills.

• Experience managing high-volume seasonal cycles in a fast-moving environment.

• Greenhouse, Handshake and CodeSignal.

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Ready to break free from clinic burn-out and build something that is truly yours?

At Finni Health, we were built with a single mission: to empower passionate BCBAs to launch, own, and lead their own thriving practices. jobs.title: Mid-Level Auto Painter - 2nd Shift Mon-Thur - $4k Bonus
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Auto Painters with a minimum of 3 years of professional automotive painting experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.
As a Mid-Level Painter, you’ll be expected to match/mix paint color and use water-based paint to paint the vehicle inside our paint booths.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Pay Range: $20.50 - $24.50

Other perks of the Job

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of paint roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see other roles available to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

• Paint Prepper (min 6 months professional experience): prepare vehicles for cosmetic paintwork, including sanding, masking, taping, bagging, unbagging/tear down, and buffing

• Entry-Level Painter (min 1 year professional experience): prime vehicles and perform final sanding before the vehicle is painted, along with buffing, touch-up, paint mixing, and airbrush.

• Mid-Level Painter (min 3 years professional experience): match/mix paint color and use water-based paint to paint the vehicle inside our paint booths

• Experienced Painter (min 5 years professional experience): painting (base coats, tri-coats, solid, metallic, and clear coats), blending adjacent panels, and paint correcting vehicles.

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

• Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles

• Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

• Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Join a team where your impact reaches beyond the stars! At Terran Orbital, you’re not just part of the system – you’re a vital force propelling our mission forward. As trailblazers in satellite manufacturing and aerospace innovation, we shatter boundaries daily to deliver groundbreaking solutions that power our nation’s defense and commercial missions. We are a unique, fast growing, and trusted team dedicated to swiftly and efficiently designing, building, launching, and operating state of the art satellites for advanced mission constellations. If you’re driven by purpose, inspired by challenges, and ready to leave your mark on the universe, you’ll find a home and endless opportunities for growth here. Together, let’s redefine what is possible in orbit and beyond!

Terran Orbital is seeking an experienced Mechanical Engineer  to join our dynamic team. Reporting to the Mechanical Engineering Manager, the Mechanical Engineer will contribute to all aspects of spacecraft mechanical design, including spacecraft layout, structural and thermal sub‑systems, mechanism design, payload and launch vehicle integration, through all stages of the product lifecycle. The Mechanical Engineer will help turn designs into reality via prototyping, development testing, and low‑rate initial production.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

• Support the mechanical engineering design and development of spacecraft and spacecraft sub‑systems including flight hardware, mechanisms, and ground support equipment.

• Model spacecraft and ground support equipment mechanical parts, cable harnesses, and assemblies in accordance with industry best practices.

• Perform vehicle and sub‑system analysis using hand calculations, finite element tools, and other relevant techniques to support robust early‑stage design.

• Create and maintain design documentation, including drawings, Bills of Material, Interface Control Drawings, Compliance Verification Matrices, and Design Notebooks.

• Generate technical content in support of internal and external design reviews.

• In coordination with Electrical Integration and Harness Manufacturing teams, support development of spacecraft electrical cabling solutions, including connector selection, bundle design, routing, retention, and integration instructions.

• Contribute mechanical engineering expertise to refine production workflows, assembly sequences, and testing protocols to support efficient initial production.

• Collaborate with design, manufacturing, automation, and production personnel to implement design‑for‑manufacturing and design‑for‑assembly best practices.

• Stay current with advancements in technologies, materials, and manufacturing processes, and apply this knowledge to enhance spacecraft design and performance.

• Support process development and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications and Skills

• B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent discipline.

• 2+ years of experience designing mechanical systems in space, aerospace, automotive, or a similar engineering sector.

• Proficiency with SolidWorks, Creo, or similar CAD software.

• Ability to interpret and apply Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing in accordance with ASME Y14.5.

• Hands‑on experience with hardware manufacture, inspection, assembly, and/or testing.

• Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively within a collaborative engineering environment.

• Experience working with internal or external customers.

• Passion for space technology and a commitment to contributing to innovative engineering solutions.

• U.S. Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

• M.S. in Mechanical Engineering or Aerospace Engineering.

• Experience supporting product development across multiple stages of the product lifecycle.

• Experience in a production environment within the space or aerospace industry.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined case-by-case and may vary based on the job-related qualification, knowledge, skills, education, and experience. In addition to base salary, we offer 100% covered medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) match, Flexible Time Off (FTO), covered life insurance, maternity and paternity leave, tuition reimbursement, employee referrals, and lots of swag!

Salary Range

$100,000—$130,000 USD

Full-time positions only:

Benefits

• 100% Company-paid comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

• 401(k) Match

• Flexible Time Off (FTO)

• Education Reimbursement

• Competitive Paid Parental Leave

About Terran Orbital

Terran Orbital is a leading manufacturer of satellite products primarily serving the aerospace and defense industries. Terran Orbital provides end-to-end satellite solutions by combining satellite design, production, launch planning, mission operations, and on-orbit support to meet the needs of the most demanding military, civil, and commercial customers. Learn more at www.terranorbital.com

Physical Demands

An employee must meet the physical demands described to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. In performing the duties of this job, the employee is routinely required to sit or stand for long durations of time, in addition to bending, reaching, and walking. This would require the ability to lift or move objects up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift or move objects up to 25 pounds. This position is generally sedentary, with substantial computer usage.

Work Environment

The job operates in a professional office environment but in a manufacturing company. This job routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and scanners.

Disclaimers

To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. In addition, please note that this position may require a current United States National Security clearance or eligibility for such a clearance.

Terran Orbital is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or membership in any other group protected by federal, state, or local law.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hr@terranorbital.com.

Terran Orbital does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or staffing firms. To conduct business with Terran Orbital, a Master Services Agreement (MSA) must be executed and confirmed prior to submitting any information relating to a potential candidate. Without a signed MSA, Terran Orbital shall not be responsible to any individual or entity for any payment relating to any form of fee or compensation.

And, in the event that a resume or candidate is submitted by a recruiter, an employment agency, or a staffing firm without a fully executed MSA, Terran Orbital has the unrestricted right to pursue and hire any of those candidate(s) without any legal or financial responsibility to the recruiter, agency, and/or firm.

jobs.description:
Definium Therapeutics is a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company and our mission is to forge a new era of psychiatry by applying scientific rigor to psychedelics, with the goal of developing accessible treatments that unlock healing at scale.

Our lead product candidate, lysergide tartrate (our proprietary orally disintegrating tablet form of lysergide (LSD) D-tartrate), represents a highly differentiated, potential best-in-class opportunity for patients suffering from generalized anxiety, major depressive disorder, and posttraumatic stress disorder. Headquartered in New York, Definium Therapeutics trades on Nasdaq under the symbol DFTX.

Together we are moving psychiatry forward—beyond better, into a boundless future. Join us!

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Clinical Trial Associate, Clinical Operations, plays a key role in administratively supporting the planning, execution, and management of clinical trials within the organization. The Senior CTA works closely with the clinical operations team to ensure the successful implementation of clinical trials, adherence to regulatory guidelines, and the collection of high-quality data.

The Senior Clinical Trial Associate is a senior administrative role and will provide mentorship and guidance to the junior Clinical Trial Assistant role. The Senior Clinical Trial Associate will also support the development and review of Clinical Operations Department Administrative SOPs, Plans and System build. In addition, the Senior CTA will support the design and structure of the Admin framework and implementation of new processes or improvements to current process create processes not currently in place. The Senior Clinical Trial Associate may take ownership and manage sub-projects within the trial (ex: DEA Schedule I oversight at the site and central trial levels) and work closely with key consultants to drive the successful implementation and oversight of sub-projects. They will be the point of contact for all administrative needs for third-party vendors used within a trial and may have some oversight on monthly financial reporting and tracking.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Establishes, performs quality control, maintains, and archives the Trial Master File (i.e., electronic folder set-up, filing, tracking, archiving) in compliance with DIA Reference Model, SOPs, ICH and GCPs. Ensures prper naming conventions are followed

• Assist with study start-up, including development of budgets, contracts, financial disclosure statements, and grant payments

• Coordinates distribution of documents and supplies/dosing room materials to sites and vendors/CRO as necessary

• Develops and maintains spreadsheets and other documents to track critical study milestones Tracks and reports on project or study information regarding subject and site status, metrics, lab sample shipments and discrepancies, and other parameters as appropriate

• Track and manage study-related documentation, including regulatory submissions, ethics committee approvals, and site contracts

• Prepares or assists with the preparation and review of study-related materials as it pertains to CTA processes (e.g., study reference manual, clinical trial material requests, and Investigator Site File)

• Organizes study information on the shared file drives

• Maintain trial Storyboard

• Lead and manage project-based assignments in support of clinical trials (ex: creating process documents and trackers; managing Schedule I activities)

• Design and create process/guidance documents for the Clinical Trial Assistant role-based tasks and responsibilities

• Assist in the writing and review of SOPs for the Clinical Operations department and support systems build out (ex: CTMS, eTMF, etc)

• Performs assigned administrative activities in a timely manner in support of clinical trials from design to completion

• Sets up and attends meetings, takes thorough meeting notes, and updates and distributes meeting minutes

• Organizes and helps plan meetings. May interact with meeting planners and travel agents

• Coordinates the distribution of communications to all sites (e.g., questionnaires, newsletters, mass mailings, IND safety reports, Investigator’s Brochures, etc.)

• Assists the Clinical Operations Trial Lead with tracking and processing of vendor or site invoices and ensures accurate accrual records are kept for the trials. Raise PO requests and request tax documents from vendors and consultants

• Maintains up-to-date knowledge of current regulations and guidelines to ensure compliance

• Provides general administrative support to the clinical team as assigned

• Processes forms, requests for information by the team, and requests to obtain information from vendors and investigative sites

• Provide guidance, mentorship, and daily oversight for more junior Clinical Trial Assistants assigned to specific clinical studies

• Responsible for obtaining license agreements for all ClinRo/PROs/scales and updating license holders as required per contract

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health-related field

• Prior experience in clinical research, preferably as a Senior Clinical Trial Assistant or with at least 2 years in the Clinical Trial Assistant role

• Experience in Psychiatry and addiction medicine preferred

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 5-10% of the time, defined by business needs

• Working knowledge of GCP/ICH guidelines and the clinical development process, understanding of drug development from pre-IND through NDA

• Prior experience in development of tools and other tracking documents that support clinical research

• Prior experience with supporting study startup activities

• Strong communication skills with outside vendors and contractors

• Willing to maintain flexible work hours as needed and available during core business hours during critical periods of a trial

• Strong working knowledge of MS Project or Smartsheet and developing Gantt charts

• Advance knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets

• Excellent oral, written, and communication skills required

• Problem-solving and strategic planning skills

• Excited by innovative ideas in clinical research space; has a voice and provides meaningful contributions in meetings/calls

• Self-motivated, resourceful with getting the job done attitude in a fast-paced team environment

• Engaging, empathetic and dynamic personality; up for challenges and determined to find solutions

• This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

Tonix Pharmaceuticals* is a fully integrated, commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on central nervous system (CNS) and immunology treatments in areas of high unmet medical need. TONMYA® (cyclobenzaprine HCl sublingual tablets 2.8 mg) is the first new treatment for fibromyalgia in adults in more than 15 years. Tonix’s CNS commercial infrastructure supports its marketed products, including its acute migraine products, Zembrace® Symtouch® (sumatriptan injection 3 mg) and Tosymra® (sumatriptan nasal spray 10 mg). Tonix is investigating TONMYA® in Phase 2 clinical trials to evaluate its potential in major depressive disorder and acute stress disorder/acute stress reaction. Tonix is also advancing a pipeline of immunology programs, including TNX-4800, a Phase 2 ready long-acting human anti-Borrelia OspA monoclonal antibody (mAb) for the prevention of Lyme disease in the U.S., and TNX-1500, a Phase 2 ready third-generation CD40 ligand inhibitor for the prevention of kidney transplant rejection. In addition, the Company is progressing TNX-2900 (intranasal potentiated oxytocin), which is Phase 2 ready for the treatment of Prader-Willi syndrome, a rare disease. jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Growth
jobs.description:
Who we are

The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort, and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive-in, drive-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn't coming; it's here, and we need builders, innovators, and problem solvers to help us create it.

Who you are

Metropolis is seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to build and scale our demand forecasting and dynamic pricing systems within the Advanced Technology Group. In this highly impactful role, you will design, deploy, and own end-to-end models that forecast demand, capture price-demand relationships, and use causal inference and double ML to create actionable pricing strategies. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business teams to translate complex requirements into scalable machine learning solutions that directly drive key metrics such as revenue, utilization, and customer demand.

What you'll do

• Lead the innovation, design, and advancement of machine learning and mathematical optimization solutions to maximize revenue and improve business performance.

• Be a technical thought leader on cutting-edge pricing topics and closely follow industry and academic trends.

• Drive technical best practices and raise the technical/operation bar for Metropolis Growth ML team.

• Design and implement advanced frameworks, including constrained optimization, mixed-integer programming, and stochastic optimization, to drive scalable pricing decisions

• Architect and productionize scalable demand forecasting models optimized for business goals like visit volume, revenue maximization, and inventory availability

• Build and deploy end-to-end data pipelines to support large-scale production usage

• Identify data issues including bias, leakage, and labeling inconsistencies, and drive solutions

• Design and analyze experiments using A/B testing, switchback, and causal inference to validate pricing strategies

• Deploy and monitor machine learning models in production to ensure reliability, scalability, and data quality

• Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to translate requirements into scalable machine learning solutions

• Mentor junior engineers and foster a culture of technical excellence within the machine learning organization

What we're looking for

• PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Operational Research, or a related STEM field with 6+ years of relevant experience, or MS with 8+ years experiences with equivalent publications.

• Proven experience owning and leading projects from inception to production, successfully deploying models and driving measurable business impact

• Solid understanding of causal inference and experimentation, with experience evaluating both short-term and long-term effects using A/B testing, DiD, Bandits and uplift modeling

• Strong experience in machine learning modeling and statistics, specifically leveraging time series forecasting, probabilistic models, and deep learning models

• Experience productionizing and supporting end-to-end solutions using forecasting, optimization, and decision-making algorithms

• Hands-on experience with data pipeline development, including AWS data storage, data transformation, distributed processing with Spark, and workflow orchestration via Airflow.

• Experience building agentic AI solutions for pricing is highly desirable.

• Proficient programming skills in Python and SQL. Power user of AI coding tools.

• Exceptional communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and business domains, influence stakeholders, read academic literature, and formulate concepts using mathematical notation. Ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical audiences.

jobs.title: Data Product Manager
jobs.description:
THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

FanDuel is looking for a Data Product Manager to join our centralized Data Products team and own the products and services behind how FanDuel personalizes and experiments. Your flagship product is Personalization, one of FanDuel’s largest strategic programs, and it is just getting started.

The vision has two parts. The first is one personalization service that works with any front end. Given a customer, a page, and a moment, it returns ranked content that any surface can render, across sports betting, casino, racing, predictions, fantasy, social and community, payments, editorial, and video. Redesign the app tomorrow and the service does not change. The second is a personalization flywheel. It is a closed loop where ideas are generated, pre-tested, run as live experiments, and analyzed, and each result feeds the next round. Today most good ideas never get tested because experiment capacity is scarce and analysis is slow. You will own the products that change that.

Working closely with the Director of Data Product, you will drive requirements, prioritization, and delivery across customer understanding, ranking, serving, and experimentation. You will partner daily with data science, ML Platform, ML engineering, product analytics, and product managers in every business unit to turn a fast-moving, cross-functional program into shipped, measurable results. This is a high-visibility role tied directly to our “One App, One Customer” data strategy, our 2027 OKRs, and customer engagement, retention, and revenue.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN

Everyone on our team has a part to play

• Own the backlog and delivery for one personalization product area, such as experimentation tooling or ranking inputs, and deliver it in small, shippable releases.

• Work with the Director of Data Product and senior PMs to shape the personalization roadmap, recommending priorities and trade-offs based on customer data and experiment results.

• Translate broader program goals into clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and data science can plan against.

• Partner with data science and ML engineering on recommendation and ranking approaches, asking questions about accuracy, latency, and cost, and turning their input into product requirements.

• Work with product analytics and the experimentation platform team to define hypotheses, success and guardrail metrics, and test readouts for your area, and share what you learn with the team.

• Support responsible gaming, privacy, and compliance requirements in your area by working with Legal, Compliance, and Responsible Gaming, and escalate open questions early.

• Give status updates to your pod and key stakeholders, flagging risks and blockers early so issues are resolved before they affect delivery.

• Escalate cross-team conflicts and decisions outside your remit to the Director, and bring a recommendation with each escalation.

• Seek and act on feedback from your manager, peers, and partners, and share knowledge with other PMs in the Product Management community.

• Contribute to other Data Product initiatives as priorities evolve, keeping focus on a small number of priorities rather than parallel work.

THE STATS

What we’re looking for in our next teammate

• 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner on personalization, recommendation, search, ranking, experimentation, or other data or ML-powered products, with a record of shipping and measuring results.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Business, or related) or equivalent industry experience. A Master’s degree is a plus.

• Working knowledge of how recommender and ranking systems work (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, embeddings, or similar), enough to engage credibly with data scientists and ML engineers on accuracy, latency, and cost.

• Exposure to personalization across varied content types (commerce, media, gaming, social feeds, payments), including cold-start and cross-sell, is a strong plus.

• Hands-on experimentation experience. You have designed and run A/B tests, chosen primary and guardrail metrics, and read results carefully. You know common traps such as peeking, underpowered tests, and novelty effects.

• Hands-on use of AI tools in your product and experimentation work, such as using LLMs to draft hypotheses, design tests, or speed up analysis.

• Working understanding of how LLM-based agents are built and evaluated (tools, prompts, guardrails, and evals). Experience taking an agent into production is a plus.

• Product-led mindset: comfortable questioning engineering-led plans, using frameworks like DACI for decision clarity, and focusing on a small number of priorities.

• Clear communicator who writes crisp requirements, explains trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences, and is comfortable sizing opportunities in dollar terms.

• SQL proficiency for exploring customer behavior, experiment results, and model performance data.

• Knowledge of sports, gaming, or entertainment, and/or experience in a heavily regulated industry with privacy and responsible-use constraints, is a plus. Familiarity with Databricks, Kafka, Amplitude, Snowplow, or Xtremepush is also a plus.

• Don’t check all the boxes? That’s okay! We encourage you to still apply if you feel like you possess an adjacent skill set and are interested in learning more about this position.

ABOUT FANDUEL
FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.
In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.
The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.
FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

PLAYER BENEFITS

We treat our team right

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: FanDuel Total Rewards. *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

jobs.title: Staff Workday HRIS Technical Analyst
jobs.description:
About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About the team/role

We are seeking a highly experienced Workday specialist to own and advance our Workday platform end to end. This role sits at the center of our people systems landscape and is responsible for deep Workday configuration, business process design, integrations, reporting, and the adoption of Workday's AI and automation capabilities. The ideal candidate has deep, hands-on Workday expertise: they know its modules, security model, and release cadence intimately, and they can translate complex HR and business requirements into clean, scalable Workday solutions. We are looking for a proactive self-starter who can independently drive work forward without needing explicit direction.

What you’ll do

• Platform Ownership & Roadmap - Serve as the Workday subject matter expert across HR, IT, and Finance; own the platform roadmap, module adoption strategy, and alignment with Workday's twice-yearly release cycle.

• Configuration & Optimization - Lead configuration, testing, and deployment across HCM Core, Compensation, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, Talent, Performance, Recruiting, Workday Adaptive Planning - including business processes, security models, calculated fields, and custom reporting.

• Release Management & Health - Conduct regression testing for each Workday release, perform regular audits, and drive performance tuning and configuration health checks to ensure platform stability.

• Integrations & Automation - Build and maintain integrations using Workday Studio, Core Connectors, EIB, and APIs to connect Workday with adjacent systems (Greenhouse, CultureAmp, Pave, payroll, finance, provisioning); identify and eliminate manual workflows through system-driven automation.

• Self-Service & Employee Experience - Optimize business processes, notifications, navigation, and the user interface to reduce administrative burden, increase adoption, and improve the employee and manager self-service experience.

• AI & Analytics - Evaluate and implement Workday AI, machine learning, skills intelligence, and Analytics capabilities; partner with data and IT teams to ensure scalability, data privacy, and ethical deployment.

• Cross-Functional Partnership - Translate stakeholder requirements into technical specifications, manage the Workday vendor and implementation partner relationships, and lead project delivery and adoption across the organization.

What you bring

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 6+ years of progressive HR technology experience, with deep, hands-on expertise configuring and optimizing Workday.

• Demonstrated expertise across multiple Workday modules, such as HCM Core, Compensation, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, Talent, or Recruiting. Workday certification (Pro or equivalent) is a strong plus.

• Hands-on experience building Workday integrations using Studio, Core Connectors, EIB, and Workday APIs.

• Strong command of the Workday security model, business process framework, calculated fields, and advanced reporting.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning is a strong plus.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills. Self-starter with a proactive approach, capable of driving work independently and identifying opportunities for improvement without explicit direction.

• Proven experience with process automation and workflow design inside Workday.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex Workday concepts for non-technical audiences.

• An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. $161,000—$189,000 USD

About Constellation:

Constellation is a cutting-edge AI solution that empowers highly regulated and complex industries with the insights and content they need to fuel their business. Specializing in industries such as healthcare, automotive, insurance, and finance, our powerful data/AI insights tools inform the creation of compliant content at scale. A global, NYC-based company, Constellation has been revolutionizing marketing technology and data intelligence in order to drive exponential growth since its founding in 2016.

Constellation was named the 65th Fastest-Growing Private Company in America, the 10th Fastest-Growing Women-Owned Private Company, and the 7th Fastest-Growing Marketing & Advertising Company by Inc 500. In 2022, our platform won the Digiday Technology Award for Best Marketing Automation Platform.

The role

We're looking for a Junior Brand & Motion Designer to join our growing Creative Team on a full-time contract basis at $300 per day. You bring strong visual design fundamentals, a sharp eye for typography and a solid start in motion design. Most of all, you want to grow at the intersection of brand craft, AI and a high-volume systems approach to creative.

You'll help bring multi-channel video and motion creative to life for legacy automotive, pharma and healthcare brands. You'll also work alongside our Product and Tech teams as we keep building products powered by Constellation's proprietary technology, learning from senior team members along the way.

Why Constellation

Constellation is an AI-powered marketing platform that helps highly regulated industries transform content at scale. Our proprietary technology automates compliant, localized, and personalized creative that drives performance.

We don’t just design ads—we architect a smarter, faster future of content. Since our founding in 2016, Constellation has been revolutionizing the technology platforms that drive marketing efficiency, earning recognition as the 65th Fastest-Growing Private Company in America, the 10th Fastest-Growing Women-Owned Private Company, and the 7th Fastest-Growing Marketing & Advertising Company by Inc. 500. In 2022, our platform was awarded the Digiday Technology Award for Best Marketing Automation Platform.

This is a place to sharpen your craft fast. You'll see your work run across real campaigns for regulated brands, get regular feedback from experienced designers and help shape how AI and creativity work together day to day.

What you'll do

• Motion and video: Edit, animate and version video content for campaigns, paid social and promo spots, working from concepts and direction set by senior team members. Use motion to make product stories clear and engaging.

• Visual and marketing design: Design and adapt sales decks, paid ads, social assets, event collateral and marketing materials for the Constellation brand and our clients' brands. Turn approved messaging into polished creative across digital formats.

• Template production: Build, version and QC modular ad templates, including video, inside our existing design systems and Constellation’s creative automation platform, keeping every size and brand compliant.

• AI in production: Use AI agents, image generation, video and voice tools, in and outside our platform, to explore ideas and speed up production. Share what works and what doesn’t so we can keep improving our workflows.

• Brand consistency: Follow brand guidelines closely on every execution. Keep work consistent while bringing variety across formats.

• Collaboration: Work with designers, our platform team, product managers and strategists to deliver work and improve our creative engine. Give and take constructive feedback, which is central to how we build our platform.

Who you are

• You have 1–3 years of professional visual and motion design experience, including internships, in an agency, SaaS or in-house creative setting.

• You have a portfolio that shows strong typography, layout and visual storytelling, plus examples of motion design and video editing.

• You must be proficient in Figma along with the Adobe Creative Suite, especially Illustrator, Photoshop and After Effects, with working knowledge of Premiere and InDesign.

• You can take a job from brief to finished files outside any one platform and pick up new software quickly.

• You're interested in design systems and reusable components, and you want to learn how they cut down manual work in production.

• You're comfortable walking teammates through your work and explaining your design choices.

• You're organized and detail-oriented, and you can manage several projects at once against deadlines.

• You're curious about AI tools, and have experience using Claude, as well as other image and video generation models.

• You care about how individual pieces of design ladder up to a full campaign or brand identity, and you're eager to build that big-picture thinking.

• You take feedback well and are hungry to grow your craft quickly.

Junior Brand & Motion Designer

Team

Creative Team

Engagement

Contract, full time

Rate

$300 per day

Experience

1–3 years

In office (required), One World Trade Center, New York, NY

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Ruby/Rails), MVR
jobs.description:
About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About the team/role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the MVR team, reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will build and evolve the systems that power Checkr's motor vehicle record screenings, helping customers make safe, fair, and fast decisions about the drivers on their platforms. You will lead the design and execution of reliable, scalable services across the MVR lifecycle, from how records are ordered and retrieved from data sources to how they are processed, normalized, and delivered in customer reports. You will partner closely with Product, Supply Chain Operations, Product, and Business Operations to shape the platform's long-term architecture and ensure MVR screenings scale alongside Checkr's growth.

What you’ll do

• End-to-End Ownership: Lead the development lifecycle for complex MVR features, from ideation and technical design through implementation, release, and ongoing operation.

• System-Level Strategy: Define and drive the technical direction for MVR systems, identifying architectural improvements that increase reliability, reduce turnaround time, and make the platform easier to extend.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Data Supply Chain, Supply Chain Operations, Product, and Operations to translate data provider realities and customer needs into scalable technical solutions.

• Engineering Excellence: Design, build, and maintain high-performance services that meet the highest standards for data accuracy, security, and compliance.

• Operational Reliability: Proactively identify systemic risks across MVR data flows, lead incident response and root-cause analysis, and drive durable fixes that prevent recurrence.

• Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers on the team and across the organization, raising the bar on code quality, design reviews, and engineering practices.

• AI-First Mindset: Embrace an engineering culture where AI tooling is standard practice, leveraging the latest AI-assisted tools, models, and assistants to amplify your impact.

What you bring

• Senior Backend Expertise: 5+ years of experience building scalable backend systems, with strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and a deep understanding of relational databases, ORMs, and RESTful APIs.

• Distributed Systems Experience: A proven track record of designing and maintaining reliable distributed systems, including hands-on experience with microservices, CI/CD, and asynchronous or event-driven architectures.

• Systems Thinking: The ability to reason about a platform end to end, weigh architectural trade-offs, and design solutions that hold up as data sources, volume, and product requirements change.

• Data Integration & Quality: Experience integrating with external data providers or third-party APIs, and building pipelines that handle inconsistent, delayed, or incomplete data with accuracy and resilience.

• Ownership & Communication: Full-cycle ownership of your work and the ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to both engineering and non-engineering partners.

• An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Pay Transparency Disclosure

If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (San Francisco, CA)

$185,000—$218,000 USD

• Learning and development allowance

• Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement

• 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services

• Flexible PTO policy

Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. This role will work with scientific, operational, and technical teams to connect data, develop useful analytics and tools, and improve how teams access, process, visualize, and report information to accelerate decisions. The role also owns the scientific and domain aspects of the ADME-BATS data foundation, bridging scientific domain knowledge, enterprise data infrastructure, stewardship, and downstream analytics and AI.

Core responsibilities

• Lead the development of data and analytics capabilities that support the team’s priorities.
• Own the scientific and domain aspects of the ADME-BATS data foundation, partnering with enterprise data infrastructure teams and internal subject matter experts to define scientific data requirements, definitions, metadata, provenance, quality, and stewardship.
• Help establish reusable, AI/model-ready data assets across ADME-BATS that connect scientific domain knowledge, enterprise data infrastructure, stewardship, and downstream analytics and AI.
• Assess existing data sources and workflows; identify opportunities to improve data quality, consistency, accessibility, and reuse.
• Build and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, reports, and workflow tools that address scientific and operational needs.
• Apply statistical analysis and appropriate predictive methods to identify trends and provide actionable insights.
• Partner with stakeholders to define problems, prioritize solutions, and support implementation and adoption.
• Establish practical approaches for data definitions, documentation, stewardship, and sustainable ownership.
• Present findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences; mentor colleagues in the effective use of data.

• PhD (6+ years), M.S. (12+ years), or B.S. (12+ years) in data science, computer science, statistics, engineering, life sciences, or a related field, with relevant academic or industry experience.
• Demonstrated experience delivering data science, analytics, or workflow solutions for complex scientific or operational needs.
• Proficiency in Python or R and SQL; experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
• Knowledge of statistical analysis, data integration, data quality practices, and machine-learning methods.
• Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and communicating technical concepts and analytical limitations to varied audiences.
• Pharmaceutical research, ADME, bioanalytical science, or laboratory operations experience is a plus.
• Experience building workflows and templates within RLIMS and ELN.
• Experience with data governance, workflow automation, or connecting team-level data with broader reporting systems is a plus.
• Experience partnering with enterprise data infrastructure teams and scientific SMEs on metadata, provenance, data quality, and stewardship, and preparing AI/model-ready data assets, is a plus.
• Highly motivated and adaptable, with strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.
• Key Leadership Competencies
• Builds strong relationships across teams to align priorities and deliver shared outcomes.
• Provides cross-functional leadership that connects scientific domain expertise, enterprise data infrastructure, stewardship, and downstream analytics and AI.
• Learns quickly, adapts to changing needs, and applies sound judgment to complex problems.
• Creates an environment that encourages learning, collaboration, and practical innovation.
• Communicates clearly and helps turn ideas into sustainable, useful solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Verifications
jobs.location: Denver, Colorado, United States; San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape the end-to-end experiences that power Checkr’s Verifications products—spanning employment, education, criminal record, and driving record verifications, with a key focus on drug & occupational health testing. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to design intuitive workflows for complex, high-trust domains—balancing candidate ease, employer clarity, and operational realities.

This is a hands-on product design role with high ownership: you’ll drive discovery through execution, bring strong craft, and help the team make great decisions through clear thinking and excellent communication.

What you’ll do

• Own design for key Verifications product areas—including drug & occupational health testing—across candidate, employer, and internal operational experiences (as applicable), from discovery through launch and iteration.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to define problems, shape roadmaps, and deliver high-quality solutions that align user needs with business outcomes.

• Simplify complex workflows (verification requests, document collection, consent/authorization, appointment scheduling, status visibility, exception handling) into clear, user-friendly experiences.

• Use AI-assisted design and development tools to rapidly prototype, validate, and—when appropriate—implement lightweight UI changes in code to improve iteration speed and overall product quality.

• Design for trust and clarity in a sensitive, regulated domain—prioritizing transparency, error prevention, accessibility, and confidence-building UI patterns.

• Translate insights into outcomes by combining qualitative research, stakeholder input, and product data to propose, test, and refine solutions.

• Create thoughtful interaction and visual design across responsive web and/or platform surfaces, producing clear specs and assets for engineering.

• Facilitate alignment with workshops, design reviews, and strong storytelling—helping teams move from ambiguity to decisions.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with partners such as Customer Success, Sales, Compliance/Legal, Data, and Operations to ensure designs work in the real world.

• Contribute to design systems and standards to improve consistency, speed, and quality across Checkr.

What you bring

• You have 5–8+ years of product design experience (or equivalent), with a strong track record of shipping high-quality work.

• Your portfolio demonstrates end-to-end thinking: problem framing, exploration, rationale, collaboration, iteration, and measurable impact.

• You’re comfortable working in complex domains where edge cases matter, and you can distill that complexity into simple, usable flows.

• You have strong product instincts—you know how to balance user needs, business goals, technical constraints, and timeline realities.

• You’re experienced in collaborative, cross-functional environments, influencing decisions through clarity rather than authority.

• You can independently plan and execute lightweight research (interviews, usability testing, concept validation) and partner effectively with researchers when available.

• You sweat the details: interaction patterns, content clarity, information hierarchy, and accessibility best practices.

• An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Nice to have

• Experience in background screening, HR tech, healthcare, identity, compliance-heavy, or other high-trust regulated spaces.

• Experience designing B2B / B2B2C products, especially workflows used by operations teams or external partners.

• Familiarity with design systems, documentation, and scalable component thinking.

• Experience designing for secure data, consent, and privacy-forward user experiences.

Pay Transparency Disclosure

We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website.

On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (San Francisco, CA)

$169,000—$199,000 USD

On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (Denver, CO)

$143,000—$168,000 USD

What We Offer

• A fast-paced and collaborative environment

• Learning and development allowance

• Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement

• 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services

• Flexible PTO policy

• Monthly wellness stipend

At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. A relocation stipend may be available for those willing to relocate to a Checkr hub location.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Checkr
Checkr is committed to building the best product and company, which requires hiring talented and qualified individuals with a diverse set of perspectives and lived experiences. Checkr believes in hiring people of all backgrounds, including those whose histories are impacted by the justice system in accordance with local, state, and/or federal laws, including the San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance.

Applicant Privacy Policy
If you are a California resident or are located in Alberta or British Columbia, our Applicant Privacy Policy applies to our collection and processing of your personal information when you apply for a role with us or otherwise participate in our recruitment process.

For applicants in Massachusetts: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

*Legitimate Checkr emails will always include our official domain name after the @ symbol (e.g., name@checkr.com or name@ext.checkr.com).

jobs.title: Medical Assistant - Sheepshead Bay, NY
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Medical Assistant plays a pivotal role in supporting dermatology physicians by delivering high-quality patient care. Responsibilities include patient rooming, updating medical histories, documenting visit details, and assisting with various dermatological procedures such as biopsies, surgeries, and skin treatments.

Must be fluent in Russian and English.

Dermatology experience preferred.

Pay and Hours:

Pay range is $20 - $21 hourly. Hours are Monday - Friday, 8 hours daily.

Essential Functions:

To perform effectively in this role, the candidate must fulfill the following duties with or without reasonable accommodations:

• Collaborate with a team to manage an average patient volume of up to 40 patients daily.

• Document patient histories, including history of present illness (HPI), medical, surgical, and family history, medications, and allergies.

• Prepare and assist with dermatological and cosmetic procedures, including ED&Cs, biopsies (shave and punch), ILK, I&D, Botox, laser treatments, excisions, and other surgical interventions.

• Administer local anesthesia and remove sutures as directed.

• Ensure strict adherence to sterile techniques and infection control practices.

• Perform scribing responsibilities, including inputting templates and chart notes as directed by physicians.

• Process prescription refills and manage prior authorizations.

• Log pathology samples and coordinate with appropriate laboratories.

• Operate specialized equipment such as Narrowband UVB and photodynamic therapy units.

• Maintain and replenish liquid nitrogen containers.

• Clean and stock examination rooms and supply areas.

• Ensure adherence to organizational infection control protocols.

• Maintain reliable and consistent attendance.

• Perform other duties as assigned by the supervising physician or department lead.

Knowledge, Skills, & Responsibilities:

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• 0–3 years of medical assistant experience, preferably in dermatology.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate patient records.

• Effective communication and teamwork skills.

• Must be bilingual in English/Russian.

This role requires a proactive, dependable, and detail-oriented individual with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic healthcare environment. The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong commitment to patient care and operational excellence.

Physical and Mental Demands:

The physical and mental demands described below are representative of those required to perform this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities:

• Physical Requirements:

• Occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for extended periods.

• Use hands to handle objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms.

• Occasionally required to climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, bend, crouch, or crawl.

• Occasionally lift, push, pull, or move up to 20 pounds.

• Vision Requirements:

• Close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Note:
This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the role. Additional responsibilities may be assigned, or duties modified by the department supervisor based on operational needs.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
NETGEAR is seeking a technically skilled and customer-centric pre-sales Systems Engineer to support our Enterprise and IT customers. This role focuses on delivering technical leadership during the sales cycle and beyond, ensuring successful deployments of wired and wireless enterprise networking solutions. The ideal candidate will be a trusted advisor with deep knowledge in Wi-Fi, LAN switching, cloud networking, and Zero Trust security, and will also play a critical role in relaying customer feedback to influence product strategy and innovation.

This is a remote role open to candidates based in North Dakota, South Dakota, Nebraska, Kansas, Minnesota, Iowa, Missouri, Wisconsin, Illinois, Indiana, Michigan or Ohio with occasional travel required across the Central United States Region.



Key Responsibilities

· Partner with account teams to deliver pre-sales technical consultation, solution design, product demos, and proof-of-concepts tailored to enterprise needs.

· Lead the architecture and deployment of enterprise-grade WiFi, switches, routers, and security and cloud solutions.

· Present technical content to diverse audiences, including IT stakeholders, channel partners, and internal teams.

· Serve as a technical bridge between the customer and Netgear’s Support organization, facilitating smooth post-sales transitions, managing escalations, and ensuring a consistent customer experience.

· Act as the voice of the customer by gathering, analyzing, and articulating technical feedback and feature requests to Product Management, helping shape product direction and ensuring customer needs are reflected in future releases.

· Design and support secure networking environments leveraging Zero Trust architecture, including user/device segmentation, role-based access, and secure onboarding.

· Promote and support the adoption of Cloud platforms, providing scalable cloud management for multi-site environments with capabilities such as zero-touch provisioning, real-time alerts, firmware lifecycle management, and network analytics.

· Conduct detailed RF planning and network design using tools such as Ekahau or similar.

· Enable and support Netgear's channel ecosystem (MSPs, VARs, distributors) through technical training, solution guidance, and joint customer engagements.

· Maintain in-depth knowledge of competitive products, market trends, and the evolving enterprise IT landscape.



Required Qualifications

· 5+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, Network Engineering, or a similar technical customer-facing role.

· Expertise in:

- Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 wireless networking technologies

- Layer 2/3 switching, VLANs, routing, QoS, and enterprise security practices

- Cloud-managed networking (Netgear Insight or competitive solutions)

- Zero Trust security concepts including identity-based access and micro-segmentation

· Strong troubleshooting and solution development skills across both wireless and wired networks.

· Experience using RF design tools (e.g., Ekahau, Hamina, etc).

· Industry certifications such as CWNA, CCNA/CCNP, or equivalent preferred.

· Experience supporting or working with channel partners, MSPs, and mid-market enterprise customers.



Attributes

· Strong interpersonal and communication skills – able to influence and build trust with both technical and business audiences.

· Excellent organizational and project coordination skills.

· A team player with a passion for customer success and product excellence.

· Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

· Willingness to travel up to 25–50%, depending on territory needs.



Company Statement

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.  

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture. 

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity. 



NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
