jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Medical Devices
jobs.description:
ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Introduction to the team:

SandboxAQ’s medical device team, AQMed, is building a magnetic sensing device to transform cardiac sensing. By measuring the heart’s magnetic field, a sensing modality known as magnetocardiography, we can gain information about heart disease unavailable through existing sensing methods. Our first application of this technology will be to better triage patients with suspected heart attacks.



Introduction to the role: 

The AQMed Team is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. This role is central to our efforts to develop a machine learning model to detect high-risk coronary artery disease using magnetocardiographic data. In this role you will be responsible for developing predictive features and machine learning models that process biosignal data, processing and cleaning clinical study data, and supporting verification and validation of a software as a medical device (SaMD) product for regulatory submission. You will work with real multi-site clinical study data. As part of a small team, your models and biomarkers will directly shape our product and you will get hands-on experience bringing a new sensing modality to patients.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Engineer novel features that can be extracted from biosignal data, taking inspiration from the literature and your knowledge of cardiac electrophysiology, and train machine learning models to detect high risk coronary artery disease

 - Own data quality and curation for clinical study datasets, from raw site exports to analysis-ready dataframes

 - Run rigorous model evaluation and write V&V and regulatory documentation for a diagnostic medical device

 - Collaborate with AQMed’s clinical operations, product, and engineering teams to support clinical studies, define ML system requirements, and deploy models into production in a cloud environment
   
   


ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE 

 - Master’s or PhD in biomedical engineering, biophysics, machine learning, or a related field

 - 5 years industry experience with biomedical signal processing and machine learning, including:
   
   -  classical machine learning in a data-scarce environment and
   
   -  experience shipping a commercial product

 - Expertise in Python data science software tools (numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, PyTorch) and familiarity with cloud data processing tools (SQL, AWS)

 - Working knowledge of ECG, cardiac electrophysiology, and quantitative biomedical research methods for diagnostics




HIGHLY DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE 

 - Experience in the cardiac or neurological medical device industry

 - Experience with medical device quality and regulatory requirements including FDA 510(k)/SaMD, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP)

 - Experience with deep learning methods (e.g. self-supervised pretraining, transfer learning, distillation)

 - Strong publication record, including first-author publications in biomedical signal processing, ML, or clinical journals

 - Experience using LLM coding assistants and agentic tools to speed up analysis and development

 - Experience with MCG or biomagnetic data, or with multichannel sensor arrays




WHY JOIN US?

We offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth.

 - Compensation: Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus equity and performance-based incentives.

 - Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match; generous parental leave.

 - Work-Life Balance: Flexible hybrid work arrangements, generous PTO, and a culture that respects focus time and recovery.

 - Career Development: Direct exposure to CHIPS Act-funded programs, senior scientific and executive leadership, mentorship, and dedicated learning budgets to support continued growth.




SANDBOXAQ WELCOMES ALL

We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and respect, where diverse perspectives are actively sought and valued. Our multidisciplinary environment provides ample opportunity for continuous growth - working alongside humble, empowered, and ambitious colleagues ready to tackle epic challenges.

Equal Employment Opportunity: All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.

Additional support for projects in development for biocompatibility activities is a responsibility of this role.

• Change Control/Marketed Product support: Support for on-market products, including global change-control activities as they relate to biocompatibility. Build and maintain strong connections/relationships with cross-functional change control requestors at global manufacturing sites. Demonstrated experience with review and evaluation of changes through formal change control systems for biocompatibility impact. • Project Support: Provide skilled technical knowledge to support cross-functional project Biocompatibility resource for projects when required. Interface with CRO’s for project support initiatives

Sci.) impact assessment notifications. Have knowledge on how to support notified body and internal audits, inspections, with respect to ISO 10993 compliance and documentation. jobs.title: Mohs Medical Assistant - Newburyport/Beverly, MA
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Mohs Medical Assistant/Surgical Technician plays a crucial role in delivering high-quality, patient-centered care to individuals undergoing Mohs surgery. This position ensures the maintenance of a safe, efficient, and quality-focused environment by conducting pre-surgical evaluations, providing patient and family education, assisting with surgical procedures, managing patient flow, and maintaining meticulous patient records in both electronic and physical formats.

Pay and Hours:

Pay range is $26 -$28 hourly, depending on experience, Hours are Monday - Thursday, 10 hours daily.

Essential Functions:

To perform effectively in this role, the candidate must fulfill the following duties with or without reasonable accommodations:

• Conduct initial assessments and review health survey data to develop comprehensive care plans tailored to patient needs.

• Provide detailed pre-operative and post-operative education to patients and their families, ensuring understanding and compliance with care instructions.

• Prepare the surgical area by organizing necessary instruments, equipment, and anesthesia.

• Assist the surgeon during procedures, including scrubbing in, handing instruments, cutting sutures, and maintaining a sterile operative field.

• Ensure the surgical environment remains clean, organized, and compliant with established protocols.

• Administer anesthesia under the direct supervision of the physician, ensuring accurate dosages and adherence to proper techniques.

• Accurately document all aspects of patient care, including detailed notes for each Mohs procedure within the Electronic Medical Records (EMR) system.

• Maintain comprehensive and accurate records of follow-up communications and post-operative instructions.

• Implement practices that promote excellence in surgical care and patient outcomes.

• Maintain a sterile environment by strictly adhering to safety standards and protocols.

• Monitor patient safety during procedures and recovery, taking all necessary precautions to ensure their well-being.

• Provide clear, written post-operative instructions, ensuring patients have access to an effective communication system for follow-up questions or concerns.

• Assist patients with mobility following surgery to ensure safety and prevent falls.

• Operate and maintain surgical equipment, including the autoclave, ensuring all instruments are properly sterilized and ready for use.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Minimum of 2 years of experience as a medical assistant or surgical technician; experience in dermatology is highly preferred.

• Proficiency with Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems and Microsoft Office applications.

• Expertise in the use of surgical instruments and maintaining sterile environments.

This role requires a proactive, dependable, and detail-oriented individual with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic healthcare environment. The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong commitment to patient care and operational excellence.

Physical and Mental Demands:

The physical and mental demands described below are representative of those required to perform this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities:

• Physical Requirements:

• Occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for extended periods.

• Use hands to handle objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms.

• Occasionally required to climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, bend, crouch, or crawl.

• Occasionally lift, push, pull, or move up to 20 pounds.

• Vision Requirements:

• Close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Note:
This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the role. Additional responsibilities may be assigned, or duties modified by the department supervisor based on operational needs.

jobs.title: Scientist - LCMS
jobs.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an LCMS Scientist to join our analytical development team. This individual will be responsible for the development, optimization, troubleshooting, and execution of LCMS- and HPLC-based analytical methods to support pharmaceutical development, characterization, and testing activities in a GMP-regulated environment. The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with laboratory, quality, and client stakeholders to ensure the generation of high-quality analytical data.

Responsibilities

• Develop, optimize, and execute analytical methods utilizing LC-MS/MS, LCMS, HPLC, and UPLC instrumentation.
• Perform method troubleshooting, transfer, qualification, and routine testing activities.
• Analyze and interpret chromatographic and mass spectrometry data, preparing technical summaries and reports.
• Support analytical activities related to drug substance and drug product testing.
• Author and review SOPs, protocols, technical reports, and laboratory documentation.
• Ensure all work is conducted in compliance with GMP, GLP, data integrity, and laboratory safety requirements.
• Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and project teams to support analytical deliverables and timelines.
• Investigate laboratory deviations, OOS/OOT results, and implement corrective actions as needed.
• Maintain laboratory instrumentation and coordinate troubleshooting, calibration, and preventative maintenance activities.
• Participate in client meetings and provide technical expertise when required.

Required:

• BS in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline with 2+ years of GMP pharmaceutical laboratory experience, OR
• MS in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline with hands-on LCMS experience.
• Minimum of 1 year of experience developing, optimizing, or troubleshooting LCMS methods, or extensive experience in HPLC method development.
• Experience operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting chromatographic instrumentation.
• Strong understanding of chromatographic theory, sample preparation techniques, and analytical data interpretation.
• Experience working within GMP-regulated laboratory environments.
• Excellent scientific documentation and technical writing skills.

Preferred:

• Experience with analytical method validation, qualification, or transfer activities following ICH guidelines.
• Knowledge of mass spectrometry applications for impurity analysis, characterization, or quantitative assays.
• Familiarity with Empower, MassHunter, Xcalibur, Analyst, or similar chromatography software.
• Experience supporting pharmaceutical development, stability testing, or release testing programs.

This is a full-time position working Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Occasional weekend overtime may be required based on business needs. Candidates who reside within a reasonable commuting distance of San Diego, California are encouraged to apply.

Compensation:

$27.00-$32.00 per hour, based on education, experience, and qualifications.

Benefits

Eurofins offers a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) plan with company match
• Paid vacation and company holidays

Eurofins USA BioPharma Services is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Network Operator
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

 - Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

 - Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Serve as the on-site Tier 3 escalation point for network and structured-cabling incidents across the site's AI infrastructure.

 - Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve physical-layer faults, validate repairs, and drive rapid resolution of issues hitting customer workloads.

 - Act as the escalation path for Tier 1 and 2 technicians, and partner with Network Operations on deeper investigations.

 - Own structured cabling and fiber infrastructure, and interpret device-level diagnostics well enough to confirm a physical repair restored connectivity.

 - Escalate out-of-scope issues to Network Operations with clear documentation, and take ownership through resolution as the sole on-site network and ICT resource.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

 - You've been the on-site network or cable-plant specialist in a data center, owning physical-layer troubleshooting end to end.

 - You know structured cabling and fiber deeply (testing, termination, fault isolation) and you read device diagnostics well enough to validate repairs.

 - You have enough network fundamentals (TCP/IP, switching, optics) to bridge cabling and the network stack.

 - You operate as the sole escalation resource on-site and take incidents through to resolution.

 - You document rigorously, so Network Operations can pick up cleanly when an issue exceeds on-site scope.

 - Bonus: High-density AI or hyperscale fabrics. Fiber certification (BICSI, Fluke). Optical transport. InfiniBand or high-speed Ethernet.


SALARY & BENEFITS

 - Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

 - Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance.

 - Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.

Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.

Physical Requirements

 - Work in non-climate-controlled environments, including active construction areas, data halls, electrical and mechanical rooms, and outdoor spaces. Temperatures can be high or low, and conditions can be humid, loud or dusty.

 - Lift, carry, push and pull up to 40 pounds on your own.

 - Sit, stand, walk, kneel, bend and crouch for long periods, including full shifts on your feet.

 - Wear the required personal protective equipment (PPE), such as hard hats, safety glasses, steel-toed boots, gloves and hearing protection, and follow site safety rules.

 - Climb stairs and ladders, and move around equipment, cable trays and uneven surfaces.

 - This role is 12-hour shift work, rotating between days and nights.

 - This is a 24/7 operation, so you will be required to work some holidays to keep the site running.

 - The scope in this posting is an example of the work. You will be asked to solve problems beyond it.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

AI Screening Notice https://fluidstack.io/legal/ai-screening-notice
Ashby Bias Audit https://fluidstack.io/legal/ashby-bias-audit



You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application--  someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

jobs.title: Director, Internal Communications
jobs.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart is looking for a Director of Internal Communications to evolve how employees understand the business we are building, how the company is performing and what our next chapter requires from them. Internal communications here is not a distribution function. It is a strategic capability that connects company decisions to our strategy, creates clarity during consequential moments and helps employees act with confidence.

You will join Upstart’s Communications, Culture & Development team, which helps employees understand where the company is going, feel connected to its purpose and build the capabilities to do their best work. You will evolve the strategy and operating rhythm for enterprise communications, serve as a senior partner to executives and functional leaders, and independently lead some of Upstart’s most consequential employee-facing work.

You will also own Upstart’s company knowledge strategy and core internal content portfolio, ensuring employees can find clear, current and trusted information across Guru and Glean. As our ways of working evolve, you will bring greater depth and thought leadership to our employee-facing GenAI communications and enablement strategy.

This is a role for a senior player-coach who sees beyond the immediate request, brings a strong point of view and stays close enough to the work to make the strategy real.

How you’ll make an impact

• Evolve Upstart’s internal communications strategy and operating rhythm, including an enterprise employee calendar and governance practices that improve prioritization, timing and coordination.

• Translate complex company priorities, performance and decisions into clear narratives that help employees understand where Upstart is headed, why it matters and what is expected of them.

• Serve as a senior communications partner to the VP of Communications, Culture & Development and to executives and functional leaders on employee communications within the role’s portfolio.

• Lead the strategy and end-to-end development of employee earnings communications, including the post-earnings all-hands, in partnership with Investor Relations, External Communications, Finance and senior leaders.

• Build proactive communications strategies for priority company goals and enterprise changes, ensuring employees are brought along with clarity and appropriate context.

• Own Upstart’s company knowledge strategy and core internal content portfolio. Establish the information architecture, editorial standards, governance and content lifecycle across Guru, Glean and emerging AI-enabled knowledge experiences.

• Directly lead priority enterprise content while creating clear standards and accountability for specialized content owned by functions across Upstart.

• Own the employee-facing GenAI communications and enablement strategy, helping employees understand how GenAI is changing the way we work and ensuring they are supported through that change.

• Elevate flagship employee storytelling and connection through programs including Upstart Unlocked, Board and Lead-to-Lead conversations, ERG infrastructure, and employee recognition and anniversary experiences.

• Partner closely with the Senior Manager of Internal Communications on TGIF, recurring employee communications, channel strategy, employer-brand storytelling and campaign execution.

• Strengthen the function’s systems, measurement and decision rights so the team can operate with greater focus, consistency and impact.

• Stay close to the work. Write, edit and deliver high-stakes communications; build the first version when something new is needed; and create repeatable approaches that allow the function to scale without sacrificing quality.

Minimum Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in internal communications, executive communications, change communications or a related field, including experience operating at a senior strategic level in a complex organization.

• Exceptional writing and editing skills, paired with the judgment to make complicated business topics clear without making them simplistic.

• Experience counseling senior executives and the confidence to challenge, advise and improve a leader’s communication while preserving their voice and intent.

• Strong business and financial fluency, including experience translating company performance, strategy and consequential organizational decisions for employees.

• Demonstrated experience building communications strategies, planning rhythms and operating systems, not only executing individual campaigns or managing channels.

• The ability to lead complex cross-functional work, influence without direct authority and make thoughtful tradeoffs across timing, message design and employee burden.

• Experience leading, coaching or developing experienced communications talent.

• The ability and willingness to move between strategy and execution, including personally writing and delivering high-priority work.

• Strong judgment, intellectual curiosity and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the right path may not yet be defined.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with employee knowledge management, content governance, enterprise search or platforms such as Guru and Glean.

• Experience developing communications or enablement strategies related to GenAI, digital transformation or significant changes in how employees work.

• Experience in a public company, financial services, a regulated industry or another environment requiring close partnership with Investor Relations, Legal and Finance.

• Experience supporting a distributed or digital-first workforce.

Position Location - This role is available in the following locations: Remote, Burlingame, CA, and Columbus, OH

Time Zone Requirements - This team operates on the East/West Coast time zones.

Travel Requirements - As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies, but in this role you can expect to travel 1-2 times per quarter.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package.  The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote -  Anticipated Base Salary Range

$195,800—$271,000 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

• Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly

• Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)

• Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.

• Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)

• Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security

• Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements

• Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)

• Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources

• Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)

• Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you

• Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from

• Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)

• Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.

Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices.

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate_accommodations@upstart.com

With the millions-strong Squishable fan community cheering us on (and a lot of cupcakes, coffee, and karaoke) we make people say “awww.” Our offices are in a sunny loft in NYC's Flatiron District and in downtown Washington, DC.

WHO ARE WE?

We are Squishable! At Squishable, products and people are at the core of why we do what we do every day. We strive to create a customer experience built on sharing our love and passion for the brand while building long-lasting relationships with our customers…turning friends into fans. As we experience rapid growth, we are seeking career-driven leaders obsessed with creating a unique, exceptional customer experience. We need great people to represent the brand where it matters most…in front of our customers. These leaders will help shape the voice and character of the Squishable store experience.

The ideal candidate is a natural-born leader who loves the store experience. They are passionate, driven, and highly organized, with a desire to bring happiness to people’s lives. Candidates must be well-spoken and confident interacting with people at all levels while remaining calm and organized at all times.

jobs.title: I.T. Project Manager
jobs.description:
Why Jencap? We are one of the largest wholesale insurance intermediaries in the United States with expertise in wholesale brokerage, binding authority, and program management. The common thread woven throughout our success story is our collaborative and driven team of people. Our teams are empowered and work together to find solutions. We have a passion culture – with teamwork, collaboration and a focus on growing individuals and giving them the tools & development opportunities to have a successful career.

Jencap Partners is comprised of our corporate operations and service teams who support our staff in their commitment to achieve greatness and exceed the expectations of our agency partners. The goal of corporate functions is to provide the necessary infrastructure, expertise, and services that enable our business to thrive, while also contributing to the overall success, efficiency, and sustainability of the organization. We act as partners, aligning support strategies to achieve Jencap’s broader objectives.

The Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of technology initiatives across the organization. This role operates within the IT Delivery & Execution function and is accountable for driving projects from initiation through completion with a strong focus on execution, transparency, accountability, and business outcomes. The Project Manager works closely with key leaders and functional areas to analyze, support, manage, lead, monitor, and report on projects across the organization.

Unlike a traditional stand-alone PMO model, this role is embedded within IT leadership and works closely with business leaders, technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to organizational priorities. The Project Manager serves as a delivery leader who brings structure, visibility, risk management, and momentum to projects while helping teams achieve successful outcomes. This position may require periodic travel based on project needs and is expected to work remotely or from a local office as appropriate.

This role can work a hybrid schedule in any of our Jencap locations or Remote.

Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Execution

• Lead assigned technology and business-facing projects through all phases of the project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure.

• Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.

• Drive project execution with a focus on accountability, follow-through, and measurable outcomes.

• Ensure project scope, objectives, and success criteria are clearly defined and aligned with business priorities.

• Coordinate project activities across cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, IT resources, vendors, and third-party partners.

• Monitor progress against plan and proactively address issues that may impact delivery.

• Track and report on project status, including budgets/expenses, and surface potential budget revisions needed to accomplish objectives within time and budget targets.

• Monitor compliance with project policies, standards, and governance requirements and address gaps proactively.

Stakeholder Communication & Coordination

• Serve as the central point of coordination for assigned projects.

• Facilitate regular project meetings, status reviews, working sessions, and stakeholder updates.

• Provide clear, concise, and timely communication regarding project status, risks, issues, decisions, and next steps.

jobs.title: Director [Multiple Positions Available]
jobs.description:
Position: Director [Multiple Positions Available]

Entity: Kroll Bond Rating Agency, LLC

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: 51 W 52nd St, New York, NY 10019. Telecommuting permitted up to 40% of the week.  Must report to office Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday. Up to 15% domestic travel required to attend conferences and off-site management meetings.

What you’ll do

• Responsible for assigning new ratings and providing surveillance for project finance and infrastructure entities (spanning energy-including oil & gas and renewables-transportation, and communication and social infrastructure sectors, among others).

• Play a key role in executing the rating process by running cash flow analysis, evaluating technical and operational aspects of projects, reviewing credit documentation, transaction structures, financial statements, and reviewing and presenting internal credit reports for rating committees.

• Assign new ratings and complete surveillance for complex infrastructure and energy project finance transactions by: forecasting future performance using financial and quantitative models; preparing internal credit reports and materials for rating committees; analyzing cash flows and key credit drivers; and evaluating legal, contractual, operational, and technical aspects of projects.

• Review stress tests of financial models to assess credit risk, including sensitivity analysis across key variables (e.g., production, pricing, operating performance).

• Apply established rating methodologies to transactions and contribute to analytical discussions for new or evolving asset classes, particularly across energy transition sectors.

• Support the development of junior team members by providing training and mentorship on credit analysis, financial modeling, and project finance structures.

• Develop rating methodology for new asset types and new jurisdictions where KBRA has not previously rated transactions.

• Facilitate client relationships with project sponsors.

• Participate in industry conferences and seminars to support KBRA's market presence and stay current on sector developments.

• Communicate KBRA's credit views to investors and market participants on specific transactions and broader industry trends.

• Contribute to research publications on the project finance and infrastructure markets, including energy transition, oil & gas, and renewables sectors.

• Telecommuting permitted up to 40% of the week. Must report to office Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday.

• Up to 15% domestic travel required to attend conferences and off-site management meetings.

Requirements

• Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or related field of study plus four (4) years of experience in the job offered or as Director, Associate, Associate Director, Operations Manager, Assistant Manager, New Projects, Project Engineer or related occupation. The employer will alternatively accept a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or related field of study plus seven (7) years of experience in the job offered or as Director, Associate, Associate Director, Operations Manager, Assistant Manager, New Projects, Project Engineer or related occupation.

• This position requires three (3) years of experience with the following: preparing credit memoranda and analytical reports including internal credit reports, publications, sector research, financial performance analysis, operating performance analysis of projects, and written analyses of credit strengths and risks; analyzing sectors including energy (pipelines and midstream assets, LNG export facilities, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and renewables), communications and digital infrastructure (data centers, fiber networks, towers, and GPU-related financings), and social infrastructure; presenting sector, financial model, cash flow, credit, and risk analyses to senior credit or investment committees.

• This position requires one (1) year of experience in project finance, infrastructure, energy, or credit analysis within a rating agency, consulting firm, bank, or similar environment.

• This position requires any amount of experience with: building and analyzing project finance and three-statement financial models; performing cash flow forecasting using financial, statistical, and economic inputs including revenue assumptions, operating cost assumptions, technical forecasts, market pricing assumptions, debt service schedules, interest rate assumptions, commodity price assumptions, inflation assumptions, macroeconomic indicators, and market demand data; using advanced Microsoft Excel functions, including financial formulas and data analysis tools to analyze large datasets; supporting execution and credit analysis of project and infrastructure finance transactions, including corporate joint ventures and structured financings; analyzing holdco financings, minority interest investments, and back-leverage preferred equity transactions; and reviewing legal documentation, including credit agreements, joint venture agreements, leases, and power purchase agreements (PPAs).

• Telecommuting permitted up to 40% of the week. Must report to office Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday.

• Up to 15% domestic travel required to attend conferences and off-site management meetings.

Salary: $185,800 - $230,000 per year

Benefits

• Competitive benefits and paid time off

• Paid family and disability leave

• 401(k) plan, including employer match (100% vested)

• Educational and professional development financial assistance

• Employee referral bonus program

About Us

Kroll Bond Rating Agency, LLC (KBRA) is a full-service credit rating agency registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission as an NRSRO. Kroll Bond Rating Agency Europe Limited is registered as a CRA with the European Securities and Markets Authority. Kroll Bond Rating Agency UK Limited is registered as a CRA with the UK Financial Conduct Authority pursuant to the Temporary Registration Regime. In addition, KBRA is designated as a designated rating organization by the Ontario Securities Commission for issuers of asset-backed securities to file a short form prospectus or shelf prospectus. KBRA is also recognized by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners as a Credit Rating Provider.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Content & Academy
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Nearly 100,000 customers count on Motive to keep drivers, crews, and job sites safe. You'll build the Academy that teaches them how, starting from ground zero and ending with a branded learning experience people actually choose to use. You'll have help center and Customer Education content to pull from, but the Academy itself is yours to build.

As Sr Manager, Content & Academy, you'll report to the VP, Sales Enablement and own customer education content and the Motive Academy end to end: roadmap, design standards, governance, platform, and adoption. You'll lead a team of three (an Instructional Designer, a Developer, and an Academy Content PM) and be accountable for customer engagement with Academy content and GTM field engagement with University content. As the Academy matures, this role has a path to Director, with scope expanding to orchestrate internal GTM and partnerships content alongside customer content.

What You'll Do:

• Launch the branded Motive Academy: finalize the customer learning platform, build and test, and balance cost with customer experience.

• Build the core library for fleet managers, safety managers, admins, and partners: onboarding pathways, self-paced modules, video walkthroughs, guides, templates, role-based courses across the Motive platform (safety, fleet, equipment, workforce, and spend), and live workshops.

• Create the admin track and certification paths that teach customers and partners to roll out and manage Motive across their fleets, sites, and teams.

• Define a certification, accreditation and badging strategy that keeps learners coming back.

• Use microlearning, video, and multimedia to make content people want to watch, growing into influencer and YouTube-style learning over time, on a predictable update cadence.

• Partner with Support to connect the help center and Motive's YouTube content seamlessly with the Academy.

• Partner with Customer Education to decide which segments and launches need high-touch training and which are best served by scaled, on-demand programs, using insights and data from their team and other sources.

• Own the customer learning roadmap and measure adoption, engagement, time to value, and support deflection, reporting progress to executive leadership each quarter.

• Lead your team of three, set instructional design standards and content governance so one library feeds onboarding, accreditation, activations, and customer education, and use AI to build and update content faster.

• Partner with Customer Education, Role Readiness, the Enablement Business Partners, GTM Activation, Product, and Marketing, and make the case for headcount where the function needs depth as the Academy proves out.

What We're Looking For:

• 5 to 7 years in customer education, learning and development, or enablement content at a fast-growing SaaS company, including launching a customer academy or LMS program.

• You've implemented a customer learning platform or LMS from requirements through launch.

• A builder with craft: you've scripted, produced, or directed video, eLearning, and microlearning, and you use AI tools to move faster.

• You've designed learning paths, certifications, and gamification or badging programs for customers.

• You turn complex products into curriculum that busy, field-based customers, such as fleet and safety managers, actually use.

• You measure what matters (e.g., the Kirkpatrick Model) and tie learning to adoption and time to value.

• You've led instructional designers, developers, or program managers on a distributed team, including offshore, and want to grow into a Director role.

Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Staff GIS Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The Philadelphia Water Department (PWD) serves the greater Philadelphia region by providing integrated water, wastewater, and stormwater services. This position supports GIS operations and analytics of PWD, and reports to the GIS Manager.

The Staff GIS Software Engineer is responsible for leading the design and development of internal GIS applications that support the design, operation, and maintenance of Philadelphia's drinking water, wastewater, and green stormwater infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can own systems end-to-end, from architecture and data modeling through frontend implementation, deployment, and long-term maintenance.

You'll work at the intersection of GIS, software engineering, and database design, building tools that engineering and operations staff depend on every day. The bulk of the role is greenfield development of modern applications that replace aging systems, with the rest spent keeping existing tools reliable, automating GIS editing workflows, and investing in the development practices that make all of it sustainable.

A core part of new application work is partnering directly with the many civil, environmental, mechanical, and electrical engineers across PWD to understand their work processes and design tools that fit what their needs. You'll work alongside a team of several GIS professionals and editors who maintain the datasets your applications display.

Essential Functions

• Developing new applications and API’s on modern tech stacks to replace legacy ones. Primarily with C#, ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server for backend, and JavaScript/TypeScript, React and the Esri ArcGIS Maps SDK for frontend.
• Design and maintain a document management system for over 340,000 georeferenced engineering drawings.
• Maintaining legacy Visual Basic and ASP.NET Framework applications.
• ArcGIS Pro Add-in/extension development using C# and the ArcGIS Pro .NET SDK to automate common workflows for GIS editors.
• Implementing modern DevOps; CI/CD pipelines and other best practices to support application development, testing, and long-term maintenance.
• Direct collaboration with civil, environmental, mechanical, and electrical engineers, city planners, and field operations staff to gather requirements, validate designs, and iterate on tools that fit their needs.
• Python GIS data processing and alerting scripts.
• Directs the work of a junior level software engineer

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.

Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Significant professional experience building and shipping production software, with strong full-stack range across C#/.NET on the backend and React + TypeScript on the frontend.
• Demonstrated ability to design and build polished, maintainable frontend applications — component architecture, state management, type safety, and an eye for UX.
• Experience with web mapping development using the Esri JavaScript API (or comparable mapping libraries) and a solid grasp of how spatial data flows from server to browser.
• Deep familiarity with SQL Server, including schema design, performance tuning, and permissions.
• Strong working knowledge of the Esri ArcGIS ecosystem and the data systems built around it.
• Hands-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and the practices around them — automated builds, deployments, environment promotion, and release management.
• Comfort working directly with non-developer subject matter experts (engineers, GIS editors, operations staff) to elicit requirements and shape the design of new applications.
• Willingness to maintain and incrementally improve legacy systems — including older Visual Basic and ASP.NET Framework codebases — while charting a path toward replacing them.
• A track record of making pragmatic architectural decisions and avoiding unnecessary complexity.
• Strong communication skills, especially around documenting decisions and explaining tradeoffs to non-developers.

Preferred Skills:

• ArcGIS Enterprise 10.6 and later
• Experience with ArcGIS Pro SDK development.
• SQL Server
• Windows Server, IIS 10
• Experience as a user of of ArcMap and ArcGIS Pro
• Python experience, particularly for GIS data processing and ETL work.
• Background in utility, municipal, civil engineering, or infrastructure data systems.

Salary cannot exceed $110,000

We’re interested in hiring the best possible candidate for the role. We recognize that experience, education, and qualifications can be attained in a variety of ways and that many skillsets are transferable. If you feel you’re a good fit, please don’t hesitate to apply.

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Build better processes. Improve performance. Make an impact.

Are you an engineer who enjoys solving complex manufacturing challenges, improving production processes, and turning ideas into measurable results? The Process Engineer will help optimize manufacturing operations, improve workplace safety and ergonomics, and drive continuous improvement initiative.

In this hands-on role, you'll work closely with production teams, front-line leaders, and plant management to identify opportunities, eliminate waste, improve workflow, and develop innovative solutions that enhance manufacturing performance.

From process optimization and shop floor layouts to equipment improvements and new manufacturing methods, you'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on operational efficiency, product quality, and business growth.

What You'll Do

As our Process Engineer, you'll take ownership of manufacturing improvement initiatives while partnering with team members throughout the facility.

Manufacturing Process Improvement

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, reduce costs, increase capacity, and support business growth.
• Evaluate production workflows, conduct time studies, and identify opportunities to eliminate waste using Lean manufacturing principles.
• Analyze manufacturing bottlenecks and resolve production and quality challenges in collaboration with Quality and Production leadership.
• Evaluate shop floor layouts and recommend improvements to optimize workflow and operational efficiency.
• Design and develop fixtures, equipment, and other solutions to improve ergonomics, safety, and production performance.

Continuous Improvement & Project Leadership

• Lead and support continuous improvement projects, including 5S, sustainability initiatives, value stream mapping, and Kaizen events.
• Maintain a pipeline of improvement opportunities and collaborate with operators and production teams to implement solutions.
• Develop and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions.
• Research and evaluate new technologies and manufacturing methods to improve efficiency, quality, and cost.
• Work cross-functionally to drive projects from concept through implementation and measure results.

Engineering & Technical Solutions

• Utilize CAD software to support product design, manufacturing layouts, and 2D drawing development.
• Apply Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles to optimize product quality, efficiency, and cost.
• Support the development and qualification of critical materials and manufacturing processes.
• Evaluate capital equipment and automation opportunities, including ROI and make-versus-buy analysis.
• Support supplier quality initiatives, including supplier audits, evaluations, and performance scorecards.

What You'll Bring

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Industrial Engineering.
• At least 3 years of experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies; Green Belt certification is a plus.
• Knowledge of production practices and manufacturing processes.
• Experience with CAD software, such as AutoCAD or SolidWorks.
• Familiarity with shop floor layout software, MRP systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and database tools.
• Experience with machining operations is a plus.
• Experience working with synthetic graphite or similar manufacturing materials is preferred.

Skills That Will Set You Apart

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
• Ability to lead projects, manage priorities, and drive improvement initiatives to completion.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
• Ability to work effectively with production operators, front-line managers, and leadership.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating across departments and teams.

Travel Requirements

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 10%. A valid driver's license and U.S. passport, or the ability to obtain one, are required.

Working Environment

• This position works primarily in an office environment with regular exposure to manufacturing operations. The manufacturing environment may include loud noise, moving mechanical equipment, and fumes or airborne particles. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required.

jobs.title: [US-DC] Operational Excellence, Sr. Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Engineer, Operational Excellence

Location: Irving, TX

The Senior Engineer, Operational Excellence is a site-based continuous improvement engineer at our Irving, TX distribution center. You will work side by side with operators and site leadership to find the recurring problems that drive efficiency and quality losses, then solve them with data, lean tools, and DMAIC.

You will be the site leader's go-to for problems and solutions, and will trial new continuous improvement initiatives locally. You will take them to completion and feed what works back to shared resources so it can be standardized across the network.

You Will…

• Monitor site efficiency and quality trends to identify recurring gaps across people, processes, and equipment.

• Lead continuous improvement projects using DMAIC, from project charter through implementation and control, delivering measurable results.

• Own the site's continuous improvement roadmap, project pipeline, and CI tracker.

• Identify problems, establish root causes, and implement sustainable solutions using data and Lean methodologies.

• Partner with site leadership, operators, central engineering, and corporate teams to develop and execute improvement initiatives.

• Support site engineering activities, including slotting, standard headcount, order allocation, AutoCAD updates, SOPs, and success guides.

• Lead and support 5S initiatives, Gemba walks, Kaizen events, and other Lean activities.

• Analyze site performance data and leverage Claude AI to conduct deep dives, develop insights, and build and test tools.

• Coach and mentor operations teams, peers, and teammates on continuous improvement practices.

• Participate in daily production meetings, planning standups, weekly operations reviews, and local area leader meetings.

• Maintain site administrative standards, including visual management, floor layout maps, and material staging.

• Pilot new continuous improvement initiatives locally, measure their success, and share best practices to support standardization across the network.

You Are…

• Operator-first, collaborative, and comfortable working directly alongside frontline operators.

• Data-driven, using facts and measurable results to guide decisions.

• A strong problem solver who focuses on identifying root causes rather than treating symptoms.

• A proactive leader who takes ownership of operational gaps and drives solutions through completion.

• An effective communicator who can influence and collaborate across teams without direct authority.

• Action-oriented, with a bias for moving quickly from identifying problems to implementing solutions.

• A continuous improvement advocate who builds relationships, coaches others, and promotes a culture of operational excellence.

• Adaptable and comfortable navigating both hands-on operational challenges and strategic improvement initiatives.

You Have…

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• At least 5 years of experience in a production or manufacturing environment, with a demonstrated track record of continuous improvement.

• Hands-on experience leading DMAIC or other structured problem-solving initiatives with measurable results.

• Strong project management skills, including project scoping, problem statements, goal setting, and timeline management.

• Working knowledge of Lean tools and methodologies, including:

• Value Stream Mapping

• 5 Whys and Fishbone Diagrams

• 5S and Standard Work

• Statistical Process Control (SPC)

• Pareto Analysis

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
WHY SALESAPE?

 

Join SalesApe, one of the fastest-growing AI companies, recognised as a leader in cutting-edge AI technology and backed by over $20 million from top VCs.

 

We’re at the dawn of a powerful evolution, set to transform society with our tech. Our mission? To tackle inequality by empowering a huge market of non-tech SMBs—93% of all businesses, think construction, automotive, real estate, and more. While the tech industry has compounded its growth with computing power, these businesses have been technically starved.

 

With AI agents and our natural language interface technology, we’re unlocking huge productivity gains for our clients. It’s deeply rewarding to see firsthand the transformation in small businesses as they embrace their agent—not just as a tool, but as a trusted, hard-working member of their team. The emotional bond our clients feel toward their agent is undeniable—they often tell us their ‘Ape’ has become part of the family. Our vision is to become the ‘ brain’ of a business spinning out agent worker, freeing up time and simplifying operations, to ensure humans spend more time in real-life interaction.

If you’re ready for intense, high-energy, meaningful work, come make a real impact with us at SalesApe



OUR VISION, MISSION AND PURPOSE:

 

As we started building with large language models and AI-powered natural language interfaces, I had an aha moment. It hit me just how significant this inflection point is: compute—the raw power of computers—is now accessible to people who don’t use computers."

 

"And when I thought about that, I realized the closest invention humanity has seen to this shift was electricity. When electricity arrived, it didn’t just light up homes—it transformed industries, democratized wealth, and empowered everyone, from factory owners to farmers, to grow and thrive. Today, with AI, we have the opportunity to do the same for the real economy."

 

"For the last two decades, the tech industry has had an incredible advantage. Computers have been like co-pilots for us, quietly amplifying our productivity and enabling us to grow faster than ever before. But 95% of businesses—builders, plumbers, and real estate agents—have been technically starved. These businesses make up 50% of GDP, five times larger than the entire tech industry, but they’ve never had access to the tools they need to compete."

 

"This is the inequality we’re solving. APE AI is democratizing technology, bringing the power of compute to businesses that have been left behind. And what’s so rewarding is that we’re not just helping faceless corporations—we’re empowering real people. Small business owners who pour their hearts into their work. People whose success directly impacts their families, their communities, and society at large. It’s deeply rewarding to see firsthand the transformation in small businesses as they embrace their agent—not just as a tool, but as a trusted, hard-working member of their team."

 

"For me, this mission is personal. I’ve spent my career building companies that encourage people to connect in real life, to be physically active, and to engage with their communities. This isn’t just about productivity—it’s about health, happiness, and thriving societies. Humans weren’t built to spend their lives staring at screens. We’re wired to interact, to move, to be part of the real world. And what excites me is that Ape AI is helping to make this possible—empowering businesses that create real-world value to thrive at the same pace as the tech giants."

 

"This isn’t just about technology. It’s about fairness. It’s about giving the power of compute to the people who need it most, so they can grow, thrive, and make a difference. That’s our mission, and it’s something we can all be proud of.

The Opportunity

As a Medical Receptionist, you will be the first face a patient or visitor sees when they walk into one of our clinics. Working alongside the clinical team, you will be responsible for greeting patients and visitors, completing patient registration, updating new and existing patient records, collecting payment, and ensuring patients with or without pre-existing reservations are seen in a timely manner.

This is the perfect opportunity for someone who's looking to get their foot in the door at a growing medical company or someone looking to kickstart their career in customer service or the medical field. If you enjoy working with people, staying organized, and are a pro at multi-tasking, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Lead
jobs.description:
Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases. See Yourself at Telix

The Quality Assurance Lead role is an site-based role located in Wilkes Barre, Pennsylvania, reporting to the Quality Director, Manufacturing Expansion & Readiness, with operational relationship to site leadership. Working under the director of the Quality Director, Manufacturing Expansion and Readiness, the role will support the  implementation and maintenance of Quality Systems, procedures, processes, documentation, training, and oversight activities required to transition the site from project execution to routine GMP operations.

This role is on-site 5 days a week in Wilkes-Barre, PA. Only candidates local to the area or seriously willing to relocate will be considered.

Quality Systems and Compliance

• Identify compliance gaps and support implementation of corrective actions and process improvements.

Quality Events and Risk Management

Training, Audits, and Inspection Readiness

• Support internal audits, external audits, and regulatory inspections, including preparation and follow-up activities.

• Review validation documentation, manufacturing records, and QC data within delegated authority.

Batch Review and Continuous Improvement

• Monitor assigned Quality metrics and recommend improvements to compliance, process effectiveness, and operational readiness.

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, biochemistry, life sciences, or related scientific discipline highly preferred

• 5 years of progressive Quality Assurance experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or similarly regulated environment

• Working knowledge of 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, cGMP requirements, and pharmaceutical quality systems

• Experience supporting deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls, internal audits, supplier quality, and validation-document review.

• Experience supporting commissioning, qualification, validation, or operational readiness of a manufacturing facility preferred. Experience using an electronic QMS, preferably MasterControl.

• Ability to work independently within established procedures and escalate significant compliance risks appropriately.

Key Capabilities:

• Commitment to excellence: Take pride in your work and consistently strive for excellence in everything you do

• Results-oriented: Driven to achieve goals and objectives, with a strong focus on delivering measurable results

• Creativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challenges

• Strong communication skills: Able to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, using clear and concise language

• Collaboration: Work effectively as part of a team, actively sharing knowledge and expertise to achieve common goals

• Resilience: Demonstrate the ability to bounce back from setbacks and persevere in the face of challenges

• Inclusive mindset: Demonstrate an understanding and appreciation for diversity, and actively work to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected

• Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, able to adjust to changing priorities, and willing to take on new challenges

• Ethical behavior: Act with integrity and demonstrate a commitment to ethical behavior in all interactions with colleagues and stakeholders

• Continuous learning: Show a commitment to ongoing learning and professional development, continually seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge and skills

At Telix, we believe everyone counts, we strive to be extraordinary, and we pursue our goals with determination and integrity. You will be part of an engaged and supportive group of colleagues who all have a shared purpose: to help people with cancer and rare diseases live longer, better quality lives. Being a Telix employee means being a part of a unique, global, interdisciplinary team working to deliver what's next in precision medicine. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI-native operating system for regulated finance.



Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform.



ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls.



We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2.3 billion valuation by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others.




ENGINEERING AT VALON

Our engineering team powers a modern software ecosystem designed to disrupt one of the most outdated and heavily regulated industries in finance: mortgage servicing. We’ve built the foundation of a scalable platform capable of managing billions in assets with precision and reliability. Now we’re focused on scaling infrastructure, improving developer experience, and building high-leverage systems that support rapid product iteration and long-term business growth. We’re a tight-knit, high-agency group of engineers from Stripe, Jane Street, Meta, and Google, and we aim to do the best work of our lives—together.

Our headquarters are in New York City, with offices in San Francisco. We also fully support remote work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team within Platform Engineering. You’ll work on the foundational infrastructure that powers all of Valon’s products—compute, databases, storage, and networking—ensuring our platform is scalable, secure, and reliable as we grow.

This is a high-impact, high-ownership role. We handle over 100 million background jobs per day and expect to scale more than 10x over the next two years. As our commercial pipeline accelerates and we onboard major enterprise customers, the infrastructure challenges shift from feature delivery to scale, reliability, and supporting novel deployment architectures. You’ll be at the center of that work.




EXAMPLE PROJECTS ON THE ROADMAP:

 - Adopt and operationalize new data stores to support our growth trajectory: Vitess, Clickhouse, Redis.

 - Scale our batch processing control plane for faster component creation and fulfillment.

 - Build production-equivalent sandbox environments for customer testing, demos, and onboarding.

 - Support new deployment models for enterprise customers, including infrastructure configurations that meet the security and data residency requirements of top-tier financial institutions.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, build, and operate core cloud infrastructure across compute, storage, databases, and networking layers.

 - Own and improve the reliability, scalability, and security of Valon’s production systems as we scale to support major enterprise deployments.

 - Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize new infrastructure technologies (e.g., Vitess, Clickhouse, Redis) to meet evolving product and scale requirements.

 - Collaborate with product engineering, platform, and operations teams to define infrastructure solutions that unlock product innovation and operational efficiency.

 - Participate in on-call rotations and incident response, driving improvements to system observability, alerting, and reliability practices.

 - Contribute to architectural decisions and technical strategy for the platform, with an emphasis on pragmatic, well-reasoned trade-offs.

 - Mentor teammates through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.




IDEAL BACKGROUND

 - 3–5 years of professional experience in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or cloud systems.

 - Hands-on experience managing and operating cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure at meaningful scale.

 - Strong working knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar).

 - Experience with distributed systems concepts: networking, storage, load balancing, and database operations.

 - Solid engineering fundamentals—you can write clean, well-tested code and contribute meaningfully to services and tooling, even if infrastructure is your primary domain.

 - A product mindset: you think about how infrastructure decisions impact the teams and products that depend on your work.

 - Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working across teams.

 - Experience in fast-paced, high-growth environments is a plus. Familiarity with regulated industries (fintech, healthcare, etc.) is a bonus but not required.




BENEFITS

 - Compensation: competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity, and 401k plan.

 - Health & well-being: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits.

 - Commuter benefits: pre-tax deductions for public transportation, rideshare services, and parking expenses.

 - Grow together: company-wide orientation, learning & development opportunities, and regular review cycles featuring 360-degree feedback.

 - Play together: quarterly budgets for team and company outings.

 - Generous time off: flexible paid time off, sick days, and 11 company holidays.

 - Baby bonding time: 12 weeks off for both birthing and non-birthing parents, fully paid.
