jobs.title: Operations & Logistics Associate, Arsenal -1
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Operations and Logistics Associate to join our rapidly growing team in Ashville, Ohio. The role of the Operations and Logistics Associate is a critical part of ensuring our hardware gets into our customer’s hands and we can successfully deploy our team to support our customer’s missions.

The Deployments team is responsible for managing the coordination and execution of fielding Anduril’s products and hardware. Working across product, engineering, sales, and account management, Deployment Operations is in charge of coordinating all Logistics and Field Operations. As an Operations and Logistics Associate, you are responsible for delivering hardware and software to our customers in mission critical and logistically challenging environments. This will require a deep understanding of logistics, the ability to work across teams seamlessly, a deep appreciation for details, the capability to work in ambiguous situations, and the curiosity to learn new subject matters quickly. As you execute on deliveries for our customers and team members, you have the unique opportunity to improve and grow our capabilities. You will be tasked to solve exceptional challenges, unblock issues, and establish procedures to make sure our customers missions are successful.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• End-to-end deployment planning and delivery of Anduril hardware and equipment for all deployments, maintenances, and demos.

• Systematically manage forward-deployed inventory to support ongoing customer contracts, sustainment operations, and maintenance activities.

• Responsible for working within systems to mirror physical hardware deployment, maintenance, and reverse logistics.

• Collaborate with supply chain and warehouse partners, business leaders, and external stakeholders to ensure the shipment lifecycle is executed successfully.

• White glove service and ownership of domestic and international shipping of Anduril hardware to end customers.

• Proactively identify, propose, and solve logistical processes and risks.

• Provide feedback to internal stakeholders on how the customer’s needs are met to enable continuous improvement.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 2+ years of experience in a high energy, fast-paced startup or logistics environment

• Ability to work proficiently and stay organized in multiple connecting systems (Oracle ERP, Odoo, Salesforce, JIRA, Slack)

• Basic efficiency in Excel

• Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelors degree

• Leadership experience

• Highly polished communication skills

• Experience collaborating cross functionally working towards a common goal

• Demonstrate ability to prioritize across multiple projects and drive outcomes

US Salary Range

$88,000—$117,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. At Patrianna, you won't just join a team you'll help build it. Ready to be part of something exciting?




THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Onboarding & Training Officer to own and elevate our virtual onboarding experience building programmes that get people up to speed fast and performing at their best from day one.




WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 1. You'll design and quality-check role-specific virtual onboarding programmes (including Customer Support and Player Operations), ensuring every piece of content e-learning, manuals, assessments lands with clarity and impact.

WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT

Patrianna runs lean and moves fast. You won't spend your days navigating bureaucracy or waiting for sign-off you'll have real ownership of work that matters, from day one.

jobs.title: Director, Medical Review
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Dyne Therapeutics is focused on delivering functional improvement for people living with genetically driven neuromuscular diseases. We are developing therapeutics that target muscle and the central nervous system (CNS) to address the root cause of disease. The company is advancing clinical programs for Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) and myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1) as well as preclinical programs for facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD), Pompe disease and multiple DMD mutations. At Dyne, we are on a mission to deliver functional improvement for individuals, families and communities. Learn more at https://www.dyne-tx.com/, and follow us on X, LinkedIn and Facebook.

Role Summary:

The Director, Medical Review is a key member of Medical Information and Review who will work closely within Medical Affairs and other cross-functional departments within the organization. The primary responsibility for this position is to serve as the core medical reviewer on the Medical, Legal, and Regulatory committees to ensure the scientific accuracy, medical integrity, fair balance, and compliance of promotional and non-promotional materials as Dyne advances toward commercialization and launch readiness. As a Director-level leader, this role will help establish and continuously improve medical review standards, processes, and governance, and will serve as a trusted, solutions-oriented partner to Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, and Commercial colleagues. In addition, the Director will provide support for the development and maintenance of Medical Information response documents used to address unsolicited inquiries from healthcare professionals and other stakeholders. The person in this role brings strong scientific judgment, hands-on experience with Medical, Legal, and Regulatory review, and the ability to build scalable, inspection-ready review processes in a fast-paced, matrixed biotech environment.

This role is based in Waltham, MA.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

• Develop and maintain comprehensive medical, scientific, and therapeutic-area expertise across the Dyne product portfolio, with a focus on neuromuscular diseases, to serve as the Medical Review subject matter expert and resource

• Serve as the lead Medical Reviewer within the medical and promotional review processes; applying medical and scientific expertise to evaluate product claims, clinical data, safety information, and supporting references, ensuring communications are evidence-based, fair-balanced, compliant, and appropriate for their intended audience and purpose

• Provide medical rationale and actionable recommendations to address review comments

• Serve as the escalation point and subject matter expert for complex review issues, providing guidance to cross-functional colleagues on review standards, expectations, and best practices

• Work closely with coordinator, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, and Commercial internal stakeholders to facilitate timely and effective promotional and non-promotional reviews.

• Support Medical Information and Review readiness for product launches and contribute to the ongoing support and strategic management across all stages of the product lifecycle.

• Analyze reports and metrics for medical activities and communicate insights to internal stakeholders to guide strategic planning and execution

• Support and participate in congress activities, as needed, including execution of pre- and post- congress deliverables, insights gathering, and booth representation

• Ensure adherence to internal review standards, SOPs, and applicable regulatory and industry requirements, and maintain inspection-ready documentation

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of medical review processes, templates, standards, and training to increase quality, consistency, and efficiency as Dyne scales toward launch

• Provide backup support for the development and maintenance of Medical Information response documents addressing unsolicited inquiries from healthcare professionals and other stakeholders

• Contribute to initiatives led by cross-functional colleagues to advance key organizational initiatives

Education and Skills Requirements:

• Doctorate degree (MD, PhD, PharmD) in related field

• 10+ years of experience in serving as a medical reviewer on Medical, Legal, and Regulatory committees and/or in Medical Information. Neuromuscular disease experience preferred but not required.

• High attention to detail, sound judgment, and commitment to compliance, scientific integrity, and Dyne's mission and values

• Must possess a thorough understanding of FDA regulations, laws and regulations governing promotional and non-promotional assets along with other relevant guidelines and industry codes (e.g., FDA/OPDP guidance, PhRMA Code) applicable to the pharmaceutical industry and its stakeholders

• Excellent scientific writing, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build trusted relationships across functions

• Strong project management, organizational, and process-building capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and improve ways of working

• Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, fast-paced biotech environment

• Well versed in conducting medical publication searches and literature reviews

• Ability to critically evaluate clinical and statistical data and supporting references to substantiate promotional and non-promotional claims

• Experience supporting launch readiness and building or scaling medical review processes in a biotech or pre-commercial-to-commercial environment preferred

• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time, including scientific congresses and internal meetings as needed

jobs.title: Senior EPM Analyst
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Strategic Financial Operations & Data Systems team serves as the backbone of our financial integrity, ensuring the foundational systems are in place that drive business outcomes. We are technical architects continually solving scalability problems, implementing automation and engineering best practices to replace manual work, and leading complex cross-functional integrations. Our mandate is to transform data into a reliable, high-quality information ecosystem that supports both the strategic needs of our finance division and the rapid, data-driven decisions of our technical and business stakeholders. Join us at a pivotal moment as we scale our financial infrastructure to support hyper-growth and strategic expansion.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Mid-Level Oracle EPM Analyst, you will serve as a hands-on functional and technical contributor across Oracle EPM Cloud modules including Enterprise Planning and Budgeting (EPBCS), Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS), Account Reconciliation (ARCS), Enterprise Data Management (EDMCS), Narrative Reporting, and Profitability and Cost Management. Your core focus areas will be Planning and Consolidations processes, with significant responsibilities in dimension and metadata management, financial and management reporting, and data exchange and integration. You will collaborate closely with finance stakeholders, IT partners, and external consultants to support month-end close, annual budgeting, long-range planning, and ad-hoc analysis cycles.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Planning (EPBCS)

• Design, build, and maintain planning applications including operating expense plans, revenue forecasts, workforce planning, and capital budgets.

• Develop and optimize business rules (Groovy and calculation scripts) to support allocation logic, driver-based models, and rolling forecasts.

• Configure data forms, task lists, approval workflows, and Smart View templates to streamline the budgeting and forecasting process for end users.

• Partner with FP&A business leads to gather requirements and translate them into scalable application design.

• Consolidations (FCCS)

• Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial consolidation cycle including intercompany eliminations, currency translation, ownership adjustments, and journal processing.

• Maintain and troubleshoot consolidation rules, configurable calculations, and equity pickup logic.

• Collaborate with Corporate Accounting to ensure accurate statutory and management consolidations in line with US GAAP or IFRS requirements.

• Assist with close-process automation using FCCS task manager and supplemental data collection.

• Account Reconciliation (ARCS)

• Administer reconciliation profiles, matching rules, and transaction-matching configurations to support balance sheet substantiation.

• Work with accounting teams to onboard new reconciliations and continuously improve automation rates.

• Dimension & Metadata Management

• Serve as a steward of the enterprise dimension library across EPM Cloud applications, ensuring consistency of Entity, Account, Currency, Custom dimensions, and Smart Lists.

• Manage metadata load files, hierarchies, and attribute mappings; perform impact analysis before structural changes are promoted to production.

• Leverage Enterprise Data Management Cloud Service (EDMCS) for governance workflows, change requests, viewpoints, and cross-application metadata synchronization.

• Maintain naming conventions, documentation, and metadata standards in alignment with the broader data governance framework.

• Data Exchange & Integration

• Design and manage data integration jobs using EPM Automate, Data Management (FDMEE / Data Integration), REST APIs, and flat-file interfaces to load actuals, budgets, rates, and reference data.

• Build and maintain inbound and outbound data mappings, transformation rules, and validation checks between EPM Cloud and source systems (ERP, HCM, data warehouse).

• Monitor integration health, troubleshoot load failures, and implement exception-handling and reconciliation controls.

• Automate recurring data workflows using EPM Automate scripts and scheduling tools to reduce manual intervention during close and planning cycles.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3-5 years of experience in EPM system administration, development, or analysis, within a fast-paced environment.

• Foundational expertise with Planning within the Oracle Cloud EPM suite (PBCS, FCCS, ARCS)

• Ability to operate with limited oversight on assigned tasks and seek guidance on more complex issues or strategies.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.

• A solid understanding of core financial concepts (e.g., budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, general ledger).

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with finance and technical stakeholders.

• Appreciation for and adherence to engineering best practices, such as version control, audit-ability, and scalability.

• Must be authorized to work in the United States.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with ERP systems (e.g., Oracle Fusion) or other finance-related applications.

• Familiarity with data visualization tools or self-service analytics platforms (e.g., Palantir Foundry).

• Exposure to scripting languages (e.g., SQL) for data extraction, transformation, and loading.

US Salary Range

$147,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Overview:
At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.


Position Summary
In this role, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work in your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.
As a Senior Sales Operations Analyst, you will have the opportunity to act as a strategic and analytical partner to Sales and Executive Leadership, turning complex business data into actionable insights that inform go-to-market strategy, improve sales performance, and support revenue growth. You will play a key role in developing and maintaining sales reporting, evaluating business performance, supporting strategic planning initiatives, and identifying opportunities to improve go-to-market effectiveness. 
Beyond delivering accurate and timely reporting, you will proactively investigate business trends, evaluate strategic opportunities, and develop data-driven recommendations that influence decision-making. Working closely with Sales Leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, you will combine strong analytical capabilities with commercial acumen to help shape and measure initiatives that drive business performance.
You'll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.
How You’ll Contribute
In this role, you will have the opportunity to…
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve sales performance reporting and dashboards, providing accurate, timely visibility into pipeline health, forecast performance, bookings, sales productivity, and other key performance indicators.
Perform quantitative and qualitative analyses to evaluate business performance and inform strategic decisions, including market segmentation, market opportunity assessment, competitive trends, sales productivity, and go-to-market effectiveness.
Serve as an analytical partner to Sales Leadership, proactively identifying performance trends, investigating business challenges, and translating complex data into actionable insights and recommendations.
Support sales forecasting processes through pipeline analysis, historical performance trends, forecast modeling, and identification of risks and opportunities to improve forecast accuracy and predictability.
Develop analytical and financial models to evaluate strategic initiatives, including customer acquisition and retention opportunities, market and customer segmentation, sales capacity, territory design, and go-to-market investments.
Support annual and ongoing sales planning activities, including quota planning, territory alignment, capacity modeling, and sales compensation analysis, providing data-driven recommendations to inform leadership decisions.
Partner with Sales Leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate strategic initiatives, define success metrics, measure outcomes, and recommend adjustments to improve business performance.
Prepare clear, compelling reports, presentations, and strategic analyses for Sales and Executive Leadership, including contributions to quarterly business reviews, annual planning, and board reporting.
Define, standardize, and monitor key sales performance indicators, ensuring consistent reporting definitions, reliable data, and accessible business insights.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and analytical processes, leveraging business intelligence tools, AI, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency and scalability.
What Success Looks Like
Within 3 Months: Develop a strong understanding of Panopto’s business model, go-to-market strategy, sales processes, and key performance indicators. Build relationships with Sales Leaderships and cross-functional stakeholders, assess existing reporting and analytical capabilities, and identify initial opportunities to improve business visibility and decision support.
Within 6 Months: Establish reliable, actionable reporting that provides leadership with clear visibility into sales performance, pipeline health, and business trends. Deliver meaningful analyses and recommendations that inform sales planning, strategic priorities, and opportunities for improved go-to-market effectiveness.
Within 1 Year: Become a trusted analytical and strategic partner to Sales Leadership, proactively identifying growth opportunities, diagnosing performance challenges, and influencing go-to-market decisions through data-driven insights. Demonstrate measurable improvements in reporting efficiency, analytical capabilities, and the organization’s ability to evaluate and execute strategic initiatives.
Your Legacy: You built a trusted foundation of data, sales analytics and strategic insights that enables Panopto’s leaders to make better decisions, identify opportunities for growth, and continuously improve go-to-market performance. Your work helped transform data into a competitive advantage and established a culture of proactive, insight-driven decision-making.
Values in Action
Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.
Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.
Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.
Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.
Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.
How We Thrive
The Sales Operations team acts as a strategic partner to Panopto’s Executive, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Legal, Product and Finance teams through the ownership of process optimization, sales technology, analytics, and operational strategy across revenue-generating departments. The team’s focus is on aligning operations across the customer lifecycle to drive growth through operational excellence, actionable insights, and data-driven decision-making.
The Foundation for Success
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related field.
4-8+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, or FP&A within a B2B SaaS company.
Demonstrated experience developing sales performance reporting, analytical models, and business insights that inform operational and strategic decisions.
Strong proficiency in Salesforce CRM, including opportunity and pipeline data, reporting, dashboards, and common sales data structures.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, financial modeling, and scenario analysis.
Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Strong understanding of B2B SaaS sales processes, forecasting methodologies, sales performance metrics, and go-to-market strategies.
Demonstrated ability to perform complex quantitative and qualitative analyses, evaluate business opportunities, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to identify trends, investigate root causes, and synthesize complex information.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to develop compelling narratives and communicate insights effectively to Sales and Executive Leadership.
Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
What Sets You Apart
Experience supporting go-to-market strategy initiatives, including market segmentation, territory planning, sales capacity modeling, or customer acquisition and retention analysis.
Experience developing financial or scenario models to evaluate strategic investments, resource allocation, or growth opportunities.
Proficiency in SQL or other data querying tools to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets.
Experience supporting annual sales planning, quota development, or sales compensation modeling.
Experience using technology and AI to automate reporting, transform data, or develop automated workflows.
Experience working with buyers in the Education market is a plus.
Total Rewards
The salary range for this position is $115,000 - $125,000 USD per year. This position is also eligible for a bonus as part of the compensation package. 
Base pay offered may vary depending on various factors, including, but not limited to: job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other eligibility factors such as geographic location. The Total Rewards package includes competitive base pay and an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs such as health insurance, flexible spending accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. At Panopto, we know that great people make an organization great. We value our people and offer employees benefits that are market competitive for our industry. Learn more about what working at Panopto can mean for you.
At Panopto, our commitment to pay equity and transparency is unwavering. We do not engage in salary negotiations beyond the established range to maintain fairness and prevent potential pay disparities among team members based on negotiation strategies.

Our Deal Desk Analyst II helps OpenSpace’s Sales team move customer transactions forward through accurate quoting, order-form preparation, approval coordination, and responsive commercial support. The analyst works directly with sellers and cross-functional partners to understand the real issue behind a request, communicate requirements clearly, and resolve routine problems using established processes and approved contract language. This role is suited to a detail-oriented, collaborative professional who already knows how to work in Salesforce and a CPQ/order-form workflow and is motivated to develop deeper skills in commercial contracting and deal execution.

What you will be doing:

• Create, review, and process quotes and customer order forms using Salesforce and CPQ, ensuring accuracy in products, pricing, commercial details, approvals, and supporting documentation.

• Work directly with Sales to clarify deal requests, ask effective questions, identify the underlying problem, and accurately communicate requirements to Finance, Legal, Accounting, and other partners.

• Apply documented deal processes, approval rules, standard commercial terms, and authorized contract fallbacks; recognize when a request falls outside approved guidance and escalate appropriately.

• Support basic commercial contracting activities, including adding approved legal language or notes to order forms, reviewing routine customer requests, and preparing clear summaries of non-standard issues for review.

• Manage assigned Deal Desk tickets and requests through resolution; follow up proactively, keep stakeholders informed, and avoid unnecessary handoffs or repeated clarification cycles.

• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve quoting, order processing, provisioning, billing, and other transaction-related issues.

• Maintain complete and accurate records of quotes, approvals, exceptions, and decisions in the relevant systems.

• Identify recurring friction in workflows, contribute to process documentation and improvements, and actively learn additional commercial and contracting responsibilities over time.

What we are looking for:

• 2+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, order management, commercial operations, or a closely related role.

• Hands-on experience creating customer quotes or order forms in Salesforce and a CPQ solution (Salesforce CPQ or comparable system) strongly preferred; candidates with equivalent order-form systems experience may be considered.

• Experience operating within documented approval processes and coordinating work across Sales and internal business partners.

• B2B SaaS or similar recurring-revenue commercial environment preferred.

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

• Working knowledge of Salesforce and CPQ/order-form workflows, with an understanding of how quotes become customer-ready commercial documents.

• Excellent active listening and verbal communication; able to restate a seller’s or customer’s issue accurately and convey it without distortion to the people who can solve it.

• Comfort initiating real-time conversations by phone or video rather than relying exclusively on written messages or ticket handoffs.

• Strong attention to detail, process discipline, follow-through, and ability to handle multiple time-sensitive requests.

• Ability to distinguish standard requests from genuine exceptions, use known solutions independently, and escalate unfamiliar issues with complete context.

• Curiosity, coachability, and demonstrated willingness to learn commercial contracts, approved fallbacks, and increasingly complex deal scenarios.

• Familiarity with basic SaaS order-form language, contract terms, or approved redlines is preferred but not required.

• Experience with ticketing systems, spreadsheets, and cross-functional transaction support is helpful.

Under the direct supervision of a Maryland-licensed pharmacist and in coordination with other technicians, the Pharmacy Technician performs various support activities and duties within the Pharmacy Department by assisting in the timely preparation, packaging, distribution and delivery of medications. This includes, but is not limited to, timely preparation of medications for pharmacist check, workflow SOPs executed within established time constraints, use of appropriate medical terms and abbreviations, patient confidentiality, and punctuality and attendance requirements.

Generates and accurately interprets reports from the primary hospital information system and other computer-based technology. There is a reasonable expectation that employees in this position will be exposed to blood-borne pathogens.

color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

jobs.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars—but we’re not car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own mom. Period. That’s why every vehicle goes through Carvana’s  process, where it’s inspected, perfected, and prepared to meet our high standards before it ever reaches you. And now, we’re bringing those same values to our new car dealerships—delivering quality, trust, and care you’d be proud to share with Mom.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

About the team and position

The Manager, Parts (Central) is a central analytics and strategy role responsible for managing the parts business across all 7 sites, as well as supporting parts needs for Carvana inspection centers (ICs) as part of the broader Fixed Ops supply chain. This role owns the high-level inventory management strategy, ordering algorithms, stocking levels, pricing, returns, and network-wide vendor relationships. Success in this role is distinct from the on-site Parts Lead, who manages the physical flow of parts at each individual location.

What you’ll be doing

• Own parts inventory strategy across the network—determine what to stock, where, and in what quantities.

• Manage ordering processes, reorder points, and stocking levels to maximize parts availability while minimizing carrying cost and obsolescence.

• Set and manage parts pricing in coordination with the Strategy & Analytics Sr. Manager.

• Manage vendor relationships—negotiate pricing, evaluate supplier performance, and ensure a reliable supply chain.

• Own the central parts returns process to minimize dead stock and maximize financial recovery on unused parts.

• Support IC (inspection center) parts needs as part of the broader Fixed Ops supply chain network.

• Analyze parts attach rates, gross margin by category, and shrinkage to systematically identify and execute opportunities to improve.

• Provide strategic guidance and best practices to on-site Parts Leads regarding stocking optimization and process compliance.

What you should have

• Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in supply chain, central inventory management, analytics, or strategy roles (automotive or parts industry experience highly preferred).

• Exceptional analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills, with experience managing inventory algorithms and complex datasets.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate corporate strategy into execution and provide guidance to site leadership.

• Proven capability in managing vendor relationships, evaluating supplier performance, and managing commercial negotiations.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment while maintaining alignment across network operations.

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time Position with a competitive salary

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401K with company match

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally

• Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization

• A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development

• A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English

• Must be at least 18 years of age

• Must have a valid driver's license

• A clean driving record with no more than two moving violations or DUI’s in the last three years

• Work both inside and outside in heat/cold, wet/humid, and dry/arid conditions

• Use personal protective equipment to prevent exposure to hazardous materials

• May be requested to work overtime and weekends for special programs and events.

• Frequent standing and sitting with varying periods of each

• Lift up to 40 pounds frequently

• Walk up to three miles each day

jobs.title: Branch Member Advocate
jobs.description:
Hourly Pay Range: $22.79 - $25.07, depending on experience

We offer a pay-for-performance compensation program including bonuses for all employees and a competitive benefits package. See https://www.cuofco.org/careers for a high-level overview of our benefits package and bonus offerings.

Remote Eligible: No

General Purpose of the Position

This role delivers exceptional service by leveraging in-depth knowledge of Credit Union of Colorado’s products to offer the best solutions for members. Compassionate and approachable, the Member Advocate builds trust, connects with people, and enhances the member experience. This role requires knowledge in deposit accounts, consumer and mortgage loans, and self-service products. Advocating for members, they take ownership of each interaction, ensuring confidence in the solutions provided. The Member Advocate consistently upholds the credit union’s Core Values and Service expectations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Member Service:

• Build rapport, identify member needs and recommend appropriate financial services, such as share accounts, loans, credit cards, digital banking and investment services. Demonstrate our “Here to help” and “Honestly Good” culture.

• Open and maintain deposit accounts, including checking, savings, certificates of deposit, and IRAs.

• Assist members with loan applications, providing guidance on requirements and next steps.

• Cross-identify credit union products and services to enhance overall member experience.

• Assist members with routine financial transactions, including deposits, withdrawals, loan payments, wire transfers, check cashing, and other services.

• Educate members on digital banking services and help with online and mobile banking enrollment.

• Provide account maintenance services such as updating personal information, processing account disputes, ordering checks, and card issuance.

Relationship Building:

• Work seamlessly with branches and support teams to deliver the best solutions for members.

• Take ownership of personal and professional growth through training, collaboration, and teamwork while supporting coworkers in their learning.

Operational Support:

• Assist with branch opening and closing procedures.

• Balance cash drawers and ensure accurate end-of-day settlements.

• Support the branch team by meeting or exceeding scorecard expectations through exceptional member service, accuracy, and member-centric behaviors. Handle account maintenance, including audits and product add-ons.

• Flexibly take on diverse roles and responsibilities as needed.

Compliance & Risk Management:

• Verify member identification and transactions to prevent fraud and financial crimes.

• Comply with NCUA requirements by registering and maintaining active Mortgage Loan Originator status per the SAFE Act.

• Obtain and maintain Membership Officer and actively serve as a Notary Public.

• Ensure compliance with all applicable federal and state regulations, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), OFAC, Fair and Accurate Credit Transactions Act (FACTA), and Anti-Money Laundering Act, while actively monitoring for illegal activity related to this role.

• May perform other duties as requested or assigned.

Requirements

Must Haves:

• Ability to communicate and connect effectively

• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with other administrative officials and the public.

• Ability to apply interpersonal skills that develop member confidence, respect and trust in Credit Union of Colorado and develop cooperative relationships with all levels of people throughout the organization.

• Ability to operate related computer applications and business equipment.

• Ability to exercise good judgment and discretion in applying and interpreting credit union policies and procedures.

• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.

• Typing and data entry; 10-key calculator.

• Ability to inspire trust and confidence from their teams, peers, and organization

Nice-to-Haves:

• Related experience working in a financial retail environment

• Direct retail sales experience and cash handling

• Demonstrated analytical, accuracy, and problem-solving skills within a work environment.

• Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel Outlook, Symitar and DocuSign systems a plus.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or general education degree (GED).

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is typically required to remain stationary for long periods and is occasionally required to lift/move or transport up to 10 pounds. Employee will need to occasionally move about inside an office to access files, mail, office machinery, etc. and constantly operates a computer and other office equipment, such as a phone, copier/printer, etc.  Will need to position self to maintain computers, including under desks and in the server closet. Employee will frequently communicate with members and co-workers and must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. Employee will travel to visit CU location as needed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Core Competencies

Every position at Credit Union of Colorado is grounded in our organizational Core Values and Core Competencies. These skills and behaviors guide how we work, collaborate, and deliver results. Click here to view our Core Values and Core Competencies on Atlas.

Credit Union of Colorado is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Please note applicants can redact any information that identifies their age, birth date, or dates of schooling on either their resume or any additional materials provided.

jobs.title: Senior Operations & Logistics Associate, Arsenal-1
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Deployments team manages the coordination and execution of fielding Anduril's hardware and software products worldwide. Working across Product, Engineering, Growth, Business Development, Technical Operations, and Mission Operations, Deployments oversees forward logistics, site installation, maintenance & repairs, field inventory management, sustainment and reverse logistics. The team is central to ensuring effective customer and mission success, shaping the future of Anduril's defense solutions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Operations & Logistics Associate to join our rapidly growing team. As Senior Operations & Logistics, you are the dependable backbone of deployment execution. You don't just follow processes, you understand why they exist and how to adapt them. You will manage multiple simultaneous deployments across product lines, juggling competing priorities without dropping the ball.

This role requires a proactive operator who thrives in ambiguity, someone who can coordinate logistics across business lines while continuously identifying what can work better. You will deliver hardware and software to our customers in mission-critical and logistically challenging environments, requiring a deep understanding of logistics, the ability to work across teams seamlessly, a deep appreciation for details, and the curiosity to learn new subject matters quickly. As you execute on deliveries, you will have the opportunity to improve and grow our capabilities by developing standards, procedures, and process improvements for Deployment Operations.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own end-to-end deployment execution across multiple product lines, from logistics planning and hardware allocation through delivery, sustainment, and reverse logistics. Manage multifaceted domestic and international logistics with increasing complexity and minimal oversight. Work deployments issues via coordination with teams across the company and in different locations.

• Systematically manage forward-deployed inventory to support ongoing customer contracts, sustainment operations, and maintenance activities. Ensure physical hardware status is accurately mirrored within systems (Oracle ERP, Odoo, Salesforce).

• Collaborate cross-functionally across Anduril and externally with customers and key stakeholders to successfully execute the logistics movements of all deployments - both domestic and international. Build productive working relationships with Product, Engineering, Growth, Technical Operations, and warehouse partners.

• Deliver white glove service for domestic and international shipping of Anduril hardware to end customers. Confirm import/export and dangerous goods compliance independently. Know international logistics procedures including customs compliance and duties.

• Proactively identify, propose, and implement improvements to logistical processes, standards, and procedures for Deployment Operations. Develop solutions that reduce risk, increase efficiency, and scale with the organization. Understand and resolve risk factors for product deployments in new operating environments.

• Communicate effectively to keep internal and external teams informed at all times. Use the necessary tools (JIRA, Oracle ERP) and channels (Slack, email, meetings) to ensure stakeholders understand what needs to be accomplished and when. Provide feedback to internal stakeholders on how customer needs are met to enable continuous improvement.

• Mentor and lead junior associates by example, showing what 'good' looks like in deployment execution. Provide guidance on logistics fundamentals, compliance, and operational best practices. Help develop the next generation of Deployment Operations talent. Keep leadership informed and ahead of decisions, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early rather than escalating after the fact.

• Problem solve and remove obstacles for the team and internal and external partners. Think critically, engage the right teams, and drive solutions in ambiguous, fast-paced situations. No task is too small, be willing to roll up your sleeves and get the job done.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of experience leading domestic and international logistics, including complex and quick-turnaround shipping scenarios, via commercial air (preferably to and from UK, Europe, Asia, and/or the Middle East)

• Experience in supply chain operations or deployment operations

• Experience in and appreciation for working in a high-energy, fast-paced environment

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple simultaneous deployments/projects and prioritize across competing projects to drive outcomes

• Hands-on experience working with hardware products and bills of materials (BOMs), with a working understanding of core manufacturing processes

• Ability to work proficiently and stay organized in multiple connecting systems (Oracle ERP, Odoo, Salesforce, JIRA, Slack)

• Experience with ERP systems in a logistics or operations context

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional efforts and influence stakeholders without direct authority, driving alignment and outcomes across teams

• Background mentoring or training junior team members

• Highly polished communication skills with the ability to convey concepts and deployment status to diverse stakeholders

• Track record of identifying process improvements and implementing operational solutions Track record of building operational processes from scratch (0→1) and scaling existing ones through periods of rapid growth (1→10), without relying on an existing playbook

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional efforts and influence stakeholders without direct authority, including working constructively through blockers and difficult stakeholders to protect critical deliverables

• Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field

• Experience shipping to/from UK, Europe, Asia, and/or the Middle East

• Experience in a defense, manufacturing, or hardware deployment environment, combined with experience in a commercial shipping environment focused on air transport (e.g., freight forwarding)

• Familiarity with military logistics requirements, government programs, or DoD operations

• Experience with import/export compliance, dangerous goods shipping, and customs regulations

• Experience with forward-deployed inventory management and reverse logistics

US Salary Range

$117,000—$154,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Classified Platform Engineer to design and build the platform services and user-facing applications that make multi-level classified computing possible: a virtual desktop and application broker, a policy-enforcing storage gateway, and the administrative interfaces for our access control platform. You will own them end to end, from architecture through the DevSecOps pipeline that delivers them into accredited, fully air-gapped environments, working alongside Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, and Infrastructure Engineering.
This is a hands-on engineering role with deep technical ownership. The constraints are unusual: everything ships into fully air-gapped, accredited environments, which means offline builds, vendor dependencies, and a pipeline that produces the evidence our accreditations require.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Design and build production web applications in React, GO and Rust that operate fully air-gapped inside accredited classified environments.

• Develop and work with S3 storage APIs and policies.

• Build the administrative and operator interfaces for our access control platform, and design the relational and distributed datastores behind authorization decisions, audit records, and application state.

• Own the DevSecOps path to production: containerize and deploy to Kubernetes through GitOps CI/CD pipelines that scan, sign, and produce the evidence our accreditations require.

• Partner with Cybersecurity, Program Management, and business line stakeholders to capture requirements and translate them into a technical plan delivered on time and on budget.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Professional experience building and shipping production web applications with React, or a comparable modern front-end framework, and TypeScript, including interfaces for complex domains where operator workflow matters.

• Professional experience developing backend services in Go.

• Experience designing and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or CockroachDB, including schema design, migrations, and query performance.

• Experience with containerization and container orchestration (Podman or Docker, and Kubernetes), and with GitOps and Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines in an Agile development process.

• Knowledge and experience with Linux Operating Systems (OS) such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu.

• Experience communicating clearly in design documents, tradeoff analyses, and decision records a peer can pick up and act on.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain a US Top Secret Clearance with customer's approval. May be required to obtain and maintain a DoD 8140/8570 qualifying certification.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with virtual desktop infrastructure or application and desktop brokering (e.g. Citrix, Omnissa/VMware Horizon, Leostream, Apache Guacamole, Kasm), and with virtualization orchestrated through Kubernetes such as KubeVirt.

• Experience implementing authorization systems (RBAC, ABAC, or relationship-based models), integrating applications against an external policy decision point, and Policy as Code (PaC) tools such as OPA, Oso, Cedar, or Kyverno.

• Experience with S3-compatible object storage APIs, POSIX filesystem semantics, or FUSE.

• Experience building software for air-gapped or network-isolated environments, including dependency vendoring and offline builds.

• Experience with DevSecOps supply-chain security practices including SBOM generation, artifact signing, and provenance attestation.

• Proficiency with core security concepts including encryption, authentication, identity and access management, and Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA), plus an understanding of NIST SP 800-53 controls and their technical implementation.

• Experience with observability tooling: structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing.

jobs.title: Territory Manager (NC, Fayetteville)
jobs.description:
Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is one of the fastest-growing startups in the healthcare industry, working tirelessly to connect people everywhere to life-saving mental health treatment. Our Outreach team members are the lifeblood of our business; they know our product, partners, and patients better than anyone. In this role, you’ll be joining a team of passionate professionals who are dedicated wholeheartedly to our mission.

You’ll build relationships with clinical partners in your local community and provide much-needed resources to thousands of people struggling with their mental health. You'll be a champion of Charlie Health and ensure that every possible patient, parent, and provider can access our programs. While this work can be challenging, we set the bar high knowing that every decision we make directly impacts our communities.

In your role, you’ll have unparalleled responsibility while collaborating with sharp, spirited, and ambitious coworkers, with room for everyone to excel and grow in their careers. You’ll also receive competitive benefits, ensuring you have the resources to thrive both personally and professionally.

At Charlie Health, we believe in leading with our “why” and connecting with our purpose every day. Join us to find not only a career but a calling.

Responsibilities

• Develop and operationalize GTM strategy for efficient new market penetration

• Create, build, and manage relationships with referral sources across priority markets

• Go in the field 4 - 5 days/week to lead meetings with patients, parents, and providers to uncover needs, address barriers to treatment, and cement community partnerships

• Design strategies to better support and engage referral partners across different channels

• Deepen Charlie Health’s penetration across existing partnerships

• Attend and lead various educational meetings, marketing presentations, and networking events both in person and via conference call

• Synthesize and share market feedback from partners, patients, and stakeholders to inform go-forward marketing and product strategies

• Work closely with internal partners including marketing, product, client success, and legal to deliver on GTM goals

Requirements

• Must be based in Fayetteville, NC

• Must be fluent in English

• You have 1-4 years proven sales experience - owning & overachieving KPIs is a plus

• Experience working with or selling to healthcare organizations a plus

• Ability to travel locally with reliable transportation & valid drivers license (within ~1 hour driving distance) 4-5 days/week for meetings with potential referral partners

• Ability to energize, advise & persuade senior corporate personnel

• Strong interpersonal, relationship-building and listening skills, with a natural, consultative style

• Strong project management skills, with a demonstrable ability to corral and manage details in a fast-paced, fluid environment

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer, PCBA, Computer Engineering (Starlink)

• Experience commissioning equipment onto a production network, including IP addressing, VLANs, and time sync

• Experience partnering with software teams on an MES or equipment-host interface

• Demonstrated ability to gather, analyze, and use data to drive systemic improvements

jobs.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars, but we are not salespeople. We have made it our mission to create a hassle-free way for people to buy and sell cars. We saw a huge problem with how much of a headache it is to buy a car the traditional way, so we committed ourselves to put customer satisfaction at the core of our business, we have built a no-pressure, no-haggle online car buying experience that saves our customers time and money. Customers can search through thousands of vehicles online, see full 360-degree views of both the interior and exterior of the vehicles before deciding to go through the purchasing process. Our Customer Advocates will then either deliver the purchased vehicle to our customer’s driveway using one of our kick-ass one car haulers, or they will meet our customers at one of our amazing coin-operated Vending Machines.

For more information on Carvana and our mission, sneak a peek at our company introduction video.

About the team and position

Carvana’s Market Operation department is known for its team-oriented, fast-paced environment. We hire bright people who are willing to roll up their sleeves, step in wherever needed, mentor and develop team members, and assume additional responsibilities as needed while juggling multiple projects. Don’t forget to bring your personality! We thrive from each unique perspective. Our strength is in our diversity of opinions.

Job Description

The Team Lead, in our Market Operations group, is responsible for running the local Carvana hub and everything that comes with it, including (but not limited to); market launch, operations, logistics, consumer branding, team engagement and effectiveness and, of course, the market’s ongoing success. We are looking for someone who is a big picture thinker with the ability to manage the employee and customer experience. A Team Lead not only crushes daily operations, but they have the savvy to assess business trends and proactively create solutions to potential roadblocks. We need a strong people leader, as a Team Lead works closely with a team of extremely talented Customer Advocates and is responsible for providing vision and development opportunities.

What you’ll be Doing

• Help interview, select, onboard and train a team of Customer Advocates and provide the tools, resources and guidance they need to be successful. Employee development is an essential part of this role.

• Actively develop a team of Customer Advocates by providing feedback, conducting performance check-ins, and setting goals to improve performance and skill set.

• Recognize and reinforce individual and team accomplishments by using existing organizational tools and programs as well as by finding new, creative and effective methods of recognition.

• Generate and monitor regular reports like a boss and presenting to upper management… also like a boss.

• Be the go to expert for your team. You’re always ready to jump in alongside an Advocate to wash cars or jump into our kick-ass single-car hauler and deliver cars to our customers while providing a stellar customer experience.

• Drive production in a fast-paced customer service environment and keep every detail of your market operating like a well oiled machine

• Actively look for ways to improve the overall customer and Advocate team experience.

• Address and effectively manage complex and sensitive customer-facing issues.

What you should have

• 5+ years work experience in a customer facing team environment

• 3+ years of management experience

• Proven history of developing and coaching employees

• Prior experience with strategic planning, process improvement, and guiding teams to exceed goals

• Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills

• Ability to diagnose and solve problems with varying complexity while maintaining focus on the customer experience

• Willingness to work on weekends

• Enthusiasm and energy to contribute to and thrive in a rapidly growing start-up atmosphere where roles continually adapt as the company evolves

It would be great if you also had

• Bachelor’s Degree

• Experience with Salesforce or Tableau

• An analytical mind

• Experience handling logistics

What we’ll offer in return

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401K with company match

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally

• Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization

• Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

• The ability to walk/stand and sustain physical activity for extended periods of time (8+ hours).

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Aerospace Structural Stress & Damage Tolerance Engineer to support advanced structural integrity assessments for aerospace propulsion systems and other highly loaded mechanical structures. This individual will perform detailed stress analysis, fatigue and lifing evaluations, and fracture mechanics assessments to ensure structural components meet demanding performance, durability, and safety requirements.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience with aerospace damage tolerance methodologies, particularly hands-on proficiency with DARWIN, along with strong capabilities in finite element analysis and structural evaluation. This role requires the ability to assess complex loading environments, evaluate crack initiation and growth, interpret analytical results, and develop technically sound recommendations that support engineering design decisions and continued structural reliability.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform structural stress, fatigue, lifing, and damage tolerance assessments for aerospace components, including gas turbine engines, rotating machinery, and propulsion-related structures.

• Utilize DARWIN to conduct aerospace damage tolerance evaluations, including probabilistic fracture mechanics and crack growth assessments.

• Develop and execute finite element analyses to evaluate component behavior under complex operating conditions and loading environments.

• Conduct fracture mechanics investigations, including crack initiation, propagation, residual strength, and structural life predictions.

• Evaluate material behavior, stress concentrations, loading conditions, and operational duty cycles to determine component durability and structural integrity.

• Analyze mission profiles, cyclic loading, and service conditions to establish fatigue life and damage tolerance characteristics.

• Interpret FEA results and stress distributions to identify critical locations, potential failure mechanisms, and structural vulnerabilities.

• Apply established aerospace engineering standards, analytical methodologies, and industry best practices to structural integrity evaluations.

• Collaborate with design, materials, systems, and other engineering teams to resolve structural concerns and provide technical guidance.

• Prepare comprehensive engineering documentation detailing analysis methodologies, assumptions, results, and technical recommendations.

• Present analytical findings and engineering conclusions to technical stakeholders and project leadership.

• Support design reviews, engineering investigations, and continuous improvement initiatives related to component durability and structural performance.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.

• Minimum of 7 years of professional experience in structural analysis, stress engineering, fatigue and lifing, fracture mechanics, or damage tolerance.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience using DARWIN for aerospace damage tolerance assessments.

• Strong understanding of structural mechanics, finite element analysis, fatigue behavior, fracture mechanics, and crack growth principles.

• Experience with Abaqus, DARWIN, or comparable advanced structural analysis and nonlinear FEA tools.

• Background analyzing rotating machinery, gas turbine engines, aerospace propulsion systems, or other structures exposed to significant mechanical and thermal loading.

• Ability to interpret complex stress fields, operational load conditions, mission profiles, and cyclic loading data.

• Experience evaluating crack initiation, crack propagation, residual strength, and component service life.

• Proficiency in developing technical engineering reports and communicating complex analytical findings to multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Experience supporting aerospace engine manufacturers, propulsion development programs, or aircraft structural integrity initiatives.

• Familiarity with probabilistic fracture mechanics and reliability-based damage tolerance methodologies.

• Experience with fatigue crack growth modeling, material characterization, and fracture mechanics databases.

• Knowledge of aerospace regulatory requirements, structural substantiation practices, and industry engineering standards.

• Experience supporting design optimization, root cause investigations, and structural failure assessments.

Salary Range: $100,000-140,000

The actual salary offered is dependent on various factors including, but not limited to, location, the candidate’s combination of job-related knowledge, qualifications, skills, education, training, and experience

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.
