jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At NerdWallet, our mission is to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions so people can move forward with confidence. We’re building a team of exceptional Nerds in an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re encouraged to grow, take smart risks, and be yourself. Whether you work remotely or in an office, we support how you thrive and invest in your well-being, development, and impact.



We're looking for a paid media lead with a history of success in SEM, youtube, and display, to drive customer acquisition across multiple financial services verticals. Experience driving marketing results with Claude or Chat GPT is highly desirable.



This is both a hands-on and strategic role: you'll build the roadmap, launch and optimize campaigns , and partner with analytics, business, creative, and engineering  to continuously drive value for our customers and business. Success here requires strong data/creative/ monetization skills, a high degree of initiative, and a vision for paid marketing tactics and experiences in the age of AI.


This role reports to the Managing Director.




WHERE YOU CAN MAKE AN IMPACT:

Strategy & Campaign Ownership

 - Own paid marketing strategy, execution, and performance across multiple verticals, aligning campaigns to each vertical's growth targets, funnel dynamics, and audience needs

 - Build campaign structures across SEM, youtube, display, Open AI, and other platforms as needed

 - Set objectives, bidding strategy, audience approach, budget allocation, and conversion events per campaign

 - Manage campaigns end-to-end: setup, QA, pacing, troubleshooting, optimization

 - Build testing plans for new verticals, bidding strategies, conversion events, creative angles, and funnel experiences

AI Utilization

 - Use AI tools to enhance and accelerate traditional marketing functions

 - Use AI as your own personal agency - building high quality creative, data insights, and landing pages, etc to overcome blockers and limited resources

 - Combine your own deep understanding of paid marketing with AI tools for novel and innovative purposes.

Optimization & Performance

 - Monitor marketing performance and diagnose CTR, CVR, and Revenue and monetization issues, data/tracking issues, funnel friction, monetization problems, and/or lead quality.

 - Make budget and pacing calls based on performance trends and business priorities

 - Stay current on platform, algorithm, privacy, and ad product changes

Reporting & Stakeholder Communication

 - Own recurring performance reporting — results, trends, learnings, risks, next steps

 - Translate platform performance into business impact for vertical leads and leadership

 - Communicate tracking issues, data discrepancies, and testing results clearly and proactively

Data, Tracking & Measurement

 - Partner with data, analytics, and engineering teams to define measurement needs and map new conversion events

 - Troubleshoot discrepancies between platform and backend data (attribution, event firing, duplicates, timing)

 - Help build measurement frameworks that optimize toward lead quality and business outcomes, not just volume

Creative Strategy

 - Lead creative strategy across verticals: messaging angles, hooks, scripts, static/video/UGC concepts

 - Write creative briefs covering business goal, audience, value prop, and key claims

 - Review assets for clarity and platform fit; give feedback through concept, script, and production stages

 - Build creative testing roadmaps and turn results into next-round recommendations

Landing Page & Funnel Strategy

 - Evaluate landing pages and funnels for message match, conversion flow, and drop-off

 - Recommend and support tests across landing pages, advertorials, lead forms, quizzes, and pre-qualification flows

 - Ensure creative, landing pages, and tracking are aligned before launch

Platform Partnerships & Competitive Research

 - Manage relationships with platform reps; evaluate their recommendations against NerdWallet's goals and data quality

 - Track competitor creative, offers, and funnel approaches; feed insights back into strategy
   
   


YOUR EXPERIENCE:

 - 5+ years of paid search experience, ideally in lead generation.

 - Proven track record of utilizing AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate marketing functions, gain data insights, and optimize creative processes.

 - Forward-thinking vision regarding how and where to market in the age of AI and video, demonstrating the ability to craft tactics for finding consumers as search behaviors shift beyond standard search engines.

 - Demonstrated experience in video marketing, with a track record of driving performance through short-form video content, emerging ad formats, and platforms like YouTube to capture audiences outside of traditional Google Ads.

 - Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Proven track record scaling paid search (7 figures in monthly spend preferred) while maintaining or improving CPA/CAC and ROAS.

 - Experience managing toward lead gen, revenue, ROAS, CPA/CAC, or funnel-based goals.

 - Ability to build paid media strategy from the ground up — structure, testing, measurement, creative, optimization.

 - Strong analytical skills, comfortable with both platform and backend business data.

 - Experience troubleshooting tracking, attribution, or reporting discrepancies.

 - Experience writing creative briefs and giving feedback to creative teams or external partners.

 - Strong project management skills across multiple concurrent verticals and workstreams.

 - Clear, confident communicator who can translate data into recommendations for non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience and success outside of Google or Bing

 - Experience in financial services (insurance, lending, wealth, banking, investing, mortgage, home equity, or other regulated categories)

 - Experience with lead gen funnels, prequalification/quiz flows, marketplace models, or affiliate/partner revenue models

 - Experience optimizing toward backend events — funded loans, booked appointments, matched leads

 - Experience with server-side tracking and conversion signal quality

 - Experience with UGC creative, creator partnerships, or video production workflows

 - Comfort working with legal, compliance, or brand review processes in regulated industries




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

 - Campaigns launch with clean setup, strong creative, accurate tracking, and aligned stakeholders

 - New revenue streams outside of traditional SEM are discovered and scaled

 - Creative & LP testing is structured, insight-driven, and tied to business outcomes

 - Tracking issues are caught early and resolved in partnership with data teams

 - Stakeholders have a clear read on performance, risk, and next steps at all times

 - New verticals have a clear, de-risked path to testing and scaling paid social




WHERE:

 - This role will be remote (based in the U.S.).

 - We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family.




WHAT WE OFFER:

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

 - Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents

 - Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown

 - New Parent Leave for employees with a newborn child or a child placed with them for adoption or foster care

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

 - Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction 

 - Our Nerds love to make an impact by paying it forward – Take 8 hours of volunteer time off per quarter and donate to your favorite causes with a company match

Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people)

 - 401K with 4% company match

VP OF FINANCE

Location: Los Angeles, Detroit, or San Francisco
Employment: Full time, in person
Base salary: $200,000–$350,000 annually

American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company supplying raw metal to frontier American manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to factories faster than the industry thought possible.


THE ROLE

We’re hiring a VP of Finance to lead the financial function behind Nox Metals’ growth. You will own financial planning, accounting, cash management, controls, and the analysis that informs our commercial and operating decisions.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will build a reliable picture of the business, understand what drives our economics, and help the team make sound decisions about inventory, pricing, hiring, equipment, and expansion. You should be equally comfortable reviewing a reconciliation, challenging a forecast, and explaining a capital investment.


YOU WILL

 - Lead accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, and forecasting, with a reliable close and clear ownership.

 - Build visibility into cash, working capital, inventory, customer collections, and supplier commitments.

 - Connect revenue and gross margin to customer mix, material costs, production, freight, and commercial terms.

 - Partner with sales and operations on pricing, capacity, customer economics, and investment decisions.

 - Develop financial models for growth, facility expansion, equipment, and staffing.

 - Establish practical controls and improve inventory accounting, costing, and financial data quality.

 - Manage relationships and workflows with banking, tax, audit, insurance, and external accounting partners.

 - Prepare clear financial reporting for leadership and the board.

 - Build and develop the finance team and improve systems as the company grows.


YOU ARE

 - A finance leader with a strong accounting foundation and a record of owning results in a growing business.

 - Experienced managing cash, forecasting performance, and turning analysis into operating decisions.

 - Comfortable with inventory, working capital, and the economics of a physical business.

 - Rigorous about accuracy and controls, and practical about building processes people can use.

 - Able to explain tradeoffs clearly to colleagues outside finance.

 - Willing to work through details while developing people and setting priorities.


NICE TO HAVE

Experience in manufacturing, distribution, metals, logistics, or another inventory-intensive business. Experience with financing, capital planning, ERP implementation, or building a finance function through rapid growth is also helpful.

jobs.title: Deal Desk Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT LATENT

Latent is the enterprise pharmacy intelligence platform, powered by a clinical agentic engine, that enables health systems to grow their pharmacy operations and serve more patients. One engine works across the pharmacy journey to identify patients who qualify for care, improve medication access, capture eligible prescriptions and support patients throughout treatment.

Latent’s platform enables more than 60+ leading health systems that collectively serve an estimated 70 million people. Founded by Sri Somasundaram and Rishabh Jain, Latent has raised $80 million from Transformation Capital, Spark Capital, Conviction, General Catalyst, Y Combinator, and others.




THE ROLE

As Latent’s first Deal Desk Manager, you’ll help structure, price, negotiate, contract, and renew complex enterprise agreements. You’ll build the commercial guidance and processes that help our team move quickly while keeping deal economics, delivery commitments, and customer outcomes clear. This role is exclusively for do-ers, and people who can create systems once they are successful in the work. You’ll work across Sales, Product, Implementation, Finance, Customer Success, and Legal, operating within approved pricing and legal guardrails.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Manage statements of work, order forms, amendments, approvals, legal reviews, and procurement requirements, ensuring <12 hr SLA for review, and controlling version history.

 - Structure pricing, bundles, ramps, discounts, and negotiation options within agreed concession limits.

 - Validate delivery commitments with Product and Implementation, and coordinate clear handoffs to Finance and Customer Success.

 - Track billing triggers, volume thresholds, contracted expansions, renewals, and opt out deadlines.

 - Build templates, pricing guidance, and approval rules that reduce deal delays and leadership involvement.

 - Coordinate contract reviews with Legal, escalating policy exceptions and legal decisions to the appropriate leaders.

 - Develop return on investment models and business cases with Account Executives, using validated assumptions, customer baselines, scenarios, and agreed success metrics.

 - Partner with Customer Success to measure realized value and prepare value summaries for executive reviews, renewals, and expansions.

 - Capture competitive pricing intelligence to inform go to market pricing and competitive strategy.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Experience in deal desk, commercial operations, sales operations, revenue operations, or enterprise contracting.

 - Strong commercial judgment and comfort with pricing analysis, deal economics, and negotiation tradeoffs.

 - Strong bias towards action with a heightened sense of urgency.

 - Experience creating approval workflows, pricing guidance, contract templates, or renewal processes.

 - Clear communication and strong partnership skills across Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, and customer teams.

 - A practical, detail oriented approach and the ability to bring structure to ambiguous work.

 - Experience with health systems, healthcare technology, or usage based pricing is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Partnerships & Integrations
jobs.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role in a nutshell:

Chainguard is building the most trusted source for open source software. To be that, we have to meet customers and developers where they already work: inside their SDLC, their existing tool stack, and increasingly their agent workflows.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the product strategy and execution for Chainguard's partnerships and integrations. You'll make sure someone can pick up Chainguard and start running within their toolchain on day one, and that Chainguard becomes a keystone in how they build, secure, and deliver software. This is a foundational, high-impact role at the intersection of product, partnerships, and go-to-market. You'll build bridges with the hyperscalers, developer tools, CI/CD systems, registries, security platforms, and AI agent ecosystems our customers depend on. You'll tie every integration to business impact, move with urgency, and lead largely through influence across internal teams and external partners.

What you’ll do:

• Integration roadmap. Own the vision and roadmap for how Chainguard plugs into the customer's software delivery lifecycle, from source and build to registry, deploy, and runtime. Define the problem spaces where integrations unlock the most value, and map every integration to clear business impact: adoption, activation, pipeline, retention, and expansion

• Meeting customers where they are. Make Chainguard seamless to adopt inside the tools developers and platform teams already use, including CI/CD systems, artifact registries, package managers, IDEs, security scanners, and cloud marketplaces. Reduce the time from "first look" to "running in production" by removing friction at every point where Chainguard touches an existing workflow

• Agent & AI workflow integrations. Define how Chainguard shows up in AI-assisted and agentic development workflows, so agents can discover, pull, and use trusted Chainguard artifacts by default. Stay ahead of how these ecosystems evolve and position Chainguard as a natural building block within them

• Partner product engagements. Partner with hyperscalers, developer tool vendors, and technology partners to scope, build, and launch joint integrations. Define clear rules of engagement for each partnership that serve the customer use case today while protecting Chainguard's future product plays. Seek win-win arrangements that create durable value for both sides

• Sales & partner team alignment. Work hand in hand with Sales, Partnerships, Solutions Engineering, and Marketing to prioritize integrations that unblock deals and accelerate adoption. Equip field and partner teams with the positioning, enablement, and feedback loops they need to land and expand with integrations

• Cross-functional leadership. Work closely with Engineering, Design, GTM, and other Product leaders to turn customer, partner, and business needs into a focused roadmap. Make fast, well-reasoned decisions, drive alignment through influence, and clearly convey the impact of the work to internal and external stakeholders

What we're looking for:

• 5+ years of Product Management experience, ideally with developer-facing, platform, infrastructure, or enterprise products

• Experience owning integrations or partner-built product experiences from problem definition through launch and measurable business impact

• Experience working closely with Sales and Partner teams to prioritize, launch, and drive adoption of integrations

• Experience defining rules of engagement with partners on product integrations, balancing customer use cases without eroding future product plays

• Experience working with hyperscalers (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and developer tool ecosystems

• Strong sense of urgency and decisive judgment, with the ability to make sound tradeoffs quickly and with incomplete information

• A win-win mindset in negotiations, with a track record of building partnerships that create value for both sides

• Enjoys working in a high-impact, and collaborative role spanning internal teams and external parties

Bonus points:

• Experience with developer tools, infrastructure, supply chain security, or other highly technical products

• Experience launching products through cloud marketplaces or co-sell motions with hyperscalers

• Background in technology partnerships, business development, or solutions engineering alongside product management

• Experience with B2B products that serve both individual developers and large enterprise customers

• Experience building integration platforms, APIs, or SDKs that partners and customers build on

Base Salary Range

$205,000—$231,000 USD

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

• We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.

• We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.

• We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.

• We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

• Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.

• Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

• 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.

• 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

jobs.title: Electrical Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Electrical Test Engineering team at Anduril develops test systems used to ensure the quality and reliability of our aerial and ground based systems. The team works on air vehicles such as the ALTIUS and develop complex manufacturing test solutions to our internal manufacturing team or contract manufacturers. We work closely and cross-functionally with the rest of our Product Engineering groups that include Electrical, Mechanical and Firmware Engineering to solve and improve our manufacturing process, product quality and reliability.

We are looking to bring on a Electrical Test engineer to design and deliver test systems for Anduril’s electronic products. This person will work with the cross-functional organizations to identify gaps in test coverage and own the design and delivery of the hardware and software test solution. A strong Test Design Engineer will need to have a proven track record of delivering user-friendly test solution for validating electronic components and sub-assemblies and has a background in hardware, software, integration and production support.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead and own Hardware Qualification test plan definition for new products and new features, in collaboration with firmware, software, and hardware design teams

• Determine test strategies that optimize product safety, product reliability, risk mitigation, FMEA coverage, and schedule

• Design and execution of PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary

• Data analysis and clear communication of results and collaboration with design engineers to resolve any product problems found via test

• Design and implement next generation test automation hardware systems to facilitate fast and repeatable testing of product

• Manage purchasing, build, integration and final commissioning of functional testers

• Develop test procedures and test automation from component level to system level

• Support board bring-up and bench validation as needed

• Support Design Engineer with DFT, provide feedback from test results to improve quality and test coverage

• Support manufacture test bring-up and yield

• Support quality field failure analysis

• Familiarity with measurement analysis techniques such as Gage RR and Process Capability Analysis

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent

• 3+ years of experience designing functional test equipment and PCBAs

• Experience in Schematic Capture and PCBA layout.

• Knowledge of a scripting language to develop automation: Python, C#, MATLAB or SHELL. Experience using NI TestStand is a plus

• Instrument control using VISA and SCPI

• Understanding of peripherals and developing test and validation strategies

• Experience with computer hardware communication bus protocols: USB, I2C, I2S, CSI, Ethernet, SPI, PCIe, HDMI, CAN, etc

• Understanding of memory hierarchy and developing test and validation strategy

• Understanding of Product Release Cycle from prototype to production and key deliverables of each phase

• Collaborate with a cross-functional team to support product development from prototype to production

• Experience with hands-on electrical engineering work

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Understanding both hardware and software integration and test process

• Advance proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and VISIO

• Understanding of lab safety protocols when working in all types of lab environment

• A detail-oriented individual who strives in an environment that values effective team collaboration

• Self-motivated: Demonstrate ability to set direction and proactively identify and fills gaps where needed

US Salary Range

$87,000—$116,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS) is a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care.

The Company is headquartered in London, UK, with a U.S. office in New Jersey. We believe mental health patients deserve the possibility of a better future. Our initial focus is developing COMP360 psilocybin, a proprietary, investigational, synthetic psilocybin treatment under evaluation for treatment-resistant depression (TRD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). COMP360 is a potentially first-in-class treatment and has Breakthrough Therapy designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), as well as Innovative Licensing and Access Pathway (ILAP) designation in the UK for TRD.

We are leading the world’s largest classic psychedelic clinical program in TRD, and building upon that robust foundation, we are executing a late-stage trial evaluating COMP360 for PTSD, another condition with high unmet need. Our goal is to advance treatments that move the field of psychiatry towards treatment options that offer rapid onset and sustained durability with infrequent dosing. - Compass Pathways

The Senior Manager, State Government Affairs will be a part of the Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team and will help achieve Compass’ state government affairs priorities. jobs.title: Director Factory of the Future
jobs.description:
The Director, Factory of the Future, leads AbbVie’s global strategy, design standards, and delivery of next-generation factories and manufacturing operations that leverage Industry 4.0/5.0, robotics, automation, and AI. The Director owns the Factory of the Future vision and roadmap across biotechnology, aseptic manufacturing, packaging, medical device, and chemical production, and leads a team of senior engineers and technical leaders who develop reference designs, run pilots, and enable deployment into new facilities and major site transformations. This role partners with Operations leadership, Engineering, Quality, PDS&T, Supply Chain, BTS, and Security to ensure future factories are safe, compliant, flexible, and highly automated, and deliver measurable gains in quality, speed, and cost.

Vision and Strategy

• Factory of the Future strategy: Define and own the multi-year Factory of the Future vision, technology roadmap, and investment case, aligned to Operations, network, and enterprise AI and digital strategies.
• Network and capital alignment: Partner with Global Engineering, Manufacturing, and Finance to embed future-factory design principles and technology choices into the capital plan, site master plans, and new-facility business cases.

Design and Technology Leadership

• Reference designs and standards: Establish global reference designs, design standards, and technology platforms for aseptic and biologics manufacturing, packaging, device assembly, and chemical production, including modular, flexible, and continuous concepts.
• Automation, robotics, and AI: Direct the evaluation, piloting, and scale-up of robotics, autonomous material handling, vision inspection, digital twins, advanced process control, and AI-enabled operations, in partnership with BTS and Operations AI.
• Technical governance: Provide design authority and review for major capital projects; ensure cGMP, Annex 1, data integrity, device regulations, EHS, and OT/IT cybersecurity requirements are built in from concept stage.

Delivery and Value

• Portfolio delivery: Lead a portfolio of Factory of the Future pilots, proofs of concept, and project deployments, managing scope, schedule, budget, risk, and benefits.
• Value tracking: Define KPIs (e.g., OEE, right-first-time, labor productivity, cycle time, capex efficiency, sustainability) and report realized value to the Operations Leadership Team.

Leadership and Ecosystem

• Team leadership: Build, lead, and develop a global team of principal and senior principal engineers and technical specialists; create a pipeline of future-factory talent.
• External engagement: Develop strategic relationships with equipment OEMs, automation integrators, technology startups, academia, and industry bodies (e.g., ISPE) to benchmark and access emerging capabilities.
• Executive communication: Represent Factory of the Future in executive and enterprise forums, translating technical concepts into business outcomes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Biomedical, Electrical, Automation, Industrial, or related) required; Master’s, PhD, or MBA preferred.
• Minimum of 18 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device manufacturing, engineering, or technology, including 8+ years leading teams and large capital or technology programs.
• Proven record of leading greenfield/brownfield facility design or major site transformations from concept through startup.
• Expertise in aseptic and sterile manufacturing and/or biologics; experience across packaging, device, or chemical production is highly desirable.
• Demonstrated leadership in deploying Industry 4.0/5.0 technologies (robotics, automation, MES/MOM, IIoT, digital twins, AI/ML) at scale in GMP environments.
• Strong command of cGMP, Annex 1, data integrity, computer system assurance, and OT/IT cybersecurity expectations.
• Ability to build business cases and manage multi-million-dollar budgets and portfolios.
• Executive presence and ability to influence senior leaders across a global matrix organization.
• Experience developing and leading high-performing technical teams, including senior technical talent.

jobs.title: Superintendent - Electrical, Principal
jobs.location: Project Based | Various U.S. Locations (Travel Required)
jobs.description:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

BUILT DIFFERENT

We believe there's a better way to build. One that moves faster, thinks bigger, and gives people the ownership to challenge what's been done before. We're not here to follow the standard. We're here to set a new one. We don't believe the best work happens inside rigid boxes. People are given real ownership, real responsibility, and the space to operate beyond a title. Scope grows with impact. Responsibility grows with trust. And the people who step up help shape what comes next. We're building an organization around ownership, not hierarchy, where your influence is defined by what you take on, not what's written on your email signature.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Superintendent, Electrical leads electrical field execution for a new data center build, owning day-to-day site operations for electrical infrastructure in a high-stakes, mission-critical environment. Reporting to the Construction Manager and Director, Construction, this role drives schedule, coordinates electrical trade partners, and enforces safety and quality from mobilization through energization and turnover. Superintendents are the standard on a Hut 8 site: what you walk past, you approve.

Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:

Electrical Power Distribution

Supervise installation of MV/LV electrical distribution systems, including switchgear, transformers, generators, UPS systems, busway/busduct, PDUs, panelboards, and branch circuits to the rack. Ensure installations meet design specifications, manufacturer requirements, and applicable electrical codes.

Electrical Installation & Testing

Oversee cable pulling, routing, terminations, grounding, bonding, labeling, and torque documentation. Coordinate electrical inspections, equipment testing, NETA acceptance testing, and system readiness for energization. Work closely with the Superintendent, HV and Electrical SME to manage power system interfaces and energization sequencing.

Trade Coordination & Sequencing

Own electrical trade sequencing and manpower coordination across electrical rooms, equipment yards, galleries, and white space. Coordinate with mechanical, plumbing, and controls teams to manage installation interfaces, resolve field conflicts, and maintain schedule. Leverage BIM-supported coordination to identify and resolve clashes before installation.

Commissioning & Energization

Drive completion of electrical installation checklists, equipment inspections, testing documentation, and prerequisites supporting Level 1-3 commissioning. Support commissioning execution through Levels 4-5 with the CXQC Field Manager, ensuring electrical systems are ready for functional testing, integrated systems testing, and turnover.

Electrical Safety & Quality Enforcement

Enforce electrical safety standards, including NFPA 70E, LOTO, arc flash protection, energized work permits, and safe work practices as systems progressively energize around ongoing construction. Hold electrical trade partners accountable for first-time quality, documented QC, and compliance with project specifications.

Planning, Documentation & Issues

Own the electrical three-week look-ahead, daily coordination, manpower planning, and progress reporting. Drive electrical RFIs and field issues to closure with the Project Engineer and discipline engineers. Maintain accurate QC records, test reports, inspection documentation, energization records, and as-built drawings.

ABOUT YOU

What we’re looking for:

• 3+ years supervising electrical construction trades on data center, semiconductor, hospital, or heavy industrial projects; mission-critical experience strongly preferred.

• Strong technical knowledge of MV/LV power distribution, switchgear, transformers, standby generators, UPS systems, busway, PDUs, and critical electrical infrastructure.

• Experience overseeing electrical installations, cable terminations, grounding, equipment testing, and energization activities.

• Familiarity with NETA acceptance testing, electrical inspections, and power system commissioning requirements.

• Experience supporting Level 1-5 commissioning activities, including electrical system readiness, functional testing, integrated systems testing, and turnover documentation.

• Strong trade-sequencing instincts in congested, schedule-critical environments; fluent in look-ahead planning and manpower loading.

• Proven electrical safety leadership, including NFPA 70E, LOTO, arc flash protection, and energized-facility transitions; OSHA 30 preferred.

• Ability to interpret electrical one-line diagrams, power distribution drawings, equipment submittals, and coordinated BIM models.

• Comfortable with Procore/ACC, BIM field use, and electrical construction documentation.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant (Full-Time) - Orange, CT
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

VEG is a rapidly growing emergency company with hospital locations across the United States. Our mission is helping people and their pets when they need it most. We are revolutionizing emergency medicine with a “customer first” mentality and a true, employee-centric work environment.

TALENT + CULTURE AT VEG

At VEG, we want people and their pets to feel safe, secure, and valued; we want our employees to feel the same way. What we’re aiming to achieve on the customer side is equivalent in nature to what we want for our employees: to have the best experience possible. With the highest NPS score in our industry, we’re ready to ensure that VEG remains the place where the best and brightest in the emergency world not only want to work, but stay and grow. For our customers and their pets, we strive to find a way to say, “yes.” We do the same and more for our teams. In fact, VEG is one of this year’s nominees for INC Magazine’s Best Places to Work!

WHO WE NEED

You are passionate and motivated. You value learning and are a team player that is honest and respectful to your peers. You love what you do. You love working with animals and people. You are comfortable adapting to new scenarios, willing to learn new techniques, and think outside the box. You have excellent interpersonal capabilities across a diverse group. You’re happy to pitch in wherever and whenever you are needed, with a positive attitude. You demonstrate the ability to accomplish assigned tasks for all areas involved, knowing when to ask for assistance. You display excellent communication skills with your peers, customers, and team.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO DO

• Treat each patient and customer with the highest level of compassion and care.

• Perform basic to intermediate nursing care tasks, patient monitoring, and treatments.

• Use understanding of common diseases and conditions, physical assessment, and monitoring parameters to accurately triage incoming patients.

• Administer subcutaneous, intramuscular, and intravenous medications and understand potential adverse effects of medications.

• Set-up, monitor, and administer intravenous fluid therapy including constant rate infusions and blood transfusion therapy.

• Contribute as a team member to incoming outpatient care and ongoing inpatient care.

• Participate in giving and receiving patient rounds to ensure continuity of care.

• Be trained to properly perform all aspects of CPR as a RECOVER Certified Rescuer.

• Collect samples and perform diagnostic tests including in-house and point-of-care tests and diagnostic imaging.

• Assist in setting-up, performing, monitoring sedation and surgical anesthesia with LVT or DVM supervision.

• Perform nursing care tasks such as placing and maintaining urinary catheters and nasal oxygen tubes, and

• Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot oxygen cages and other oxygen administration techniques.

• Work alongside licensed veterinary technicians as a vital member of the nursing care team.

• Obtain additional training along guided growth pathways offering roles in addition to direct nursing care such as veterinary technician credentialing, trainer role, community outreach, and leadership.

Veterinary Assistants can additionally (where permitted by law):

• Administer, monitor, and maintain patients under general anesthesia with or without mechanical ventilation for patients with varied levels of risk.

• Perform advanced vascular access techniques including jugular catheter placement, sampling line placement, central line placement, intraosseous catheterization, and arterial catheterization.

• Perform advanced diagnostic techniques including ultrasonography and paracentesis,

• Participate in formulating treatment, anesthetic, and nursing care plans.

• Obtain additional training along guided growth pathways offering roles in addition to direct nursing care such as a trainer role, coordination of care, community outreach, and leadership.

WHY YOU SHOULD CHOOSE US

Because emergency is all we do, so we do it best! We also offer:

• Industry-leading‌ ‌compensation‌ ($18.50 - $39.00/hr)

• We build our hospitals from scratch. You’ll be using all of the latest equipment and technology.

• Generous employee pet discount

• Referral rewards - tell your friends why they should come work for VEG too!

• Health‌, Vision, and Dental ‌Insurance‌ ‌ ‌

• 401K‌ ‌w/‌ ‌company‌ ‌match‌ ‌ ‌

• Paid‌ ‌parental‌ ‌leave‌ ‌-‌ ‌up to 12 ‌weeks‌ ‌of‌ ‌paid‌ ‌leave‌ ‌at‌ ‌100%‌ ‌of‌ ‌regular‌ ‌salary‌ ‌

• Unlimited‌ ‌Continuing Education opportunities - we want to help you grow in your career!

• Flexible‌ ‌work‌ ‌schedules‌ ‌for‌ ‌a‌ ‌true‌ ‌work-life‌ ‌balance‌ ‌ ‌

• Growth‌ ‌potential‌ ‌ ‌

• Groceries‌ ‌sent‌ ‌to the hospitals weekly for the staff to enjoy,‌ ‌monthly‌ ‌and‌ ‌quarterly‌ ‌contests,‌ ‌quarterly‌ ‌hospital‌ ‌outings,‌ company-wide retreats,‌ ‌etc!‌ ‌

• Lastly, because while our work is serious, we believe that it should also be fun!

VEG celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. You've found the equal opportunity employer you are looking for. We can't wait to meet you!

jobs.description:
As the Director of Service Operations at Lumos, you'll play a critical leadership role in delivering reliable fiber connectivity and an exceptional customer experience across our growing markets. You'll lead and develop regional operations teams, oversee service installations and maintenance, and drive the performance, safety, and efficiency of our field operations.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact as Lumos continues to expand, combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational expertise to strengthen service delivery, improve processes, and build high-performing teams that support our customers and continued growth.

This is a remote position supporting Service Operations across the Midwest region, with a preference for candidates located within a Lumos market in Ohio, Indiana, or Kentucky. Regional travel is required.

Why Lumos:

Lumos is transforming the future of connectivity by building one of the nation's fastest-growing 100% Fiber Optic networks. Through T-Fiber, our joint venture with T-Mobile, we're working toward a shared goal of connecting 12 to 15 million homes by 2030 while expanding access to reliable, high-speed internet in the communities we serve.

Here, you'll find more than a job, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, take ownership of your work, and help shape how we grow. We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and believe the best ideas come from people who are curious, solutions-oriented, and ready to build what's next.

What You'll Do:

• Lead, coach, and develop regional Service Operations managers and teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and a strong customer-first culture.

• Oversee service installations, maintenance, and field operations across assigned markets, ensuring consistent quality, safety, and operational performance.

• Establish and monitor KPIs, SLAs, and customer experience metrics to drive efficiency, service reliability, and continuous improvement.

• Develop and execute operational strategies that support market expansion, service delivery objectives, and long-term business growth.

• Manage department budgets, resources, and operational projects to ensure effective planning, execution, and cost management.

• Oversee vendor and contractor performance, including negotiations, service expectations, and accountability for operational results.

• Serve as a key escalation point for complex customer and operational challenges, driving timely resolution and improvements to the customer experience.

• Partner across Network Operations, Engineering, Construction, Customer Care, and other teams to improve workflows, strengthen service delivery, and support business objectives.

• Establish and maintain operational policies, procedures, and safety standards while identifying opportunities to improve processes and scale operations.

What You'll Bring:

• 7+ years of experience in telecommunications service operations, field operations, or a related area.

• Proven experience leading geographically dispersed teams, developing managers, and driving operational performance across multiple markets.

• Strong understanding of telecommunications service installation, maintenance, network operations, and customer service delivery.

• Experience managing operational budgets, vendor relationships, contractor performance, and service-level agreements.

• Ability to analyze KPIs, operational performance, and customer satisfaction metrics to identify trends and drive improvements.

• Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and operational software platforms, with the ability to adapt to new systems and technologies.

• A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the ability to work independently and lead effectively in a fast-paced environment.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Bachelor's degree in business, telecommunications, engineering, or a related field.

• Direct experience in the fiber broadband or FTTH industry, including distributed and centralized split network architectures.

• Knowledge of central office infrastructure, network equipment, and telecommunications facilities.

• Experience improving customer satisfaction, NPS scores, and operational efficiency across multiple markets.

• A track record of developing high-performing teams, improving operational processes, and supporting growth in a scaling organization.

• A collaborative, hands-on leadership style with the ability to balance strategic priorities with day-to-day operational execution.

Physical Requirements:

• Frequently operates a computer, phone, and standard office tools.

• Ability to travel to properties and regional offices as needed.

• Near-constant use of sight, speech, hearing, comprehension, and reasoning.

• Must be able to sit or remain in a stationary position for extended periods.

Our commitment to communities includes recruiting and rewarding the Lumos team members who are working together to build a brighter tomorrow.

jobs.title: Immediate Care Technician-Immediate Care Center Sycamore Full Time Days
jobs.description:
**This is a Full Time position at 36 hours per week for the Immediate Care Center located at the Sycamore clinic.  This would be 3, 12hr shifts from 6:45am-7:15pm with weekend and holiday coverage requirement. Floating to other clinics may be required. Must be a CMA or EMT.**

The Immediate Care Technician reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Immediate Care Technician supports physicians (MD) and advance practice providers (APP) by facilitating patient flow, assisting with various patient care activities, and performing related administrative functions. This role is responsible for ensuring efficient patient flow; maintaining neat, clean and safe patient care areas;  promoting patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner; safeguarding patient confidentiality.

Responsibilities:

Description

Assures efficient patient flow through the site:

• Escorts patient to exam room, identifies patient with 2 identifiers and prepares patient for examination.
• Obtains accurate vital signs, per organization standards.
• Documents reason for visit and updates/confirms, allergies, smoking history and pharmacy information.
• Promptly informs the MD/APP of any significant change in vital signs or acute symptoms.
• Anticipates/sets up equipment or supplies needed for visit.
• Cleans and prepares exam room for next patient.

• Build reproducible distributed pipelines for training, rollout generation, evaluation, and inference; profile and resolve bottlenecks that only appear at scale.

jobs.title: Deployment
jobs.description:
INTRODUCTION

Hi, I'm Al https://www.linkedin.com/in/al-stolz/ and I lead everything customer-facing at Candid. As a team, we’re primarily responsible for delivering valuable outcomes with and for our customers. Prior to Candid, I led teams at McKinsey & Co for 5 years, based in both NYC and Sydney, Australia. I started my career as an M&A lawyer at Allens, a top Australian law firm.

We’re hiring for outstanding folks on my team, and I want to share a bit about how we think about this role, because it's different from what you'll find at most companies - and that difference is very intentional.

At Candid, our model is one where a single, empowered individual is responsible for delivering outcomes with and for customers. Our internal name for this role is “Valkyrie” and it was designed this way from the start. In the early days of Candid, as with many startups, it was impossible to have separate people owning all the things required to help customers win; one person had to integrate across all of it. However, we believe that this isn’t just a startup constraint - it is an incredibly effective way to organize ourselves to win, together with our customers. A single, empowered owner who can move fluidly across functional boundaries will outperform a team of specialists nearly every time, especially in a domain as operationally complex and fragmented as revenue cycle management.

As we've scaled to 200 people and beyond, we've intentionally preserved that model. We've split off certain functionally specialized supporting teams - such as Customer Experience, Forward Deployed Engineering, and Training & Enablement - but the Valkyrie remains the single-point owner of customer outcomes. The anti-pattern we actively resist is the substance-light CSM role that's mostly about relationship management and renewal motions.

To be effective at Candid, you have to be willing and able to operate at the lowest tactical level; iterating on prompts for agent phone calls to navigate payer IVRs, debugging detailed syntax errors in EDI rejections with a clearinghouse, mapping hundreds of fields between a legacy system and ours. Some might describe that work as unglamorous, but the best people on this team relish doing it, because that's where the valuable outcomes live.

But that’s not enough: you also have to be able to zoom out to shape the strategic direction of our partnership with a customer, decomposing complex and ambiguous problems, defining solutions, then driving cross-functional execution to deliver the outcome.  Being able to do both is what really unlocks value for our customers and enables people to thrive in this role.

The shape of person we have seen most commonly thrive in this setting is a low-ego, high-slope generalist. They are resourceful, laser-focused on value delivery, and wired to expand into unowned space rather than wait for scope to be handed to them. This is not a role where your responsibilities are neatly defined and bounded. Valkyries see what needs to happen and make it happen, often before anyone asks. When you spot a gap between teams, an unowned customer problem, or an emerging product opportunity, the expectation is that you move toward it.

Our core thesis - that a scrappy, resourceful generalist given space and expansive ownership will outperform a specialist - has paid off at every stage of Candid's growth. I'm looking for people who will keep proving it right.




THE ROLE

Candid Health is looking to hire Deployment team members in 2026! Over the past year, this team has grown significantly, and we’re excited to bring on new talent to help drive that momentum forward and support our continued expansion.

In this role, you will own a portfolio of current customers and will be responsible for ensuring that they achieve world-class revenue cycle outcomes. You will work directly with them to understand their challenges (e.g., root causing denials issues, digging into workflow gaps), as well as cross-functionally with other internal teams at Candid to develop solutions.

This team is at the tip of the spear working with customers helping to make medical billing less painful for everyone involved. If you are excited about what we are building, we’d love to speak with you and see if there is a fit across the team!




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - As a Valkyrie, you'll be the single owner of outcomes for your customers. Your goal is to help ensure a higher portion of their claims get paid, more quickly, and with less effort. When something stands in the way, it's yours to solve, whether or not it sits neatly in your lane.

 - As part of this, you’ll own the customer relationship at all levels - whether that is the CEO, or the front-line user. You need to be able to flex your engagement style to suit the person, and help tell a compelling value narrative to each persona. As part of this, you’ll go onsite to sit desk-side with users, be able to deliver a killer demo, and do workflow discovery and solutioning. Engaging directly with customers is how we win, and this role is the primary interface and owner of the customer relationship.

 - You'll work at both ends of the spectrum. One day that might be iterating on prompts for agent phone calls to navigate payer IVRs, debugging EDI rejections with a clearinghouse, or mapping fields from a legacy system into ours. The next, you're shaping the strategic direction of our partnership with a customer's leadership team. The detailed work is where the valuable outcomes live.

 - You'll dig into the data (e.g., claims metrics, denial patterns, workflow gaps) to find the root cause of customer issues, then help build the fix. Fixes may be operational (workflow (re-)design), technical, or product-oriented (automation of manual workflows). You'll bring data-informed recommendations, not just escalations.

 - You'll drive our growth by first driving our customers' growth. By understanding their goals and acting as a strategic partner, you'll help them unlock the full value of our product and have more impact with their patients. Your credibility comes from outcomes delivered, not meetings held.

 - You'll orchestrate across Candid, working closely with our RCM team (i.e., our expert billers working day to day in the Candid platform) as well as pulling in Customer Experience, Forward Deployed Engineering, Training & Enablement, Product, Design, and Engineering as needed. You stay accountable for the outcome end to end.

 - You'll move toward gaps: between teams, unowned customer problems, emerging product opportunities. You'll pick them up, often before anyone asks, and your scope will grow as fast as you can handle it.




WHO YOU ARE

 - 1–5 years of experience. We care more about slope than tenure: how quickly you've grown and how much scope you've taken on.

 - You have a demonstrated track record of expansively owning and driving key business outcomes, ideally by taking on scope no one handed you.

 - You're a low-ego, resourceful generalist. You learn fast, you'll happily do the unglamorous work yourself, and you care more about the customer winning than who gets the credit.

 - You're comfortable without neatly bounded responsibilities. When you spot a gap or an unowned problem, your instinct is to step in rather than wait or hand it off.

 - You can zoom in and out. You're as comfortable debugging a data mapping or an EDI rejection as you are discussing partnership strategy with a customer executive.

 - You take pride in your craft and keep a high quality bar, but you believe "done is better than perfect." You have good intuition about which corners are okay to cut and which aren't.

 - You enjoy spotting recurring customer problems and shaping solutions, whether workflow fixes, automation, or product ideas, and you roll up your sleeves to get the work done in the meantime.

 - You're a clear and concise communicator, in person and in writing, whether you're talking to customers, payers, or engineers.

 - Experience in healthcare technology, RCM, or healthcare financial services is a plus but not required.




PAY TRANSPARENCY

The estimated starting annual salary range for this position is $120,000 - $160,000 USD. The listed range is a guideline from Pave https://www.pave.com/ data, and the actual base salary may be modified based on factors including job-related skills, experience/qualifications, interview performance, market data, etc. Total compensation for this position may also include equity, sales incentives (for sales roles), and employee benefits. Given Candid Health’s funding and size, we heavily value the potential upside from equity in our compensation package. Further note that Candid Health has minimal hierarchy and titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles.

Please note: we are looking for employees to join our in-person culture at one of our offices (Denver, San Francisco, or New York). Our ideal weekly schedule is 4 days in-office and 1 day working remotely. Depending on the focus of your role, travel may be up to 25%.

COMPANY DESCRIPTION:

A career here is life-enhancing.

At Syner-G, we enable our people to build careers that impact positively on their quality of life. Through our expertise, insight, consulting and management skills, we accelerate breakthrough science and delivery of life-enhancing therapies to more patients. We work across a diverse range of clients and projects, supporting many organizations from the most critical phases of the drug discovery and approval process through to commercialization. It is meaningful, varied and thought-provoking work with a strategic emphasis, a solutions-driven approach and significant, real-world outcomes, from science to delivery/success. To learn more about who we are and what drives us, watch our company video here.

Underpinning this mission is a culture that aligns perfectly with what we want to achieve. We enable our people to grow, we support them in their learning and we reward them in so many different ways. In return, they play an instrumental role in maintaining our reputation across the globe as a strategic biopharma product development and delivery partner.

Syner-G was recently honored with BioSpace's prestigious "Best Places to Work" 2026 award, for the third consecutive year, along with many other award-winning programs to make a career here truly life-enhancing. These recognitions are a testament to our commitment to fostering a positive and engaging work environment for our employees, with a particular emphasis on culture, career growth and development opportunities, financial rewards, leadership and innovation.

At Syner-G, we recognize that our team members are our most valuable asset. Join us in shaping the future, where your talents are valued, and your contributions make a meaningful impact.

For more information, visit www.Synergbiopharma.com

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking a Reliability Engineer to support reliability, maintenance, and asset management activities within a regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing environment. The Reliability Engineer will work cross-functionally with Facilities, Engineering, Maintenance, Manufacturing, Quality, and other stakeholders to improve equipment reliability, optimize preventive maintenance strategies, reduce unplanned downtime, and support operational readiness.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with mechanical, electrical, process, or facility systems in GMP environments and a strong understanding of reliability engineering principles, maintenance best practices, and data-driven continuous improvement.

This position is internally classified as a Facilities Engineer and will have a primary focus on reliability engineering.

WORK LOCATION
Travel to client sites may be required up to 100%, depending on project demands and client expectations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
(This list is not exhaustive and may be modified as needed.)

• Support reliability engineering activities for facility, utility, process, and manufacturing equipment in GMP and non-GMP environments.

• Develop, implement, and continuously improve preventive maintenance (PM) programs and asset maintenance strategies.

• Perform equipment and system criticality assessments to prioritize maintenance and reliability activities.

• Lead or support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), failure investigations, and failure mode assessments for equipment and system issues.

• Analyze equipment performance, maintenance history, downtime, and failure data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.

• Develop, maintain, and report reliability metrics and KPIs to measure equipment performance and identify potential failures or performance gaps.

• Support spare parts assessments, critical spare identification, inventory strategies, and risk mitigation planning.

• Recommend equipment life-extension strategies and reliability improvements for mechanical and electrical systems.

• Utilize Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to review equipment history, work orders, preventive maintenance activities, and asset data.

• Support operational readiness activities for new or modified equipment, systems, and facilities.

• Identify opportunities to improve equipment availability, maintainability, and overall asset performance.

• Apply Good Engineering Practices (GEP), reliability best practices, and maintenance best practices to engineering activities.

• Collaborate with Engineering, Facilities, Maintenance, Manufacturing, Quality, Validation, and other cross-functional stakeholders.

• Develop reports, presentations, and recommendations to communicate reliability performance and improvement initiatives.

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, or another related Engineering discipline.

Experience

• Minimum of 1 year of relevant engineering experience.

• Experience within oral solid dose, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, R&D, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment preferred.

• Experience in Reliability Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Process Engineering, Plant Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Experience developing, implementing, or improving preventive maintenance programs and asset maintenance strategies.

• Experience with or knowledge of Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).

• Experience analyzing maintenance and reliability data and developing metrics, KPIs, dashboards, or reports to support engineering decisions.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Working knowledge of reliability engineering methodologies, including Root Cause Analysis (RCA), failure mode assessment, equipment criticality, and preventive maintenance optimization

• Knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems, equipment operation, common failure modes, and equipment life-extension strategies.

• Familiarity with spare parts assessments, equipment criticality reviews, and mitigation strategies designed to reduce unplanned downtime.

• Understanding of GMP requirements, Good Engineering Practices, and engineering expectations within regulated life sciences environments.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

• Experience supporting GMP manufacturing facilities, utilities, process equipment, or production systems.

• Experience with reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), FMEA/FMECA, predictive maintenance, or condition-based maintenance strategies.

• Experience supporting equipment commissioning, qualification, operational readiness, or maintenance program development for new or modified assets.

• Familiarity with CMMS platforms such as Maximo, Blue Mountain, SAP, or similar systems.

• Demonstrated ability to use reliability and maintenance data to identify performance gaps, reduce recurring failures, and improve asset availability.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of the requirements that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer keyboard and mouse; reach with hands and arms; talk and listen. The employee is frequently required to walk and sit, as well as to lift and carry objects such as books and files weighing up to 25 pounds. The employee is occasionally required to stand, stoop, or kneel. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, including moderate noise level, an indoor temperate environment, and light levels that are bright and conducive to minimal eye strain, typical for an office environment.

TOTAL REWARDS PROGRAM:

We define total rewards as compensation, benefits, remote work/flexibility, development, recognition, and our culture with programs that support each of our reward pillars. This includes a market competitive base salary and annual incentive plan, robust benefit offerings, and ongoing recognition and career development opportunities. Employees also enjoy our generous flexible paid time off program, company-paid holidays, flexible working hours, and fully remote work options for most positions and the ability to work “almost anywhere.” However, if a physical work location is more for you, we have office locations in Greater Boston; San Diego, CA; Boulder, CO; and India.

At Clover, AI is part of how we work. We expect leaders to thoughtfully incorporate tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and emerging enterprise AI technologies into their daily workflows to improve analytical quality, accelerate execution, and enable better decisions.

The Enterprise Performance Lead serves as a strategic business partner within Clover's Actuarial Strategic Operations, owning financial and operational partnership for one or more areas across the Medicare Advantage business. This role partners across Finance, Actuarial, Clinical, Revenue, Pharmacy, and Operations to align operational execution with financial performance, ensuring enterprise initiatives deliver expected outcomes. The Enterprise Performance Lead reports to the Director of Actuarial Strategic Operations and serves as a strategic business partner within Clover's MA Plan Actuarial Strategic Operations team.

Successful candidates are curious, analytical, and collaborative problem-solvers who enjoy working across multiple business functions to evaluate strategic initiatives, identify opportunities,

As an Enterprise Performance Lead, you will:

• Develop and continuously evolve performance monitoring frameworks using leading and lagging indicators, dashboards, and KPIs to evaluate initiative performance, proactively identify execution risks, and recommend actions that enable faster, data-driven decision making.

jobs.title: Manager, Vehicle Fluids (Systems)
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Stage Fluids team designs and delivers the propellant, pressurant, pneumatics, and other fluid systems that turn structures into functioning rockets. The team has full ownership across design, production, test, and flight, maintaining a holistic view of Terran R, focused not on isolated parts but integrated functionality. Working on-site at the factory means you’re never far from the hardware, enabling rapid iteration and tight feedback loops across design and manufacturing. You won’t just be handed requirements: you’ll be expected to ask the right questions, collaborate with partners across the company, and ultimately find the best solutions for Terran R.

About the Role:

As the Vehicle Fluids Product Manager, you will be leading the team responsible for the fluid system architecture and function across the vehicle. You and your team will apply deep expertise in system architecture, complex systems operations, and fluid thermodynamics applications to guide hardware design, system analysis, manufacturing, validation and operations.

You will:

• Manage a high-performing fluids product team while aligning and executing against program milestones

• Define, scope and schedule the stage-level fluid architecture, requirements and documentation at appropriate maturity to conduct integrated testing and readiness for flight

• Lead cross-functional interface definitions and negotiations with partner vehicle teams (Propulsion/Engine, Structures, GNC, and Avionics) to ensure flawless system integration

• Set clear team goals and drive accountability

• Assist with sizing and fluid 1D steady-state thermofluids analysis at both the system and component levels when necessary to

• Define development, qualification, and acceptance testing scopes to buy down technical risk prior to vehicle-level integrated testing

• Participate in concept of Operations (CONOPS) development and operation data review to take ultimate ownership of the successful operational philosophy and testing execution of the fluid systems at the integrated vehicle level

• Mentor engineers and guide hardware owners to ensure systems meet fluid requirements

To succeed in this role, you will bring a solid foundation in fundamental physics and the ability to apply first principles thinking to complex problems. You are self-motivated, adaptable, and thrive in a fast-paced, highly integrated and collaborative vehicle development environment.

This role offers the opportunity to directly influence major engine and vehicle stage hardware while accelerating your professional growth in a culture that values collaboration, ownership, technical rigor, and calculated risk-taking.

About You:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field and +7 years of relevant experience across at least 1 aerospace vehicle program lifecycle

• Proven experience leading high-performing engineering teams delivering successful hardware on complex, cross-functional projects

• Demonstrated mentoring and technical leadership skills

• Strong background in fluid system architecture, operations and application of engineering fundamentals in system design, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and heat transfer

• Proficient with one or more fluid or thermal modeling tools for internal compressible and incompressible fluid analysis

• Experience using programming languages such as Matlab, Python, or C++ for data analysis or modeling

• Direct experience designing or operating launch vehicle or spacecraft fluid or propulsion systems

Nice to haves, but not required:

• Experience with certification of a vehicle fluid system for NSSL and/or range certification
