jobs.title: Software Engineer, Federal
jobs.description:
ABOUT STARBRIDGE

We're building the front door for how businesses partner with government in America.

Public agencies spend roughly a trillion dollars a year with private companies, and nearly all of it still moves through infrastructure that hasn't changed in decades. Starbridge is building the full operating system for that relationship: the data, the signals, the workflows, and the rails that let a company find a public buyer, win the work, and get paid.

We monitor 320,000+ public sector entities around the clock. 500+ customers have joined us since our launch in March. We've raised $50M from top investors including Craft and Michael Seibel of Y Combinator.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Starbridge Federal is a small team inside Starbridge focused on companies selling to the federal government. We're hiring a software engineer to build and own SweetSpot, our federal product, and to bring what works there into the core Starbridge platform.

This is a small team with tons of ownership. You'll work directly with the founders and the engineering lead on what to build, then take it from idea to production yourself. There's no layer of PMs or tickets between you and the problem: you'll talk to users, make the technical calls, ship, and keep improving what you shipped.

Our stack is React and TypeScript on the frontend and Python on the backend. We're particularly interested in someone who enjoys working with AI tools and building agents and automations into their own workflow.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Own Starbridge Federal end to end. Build new features across the frontend and backend, maintain and improve what's already there, and keep it fast and reliable in production.

 - Build with AI. Work on semantic search, search infrastructure, and AI-driven workflows that help companies find and win federal opportunities.

 - Work directly with founders. Shape the product roadmap with leadership and customers, not just implement a spec.

 - Raise the bar. Make sound technical decisions, write maintainable code with meaningful tests, and help set engineering practices for a small team.




WHAT YOU BRING:

 - 1–5 years of experience as a software engineer shipping production code, with a track record of fast growth.

 - Strong Python and React/TypeScript. You're comfortable across the full stack and can own a feature from database to UI.

 - Solid fundamentals. Data structures, concurrency, databases, and system design, including how to scale a system and handle failures.

 - Ownership. You've owned something meaningful end to end and want more of that, not less.

 - Startup experience, or a clear appetite for a fast-moving, small-team environment.

 - Curiosity about AI and automation. You use AI tools and agents to move faster and enjoy experimenting with new ones.

 - Based in or willing to relocate to NYC and work from our office.

 - U.S. citizenship is required, as this role will have access to our federal environment.

Bonus if you have:

 - Experience with search, LLMs, or data-heavy products.

 - Experience with government data, GovTech, or regulated industries.

 - Experience with GCP or AWS.

Interview process

We move fast — really fast. Getting back to someone today beats tomorrow, and our interview process reflects that mindset. Please keep us posted on your timeline so we can move quickly and speed things up where needed.

 1. A 15-minute intro chat with the hiring manager.

 2. A 30-minute programming exercise.

 3. A 1-hour pair programming session on a real codebase: fixing bugs and adding a feature.

 4. An onsite in our NYC office, where you'll build a small feature end to end with the team and meet our founders.

How we work

 - Build Bridges to Help Customers Win - We pride ourselves on being obsessively customer-centric.

 - Shooting Star Speed - We move with extreme speed. We value momentum, decisiveness, and the ability to accelerate when it matters.

 - Fun Is a Feature - We intentionally design Starbridge to be an energizing place to do hard work. Joy, humor, and camaraderie make great teams faster, sharper, and more resilient.

 - In the Arena - We believe the best ideas come from living close to the work, feeling the friction, hearing the nuance, and experiencing the details firsthand.

Benefits include

 - Competitive salary + early-stage equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Company-provided lunch in the office every day

 - Gym stipend

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Regular offsites (NYC + global locations)

Who We Are:

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company.  Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service.  With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

• Integrity: Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.

• Courage: We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always.

• Together: The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

Job Summary:

The Customer Success organization helps SmithRx’s clients derive the full value of their PBM services. We build and manage effective relationships with customers’ operational leadership, communicating the value of our services in the context of customers’ business objectives with the goal of retaining high performing, satisfied customers. We identify risks to client satisfaction proactively and collaborate across product and operational lines to tenaciously pursue solutions and advocate for our clients.

As the Manager of the Implementation team, you lead a high caliber team of implementation professionals responsible for the overall implementation, project management and relationship management of SmithRx customers for a successful onboarding to our solution.

You will bring strong industry and product knowledge and serve as a trusted advisor and business partner for our client’s leadership. The Customer Success organization begins involvement with their clients at implementation kick-off and develops and executes the project planning for new clients and changes with existing clients, orchestrating the involvement of additional SmithRx teams to ensure the client is achieving its stated business goals.

What will you do:

• Provide people management and strategic leadership to our implementation team including: new group implementation assignments, new group implementation go live audits, and implementation documentation.

• Oversees and supports multiple implementation projects. May directly lead the largest or most-complex client implementations and channel partner implementations.

• Ensures that implementations are completed on time, within budget, and meet client expectations.

• Provides input to strategic decisions that affect the implementation processes and team members.

• Develops and implements policies, procedures and training including: client on-boarding, process documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and client training.

• Build a strong and cohesive team by providing leadership to direct reports through coaching, setting strategic direction and applying working knowledge of systems and procedures.

• Accountable for customer satisfaction of the client implementation.

• Support sales in finalist meetings, representing the SmithRx approach to delivering high-touch implementation support.

• Maintain a comprehensive understanding of business challenges faced by customers.

• Manage cross-functional issue resolution for client escalations, ensuring internal and external teams are coordinated as necessary.

• 10% travel may be required.

What will you bring to SmithRx:

• Bachelor’s degree required

• Requires 5+ years of managerial experience

• Requires 8+ years of implementation and project management experience, managing multiple projects simultaneously

• Requires previous experience within healthcare, pharmacy benefits management (PBM), and third-party administrator (TPA)

• Ability to work independently as well as part of an extended, cross-functional team

• Conflict resolution skills

• Empathetic communicator with a consultative approach, able to see things from other person's point of view

• Robust analytical skills; advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and ability to work in different systems simultaneously

• Strong communication skills via face-to-face meetings, conference calls and written correspondence

• Self-starter mentality: ability to make informed decisions, find creative approaches to difficult challenges, and deliver on commitments

• Execution-focused ethos - you are a solutions-oriented problem solver and efficiency driven

• Flexible, adaptable, and able to respond under the pressure of a fast-paced technology company

What SmithRx Offers You:

• Highly competitive wellness benefits including Medical, Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance

• Flexible Spending Benefits

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Program

• Short-term and long-term disability

• Discretionary Paid Time Off

• 12 Paid Holidays

• Wellness Benefits

• Commuter Benefits

• Paid Parental Leave benefits

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Well-stocked kitchen in office locations

• Professional development and training opportunities

Zone A includes the following locations:

• San Francisco Bay Area - California

• Metro New York City - Connecticut, New Jersey, New York and Pennsylvania

Zone A Pay Range

$142,800—$168,000 USD

Zone B includes the following locations:

• California - outside of San Francisco Bay Area

• Metro Denver / Boulder - Colorado

• Metro District of Columbia - District of Columbia, Maryland, Virginia and West Virginia

• Metro Boston / Cambridge - Massachusetts and New Hampshire

• Metro Austin - Texas

• Metro Seattle - Washington

Zone B Pay Range

$130,900—$154,000 USD

Zone C includes all other locations not listed above, including:

• Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Utah, Vermont, Wisconsin, Wyoming

• Non metro Colorado, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and West Virginia

Zone C Pay Range

$119,000—$140,000 USD

Compensation & Benefits

• Base Salary: The range listed above reflects our standard pay scale and actual pay will vary based on work location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

• Total Rewards: In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or equity. SmithRx offers a variety of benefits to help you live well, including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance and 401(k).

Individual offers are tailored to your geography, experience, skills, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details during the hiring process. In the meantime, feel free to explore our comprehensive benefits here.

jobs.title: 6th-8th Grade ELA/Writing Teacher
jobs.description:
About the Team

ACCEL Schools is hiring a highly qualified 6th-8th Grade ELA/Writing Teacher at Cleveland Arts & Social Sciences Academy in Cleveland, Ohio dedicated to providing a superior education for all students. We are seeking teachers who are passionate and dedicated to bringing the curriculum to life for each student. We want our teachers to be excited to create a positive classroom environment that prioritizes student learning and social-emotional development.

Be part of the difference at Cleveland Arts & Social Sciences Academy (CASSA)! Serving the Buckeye-Shaker community and surrounding neighborhoods, Cleveland Arts & Social Sciences is a public charter school offering a hands-on college prep curriculum that emphasizes the arts and humanities. CASSA provides small group learning, educational technology, and a wide range of specialty classes. The close-knit K-8 school features a positive school culture with many campus events and activities. Cleveland Arts & Social Sciences Academy is part of ACCEL Schools, an established network of public charter schools serving K-12 students throughout the United States since 2014.

About the Opportunity:

Responsibilities of the Teacher include to-

• Prepare and deliver lesson plans with the ability to modify accordingly during the school year

• Differentiate instruction to meet the needs of all students

• Maintain accurate and complete records of students’ progress and development

• Utilize research-based best practices in daily planning and classroom instruction

• Manage student behavior in the classroom

• Create a positive classroom environment for students to learn in

• Utilize school approved curricula that reflects the diverse educational, cultural, and linguistic backgrounds of the students

• Implement school-wide culture expectations and norms

• Communicate and meet with families regarding the academic and social-emotional growth of their child

• Incorporate technology skills into daily classroom practice to support learning

• Participate in the planning and implementation of non-instructional activities, as needed

• Collaborate and communicate effectively with colleagues

• Perform other duties as assigned

About You:

• Active and current state of Ohio teaching license in appropriate content area

• Bachelor’s degree in education or related field

• High level of comfort working in a growth-focused coaching environment based on frequent observations, debriefs, action planning, and progress monitoring

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to properly manage confidential information

• Able to supervise students of various ages in different school settings (playground, cafeteria, etc.)

• Ability to pass federal and state criminal background checks

• Experience working within an urban environment

About Us

“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” – Ron Packard, CEO & Founder

ACCEL Schools is a network of 80+ high-performing, public charter schools serving PK-12 students. We proudly advocate for school choice and work to address educational inequities throughout the United States. Our schools are inclusive and widely differ to reflect the unique values of the many urban, suburban, and rural communities we serve. Our brick and mortar, and virtual schools specialize in closing educational gaps and offer innovative models such as career-technical education, sports training, bilingual programming, and more. We have been recognized and praised by legislators, authorizers, and researchers for providing exceptional education options to students in historically under-resourced communities.

We offer the following benefits:

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $40,000 - 49,500. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Life benefits – time & peace of mind

• Paid time off

• Retirement contributions

• Optional Basic Life and AD&D insurance

• Voluntary life insurance (employee, spouse, child)

• Discounted childcare at Early Learning Academies locations

Health benefits – stay well & thrive

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Employee Assistance Program

• Voluntary short-term disability insurance

• Voluntary long-term disability insurance

Career benefits – keep growing

• Career advancement opportunities throughout Accel Schools and our strong network of 4,000+ instructors and education professionals

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

jobs.title: Janitorial Services Technician - EVS
jobs.description:
Join MIND 24-7: Transforming Mental Health Care, 24/7

At MIND 24-7, we are fundamentally changing the landscape of mental health care by creating a "front door" that is always open, always welcoming, and always ready to help. Our mission is to provide accessible, compassionate care for everyone—no matter the time of day or the challenges they face. Through our Express Care, Crisis Care, and Outpatient Progressions programs, we meet people where they are, delivering immediate and inclusive support that lifts up individuals and families. We believe that every team member, whether providing direct care or supporting behind the scenes, is essential to making this mission real every single day.

Environmental Services Technician – Healthcare Janitorial Services
📍 Location: Mesa, AZ | 📆 Schedule: 4/10s (Wednesday-Saturday, 5:00PM - 3:30AM)
💰 Competitive Pay + Full Benefits

Mind 24-7 is transforming the way behavioral health care is delivered by offering walk-in, 24/7 access to mental health services for youth and adults. Our model supports individuals in crisis, urgent care needs, and short-term medication stabilization. We operate high-acuity environments where cleanliness, safety, and compassion are critical to healing.

As an Environmental Services Technician (EVS Tech) at Mind 24-7, you’ll play a vital role in creating a clean, safe, and healing space for patients, staff, and visitors!

Why Choose MIND 24-7?

✅ 24/7 innovative, collaborative healthcare environment
✅ Opportunities for growth in a mission-driven organization
✅ Full benefits: medical, dental, vision, PTO, and 401(k)
✅ Make a daily impact by maintaining a safe and healing space for patients

Your Role & Impact

🧹 Perform routine cleaning duties including sweeping, mopping, disinfecting furniture, and sanitizing high-touch areas
🗑️ Empty trash receptacles in patient and staff areas following behavioral health safety protocols
🚿 Clean recliners, windows, tables, and restrooms to maintain a safe and sanitary environment
📦 Replenish janitorial supplies and restock paper products as needed
🍽️ Support patient nutrition by organizing snacks, heating meals, and logging refrigerator/freezer temperatures
🧼 Sanitize countertops, sinks, and dispose of expired food in nutrition areas
📞 Respond to emergency cleanup requests and support staff via walkie-talkie communication
🌿 Conduct daily exterior walkthroughs to maintain a clean facility appearance
🧍‍♂️ Interact professionally with patients, staff, and visitors, contributing to a positive healing environment
📋 Follow all OSHA, ADHS, and CARF standards for safety and compliance

What We’re Looking For

✔️ High School Diploma or GED (required)
✔️ Valid Arizona Driver’s License (required)
✔️ Level 1 Fingerprint Clearance Card or ability to obtain
✔️ Experience in environmental services, janitorial work, or healthcare cleaning preferred
✔️ Ability to safely use cleaning chemicals and disinfectants
✔️ Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and perform physical tasks for extended periods
✔️ Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently

Join a team that’s redefining mental health care—where your role in keeping our environment safe and clean directly supports recovery and compassion. Apply today to start making an impact!

To support you in this essential work, we offer a benefits package grounded in empathy, including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. We provide a 401(k) plan with company contributions and accrued paid time off to ensure you have the space to rest and recharge. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that diversity makes us stronger and we are committed to creating a culture where you can be your authentic self and truly belong. If you are ready to take ownership of your impact and help us do great things, we invite you to apply today

jobs.title: BestDrive Georgia Zone Store Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

BestDrive is seeking a Georgia Zone Store Manager to coach and support the five Store Managers in Doraville, Cartersville, Forest Park, Marietta, and Valdosta. The five Store Managers report directly to the Georgia Zone Store Manager and have a dotted-line reporting relationship to Allan Cieniuch, National Operations Manager. The Georgia Zone Store Manager reports directly to Allan Cieniuch. This Atlanta-area, field-based role requires extensive, recurring travel across the five Georgia locations. Overnight travel may be required

What You'll Do

Store Operations & Leadership Support

• Meet regularly with each Store Manager to review priorities, set clear expectations, and follow up on commitments and performance.

• Help Store Managers resolve issues with staffing, scheduling, dispatch, shop workflow, service quality, and customer escalations.

• Help Store Managers coordinate the sharing of service trucks, qualified technicians, specialty casings, and new tire inventory across locations to meet customer demand.

• Provide on-site support during management vacancies and help maintain service continuity.

• Assess staffing, training, workflow, equipment, and service readiness needs.

• Help Store Managers develop and carry out plans to stabilize operations when staffing or service issues arise.

• Hold Store Managers accountable for store performance and agreed actions. Escalate unresolved issues and resource needs to the National Operations Manager.

• Support successful transitions to permanent store leadership.

Sales & Financial Performance Support

• Review store P&L and performance trends with Store Managers, including revenue, gross margin, labor costs, expenses, and inventory. Help managers identify corrective actions and follow up on progress.

• Support Store Managers and sales leadership in retaining and growing commercial accounts and aligning service capacity with customer commitments.

Training & Employee Development

• Deliver operational training and coaching to Store Managers, Service Leads, Technicians, and other operational employees.

• Help Store Managers identify skill gaps and develop training plans for their teams.

• Train teams on operational processes, inventory controls, workflow management, equipment use, and company systems.

• Monitor training effectiveness and document employee progress.

• Partner with Safety and other functional teams to reinforce compliance and operational excellence.

Recruiting & Onboarding Support:

• Partner with HR, recruiting, and store leaders to identify staffing needs and prioritize openings.

• Participate in candidate interviews and operational assessments.

• Support Store Managers with onboarding so new hires have system access, equipment, safety orientation, and role-specific training. Follow up with managers on onboarding progress.

• Help identify and address retention and development opportunities.

Operational Improvement:

• Use store visits and performance reports to identify recurring problems such as service delays, overtime, inventory shortages, and equipment downtime.

• Reinforce company operating procedures and best practices.

• Monitor store readiness, service quality, staffing levels, and training completion.

• Help Store Managers set improvement priorities, track results, and report progress and recommendations to the National Operations Manager.

What We're Looking For

• At least three years of experience directly managing a commercial tire location.

• Experience reviewing store P&L and using performance reports to guide decisions about sales, margin, labor, and expenses.

• Proven success developing, coaching, and training employees.

• Multi-location commercial tire or fleet service leadership experience preferred.

• Strong problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.

• Working knowledge of heavy-duty commercial tire service, dispatch, inventory control, and fleet and equipment readiness.

• Strong commitment to safety, accountability, and operational excellence.

• Valid driver’s license, ability to meet BestDrive driving requirements, and availability for extensive travel across Georgia.

Work Environment & Expectations

• Exposure to varying weather conditions, noise, heavy equipment, and moving vehicles
• Regular interaction with fleet customers, technicians, and delivery vehicles
• Flexible scheduling required, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and on-call service support as business needs require
• Strong emphasis on safety, compliance, attendance, and operational accountability

Physical Requirements

• Ability to occasionally lift 150+ lbs
• Ability to occasionally push or pull 200+ lbs
• Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, and work in a physically demanding environment

THE PERKS -

• Immediate Benefits
• Paid Time Off
• Employee Discounts, including tire discounts
• Employer 401(k) Match
• Diverse & Inclusive Work Environment
• Employee Assistance Program
• Future Growth Opportunities
• And more benefits that come with working for a global industry leader!

Why This Role Matters

You’ll give Georgia Store Managers a consistent point of support for solving problems, developing their teams, and following through on performance commitments.If you are a hands-on leader who enjoys developing people, solving operational challenges, and driving results in the field, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of BestDrive operations.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Category Management, Meetings, Events & Travel
jobs.description:
The Associate Director, Category Management – Meetings, Events & Travel role will serve as the global procurement leader for one of AbbVie’s most dynamic and highly visible spend categories, shaping how the organization plans, sources and delivers meetings, events and business travel across the enterprise. This leader will help shape the future of Meetings, Events & Travel at AbbVie, balancing experience, compliance, efficiency and enterprise value while positioning Procurement as a strategic partner in how AbbVie connects its people, customers and stakeholders around the world. This leader will partner with VP-level business or functional stakeholder(s) to develop global procurement strategies, contributing to a cross-functional team that informs strategy through analysis, market expertise, and understanding of broader business objectives. This role builds an annual strategic plan and leads a team of managers to achieve ambitious performance targets aligned with organizational goals.

Core Responsibilities:

• Lead a team of category management professionals who are transforming the category through stronger global governance, strategic supplier management, demand and cost optimization, technology and data transparency, and consistent sourcing and contracting standards
• Build comprehensive long-range category strategies with a focus on advancing AbbVie’s strategic meetings management capabilities, including preferred supplier networks, global meeting policies and processes, travel optimization, supplier performance and innovative solutions that improve the attendee experience while delivering measurable financial and operational value
• Partner with VP-level business or functional stakeholders to develop global procurement strategies for an individual procurement category, acting as a Business Partner where necessary.
• Contribute to a cross-functional team that informs strategic decision-making by leveraging market intelligence, staying abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and market dynamics.
• Define and develop strategic value drivers with key category suppliers to secure collaborative partnerships that challenge the status quo to achieve cost savings, optimize processes, and enhance overall procurement value.
• Integrate sustainability and environmental, social, and governance (ESG) measures into category strategies, collaborating with suppliers to enhance sustainable and responsible sourcing practices.
• Lead Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) strategies, driving innovation with key category suppliers and collaborating to enact creative and cutting-edge solutions that deliver on long-term business needs.
• Develop and activate mitigation strategies to proactively define and manage procurement risk across the relevant category, ensuring compliance.
• Ensure effective project management from initiation to completion, directing and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver strategic category-related projects. Identify opportunities for process optimization and efficiency gains, leveraging data analytics to develop long-term continuous improvement programs that achieve strategic objectives.
• Drive the end-to-end procurement process from sourcing strategy to contract negotiation and execution, leading negotiations with key category suppliers and strengthening decisions with strong analytical insight and strategic perspective.
• Lead & coach a team of Managers, setting ambitious performance targets, providing tailored coaching, and evaluating team performance. Assist in planning to address skillsets, workforce requirements, capability needs, and long-term organizational staffing goals.

• Proven experience building and executing global Meetings & Events or Travel category strategies, leveraging spend analytics, demand management, supplier optimization, sourcing, technology and governance to improve cost, compliance, operational efficiency and stakeholder experience.
• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Mgmt or related field. Master’s degree is preferred
• Minimum of 10 years of experience in procurement, supply chain, or related business or operations function.
• Previous experience leading category teams, partnering with major suppliers, and reporting to senior leaders.
• Strong proficiency in developing high-impact executive-level deliverables.
• Knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry is strongly preferred.
• Comprehensive expertise in category management, including market analysis, cost and financial assessment, ensuring strategic and informed procurement decisions. Fluency in negotiation and bidding, adept in overseeing complex projects with a focus on effective change management.
• Strong capabilities in internal stakeholder management and influence, aligning procurement strategies with business needs and fostering collaborative supplier relationships.
• Strategic thinking and accountability, anticipating future trends, and taking responsibility for impactful procurement outcomes that challenge the status quo.
• Innovative problem-solving skills combined with a significant executive presence, enabling creative solutions and influential communication at all organizational levels. High cross-functional leadership abilities, conflict resolution skills, effectively navigating & harmonizing diverse team dynamics.

jobs.title: Superintendent - Mechanical, Principal
jobs.location: Project Based | Various U.S. Locations (Travel Required
jobs.description:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

BUILT DIFFERENT

We believe there's a better way to build. One that moves faster, thinks bigger, and gives people the ownership to challenge what's been done before. We're not here to follow the standard. We're here to set a new one. We don't believe the best work happens inside rigid boxes. People are given real ownership, real responsibility, and the space to operate beyond a title. Scope grows with impact. Responsibility grows with trust. And the people who step up help shape what comes next. We're building an organization around ownership, not hierarchy, where your influence is defined by what you take on, not what's written on your email signature.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Superintendent, Mechanical leads mechanical and cooling systems field execution for a new data center build, owning day-to-day site operations for this scope in a high-stakes, mission-critical environment. Reporting to the Construction Manager and Director, Construction, this role drives schedule, coordinates mechanical trade partners, and enforces safety and quality from mobilization through turnover. Superintendents are the standard on a Hut 8 site: what you walk past, you approve.

Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:

Mechanical & Cooling Systems

Supervise installation of chilled water plants, air and liquid cooling systems, CRAHs, CDUs, heat exchangers, pumps, piping, valves, and insulation. Ensure mechanical systems are installed in accordance with design specifications, manufacturer requirements, and project quality standards.

Piping, Testing & System Cleanliness

Oversee hydronic piping installation, pressure testing, pipe flushing, chemical treatment, and system cleanliness protocols. Enforce strict quality standards for critical cooling loops, ensuring systems are ready for commissioning without contamination or installation deficiencies.

Trade Coordination & Sequencing

Own mechanical trade sequencing and manpower coordination across mechanical rooms, equipment yards, white space, and utility areas. Coordinate closely with electrical, plumbing, and controls teams to manage installation interfaces, resolve field conflicts, and maintain construction progress. Leverage BIM-supported coordination to identify and resolve clashes before installation.

Commissioning Handoff

Drive completion of mechanical installation checklists, equipment startup requirements, testing, adjusting, and balancing (TAB), and prerequisites supporting Level 1-3 commissioning. Support commissioning execution through Levels 4-5 alongside the CXQC Field Manager, ensuring mechanical systems are ready for integrated testing and turnover.

Safety & Quality Enforcement

Enforce mechanical construction safety standards, including rigging and lifting operations, hot work, confined space entry, pressure testing, and LOTO procedures. Hold mechanical trade partners accountable for first-time quality, documented inspections, and compliance with project specifications.

Planning, Documentation & Issues

Own the mechanical three-week look-ahead, daily coordination, manpower planning, and progress reporting. Drive mechanical RFIs and field issues to closure with the Project Engineer and discipline engineers. Maintain accurate QC records, test documentation, equipment startup reports, and as-built drawings.

ABOUT YOU

What we’re looking for:

• 3+ years supervising mechanical construction trades on data center, semiconductor, hospital, or heavy industrial projects; mission-critical experience strongly preferred.

• Strong technical knowledge of chilled water plants, HVAC systems, liquid cooling infrastructure, CRAHs, CDUs, pumps, heat exchangers, and hydronic piping systems.

• Experience overseeing mechanical equipment installation, system startup, pressure testing, pipe flushing, hydronic balancing, and cleanliness requirements.

• Experience supporting Level 1-5 commissioning activities, including mechanical system readiness, functional testing, and turnover documentation.

• Strong trade-sequencing instincts in congested, schedule-critical environments; fluent in look-ahead planning and manpower loading.

• Proven safety leadership across mechanical construction activities, including rigging, hot work, LOTO, and pressure testing; OSHA 30 preferred.

• Ability to interpret mechanical drawings, P&IDs, equipment submittals, and coordinated BIM models.

• Comfortable with Procore/ACC, BIM field use, and mechanical construction documentation.

• Clear documentation habits, including daily reports, QC inspections, test

jobs.title: Customer Support Agent - (Ukrainian Speaking) (Bench Team)
jobs.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Customer Support Agent with fluency in Ukrainian to join our Bench Team. In this individual-contributor role, you’ll provide fast, accurate, and personalized support to customers through research, investigation, troubleshooting, and effective resolution.

You’ll work within a fast-paced, structured support environment where clear communication, critical thinking, and consistent performance are essential. Your goal will be to resolve customer needs efficiently while meeting client expectations for service, quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction.

What You'll Do

• Deliver high-quality customer service by following established departmental policies, processes, and support standards.

• Manage and respond to customer-support tickets within established service-level agreements, client standards, and performance guidelines.

• Focus on accurate and efficient first-contact resolution whenever possible.

• Follow established troubleshooting procedures and use approved resources, knowledge documentation, and desktop tools to diagnose and resolve customer issues.

• Work across multiple tools, systems, knowledge bases, and communication channels while applying available information to individual customer situations.

• Assist with creating and updating knowledge-base articles.

• Contribute to team development through active collaboration, knowledge sharing, and issue resolution.

• Coordinate with internal teams to provide feedback, identify trends, report recurring concerns, and resolve customer issues.

• Research and resolve escalated issues within the approved scope of the role.

• Serve as a point of escalation for customer inquiries when assigned.

• Monitor client-facing communication tools, including Mattermost, and remain current on client updates and directives.

• Respond to customer requests escalated by Tier 2 agents and address customer needs, complaints, and account-related concerns.

• Use critical thinking and sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps and support positive outcomes for the client and customer.

• Support managers with onboarding new and existing agents into the Escalated Accounts workflow when assigned.

• Demonstrate Blueprint’s values through daily interactions with customers, clients, and colleagues.

• Provide support across additional ticket queues based on business needs.

• Support additional customer-experience initiatives and projects as assigned.

What You'll Bring

• At least one year of customer-service experience or equivalent relevant experience.

• Associate degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Written fluency in English and Ukrainian.

• Strong written communication skills and the ability to provide clear, accurate, and professional customer responses.

• Experience using computers and working across multiple systems and support tools.

• Ability to perform initial troubleshooting of common computer and network issues.

• Ability to remain composed and professional when handling stressful or complex customer situations.

• Strong customer focus and a genuine interest in helping people resolve problems.

• Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and customer-service skills.

• Strong attention to detail and time-management skills.

• Ability to meet deadlines, client productivity standards, and service expectations.

• Strong critical-thinking, research, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to receive, apply, and grow from constructive feedback.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office or related productivity software.

• Ability to work independently, use sound judgment, and seek guidance when appropriate.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree.

• Knowledge of or interest in online gaming.

• Experience working with account-related support tickets.

• Ability to troubleshoot account-related ticket issues independently and collaboratively.

• Experience working with ticketing systems or customer-support platforms.

Schedule and Work Requirements

This role may require scheduled coverage during weekends and holidays based on business and customer-support needs.

Work schedules may change based on operational requirements.

Time-off availability may be limited during peak business periods to maintain appropriate customer coverage.

Compensation

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated compensation range is $23.00 to $25.50 USD per hour. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications.

Location and Work Arrangement

Bellevue, Washington

This is a hybrid role that generally requires two days per week in the Bellevue office, with additional flexibility based on Blueprint’s work-from-home policy and business needs.

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• 401(k) retirement plan

• Competitive paid time off

• Parental leave

• Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicant Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.
